lemmas.def_en: find or declare guilty
lemmas.def_zh: v. 宣判……有罪；证明……有错

examples.en: He was convicted of armed robbery last year.
examples.zh: 他去年被判犯有持械抢劫罪。

lemmas.def_en: an unshakable belief in something without need for proof or evidence
lemmas.def_zh: n. 定罪；深信，坚定的信念

examples.en: She spoke with absolute conviction on the issue.
examples.zh: 在这个问题上，她充满绝对的信念发言。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 con-（完全）+ vict（战胜、征服），法理上指“完全击败对方的反驳，定罪”。
family_guide.core_distinction: convict动词重音在后，表示宣判有罪；conviction名词重音在第三音节，兼指定罪或坚定的信念。

lemmas.def_en: make believe with the intent to deceive
lemmas.def_zh: v. 假装；伪称；自称

examples.en: He pretended not to hear the phone ringing.
examples.zh: 他假装没听见电话响。

lemmas.def_zh: 借口, 虚假, 伪装
lemmas.def_en: the act of giving a false appearance

examples.en: He dropped all pretense of friendship once he got the promotion he wanted.
examples.zh: 一旦得到了想要的晋升，他就放下了所有友善的伪装。

lemmas.def_en: a claimant to the throne or to the office of ruler (usually without just title)
lemmas.def_zh: 冒牌者, 妄想者, 觊觎王位者

examples.en: The king quickly banished the pretender who claimed rights to the throne.
examples.zh: 国王迅速流放了那个声称拥有王位继承权的觊觎者。

lemmas.def_zh: 假装, 虚伪, 借口, 自称, 要求
lemmas.def_en: a false or unsupportable quality
a false or unsupportable quality
lemmas.def_zh: 自负, 骄傲, 主张

examples.en: His humble attitude was refreshing in an industry often filled with pretension.
examples.zh: 在普遍充满自命不凡的行业中，他的谦逊态度令人耳目一新。

lemmas.def_zh: 自负, 做作, 狂妄, 自命不凡
lemmas.def_en: lack of elegance as a consequence of being pompous and puffed up with vanity

lemmas.def_zh: 自负的, 自命不凡的, 夸耀的
lemmas.def_en: making claim to or creating an appearance of (often undeserved) importance or distinction

examples.en: a pretentious country house
a pretentious fraud

lemmas.def_zh: 不铺张的, 不炫耀的, 不装模作样的, 不招摇的, 谦逊的, 质朴的
lemmas.def_en: lacking pretension or affectation

examples.en: an unpretentious country church
her quiet unpretentious demeanor

lemmas.def_zh: 狂妄自大地
lemmas.def_en: in a pretentious manner

examples.en: this author writes pretentiously

lemmas.def_zh: 不炫耀地, 不招摇地, 不装腔作势地
lemmas.def_en: in an unpretentious manner

examples.en: she was unpretentiously dressed even though she was the guest of honor

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 pre-（向前）+ tend（伸展、展出），原义为“在前方展示假象”，引申为“假装”。

lemmas.def_en: traverse or travel on (a body of water)
lemmas.def_zh: v. 航行；起航；飘过

examples.en: The ship will sail for New York tomorrow morning.
examples.zh: 这艘轮船将于明早起航开往纽约。

lemmas.def_en: the work of a sailor
lemmas.def_zh: n. 帆船运动；航海；（轮船）班次

examples.en: They go sailing around the Greek islands every summer.
examples.zh: 他们每年夏天都在希腊群岛一带进行帆船航行。

lemmas.def_en: any member of a ship's crew
lemmas.def_zh: n. 水手；海员

examples.en: The old sailor told tales of treacherous ocean storms.
examples.zh: 老水手讲述了危险洋面风暴的传说。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自日耳曼语，核心含义为“帆”，引申为“操帆航行”。
family_guide.core_distinction: sailing多指帆船运动或航海活动，sailor指航海人员（水手、海员）。

lemmas.def_en: the emotion of great happiness
lemmas.def_zh: 欢喜, 乐事, 高兴

examples.en: A newborn baby brought immense joy and laughter to the entire household.
examples.zh: 新生儿的降生给整个家庭带来了巨大的喜悦与欢笑。

lemmas.def_en: the emotion of great happiness
lemmas.def_zh: 快乐;快活;高兴

examples.en: The festival was marked by the spontaneous joyousness of the dancing crowd.
examples.zh: 这个节日的特点是跳舞人群所展现出的自发欢乐。

lemmas.def_en: feel happiness or joy
lemmas.def_zh: 使快乐, 令人高兴；欢喜

examples.en: A newborn baby brought immense joy and laughter to the entire household.
examples.zh: 新生儿的降生给整个家庭带来了巨大的喜悦与欢笑。

lemmas.def_en: full of or characterized by joy
lemmas.def_zh: 快乐的, 高兴的

examples.en: They celebrated their wedding anniversary with a joyous gathering of close friends.
examples.zh: 他们举办了一场亲朋好友欢聚的派对来庆祝结婚纪念日。

lemmas.def_en: in a joyous and gleeful manner
lemmas.def_zh: 快乐地

examples.en: The children ran joyously across the green lawn under the warm sun.
examples.zh: 孩子们在温暖的阳光下快乐地穿过绿色的草坪。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古法语 joie，最终来自拉丁语 gaudere（欢喜），指深层的欣喜与快乐。

lemmas.def_en: a raised mark on the skin (as produced by the blow of a whip); characteristic of many allergic reactions
lemmas.def_zh: n. 鞭痕；（灯芯绒等的）凸条纹；护舷木

examples.en: This corduroy jacket has a fine wale.
examples.zh: 这件灯芯绒夹克有着细密的凸条纹。

family_guide.root_logic: 本义为“由鞭笞打出的隆起伤痕”，引申指织物表面凸起的条纹。

lemmas.def_en: any broad thin expanse or surface
lemmas.def_zh: 床单, 张, 纸张, 印刷品, 裹尸布, 薄片

examples.en: She took a blank sheet of paper and began writing her thoughts.
examples.zh: 她拿出一张白纸，开始写下自己的想法。

lemmas.def_en: come down as if in sheets
lemmas.def_zh: 盖上被单, 遍布；大片落下

examples.en: She took a blank sheet of paper and began writing her thoughts.
examples.zh: 她拿出一张白纸，开始写下自己的想法。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 sciete，指“宽阔平展的一片事物”，如薄片、床单、纸张。

lemmas.def_en: sell or transfer abroad
lemmas.def_zh: 出口，输出

examples.en: The country exports vast quantities of olive oil across the globe.
examples.zh: 该国向全球出口大量橄榄油。

lemmas.def_en: a businessperson who transports goods abroad (for sale)
lemmas.def_zh: 出口商, 输出者, 出口公司

examples.en: The country has become a leading exporter of electronic goods in Asia.
examples.zh: 该国已成为亚洲领先的电子产品出口国。

lemmas.def_en: commodities (goods or services) sold to a foreign country
lemmas.def_zh: 输出, 出口物, 输出品, 出口

examples.en: New regulations were introduced to restrict the illegal exportation of rare antiquities.
examples.zh: 出台了新规定以限制珍贵文物的非法出口。

family_guide.root_logic: ex-（向外）+ port（运送），引申为向境外输出货物或数据。

lemmas.def_en: meet the requirements or expectations of
lemmas.def_zh: 使满意，满足（需求、条件）

examples.en: The proposed contract failed to satisfy the union's demands.
examples.zh: 拟定的合同未能满足工会的要求。

lemmas.def_en: giving satisfaction
lemmas.def_zh: 令人满意的；符合要求的

examples.en: The student made satisfactory progress throughout the semester.
examples.zh: 这名学生在整个学期中都取得了令人满意的进步。

lemmas.def_en: not giving satisfaction
lemmas.def_zh: 不令人满意的

examples.en: The committee rejected the proposal because the safety standards were deemed completely unsatisfactory.
examples.zh: 委员会驳回了该提案，因为其安全标准被认为完全不能令人满意。

lemmas.def_en: not having been satisfied
lemmas.def_zh: 未得到满足的, 不满意的

examples.en: Several customers remained unsatisfied with the response from the support team.
examples.zh: 几位顾客对客服团队给出的回应仍然感到不满意。

lemmas.def_en: not up to expectations
lemmas.def_zh: 无法令人满足的

examples.en: The thriller ended abruptly, leaving the audience with an unsatisfying mystery.
examples.zh: 这部惊悚片戛然而止，给观众留下了一个无法释怀的谜团。

lemmas.def_en: in a satisfactory manner
lemmas.def_zh: 令人满意地

examples.en: All safety tests were completed satisfactorily before the new car was officially launched.
examples.zh: 新车正式上市前，所有安全测试均已圆满完成。

lemmas.def_en: in a gratifying manner
lemmas.def_zh: 使人满意地

examples.en: The heavy oak door closed satisfyingly with a solid and reassuring click.
examples.zh: 厚重的橡木门严实地关上了，发出令人安心的清脆咔哒声。

lemmas.def_en: in an unsatisfactory manner
lemmas.def_zh: 不能令人满意地

examples.en: The complaint was resolved unsatisfactorily, leaving the customer feeling ignored and angry.
examples.zh: 投诉未得到令人满意的解决，让顾客感到被忽视且十分愤怒。

lemmas.def_en: the contentment one feels when one has fulfilled a desire, need, or expectation
lemmas.def_zh: 满意；满足；称心

examples.en: Customer satisfaction remains the top priority for our support team.
examples.zh: 客户满意度始终是我们支持团队的首要任务。

lemmas.def_en: the quality of being inadequate or unsuitable
lemmas.def_zh: unsatisfactory的变形

examples.en: The unsatisfactoriness of the current system forced the management to design a replacement.
examples.zh: 现行系统的不足之处迫使管理层设计新的替代方案。

family_guide.root_logic: satis-（足够）+ -fy（使……），核心意为“使满足、达到要求”。

lemmas.def_en: the act of punishing
lemmas.def_zh: 惩罚，罚金，点球/受罚

examples.en: There is a stiff penalty for breaking the non-disclosure agreement.
examples.zh: 违反保密协议将面临严厉的惩罚。

lemmas.def_zh: [法] 处罚, 惩罚
lemmas.def_en: the act of punishing

lemmas.def_zh: 处刑, 对...处罚(刑), 使不利
lemmas.def_en: impose a penalty on; inflict punishment on

examples.en: The referee decided to penalize the defender for an aggressive sliding tackle.
examples.zh: 裁判决定对防守队员的激进铲球进行判罚。

lemmas.def_zh: 对...处以刑罚/刑事惩罚, 惩罚, 处罚, 使处于严重不利地位
lemmas.def_en: impose a penalty on; inflict punishment on

examples.en: The students were penalized for showing up late for class
we had to punish the dog for soiling the floor again

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 poena（惩罚、痛苦），核心指对违规、违纪或违法行为的处罚。

lemmas.def_en: a message received and understood
lemmas.def_zh: 信息，情报（非正式）

examples.en: Check the official website for further info on the event.
examples.zh: 查看官方网站以获取该活动的进一步信息。

family_guide.root_logic: information的口语/非正式截短形式，直接指代“信息、情报”。

lemmas.def_en: a state of high honor
lemmas.def_zh: 光荣，荣耀；辉煌

examples.en: The team fought bravely to restore their former glory.
examples.zh: 球队英勇奋战，以重塑往日的辉煌。

lemmas.def_zh: 美化了的东西
lemmas.def_en: a state of high honor

examples.en: Critics argued that the violent film relied on the unnecessary glorification of crime.
examples.zh: 影评人认为这部暴力电影过度美化了犯罪行为。

lemmas.def_en: having or deserving or conferring glory
lemmas.def_zh: 光荣的，辉煌的；壮丽的

examples.en: We spent a glorious afternoon walking along the coastline.
examples.zh: 我们沿着海岸线散步，度过了一个美好的下午。

lemmas.def_en: rejoice proudly
lemmas.def_zh: 光荣，荣耀；辉煌

examples.en: The team fought bravely to restore their former glory.
examples.zh: 球队英勇奋战，以重塑往日的辉煌。

lemmas.def_en: praise, glorify, or honor
lemmas.def_zh: 赞美, 美化, 赞扬, 使辉煌

examples.en: The director refused to glorify gang violence in his gritty new movie.
examples.zh: 导演拒绝在他这部硬朗的新电影中去美化帮派暴力。

lemmas.def_en: with glory or in a glorious manner
lemmas.def_zh: 辉煌地；光荣地；壮观地, 壮丽地

examples.en: The autumn leaves glowed gloriously under the gentle afternoon sun.
examples.zh: 秋天的落叶在午后柔和的阳光下绚烂耀眼。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 gloria（赞誉、光荣），核心意象为耀眼的光芒与崇高的声誉。

lemmas.def_en: cause to burst with a violent release of energy
lemmas.def_zh: 爆炸，爆发；激增

examples.en: The fire caused the gas tank to explode violently.
examples.zh: 火灾导致煤气罐发生剧烈爆炸。

lemmas.def_en: a violent release of energy caused by a chemical or nuclear reaction
lemmas.def_zh: 爆炸；激增，爆发

examples.en: The city experienced an explosion of technological innovation.
examples.zh: 该城市经历了技术创新的爆发式增长。

lemmas.def_en: still capable of exploding or being fired
lemmas.def_zh: 未爆炸的,未发射的,装着炸药的

examples.en: Bomb disposal experts carefully neutralized an unexploded shell from the war.
examples.zh: 排爆专家小心翼翼地拆除了战争时期遗留的一枚未爆炸弹。

family_guide.root_logic: ex-（出）+ plaudere（鼓掌），原指起哄将演员轰下台，后引申为伴随巨大声响向外爆发或炸裂。
family_guide.core_distinction: explode 为动词；explosion 为其派生的名词形式，强调爆发动作或爆炸事件本身。

lemmas.def_en: heal or recover
lemmas.def_zh: （使）治愈，愈合；调解

examples.en: Time will eventually heal the sorrow of losing a loved one.
examples.zh: 时间最终会抚平失去至亲的悲痛。

lemmas.def_en: the natural process by which the body repairs itself
lemmas.def_zh: 康复，治愈过程；疗愈

examples.en: Laughter is known to play a vital role in emotional healing.
examples.zh: 众所周知，欢笑在情绪疗愈中起着至关重要的作用。

lemmas.def_en: a person skilled in a particular type of therapy
lemmas.def_zh: 医治者, 治疗物

examples.en: Villagers trusted the traditional healer more than the distant city doctors.
examples.zh: 比起遥远的城里医生，村民们更信任传统的医治者。

lemmas.def_en: not healed
lemmas.def_zh: 未治愈的

examples.en: The deep cut remained unhealed after weeks of neglecting proper care.
examples.zh: 由于数周缺乏妥善护理，那道深深的伤口仍未愈合。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 hælan（使完整、健壮），核心为创伤、疾病或裂痕的修复与痊愈。
family_guide.core_distinction: heal 为动词；healing 可作名词表示康复过程或治疗作用。

lemmas.def_en: a resident of modern Rome
lemmas.def_zh: 古罗马人；罗马字体（正体字）

examples.en: Headings in the document are printed in bold roman.
examples.zh: 文档中的标题使用粗体正体字印刷。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古罗马地名 Roma，专指与古罗马帝国或现代罗马城相关的文化、文字或人。

lemmas.def_en: the act of beginning something new
lemmas.def_zh: 初次登台，首秀

examples.en: The young pianist made her critically acclaimed debut at Carnegie Hall.
examples.zh: 这位年轻的钢琴家在卡内基音乐厅完成备受赞誉的首演。

lemmas.def_en: present for the first time to the public
lemmas.def_zh: 初次登台，首秀

examples.en: The young pianist made her critically acclaimed debut at Carnegie Hall.
examples.zh: 这位年轻的钢琴家在卡内基音乐厅完成备受赞誉的首演。

family_guide.root_logic: 借自法语 début（首盘击球），引申为个人或作品在公众场合的“初次亮相”。

lemmas.def_en: a small fragment of something broken off from the whole
lemmas.def_zh: 碎片；芯片；炸薯条

examples.en: Modern cars rely heavily on microchip technology for navigation.
examples.zh: 现代汽车在导航方面高度依赖微芯片技术。

lemmas.def_en: break off (a piece from a whole)
lemmas.def_zh: 碎片；芯片；炸薯条

examples.en: Modern cars rely heavily on microchip technology for navigation.
examples.zh: 现代汽车在导航方面高度依赖微芯片技术。

family_guide.root_logic: 拟声兼象形，本义为砍、削下的小碎片，后延伸至集成电路芯片及动作切削。

lemmas.def_en: be greater in scope or size than some standard
lemmas.def_zh: 超过，超出（限度）

examples.en: Drivers who exceed the speed limit will face heavy fines.
examples.zh: 超速驾驶者将面临巨额罚款。

lemmas.def_en: beyond normal limits
lemmas.def_zh: 过度的，过分的

examples.en: Excessive intake of sugar is linked to multiple health issues.
examples.zh: 摄入过多糖分与多种健康问题密切相关。

lemmas.def_en: to an extreme degree
lemmas.def_zh: 极端地, 极度地, 非常

examples.en: Finding parking downtown on a Saturday night proved to be exceedingly difficult.
examples.zh: 事实证明，周六晚上在市中心找停车位极其困难。

lemmas.def_en: to a degree exceeding normal or proper limits
lemmas.def_zh: 过多, 极度, 过度, 过分

examples.en: Drinking excessively before a long flight will only lead to extreme dehydration.
examples.zh: 长途飞行前过度饮水只会导致极度脱水。

lemmas.def_en: (geology) the probability that an earthquake will generate a level of ground motion that exceeds a specified reference level during a given exposure time
lemmas.def_zh: [统计] 超过数

examples.en: The factory faced heavy fines for the repeated exceedance of emission limits.
examples.zh: 该工厂因屡次超出排放限值而面临巨额罚款。

lemmas.def_en: immoderation as a consequence of going beyond sufficient or permitted limits
lemmas.def_zh: 冗余

examples.en: The judge criticized the excessiveness of the legal fees charged by lawyers.
examples.zh: 法官批评了律师所收取的过高诉讼费用。

family_guide.root_logic: ex-（超出）+ ceed（走），本义为“走到……之外”，引申为数量、限制或能力的超越。
family_guide.core_distinction: exceed 为动词动作；excessive 为形容词，侧重“过度的、过分的”，含消极偏离常规之意。

lemmas.def_en: a stringed instrument usually having six strings; played by strumming or plucking
lemmas.def_zh: 吉他

examples.en: He tuned his acoustic guitar before taking the stage.
examples.zh: 上台前，他为自己的原声吉他调了音。

lemmas.def_en: a musician who plays the guitar
lemmas.def_zh: 吉他手

examples.en: The lead guitarist performed a breathtaking solo during the concert.
examples.zh: 主音吉他手在音乐会上表演了一段令人惊叹的独奏。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自西班牙语 guitarra，经由希腊语 kithara 演变而来，指一种弹拨弦乐器。

lemmas.def_en: work together on a common enterprise of project
lemmas.def_zh: 合作，协作；配合

examples.en: Both departments must cooperate fully to deliver the project on time.
examples.zh: 两个部门必须全力合作，才能按时交付该项目。

lemmas.def_en: joint operation or action
lemmas.def_zh: 合作，协作

examples.en: Economic cooperation between the two nations has reached a new high.
examples.zh: 两国间的经济合作达到了新高度。

lemmas.def_en: a jointly owned commercial enterprise (usually organized by farmers or consumers) that produces and distributes goods and services and is run for the benefit of its owners
lemmas.def_zh: 合作社，合作组织

examples.en: The local farmers formed a cooperative to market their organic produce.
examples.zh: 当地农户成立了一家合作社来推广销售他们的有机农产品。

lemmas.def_en: an associate in an activity or endeavor or sphere of common interest
lemmas.def_zh: 合作社社员, 合作者

examples.en: She proved to be a reliable cooperator during the entire joint project.
examples.zh: 在整个合作项目中，她证明了自己是一位可靠的合作者。

lemmas.def_en: the trait of being cooperative
lemmas.def_zh: [经] 协调, 合作

examples.en: The manager praised the team's cooperativeness during the difficult merger process.
examples.zh: 经理称赞了团队在困难的合并过程中展现出的合作精神。

lemmas.def_en: unwilling to cooperate
lemmas.def_zh: 不合作的, 不配合的, 执拗的

examples.en: The witness remained uncooperative despite hours of questioning by the detectives.
examples.zh: 尽管侦探询问了几个小时，那名证人仍然不予配合。

lemmas.def_en: in close cooperation
lemmas.def_zh: 合作地

examples.en: Both departments worked cooperatively to finish the annual budget ahead of schedule.
examples.zh: 两个部门通力合作，提前完成了年度预算。

family_guide.root_logic: co-（共同）+ operate（工作、运作），核心逻辑为“协力同心，共同完成工作”。
family_guide.core_distinction: cooperate 为动词；cooperation 为名词抽象概念；cooperative 作名词指具体的“合作组织/合作社”。

lemmas.def_en: a toothed wheel that engages another toothed mechanism in order to change the speed or direction of transmitted motion
lemmas.def_zh: 齿轮；传动装置；装备

examples.en: Don't forget to pack your waterproof gear for the hiking trip.
examples.zh: 徒步旅行时别忘了带上你的防水装备。

lemmas.def_en: set the level or character of
lemmas.def_zh: 齿轮；传动装置；装备

examples.en: Don't forget to pack your waterproof gear for the hiking trip.
examples.zh: 徒步旅行时别忘了带上你的防水装备。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古诺尔斯语 gervi（装备、准备好），从齿轮机械装置延伸到成套的工具、行装及调整状态。

lemmas.def_en: not thin; of a specific thickness or of relatively great extent from one surface to the opposite usually in the smallest of the three solid dimensions
lemmas.def_zh: adj. 厚的，粗的；浓的

examples.en: The forest was covered in a thick layer of snow.
examples.zh: 森林被一层厚厚的雪覆盖着。

lemmas.def_en: the dimension through an object as opposed to its length or width
lemmas.def_zh: n. 厚度；浓度

examples.en: Measure the thickness of the board before cutting it.
examples.zh: 切割之前先量一下木板的厚度。

lemmas.def_en: spoken with poor articulation as if with a thick tongue
lemmas.def_zh: 厚地；浓地

examples.en: The freshly baked bread was thickly spread with homemade strawberry jam.
examples.zh: 刚烤好的面包上厚厚地抹了一层自制草莓酱。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 thicce，核心表“密度大、深度大或维度粗”，引申指浓密的、厚的或迟钝的。

lemmas.def_en: burn superficially or lightly
lemmas.def_zh: v. 烧焦，烤焦（表面）

examples.en: The heat from the fire was enough to singe his eyebrows.
examples.zh: 火堆的热气足以烤焦他的眉毛。

lemmas.def_en: deliver by singing
lemmas.def_zh: v. 唱歌，鸣叫

examples.en: Birds sing outside my window every morning.
examples.zh: 每天清晨鸟儿都在我窗外鸣唱。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 sengan（使烤焦），原为 sing 的致使形式，核心语义为“轻微灼烧”。注意 sing（唱歌）词源不同，属于同形异源词。
family_guide.core_distinction: singe 指浅表微烧，而 sing 指发出有音调的歌声。

lemmas.def_en: work together on a common enterprise of project
lemmas.def_zh: v. 合作，协作；通敌

examples.en: Researchers from both universities decided to collaborate on the project.
examples.zh: 两所大学的研究人员决定在该项目上展开合作。

lemmas.def_en: act of working jointly
lemmas.def_zh: n. 合作，协作；合作成果

examples.en: The exhibition was the result of a successful collaboration between artists.
examples.zh: 这次展览是艺术家们成功合作的结晶。

lemmas.def_en: someone who assists in a plot
lemmas.def_zh: 合干者, 合作者, 通敌者

examples.en: She thanked her long-time collaborator for helping complete the scientific study.
examples.zh: 她感谢了长期的合作伙伴帮助完成这项科学研究。

lemmas.def_en: someone who collaborates with an enemy occupying force
lemmas.def_zh: 通敌者

examples.en: During the occupation, he was condemned as a traitorous collaborationist.
examples.zh: 在沦陷期间，他被谴责为一个卖国的通敌者。

lemmas.def_en: accomplished by collaboration
lemmas.def_zh: adj. 合作的，协作的

examples.en: The team fosters a collaborative learning environment.
examples.zh: 该团队营造了一个协作性的学习环境。

family_guide.root_logic: 由前缀 col-（共同）与 labor（劳动、工作）结合而成，核心语义为“共同工作、合作”。
family_guide.core_distinction: collaboration 是合作的名词形态，collaborative 则是形容具有合作性质的形容词。

lemmas.def_en: propose as a candidate for some honor
lemmas.def_zh: v. 提名，任命

examples.en: They plan to nominate her for the position of chairperson.
examples.zh: 他们计划提名她担任主席职务。

lemmas.def_en: the act of officially naming a candidate
lemmas.def_zh: n. 提名，任命

examples.en: The film received five Academy Award nominations.
examples.zh: 这部电影获得了五项奥斯卡奖提名。

lemmas.def_en: the category of nouns serving as the grammatical subject of a verb
lemmas.def_zh: 主格, 主格语

examples.en: In this Latin sentence, the pronoun must be in the nominative.
examples.zh: 在这个拉丁语句子中，代词必须使用主格。

lemmas.def_en: someone who proposes a candidate for appointment or election
lemmas.def_zh: 提名者, 任命者

examples.en: The committee kept the identity of the award nominator strictly confidential.
examples.zh: 委员会对该奖项提名者的身份严格保密。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 nomen（名字），字面意为“按名字指定、提名”。
family_guide.core_distinction: nominate 强调提名的动作，nomination 指提名的行为或提名资格。

lemmas.def_en: liquid excretory product
lemmas.def_zh: n. 尿；撒尿 /

examples.en: He had to stop at the service station for a quick piss.
examples.zh: 他不得不停在服务区去撒个尿。

lemmas.def_en: a person who urinates
lemmas.def_zh: 小便的人, (美)(非正式)难事, 艰苦的活儿, (美)(非正式)淘气男孩

examples.en: Losing the championship in the final minute was a real pisser.
examples.zh: 在最后一分钟痛失冠军真是件让人懊恼的倒霉事。

lemmas.def_en: eliminate urine
lemmas.def_zh: v. 撒尿；激怒（常与 off 连用）

examples.en: He had to stop at the service station for a quick piss.
examples.zh: 他不得不停在服务区去撒个尿。

family_guide.root_logic: 拟声词，模拟排尿的声音，常用于俚语和非正式表达。

lemmas.def_en: transfer to another
lemmas.def_zh: v. 传输，传播；传导（光、热）

examples.en: The disease can be transmitted through contaminated water.
examples.zh: 该疾病可以通过受污染的水传播。

lemmas.def_en: the act of sending a message; causing a message to be transmitted
lemmas.def_zh: n. 播送；传输；传染；变速器

examples.en: Live transmission of the concert will begin at eight.
examples.zh: 音乐会的现场直播将于八点开始。

lemmas.def_zh: 传送者, 传达人, (疾病的)传播者
lemmas.def_en: someone who transmits a message

examples.en: Engineers replaced the faulty radio transmitter to restore clear communication with the ship.
examples.zh: 工程师更换了故障的无线电发射机，以恢复与船只的清晰通信。

lemmas.def_zh: [计] 传输的
lemmas.def_en: the act of sending a message; causing a message to be transmitted

examples.en: Please sign the attached form to confirm the safe transmittal of confidential data.
examples.zh: 请在附表上签字，以确认机密数据的安全传输。

lemmas.def_zh: 能递送的, 可传递的, 可传达的
lemmas.def_en: (of disease) capable of being transmitted by infection

examples.en: The new virus strain is highly transmissible through respiratory droplets.
examples.zh: 这种新病毒株极易通过呼吸道飞沫传播。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 trans-（横过、穿过）+ mittere（发送），核心义为“跨越距离传送或传导”。
family_guide.core_distinction: transmit 强调发射、播送或传染的动作，transmission 指传递的过程、信号传输或汽车变速箱。

lemmas.def_en: increase
lemmas.def_zh: v. 提高，促进，增强 /

examples.en: The tax cut is intended to boost consumer spending.
examples.zh: 减税旨在刺激消费者支出。

lemmas.def_en: the act of giving hope or support to someone
lemmas.def_zh: n. 提高，激励

examples.en: The tax cut is intended to boost consumer spending.
examples.zh: 减税旨在刺激消费者支出。

lemmas.def_en: a person who backs a politician or a team etc.
lemmas.def_zh: n. 支持者；升压器；疫苗加强针；助推火箭

examples.en: Health officials urged adults to get a booster shot this winter.
examples.zh: 卫生官员敦促成年人在今年冬天接种加强针。

family_guide.root_logic: 来源未明，可能源自方言或拟声，核心语义为“从下方推起、向上推举”，引申为提升、增强。
family_guide.core_distinction: boost 兼作动词和抽象的名词提振，booster 常指具体起到推动、增强作用的人、物或辅助发动机/加强针。

lemmas.def_en: a room (as in a residence) containing a bathtub or shower and usually a washbasin and toilet
lemmas.def_zh: n. 浴室，盥洗室；卫生间

examples.en: Excuse me, could you tell me where the bathroom is?
examples.zh: 打扰一下，能告诉我洗手间在哪里吗？

family_guide.root_logic: 复合词 bath（洗澡）+ room（房间），原指放置浴缸的房间，现泛指带盥洗或如厕设施的卫生间。

lemmas.def_en: on or to one side
lemmas.def_zh: adv. 在旁边，到一边 /

examples.en: He stepped aside to allow the doctor to pass.
examples.zh: 他退到一旁，让医生走过去。

lemmas.def_en: a line spoken by an actor to the audience but not intended for others on the stage
lemmas.def_zh: n. 旁白；离题话

examples.en: He stepped aside to allow the doctor to pass.
examples.zh: 他退到一旁，让医生走过去。

family_guide.root_logic: 由 a-（在……方向）+ side（旁边）构成，本义为“在一旁、靠边”。
family_guide.core_distinction: 副词 aside 表动作方向（留出、撇开），名词 aside 专指戏剧中的旁白或随口插话。

lemmas.def_en: footwear that covers the whole foot and lower leg
lemmas.def_zh: n. 靴子；汽车后备箱 /

examples.en: Press the power button to boot up the system.
examples.zh: 按下电源按钮以启动系统。

lemmas.def_en: kick; give a boot to
lemmas.def_zh: v. 猛踢；启动（计算机）

examples.en: Press the power button to boot up the system.
examples.zh: 按下电源按钮以启动系统。

lemmas.def_en: unproductive of success
lemmas.def_zh: 无用的, 无益的

examples.en: Arguing with the stubborn referee proved to be a bootless effort.
examples.zh: 事实证明，与固执的裁判争执是徒劳无功的。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古法语 bote（靴子），由皮靴护足意象引申至汽车后备箱、踢击以及计算机的“自举引导（bootstrap）”。

lemmas.def_en: an artifact designed to be played with
lemmas.def_zh: n. 玩具，玩物 /

examples.en: He sat at his desk, toying with a pen while thinking.
examples.zh: 他坐在桌前，一边思考一边摆弄着一支笔。

lemmas.def_en: behave carelessly or indifferently
lemmas.def_zh: v. 漫不经心地考虑；摆弄

examples.en: He sat at his desk, toying with a pen while thinking.
examples.zh: 他坐在桌前，一边思考一边摆弄着一支笔。

family_guide.root_logic: 中古英语起源，最初指小玩意、风情举止，后专指供玩耍的“玩具”，动词化后表示轻率玩弄或漫不经心对待。

lemmas.def_en: a person who is confined; especially a prisoner of war
lemmas.def_zh: n. 囚犯，犯人；战俘

examples.en: The guards escorted the prisoner back to his cell.
examples.zh: 警卫押送这名囚犯回到了牢房。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自 prison（监狱）加表示人的后缀 -er，意指“被关押在监狱中的人”。

lemmas.def_en: a story about mythical or supernatural beings or events
lemmas.def_zh: n. 传说，传奇；传奇人物；图例

examples.en: According to ancient legend, the dragon guarded the sacred jewel.
examples.zh: 根据古老的传说，神龙守护着那颗圣石。

lemmas.def_en: so celebrated as to having taken on the nature of a legend
lemmas.def_zh: 传奇的；传说中的

examples.en: The legendary singer gave her final performance last night.
examples.zh: 这位传奇歌手昨晚进行了她的最后一场演出。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自中世纪拉丁语 legenda（本义为“应当被阅读的事物”，多指圣徒传记），后演变出“传说”与“传奇人物”之义。

lemmas.def_en: a solid food prepared from the pressed curd of milk
lemmas.def_zh: n. 奶酪，干酪 /

examples.en: This pasta dish tastes best with freshly grated cheese.
examples.zh: 这道意面配上现磨的奶酪味道最好。

lemmas.def_en: used in the imperative (get away, or stop it)
lemmas.def_zh: v. [俚]停止；使恼怒

examples.en: This pasta dish tastes best with freshly grated cheese.
examples.zh: 这道意面配上现磨的奶酪味道最好。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 cēse（乳酪）；俚语动词 cheese（如 cheese it 意为停止、快跑，或 cheesed off 意为恼火）源自近代街头黑话。

lemmas.def_en: a long thin piece of cloth or paper as used for binding or fastening
lemmas.def_zh: 带子, 录音带, 磁带, 窄带, 卷尺

examples.en: He used strong adhesive tape to seal the cardboard delivery box.
examples.zh: 他用强力胶带封好了硬纸板快递盒。

lemmas.def_en: a recording made on magnetic tape
lemmas.def_zh: 磁带录音

examples.en: The studio audience fell silent as the taping of the show began.
examples.zh: 节目开始录制时，演播室的观众安静了下来。

lemmas.def_en: cut a female screw thread with a tap
lemmas.def_zh: 轻打, 轻敲, 敲打出, 选择, 装上嘴子, 使流出, 开发, 分接, 向...乞讨；轻叩, 轻拍, 啪塔啪塔地走

examples.en: She reached out to tap his shoulder to get his attention.
examples.zh: 她伸手轻敲他的肩膀以引起他的注意。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语，核心意象为“细长条状物”，后引申为磁带、胶带及用胶带固定或录音等行为。
family_guide.core_distinction: tape指胶带或磁带本身；taping常指用胶带包扎固定或录音录像的过程。

lemmas.def_en: be compatible, similar or consistent; coincide in their characteristics
lemmas.def_zh: 符合, 通信, 相当

examples.en: The numbers on the invoice do not correspond with our records.
examples.zh: 发票上的数字与我们的记录不相符。

lemmas.def_en: someone who communicates by means of letters
lemmas.def_zh: 通讯记者, 通信者

examples.en: The foreign correspondent reported live from the center of the conflict.
examples.zh: 驻外记者从冲突中心发回了现场报道。

lemmas.def_en: communication by the exchange of letters
lemmas.def_zh: 相符, 通信, 信件

examples.en: He kept up a regular correspondence with his former college professor.
examples.zh: 他与以前的大学教授一直保持着定期通信。

lemmas.def_en: in a corresponding manner
lemmas.def_zh: 相应地, 相对地

examples.en: As consumer demand increased, the production costs rose correspondingly high.
examples.zh: 随着消费者需求的增加，生产成本也相应上升。

lemmas.def_zh: adj. 相应的；符合的；相关的
lemmas.def_en: matching, related, or connected to something else
lemmas.usage_note: 常修饰名词以表达对应或伴随关系，如 corresponding period / increase / page。

examples.en: Sales went up, but there was no corresponding increase in profits.
examples.zh: 销售额上升了，但利润却没有出现相应的增长。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 cor-（共同）+ respond（回应），核心语义为“双方互相应答”，引申为符合、对应与通信。
family_guide.core_distinction: correspondence通常指通信行为或信件总称，也指对应关系；correspondent特指驻外或特派记者，或通信者。

lemmas.def_en: a lightweight cord
lemmas.def_zh: 线, 细绳, 一串, 字符串

examples.en: She tied a piece of red string around the parcel securely.
examples.zh: 她用一根红细绳把包裹牢牢地系紧。

lemmas.def_zh: 纵梁, 楼梯基, 上弦工人, 出售弓弦的人, 制造弓弦的人
lemmas.def_en: a member of a squad on a team

examples.en: The newspaper hired an experienced local stringer to cover the unfolding crisis.
examples.zh: 该报社聘请了一位经验丰富的本地特约记者报道这场危机。

lemmas.def_en: thread on or as if on a string
lemmas.def_zh: 串起, 成串, 收紧, 缚, 扎；成一串

examples.en: She tied a piece of red string around the parcel securely.
examples.zh: 她用一根红细绳把包裹牢牢地系紧。

lemmas.def_en: thread on or as if on a string
lemmas.def_zh: string的过去式和过去分词

examples.en: They strung colorful festival lights across the entire length of the street.
examples.zh: 他们把五彩斑斓的节日彩灯串联挂满了整条街道。

lemmas.def_en: remove the strings from
lemmas.def_zh: unstring的过去式和过去分词

examples.en: The archer carefully unstrung his wooden bow after finishing his daily practice.
examples.zh: 弓箭手在完成日常练习后小心翼翼地卸下了木弓的弦。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自日耳曼语，核心语义为“细绳、拉紧的线”，引申为乐器的弦、一连串事物及串联动作。

lemmas.def_en: a very short time (as the time it takes the eye to blink or the heart to beat)
lemmas.def_zh: 立即, 瞬间

examples.en: For a brief instant, she thought she recognized the passing stranger.
examples.zh: 有那么一瞬间，她以为自己认出了走过的陌生人。

lemmas.def_en: occurring with no delay
lemmas.def_zh: 紧急的, 立即的, 即时的

examples.en: For a brief instant, she thought she recognized the passing stranger.
examples.zh: 有那么一瞬间，她以为自己认出了走过的陌生人。

lemmas.def_zh: 即时的, 瞬间的, 猝发的
lemmas.def_en: occurring with no delay

examples.en: The new fiber-optic network provides an almost instantaneous connection to the internet.
examples.zh: 新型光纤网络提供了几乎瞬时的互联网连接。

lemmas.def_en: without delay or hesitation; with no time intervening
lemmas.def_zh: 立即地, 即刻地

examples.en: The medicine took effect, and his severe headache disappeared almost instantly.
examples.zh: 药物起效了，他的剧烈头痛几乎立刻消失了。

lemmas.def_zh: 即刻, 立即
lemmas.def_en: without any delay

examples.en: he was killed outright

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 in-（在……上）+ stant（站立/临近），原指“迫在眉睫的”，引申为极短的一瞬间及即时的。
family_guide.core_distinction: instant作名词强调极短的时间节点；作形容词强调无需等待、立即发生的或方便速食的。

lemmas.def_en: being actually such in almost every respect
lemmas.def_zh: 实际上起作用的, 虚的, 实质的, 有效的, 事实上生效的

examples.en: The sudden train strike caused a virtual standstill across the entire city.
examples.zh: 突如其来的火车罢工几乎使整座城市陷入瘫痪。

lemmas.def_en: in essence or effect but not in fact
lemmas.def_zh: 事实上

examples.en: The project was virtually impossible to complete within the tight deadline.
examples.zh: 在紧迫的截止日期内完成该项目几乎是不可能的。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自 virtue（潜能、内在力量），原指“虽无其实但有其效”，现代引申为实质上的及计算机生成的虚拟概念。
family_guide.core_distinction: virtual形容接近实质或非物理的数字化实体；virtually强调“几乎、实际上”的副词修饰。

lemmas.def_en: polished surface that forms images by reflecting light
lemmas.def_zh: 镜子, 写真, 典范

examples.en: She paused in front of the mirror to adjust her coat.
examples.zh: 她在镜子前停下脚步整理外套。

lemmas.def_en: reflect as if in a mirror
lemmas.def_zh: 反映, 映出

examples.en: She paused in front of the mirror to adjust her coat.
examples.zh: 她在镜子前停下脚步整理外套。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 mirari（惊奇地观看），原指观照自我的反光器具，引申为反映、映照与模仿。

lemmas.def_en: an abundant nonmetallic tetravalent element occurring in three allotropic forms: amorphous carbon and graphite and diamond; occurs in all organic compounds
lemmas.def_zh: 碳, 副本, 复写纸

examples.en: Reducing our carbon emissions is crucial to combating global warming effectively.
examples.zh: 减少碳排放对有效应对全球变暖至关重要。

lemmas.def_en: a salt or ester of carbonic acid (containing the anion CO3)
lemmas.def_zh: 碳酸盐

examples.en: The geologists discovered a large deposit of calcium carbonate in the cave.
examples.zh: 地质学家在洞穴中发现了大量碳酸钙沉积物。

lemmas.def_en: saturation with carbon dioxide (as soda water)
lemmas.def_zh: 二氧化碳饱和, 碳化作用

examples.en: This machine allows you to adjust the level of carbonation easily.
examples.zh: 这台机器可以让你轻松调节碳酸化程度。

lemmas.def_en: the destructive distillation of coal (as in coke ovens)
lemmas.def_zh: 碳化(作用)

examples.en: High temperatures accelerate the carbonization of organic matter in the soil.
examples.zh: 高温加速了土壤中有机物的碳化过程。

lemmas.def_en: turn into a carbonate
lemmas.def_zh: 使碳酸盐化, 使充满二氧化碳

examples.en: The geologists discovered a large deposit of calcium carbonate in the cave.
examples.zh: 地质学家在洞穴中发现了大量碳酸钙沉积物。

lemmas.def_en: unite with carbon
lemmas.def_zh: 使焦化, 使碳化, 使与碳化合

examples.en: The intense heat began to carbonize the wood within a few minutes.
examples.zh: 强烈的热量在几分钟内就开始使木头碳化。

lemmas.def_en: relating to or consisting of or yielding carbon
lemmas.def_zh: 碳的, 由碳得到的

examples.en: Carbonic acid forms when carbon dioxide dissolves in natural water sources.
examples.zh: 当二氧化碳溶解在天然水源中时，便会形成碳酸。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 carbo（煤炭、木炭），指构成有机物基础的化学元素碳，现代常与环保、碳排放相关。

lemmas.def_en: declare to be true or admit the existence or reality or truth of
lemmas.def_zh: 承认, 告知收悉, 答谢, 报偿

examples.en: He refused to acknowledge his mistake despite overwhelming evidence against him.
examples.zh: 尽管有确凿的证据，他仍拒绝承认错误。

lemmas.def_en: the state or quality of being recognized or acknowledged
lemmas.def_zh: 承认, 确认, 感谢, 收到的通知

examples.en: She sent a quick email as an acknowledgement of the receipt.
examples.zh: 她发了一封简短的电子邮件确认收货。

lemmas.def_en: the state or quality of being recognized or acknowledged
lemmas.def_zh: 承认, 答谢, 认可, 谢礼, 收到的通知, 收到的回音, 谢意

examples.en: His hard work finally received the public acknowledgment that it deserved.
examples.zh: 他的辛勤付出终于得到了应有的公众认可。

lemmas.def_en: not recognized or admitted
lemmas.def_zh: 未被承认的, 未被公认的, 未答复的

examples.en: Her vital contribution to the project went largely unacknowledged by management.
examples.zh: 她对该项目的重大贡献在很大程度上未得到管理层的认可。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 ac-（加强）+ knowledge（知晓），核心语义为“正式向对方表明已知”，引申为承认、确认收到与感谢。

lemmas.def_en: living in or characteristic of farming or country life
lemmas.def_zh: 乡下的, 田园的, 乡村风味的

examples.en: Many young professionals are moving from big cities to rural areas.
examples.zh: 许多年轻的专业人士正从大城市搬迁到乡村地区。

lemmas.def_en: in a rural manner
lemmas.def_zh: 乡下地；农村风味地

examples.en: Families living rurally often have limited access to high-speed internet.
examples.zh: 生活在农村的家庭通常难以享受高速互联网。

lemmas.def_en: a rural characteristic or trait
lemmas.def_zh: 田园风味, 田园生活, 田园风光

examples.en: The quiet charm of the town's rurality attracted many summer tourists.
examples.zh: 该镇宁静的乡村风情吸引了许多夏季游客。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 rus（乡村、田野），与城市（urban）相对，专指田园或乡村风貌的。

lemmas.def_en: relating to or bordering the Pacific Ocean
lemmas.def_zh: 太平洋的, 太平洋沿岸的, 爱好和平的, 安静的, 平息的

examples.en: The two rival nations managed to maintain pacific relations for decades.
examples.zh: 这两个敌对国家数十年来设法保持着和平关系。

lemmas.def_en: in a peaceable manner
lemmas.def_zh: 和平地

examples.en: The community leaders worked hard to resolve the territorial dispute pacifically.
examples.zh: 社区领袖们努力以和平方式解决领土争端。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 pax（和平）+ -fic（使产生），原指“制造和平的、温和的”，大写时特指南美航海家命名的太平洋。

lemmas.def_en: a metal frame or container holding cartridges; can be inserted into an automatic gun
lemmas.def_zh: 修剪, 夹子, 回形针, 剪下来的东西

examples.en: She used a metal paper clip to keep the loose sheets together.
examples.zh: 她用一个金属回形针把散乱的纸张夹在一起。

lemmas.def_en: an excerpt cut from a newspaper or magazine
lemmas.def_zh: 剪断, 剪裁, 剪下物, 剪报

examples.en: He kept an old newspaper clipping about his grandfather's historic flight.
examples.zh: 他保留着一张关于祖父历史性飞行的旧剪报。

lemmas.def_en: (electronics) a nonlinear electronic circuit whose output is limited in amplitude; used to limit the instantaneous amplitude of a waveform (to clip off the peaks of a waveform)
lemmas.def_zh: 大剪刀

examples.en: He grabbed a hedge clipper from the shed to trim the bushes.
examples.zh: 他从棚子里拿了一把树篱修剪剪刀来修剪灌木丛。

lemmas.def_en: sever or remove by pinching or snipping
lemmas.def_zh: 修剪, 痛打, 夹牢, 剪报；剪报

examples.en: She used a metal paper clip to keep the loose sheets together.
examples.zh: 她用一个金属回形针把散乱的纸张夹在一起。

lemmas.def_en: remove the clip from
lemmas.def_zh: [网络] 快挂脱开；大叫；发音播放

examples.en: Please unclip your safety harness before trying to exit the ride.
examples.zh: 在尝试离开游乐设施之前，请解开安全带搭扣。

lemmas.def_en: not clipped
lemmas.def_zh: 未剪(短)的

examples.en: The garden looked messy because the unclipped hedges grew wild and tall.
examples.zh: 由于未经修剪的树篱肆意疯长，花园显得杂乱无章。

family_guide.root_logic: 具有双重词源：一指“修剪、夹断”，一指“夹住、抱紧”，两意共存衍生为剪切与夹子相关语义。
family_guide.core_distinction: clip作名词常指夹子或截取的片段；clipping特指从报刊上剪下的一小段文字或插图剪报。

lemmas.def_en: a succession of notes forming a distinctive sequence
lemmas.def_zh: 歌曲, 主旋律, 心情, 声调, 和谐, 一致, 语调, 程度

examples.en: The catchy tune played on the radio all afternoon.
examples.zh: 电台整个下午都在播放那首朗朗上口的曲子。

lemmas.def_en: (music) calibrating something (an instrument or electronic circuit) to a standard frequency
lemmas.def_zh: 调音, 调谐, 协调

examples.en: Accurate tuning of the violin took several minutes before the concert.
examples.zh: 音乐会前，小提琴的精准调音花了几分钟。

lemmas.def_en: someone who tunes pianos
lemmas.def_zh: 调音师, 调音的人, 调节器

examples.en: The piano tuner adjusted the tension of every single string.
examples.zh: 钢琴调音师调整了每一根琴弦的张力。

lemmas.def_en: adjust for (better) functioning
lemmas.def_zh: 为...调音, 调整, 调谐, 使一致；协调, 调谐

examples.en: The catchy tune played on the radio all afternoon.
examples.zh: 电台整个下午都在播放那首朗朗上口的曲子。

lemmas.def_en: cause to lose one's composure
lemmas.def_zh: 使走调, 使不和谐； 使紊乱, 扰乱

examples.en: Humidity and sudden temperature shifts can easily untune the instrument.
examples.zh: 湿度和骤变的气温极易让乐器走调。

lemmas.def_en: having a musical sound; especially a pleasing tune
lemmas.def_zh: 和谐的, 音调优美的

examples.en: Birds filled the quiet morning air with tuneful melodies.
examples.zh: 鸟儿悦耳的鸣叫声充满了宁静的清晨。

lemmas.def_en: not having a musical sound or pleasing tune
lemmas.def_zh: 不和谐的, 不成调子的

examples.en: He whistled a tuneless noise while working in the garage.
examples.zh: 他在车库干活时吹出不成调的哨声。

lemmas.def_en: in a melodious manner
lemmas.def_zh: 声音悦耳地; 和谐地

examples.en: The choir sang tunefully together throughout the entire performance.
examples.zh: 整个演出过程中，合唱团的声音始终和谐优美。

lemmas.def_en: in a tuneless fashion
lemmas.def_zh: 不入调地；不悦耳地

examples.en: She hummed tunelessly while scrubbing the kitchen floor.
examples.zh: 她一边擦厨房地板，一边哼着不成调的声音。

family_guide.root_logic: 由 tone（音调）派生而来，核心指音乐声调的高低与和谐，引申为调整频道、状态使之和谐。
family_guide.core_distinction: tune指曲调或调谐动作；tuning侧重调谐、校准的过程或所达到的调音状态。

lemmas.def_en: a grouping of a number of similar things
lemmas.def_zh: 串, 束

examples.en: He bought a fresh bunch of grapes at the farmers' market.
examples.zh: 他在农贸市场买了一串新鲜葡萄。

lemmas.def_en: form into a bunch
lemmas.def_zh: [医] 骨肿块(马)

examples.en: He bought a fresh bunch of grapes at the farmers' market.
examples.zh: 他在农贸市场买了一串新鲜葡萄。

lemmas.def_en: occurring close together in bunches or clusters
lemmas.def_zh: 成串的, 束状的

examples.en: The thick fabric created a bunchy silhouette around her waist.
examples.zh: 厚重的面料在她腰部堆叠出臃肿的轮廓。

family_guide.root_logic: 可能源自拟声词或日耳曼语，核心意象为“隆起、聚拢的一团”，引申为一束、一堆或聚拢动作。

lemmas.def_en: fall or descend to a lower place or level
lemmas.def_zh: 下沉, 沉没, 下陷, 减弱, 衰退, 消沉, 堕落, 渗透；使低落, 使下沉, 陷于, 投入(资金等), 挖掘

examples.en: Heavy rocks sink to the bottom of the lake immediately.
examples.zh: 沉重的石头会立即沉入湖底。

lemmas.def_en: fall or descend to a lower place or level
lemmas.def_zh: sink的过去式和过去分词

examples.en: The submarine had sunk deep beneath the icy ocean waves.
examples.zh: 潜艇已经沉入了冰冷的海浪深处。

lemmas.def_en: fall or descend to a lower place or level
lemmas.def_zh: sink的过去式

examples.en: The small wooden rowboat sank during the violent thunderstorm.
examples.zh: 那艘小木划艇在猛烈的雷雨中沉没了。

lemmas.def_en: fall or descend to a lower place or level
lemmas.def_zh: sink的过去分词

examples.en: Divers discovered a sunken treasure ship off the coast.
examples.zh: 潜水员在近海发现了一艘沉没的宝藏船。

lemmas.def_en: plumbing fixture consisting of a water basin fixed to a wall or floor and having a drainpipe
lemmas.def_zh: 藏垢的场所, 沟渠, 污水槽

examples.en: Heavy rocks sink to the bottom of the lake immediately.
examples.zh: 沉重的石头会立即沉入湖底。

lemmas.def_en: a small ring-shaped friedcake
lemmas.def_zh: 使下沉的人, 铅锤, 凿井工

examples.en: The fisherman tied a heavy lead sinker to the fishing line.
examples.zh: 渔夫在钓线上系了一个重铅锤。

lemmas.def_en: having a sunken area
lemmas.def_zh: 沉没的, 下凹的

examples.en: Divers discovered a sunken treasure ship off the coast.
examples.zh: 潜水员在近海发现了一艘沉没的宝藏船。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语，核心语义为“受重力作用向下坠落”，用于物质下沉、水槽器具或衰退。
family_guide.core_distinction: sank为一般过去式；sunk为过去分词；sunken为专职形容词，强调沉落已久或凹陷的状态。

lemmas.def_en: slow to learn or understand; lacking intellectual acuity; ; ; - Thackeray
lemmas.def_zh: 哑的, 不说话的, 无声音的

examples.en: Shock left him completely dumb for several long seconds.
examples.zh: 震惊让他足足好几秒钟说不出话来。

lemmas.def_en: the quality of being mentally slow and limited
lemmas.def_zh: 哑, 无言, 沉默

examples.en: Her temporary dumbness was caused by severe emotional shock.
examples.zh: 她暂时的失语是由严重的精神打击引起的。

lemmas.def_en: in a stupid manner
lemmas.def_zh: 默默地, 无言地

examples.en: He nodded dumbly, unable to comprehend the terrible news.
examples.zh: 他默默地点了点头，无法理解这个可怕的坏消息。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自日耳曼语，原指“无法说话、哑的”，现代口语中引申指“愚蠢的”或因震惊而说不出话的。

lemmas.def_en: search without warning, make a sudden surprise attack on
lemmas.def_zh: 奇袭, 搜捕

examples.en: Police officers planned to raid the warehouse at dawn.
examples.zh: 警察计划在黎明时突袭搜查那座仓库。

lemmas.def_en: a sudden short attack
lemmas.def_zh: 袭击, 突袭, 搜捕

examples.en: Police officers planned to raid the warehouse at dawn.
examples.zh: 警察计划在黎明时突袭搜查那座仓库。

lemmas.def_en: someone who takes spoils or plunder (as in war)
lemmas.def_zh: 奇袭者, 侵入者

examples.en: The masked raider escaped with jewels before the alarm sounded.
examples.zh: 蒙面劫匪在警报响起前带着珠宝逃跑了。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自苏格兰语，与 road 同源，原指“骑马进犯”，现引申为突袭、搜查或抢掠。

lemmas.def_en: the original amount of a debt on which interest is calculated
lemmas.def_zh: 校长, 首长, 本金, 主犯, 资本, 委托人

examples.en: The school principal welcomed the new students during the morning assembly.
examples.zh: 校长在早会上对新同学表示了欢迎。

lemmas.def_en: the post of principal
lemmas.def_zh: 首要的地位, 职务

examples.en: She was offered the principalship of the prestigious local high school.
examples.zh: 她获得了这所著名当地高中的校长职位。

lemmas.def_en: most important element
lemmas.def_zh: 主要的, 最重要的, 首要的

examples.en: The school principal welcomed the new students during the morning assembly.
examples.zh: 校长在早会上对新同学表示了欢迎。

lemmas.def_en: for the most part
lemmas.def_zh: 主要地, 大部分

examples.en: The charity organization is funded principally by private donations from citizens.
examples.zh: 该慈善机构主要由市民的私人捐款资助。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 principalis（第一的、主要的），指处于首要地位的人或事物。
family_guide.core_distinction: principal（主要的、校长、本金）易与 principle（原则、原理）混淆，后者仅作名词。

lemmas.def_en: an elected governmental council in a communist country (especially one that is a member of the Union of Soviet Socialist Republics)
lemmas.def_zh: 代表会议, 苏维埃, 苏联

examples.en: The old factory was built during the era of the Soviet Union.
examples.zh: 这家老工厂建于苏联时期。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自俄语 sovet，本义为“会议、委员会”，特指原苏联的各级代表会议及与该政权相关的事物。

lemmas.def_en: a contentious speech act; a dispute where there is strong disagreement
lemmas.def_zh: 论争, 辩论, 论战, 争论

examples.en: The mayor's new housing policy sparked huge controversy among local residents.
examples.zh: 市长的新住房政策在当地居民中引发了巨大争议。

lemmas.def_en: marked by or capable of arousing controversy
lemmas.def_zh: 争论的, 论争的, 被议论的

examples.en: The director decided to cut the controversial scene from the final movie.
examples.zh: 导演决定将这个有争议的镜头从最终电影中删掉。

lemmas.def_en: not likely to arouse controversy
lemmas.def_zh: 非争论性的；不会引起争论的

examples.en: The committee quickly passed the uncontroversial proposal without any major debate.
examples.zh: 委员会毫无重大争论地迅速通过了这项无争议的提议。

lemmas.def_en: not likely to arouse controversy
lemmas.def_zh: 无争议的

examples.en: They focused on noncontroversial issues to keep the meeting calm and productive.
examples.zh: 他们专注于没有争议的问题，以保持会议平稳且富有成效。

lemmas.def_en: involving controversy
lemmas.def_zh: 颇有争议地；引起争议地

examples.en: The referee controversially awarded a penalty in the final minute of the match.
examples.zh: 裁判在比赛最后一分钟极具争议地判罚了一个点球。

lemmas.def_en: not involving any controversy
lemmas.def_zh: [网络] 无争议地

examples.en: The experienced scientist was uncontroversially chosen to lead the new research project.
examples.zh: 这位经验丰富的科学家毫无争议地被选为新研究项目的负责人。

family_guide.root_logic: 词根 contro-（相反）+ vers-（转动），即“观点反向转向”，引申为公开的争辩与争议。

lemmas.def_en: close fighting during the culmination of a military attack
lemmas.def_zh: 攻击, 袭击

examples.en: The soldiers launched a surprise assault on the enemy fortress at dawn.
examples.zh: 士兵们在黎明时分对敌军要塞发动了突袭。

lemmas.def_en: someone who attacks
lemmas.def_zh: [法] 犯伤害罪者, 侵犯者, 殴人者

examples.en: Police are still searching for the assaulter who fled the crime scene.
examples.zh: 警方仍在搜捕逃离犯罪现场的袭击者。

lemmas.def_en: attack someone physically or emotionally
lemmas.def_zh: 袭击, 攻击；发动攻击

examples.en: The soldiers launched a surprise assault on the enemy fortress at dawn.
examples.zh: 士兵们在黎明时分对敌军要塞发动了突袭。

lemmas.def_en: disposed to attack
lemmas.def_zh: 攻击, 强击, 突击, 冲击, 袭击

examples.en: The security guards restrained the assaultive patron before anyone was seriously injured.
examples.zh: 保安在有人受重伤之前制服了那名具攻击性的顾客。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 ad-（向）+ saltus（跳跃），本义为“扑上去攻击”，引申为强烈的暴力袭击。

lemmas.def_en: an accidental hole that allows something (fluid or light etc.) to enter or escape
lemmas.def_zh: 漏洞, 漏处, 漏出, 泄漏

examples.en: A sudden pipe leak caused significant water damage in the basement.
examples.zh: 突然的水管泄漏导致地下室遭受严重的严重水损。

lemmas.def_en: the discharge of a fluid from some container
lemmas.def_zh: 漏, 漏出物, 泄漏

examples.en: Regular inspections help prevent the leakage of hazardous chemicals from the tanks.
examples.zh: 定期检查有助于防止储罐中危险化学品的泄漏。

lemmas.def_en: a surreptitious informant
lemmas.def_zh: [机] 漏水铸件, 漏箱

examples.en: Government officials are trying to identify the leaker of the confidential memo.
examples.zh: 政府官员正试图查明机密备忘录的泄密者。

lemmas.def_en: the condition of permitting leaks or leakage
lemmas.def_zh: 泄漏, 易泄漏秘密, 爱哭

examples.en: The leakiness of the old roof became obvious during the heavy downpour.
examples.zh: 暴雨期间，老屋顶的易漏水问题显露无遗。

lemmas.def_en: tell anonymously
lemmas.def_zh: 漏, 泄漏；使渗漏

examples.en: A sudden pipe leak caused significant water damage in the basement.
examples.zh: 突然的水管泄漏导致地下室遭受严重的严重水损。

lemmas.def_en: permitting the unwanted passage of fluids or gases
lemmas.def_zh: 有漏洞的, 易泄漏秘密的, 爱哭的

examples.en: He placed a plastic bucket under the leaky faucet to catch water.
examples.zh: 他在漏水的水龙头下放了一个塑料桶来接水。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自日耳曼语系，本义指流体从裂缝中滴落，引申为物质或信息的泄漏。

lemmas.def_en: operate like a pump; move up and down, like a handle or a pedal
lemmas.def_zh: 用唧筒抽水, 打气, 盘问, 倾注, 使疲惫；抽水, 上下(或往复)运动

examples.en: We used an electric pump to drain the flooded garage after rain.
examples.zh: 雨后我们用一台电动泵排干了被淹的车库。

lemmas.def_en: a mechanical device that moves fluid or gas by pressure or suction
lemmas.def_zh: 抽水机, 打气筒, 泵, 抽吸

examples.en: We used an electric pump to drain the flooded garage after rain.
examples.zh: 雨后我们用一台电动泵排干了被淹的车库。

family_guide.root_logic: 拟声词，模拟液体被压缩抽吸的声音，后扩展指用泵抽送或像泵一样持续注入。

lemmas.def_en: a major road for any form of motor transport
lemmas.def_zh: 公路, 大道, 捷径

examples.en: The new highway will significantly reduce travel time between the two cities.
examples.zh: 这条新公路将大幅缩短两座城市之间的通行时间。

family_guide.root_logic: high（高级的、主要的）+ way（道路），原指由罗马帝国建造的“筑高路面的大道”，后泛指公路干线。

lemmas.def_en: turn up, loosen, or remove earth
lemmas.def_zh: 挖, 翻土, 发掘；挖掘

examples.en: The children love to dig deep holes in the sand at the beach.
examples.zh: 孩子们喜欢在海滩的沙子里挖深坑。

lemmas.def_en: the act of digging
lemmas.def_zh: 挖掘

examples.en: The continuous digging near our house made a terrible noise all morning.
examples.zh: 我家附近持续的挖掘工作整整吵了一上午。

lemmas.def_en: an udder or breast or teat
lemmas.def_zh: （雌性哺乳动物的）乳房，乳头

examples.en: He dug a small trench in the garden to plant the new roses.
examples.zh: 他在花园里挖了一条小沟来种新玫瑰。

lemmas.def_en: a laborer who digs
lemmas.def_zh: 挖掘者

examples.en: The yellow mechanical digger quickly cleared away the heavy pile of rubble.
examples.zh: 那台黄色的挖掘机迅速清理了厚重的瓦砾堆。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语，核心动作是用工具翻土挖洞，引申为搜寻挖掘或（俚语）喜欢。

lemmas.def_en: move stealthily
lemmas.def_zh: 滑动, 滑倒, 失足, 溜走, 滑落, 犯错, 变坏；使滑动, 滑过, 摆脱, 闪开, 塞入, 从...取接枝

examples.en: Be careful not to slip on the wet tiles after taking a shower.
examples.zh: 洗完澡后要小心，别在湿瓷砖上滑倒。

lemmas.def_en: a socially awkward or tactless act
lemmas.def_zh: 滑, 滑行, 事故, 溜, 差错, 滑台, 下降, 插条, 后裔, 板条, 瘦长的年轻人

examples.en: Be careful not to slip on the wet tiles after taking a shower.
examples.zh: 洗完澡后要小心，别在湿瓷砖上滑倒。

lemmas.def_en: a decrease of transmitted power in a mechanical system caused by slipping
lemmas.def_zh: 滑移, 滑动, 滑程

examples.en: Any further slippage in the project schedule will increase our total costs significantly.
examples.zh: 项目进度的任何进一步推迟都会大幅增加总成本。

lemmas.def_en: causing or tending to cause things to slip or slide
lemmas.def_zh: 快的

examples.en: The mountain path becomes extremely slippy whenever it rains in the evening.
examples.zh: 每当傍晚下雨，山间小路就会变得非常湿滑。

lemmas.def_en: designed to reduce or prevent slipping
lemmas.def_zh: 不滑的

examples.en: We installed nonslip mats in the bathroom to protect the elderly residents.
examples.zh: 我们在浴室安装了防滑垫，以保护年长的住户。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自低地德语，核心语义为“无意滑移、悄悄溜走”，衍生出细长滑片纸条之意。

lemmas.def_en: of surpassing excellence
lemmas.def_zh: 光辉的, 灿烂的, 有才气的

examples.en: She came up with a brilliant idea that solved the entire marketing dilemma.
examples.zh: 她想出了一个绝妙的主意，解决了整个营销困境。

lemmas.def_en: with brightness
lemmas.def_zh: 辉煌地, 光亮地, 灿烂地

examples.en: The young pianist performed the complicated piece brilliantly, earning a standing ovation.
examples.zh: 那位年轻的钢琴家出色地演奏了这首复杂乐曲，赢得了全场起立鼓掌。

lemmas.def_zh: 卓越, 光辉
lemmas.def_en: a light within the field of vision that is brighter than the brightness to which the eyes are adapted

examples.en: Her musical brilliance was evident from the moment she first touched the piano.
examples.zh: 从她第一次触碰钢琴的那一刻起，她的音乐才华就展露无遗。

lemmas.def_en: a quality that outshines the usual
lemmas.def_zh: 光辉, 出色

examples.en: The stunning brilliancy of the diamond caught everyone's attention across the room.
examples.zh: 那颗钻石耀眼的光芒吸引了房间里所有人的注意。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自法语 briller（闪耀），词根意为“发光”，引申出耀眼的、极聪慧的及杰出的。

lemmas.def_en: an association of criminals
lemmas.def_zh: 队, 群, 帮

examples.en: A local street gang was caught by the police late last night.
examples.zh: 一个当地街头帮派昨晚深夜被警方抓获。

lemmas.def_en: a criminal who is a member of gang
lemmas.def_zh: n. 匪徒，黑帮分子

examples.en: The movie depicts the rise and fall of a notorious 1920s gangster.
examples.zh: 这部电影描绘了20世纪20年代一名臭名昭著的黑帮分子的崛起与覆灭。

lemmas.def_en: act as an organized group
lemmas.def_zh: 成群结队, 结成一伙；使成群结队

examples.en: A local street gang was caught by the police late last night.
examples.zh: 一个当地街头帮派昨晚深夜被警方抓获。

lemmas.def_en: tall and thin and having long slender limbs
lemmas.def_zh: 身材瘦长的

examples.en: The gangly teenager struggled to find jeans that were long enough for him.
examples.zh: 那个身材瘦高瘦长的少年很难买到足够长的牛仔裤。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语，本义为“一行人的行进”，后演变为聚集在一起的一帮人，多指黑帮或团伙。

lemmas.def_en: amounts paid for goods and services that may be currently tax deductible (as opposed to capital expenditures)
lemmas.def_zh: 费用, 代价, 开支, 损失

examples.en: The company agreed to cover all travel expenses for the upcoming conference.
examples.zh: 公司同意报销即将召开的会议产生的所有差旅费用。

lemmas.def_en: reduce the estimated value of something
lemmas.def_zh: [经] 费用, 开支, 将支出转为费用

examples.en: The company agreed to cover all travel expenses for the upcoming conference.
examples.zh: 公司同意报销即将召开的会议产生的所有差旅费用。

family_guide.root_logic: 词根 ex-（出）+ pend/pens（支付、花费），即“花出去的钱财”，引申为开销与代价。

lemmas.def_en: many and different
lemmas.def_zh: 不同的, 变化多的

examples.en: Our international team brings diverse perspectives and creative ideas to the project.
examples.zh: 我们的跨国团队为该项目带来了多元的视角和创造性的想法。

lemmas.def_zh: 没有变化的, 千篇一律的, 清一色的, 单一的
lemmas.def_en: not diversified
noticeable heterogeneity
lemmas.def_zh: 差异, 多样性

examples.en: Cultural diversity makes the city a much more vibrant place to live.
examples.zh: 文化的多样性让这座城市成为了一个更加充满生机的地方。

lemmas.def_zh: 变化, 多样化
lemmas.def_en: the act of introducing variety (especially in investments or in the variety of goods and services offered)

examples.en: Business diversification helped the company survive the sudden downturn in the tech sector.
examples.zh: 业务多元化帮助该公司在科技行业的突然衰退中生存下来。

lemmas.def_en: in diverse ways
lemmas.def_zh: 不同地, 各色各样地

examples.en: The scholarship fund was diversely allocated to students from various economic backgrounds.
examples.zh: 奖学金以多样化的方式分配给了来自不同经济背景的学生。

lemmas.def_zh: 使多样化, 使变化
lemmas.def_en: make (more) diverse

examples.en: Financial advisors urge young investors to diversify their portfolios to minimize market risk.
examples.zh: 财务顾问敦促年轻投资者实现投资组合多样化，以降低市场风险。

family_guide.root_logic: 词根 di-（分离）+ vers-（转向），字面意为“转向不同方向的”，引申出形形色色、多样的。

lemmas.def_en: set (printed matter) into a specific format
lemmas.def_zh: v. 格式化；编排格式

examples.en: You need to format the external hard drive before using it on this operating system.
examples.zh: 在这个操作系统上使用该外接硬盘之前，你需要先对其进行格式化。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 formatum（成型之物），现主要指设定版式或在计算机中初始化存储介质。

lemmas.def_en: a creature of Teutonic mythology; usually represented as breathing fire and having a reptilian body and sometimes wings
lemmas.def_zh: n. 龙；凶悍的人

examples.en: In Western mythology, the dragon often guards a hoard of treasure.
examples.zh: 在西方神话中，龙通常守护着一大堆财宝。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 drakon（蛇、巨兽，字面义为‘凝视者’），指神话中的龙或凶暴之人。

lemmas.def_en: the region that is inside of something
lemmas.def_zh: n. 内部；内陆；内政

examples.en: The interior of the cathedral was illuminated by soft candlelight.
examples.zh: 大教堂的内部被柔和的烛光照亮。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 inter（在……之间）的比较级形式，指空间或事物内部的。

lemmas.def_en: take something away by force or without the consent of the owner
lemmas.def_zh: v. 抢劫，盗取；剥夺

examples.en: Masked gunmen attempted to rob the local bank yesterday morning.
examples.zh: 昨天上午，蒙面枪手企图抢劫当地银行。

lemmas.def_en: larceny by threat of violence
lemmas.def_zh: 抢劫，盗窃案

examples.en: Police are investigating an armed robbery at the local bank.
examples.zh: 警方正在调查当地一家银行发生的持械抢劫案。

lemmas.def_en: a thief who steals from someone by threatening violence
lemmas.def_zh: 强盗, 盗贼

examples.en: The armed robber demanded cash from the bank teller and fled immediately.
examples.zh: 那名持械强盗向银行出纳员勒索现金后立即逃跑了。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自日耳曼语系词根，核心义为暴力抢夺、非法剥夺财物。

lemmas.def_en: put in effect
lemmas.def_zh: v. 完成，实现，达到

examples.en: She worked diligently to accomplish all her career goals before thirty.
examples.zh: 她勤勉工作，在三十岁之前实现了所有的职业目标。

lemmas.def_en: the action of accomplishing something
lemmas.def_zh: n. 成就，造诣；完成

examples.en: Graduating at the top of her class was a remarkable accomplishment.
examples.zh: 以全班第一名的成绩毕业是一项了不起的成就。

lemmas.def_en: capable of existing or taking place or proving true; possible to do
lemmas.def_zh: 可完成的；可达成的

examples.en: Breaking the massive project into smaller milestones makes it entirely accomplishable.
examples.zh: 将庞大的项目拆分为较小的里程碑能让它完全可达成。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 ad-（表强调）+ complere（装满、完成），引申为彻底实现目标或任务。

lemmas.def_en: one who works hard at boring tasks
lemmas.def_zh: n. 做苦工的人；雇佣文人

examples.en: Someone managed to hack into the government's official database.
examples.zh: 有人成功黑入了政府的官方数据库。

lemmas.def_en: someone who plays golf poorly
lemmas.def_zh: n. 电脑黑客；计算机发烧友

examples.en: The company hired a skilled hacker to test its network security.
examples.zh: 该公司雇佣了一名技术娴熟的黑客来测试其网络安全性。

lemmas.def_en: cut with a hacking tool
lemmas.def_zh: v. 砍；非法侵入（系统）；应付

examples.en: Someone managed to hack into the government's official database.
examples.zh: 有人成功黑入了政府的官方数据库。

family_guide.root_logic: 古英语原义为粗暴地砍劈，现代技术语境引申为快速拼凑、非正规入侵或巧妙解决。

lemmas.def_en: of relatively small extent from one surface to the opposite or in cross section
lemmas.def_zh: adj. 薄的；细的

examples.en: You should thin out the seedlings to give them room to grow.
examples.zh: 你应该把幼苗间苗疏开，给它们留出生长空间。

lemmas.def_en: lose thickness; become thin or thinner
lemmas.def_zh: v. （使）变薄；（使）稀疏

examples.en: You should thin out the seedlings to give them room to grow.
examples.zh: 你应该把幼苗间苗疏开，给它们留出生长空间。

lemmas.def_en: without force or sincere effort
lemmas.def_zh: 薄, 细, 瘦

examples.en: Please spread the butter thinly over the fresh slice of sourdough bread.
examples.zh: 请把黄油薄薄地涂在刚切好的酵母面包片上。

lemmas.def_en: a diluting agent
lemmas.def_zh: n. 稀释剂，稀料

examples.en: Use a small amount of paint thinner to clean your brushes.
examples.zh: 用少量油漆稀释剂来清洗你的画笔。

lemmas.def_en: relatively small dimension through an object as opposed to its length or width
lemmas.def_zh: 薄, 细, 瘦

examples.en: The remarkable thinness of this new laptop makes it extremely portable for travel.
examples.zh: 这款新笔记本电脑极致轻薄，非常适合随身携带旅行。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自原始印欧语词根，表延伸、拉长，引申为厚度或密度极小的状态。

lemmas.def_en: a cheap disreputable nightclub or dance hall
lemmas.def_zh: n. 廉价下等的酒吧（或夜总会）

examples.en: Seabirds dive deep into the ocean to catch schooling fish.
examples.zh: 海鸟潜入海洋深处捕捉鱼群。

lemmas.def_en: any of numerous small pigeons
lemmas.def_zh: n. 鸽子；鸽派人士（温和派）

examples.en: A white dove is globally recognized as an enduring symbol of peace.
examples.zh: 白鸽是全球公认的恒久和平象征。

lemmas.def_en: someone who works underwater
lemmas.def_zh: 潜水者

examples.en: The professional diver explored the ancient shipwreck deep beneath the ocean surface.
examples.zh: 这位专业潜水员探索了深埋于海洋之下的古代沉船。

lemmas.def_en: drop steeply
lemmas.def_zh: v. 跳水；潜水；急剧下降

examples.en: Seabirds dive deep into the ocean to catch schooling fish.
examples.zh: 海鸟潜入海洋深处捕捉鱼群。

family_guide.root_logic: 古英语原义为沉没、潜入水中，引申为急剧下降或投入某种状态。
family_guide.core_distinction: dive 可作为动词或名词，dove 在美语中可作为 dive 的过去式，但在此作为独立名词表‘鸽子’，仅形似而词源不同。

lemmas.def_en: express approval of
lemmas.def_zh: v. 表扬；赞扬

examples.en: Her groundbreaking research won widespread praise from the scientific community.
examples.zh: 她的开创性研究赢得了科学界的广泛赞誉。

lemmas.def_en: an expression of approval and commendation
lemmas.def_zh: n. 赞扬，称赞；崇拜

examples.en: Her groundbreaking research won widespread praise from the scientific community.
examples.zh: 她的开创性研究赢得了科学界的广泛赞誉。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 pretium（价值、价格），核心义为高度肯定某人的价值并予以赞赏。

lemmas.def_en: a serviceman who has seen considerable active service
lemmas.def_zh: n. 老兵；退伍军人

examples.en: A veteran journalist was assigned to cover the complex political crisis.
examples.zh: 一位资深记者被派去报道这场复杂的政治危机。

lemmas.def_en: rendered competent through trial and experience
lemmas.def_zh: adj. 经验丰富的，老练的

examples.en: A veteran journalist was assigned to cover the complex political crisis.
examples.zh: 一位资深记者被派去报道这场复杂的政治危机。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 vetus（年老的、陈旧的），引申为经验丰富的老手或退伍老兵。

lemmas.def_en: the goal intended to be attained (and which is believed to be attainable)
lemmas.def_zh: n. 目标；目的

examples.en: It is crucial to maintain an objective perspective when analyzing the data.
examples.zh: 分析数据时保持客观视角至关重要。

lemmas.def_en: judgment based on observable phenomena and uninfluenced by emotions or personal prejudices
lemmas.def_zh: 客观, 客观现实, 客观性

examples.en: Journalists must strive for objectivity when reporting on sensitive political events.
examples.zh: 记者在报道敏感政治事件时必须力求客观。

lemmas.def_en: judgment based on observable phenomena and uninfluenced by emotions or personal prejudices
lemmas.def_zh: 客观, 客观性

examples.en: The scientific committee evaluated the research proposal with complete objectiveness.
examples.zh: 科学委员会以完全的客观性评估了这项研究提案。

lemmas.def_en: undistorted by emotion or personal bias; based on observable phenomena
lemmas.def_zh: adj. 客观的；公正的

examples.en: It is crucial to maintain an objective perspective when analyzing the data.
examples.zh: 分析数据时保持客观视角至关重要。

lemmas.def_en: with objectivity
lemmas.def_zh: 客观地

examples.en: Try to view the complex problem objectively rather than emotionally.
examples.zh: 试着客观地而非感情用事地看待这个复杂的问题。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 objectum（置于眼前之物），引申为作为目标的事物，或不偏不倚的客观态度。

lemmas.def_en: give the right to
lemmas.def_zh: v. 给……命名；使享有权利/资格

examples.en: This coupon entitles you to a twenty percent discount on all items.
examples.zh: 凭此优惠券，您可享受所有商品八折优惠。

lemmas.def_en: right granted by law or contract (especially a right to benefits)
lemmas.def_zh: n. 权益，应得的权利；特权感

examples.en: The new law ensures that workers do not lose their pension entitlements.
examples.zh: 新法律确保工人不会失去其养老金权益。

lemmas.def_zh: adj. 有资格的；有权利的；自命不凡的
lemmas.def_en: believing oneself to be inherently deserving of privileges or special treatment; having a legal or official right to do or receive something
lemmas.usage_note: 常作表语结构 be entitled to (do) sth；现代口语中常贬义指“自以为是、自视甚高”的人（entitled people）。

examples.en: Full-time employees are entitled to receive four weeks of paid vacation each year.
examples.zh: 全职员工每年有权享受四周的带薪休假。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 en-（使处于……状态）+ title（头衔、权利资格），即赋予名义或赋予资格。

lemmas.def_en: large gallinaceous bird with fan-shaped tail; widely domesticated for food
lemmas.def_zh: n. 火鸡；彻底的失败之作

examples.en: Roast turkey is the traditional centerpiece of Thanksgiving dinner.
examples.zh: 烤火鸡是感恩节晚餐传统的压轴大菜。

family_guide.root_logic: 本指土耳其国名，因早期英国人将原产于美洲的火鸡误认为从土耳其进口的珠鸡而得名。

lemmas.def_en: spectators at a golf or tennis match
lemmas.def_zh: n. 美术馆，画廊；顶层楼座；走廊

examples.en: The artist displayed her latest oil paintings at a prestigious gallery in Paris.
examples.zh: 这位艺术家在巴黎一家享有盛誉的画廊展出了她最新的油画作品。

examples.en: The historic hotel features a grand galleried courtyard overlooking the gardens.
examples.zh: 这家历史悠久的酒店拥有一个俯瞰花园的壮观回廊庭院。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自中世纪拉丁语 galeria（走廊、长廊），后演变为陈列展示艺术品的长廊或展馆。

lemmas.def_en: the largest Latin American country and the largest Portuguese speaking country in the world; located in the central and northeastern part of South America; world's leading coffee exporter
lemmas.def_zh: n. 巴西（国名）；巴西红木；巴西坚果（常作 Brazil nut）

examples.en: Brazil is famous for its vibrant culture, carnival, and vast rainforests.
examples.zh: 巴西以其充满活力的文化、狂欢节和广袤的热带雨林而闻名。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自葡萄牙语 pau-brasil（巴西红木），因木材色泽如余烬（brasa，炭火）而得名，现为国名及植物名。

lemmas.def_en: remove or make invisible
lemmas.def_zh: v. 删除；抹去

examples.en: Make sure you don't delete any critical system files by mistake.
examples.zh: 确保不要误删任何关键的系统文件。

lemmas.def_en: any process whereby sounds or words are left out of spoken words or phrases
lemmas.def_zh: 删除, 删除部分

examples.en: The sudden deletion of the important file caused widespread panic.
examples.zh: 重要文件的突然删除引起了普遍的恐慌。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 de-（彻底）+ linere（抹去、涂掉），引申为清除或删除。

lemmas.def_en: decoration consisting of the layout and furnishings of a livable interior
lemmas.def_zh: n. （室内）装饰风格，装潢

examples.en: The restaurant features a minimalist decor with neutral tones.
examples.zh: 这家餐厅以中性色调的极简装潢风格为特色。

lemmas.def_en: something used to beautify
lemmas.def_zh: n. 装饰；装饰品；勋章

examples.en: They took down the Christmas decorations right after the holidays.
examples.zh: 节后他们立刻收起了圣诞装饰品。

lemmas.def_en: a person who specializes in designing architectural interiors and their furnishings
lemmas.def_zh: 装饰家, 裱糊工, 室内外墙壁油漆工, 制景人员

examples.en: They hired an experienced interior decorator to redesign their living room.
examples.zh: 他们聘请了一位经验丰富的室内装饰师来重新设计客厅。

lemmas.def_en: make more attractive by adding ornament, colour, etc.
lemmas.def_zh: 装饰

examples.en: The whole family gathered to decorate the pine tree for Christmas.
examples.zh: 全家人聚在一起为圣诞节装饰这棵松树。

lemmas.def_en: serving an esthetic rather than a useful purpose
lemmas.def_zh: adj. 装饰性的；起修饰作用的

examples.en: The mirror serves a purely decorative purpose in the hallway.
examples.zh: 这面镜子在走廊里纯粹起装饰作用。

lemmas.def_en: not decorated with something to increase its beauty or distinction
lemmas.def_zh: 未加装饰的, 简朴的

examples.en: She preferred an undecorated bedroom with simple wooden furniture.
examples.zh: 她更喜欢一个没有多余装饰、配有简单木制家具的卧室。

lemmas.def_en: in a decorative manner
lemmas.def_zh: 装饰地

examples.en: The chef decoratively arranged fresh herbs around the main dish.
examples.zh: 厨师将新鲜香草装饰性地摆放在主菜周围。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 decus（美化、优雅），引申为装饰、装潢及美化之物。
family_guide.core_distinction: decor 指整体的室内装潢风格；decoration 偏指具体的装饰品或装饰行为；decorative 强调起修饰作用的。

lemmas.def_en: pull, as against a resistance
lemmas.def_zh: v. 拖，拉；缓慢进行

examples.en: You can simply drag and drop the files into the new folder.
examples.zh: 你只需把文件拖放到新文件夹中即可。

lemmas.def_en: someone who pulls or tugs or drags in an effort to move something
lemmas.def_zh: 小型拖网渔船

examples.en: The old wooden dragger returned to the harbor with a heavy catch.
examples.zh: 那艘老旧的木制拖网渔船满载渔获返回了港口。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自日耳曼语系词根，核心义为在地面上费力拖、拉。

lemmas.def_en: occurring from time to time
lemmas.def_zh: adj. 偶尔的；临时的

examples.en: Aside from an occasional cough, she felt completely fine.
examples.zh: 除了偶尔咳嗽一下，她感觉完全正常。

lemmas.def_en: now and then or here and there
lemmas.def_zh: adv. 偶尔，间或

examples.en: We still meet up for dinner occasionally to catch up.
examples.zh: 我们偶尔还是会聚在一起吃顿饭叙叙旧。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自 occasion（时机、场合），加形容词后缀 -al，表示非经常、仅在特定场合发生的。

lemmas.def_en: a flat metal piece (usually a disc) used as money
lemmas.def_zh: n. 硬币

examples.en: She flipped a coin to decide who would go first.
examples.zh: 她抛硬币来决定谁先开始。

lemmas.def_en: coins collectively
lemmas.def_zh: 造币

examples.en: The word 'cyberspace' is a relatively modern English coinage.
examples.zh: “网络空间”这个词是一个相对现代的英语新造词。

lemmas.def_en: a maker of counterfeit coins
lemmas.def_zh: 造币者, 伪造货币者, 创造者

examples.en: The brilliant coiner of the popular slogan remained largely unknown.
examples.zh: 这个流行口号的杰出创造者在很大程度上并不为人所知。

lemmas.def_en: make up
lemmas.def_zh: v. 创造（新词语等）；杜撰

examples.en: She flipped a coin to decide who would go first.
examples.zh: 她抛硬币来决定谁先开始。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 cuneus（楔子，早期用于压印硬币的冲模），后引申为铸造硬币及创造新词。

lemmas.def_en: covered or soaked with a liquid such as water
lemmas.def_zh: adj. 潮湿的；有雨的

examples.en: Be careful on the stairs; the floor is still wet.
examples.zh: 下楼梯小心点，地板还是湿的。

lemmas.def_en: cause to become wet
lemmas.def_zh: v. 使变湿；弄湿

examples.en: Be careful on the stairs; the floor is still wet.
examples.zh: 下楼梯小心点，地板还是湿的。

lemmas.def_en: the condition of containing or being covered by a liquid (especially water)
lemmas.def_zh: 湿润, 下雨

examples.en: The persistent wetness of the soil caused the delicate roots to rot.
examples.zh: 土壤的持续潮湿导致脆弱的根系腐烂。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自原始日耳曼语，与 water（水）同源，核心语义为“沾水、潮湿”。

lemmas.def_en: an effort that is inconvenient
lemmas.def_zh: n. 困难；难题

examples.en: She overcame great difficulty to finish her degree while working full-time.
examples.zh: 她克服了重重困难，在全职工作的同时完成了学业。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 dis-（难）+ facile（容易）+ -ity（名词后缀），字面即“不容易的状态”。

lemmas.def_en: an award for winning a championship or commemorating some other event
lemmas.def_zh: n. 奖牌；勋章

examples.en: He won a silver medal in the 100-meter sprint.
examples.zh: 他在百米冲刺中摘得了一枚银牌。

lemmas.def_en: someone who has won a medal
lemmas.def_zh: 奖章获得者, 奖章设计者, 奖章制作者, 勋章制作者, 奖章搜集者, 勋章搜集者

examples.en: The Olympic gold medalist gave an inspiring speech to young athletes.
examples.zh: 这位奥运金牌获得者向年轻运动员发表了鼓舞人心的演讲。

lemmas.def_en: someone who has won a medal
lemmas.def_zh: 奖章获得者

examples.en: The silver medallist proudly displayed her hard-earned prize to the cheering crowd.
examples.zh: 这位银牌得主向欢呼的人群自豪地展示了她来之不易的奖牌。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 metallum（金属），特指用金属铸造的奖牌、勋章。

lemmas.def_en: clearly revealed to the mind or the senses or judgment
lemmas.def_zh: adj. 朴素的；清晰易懂的；平坦的

examples.en: The instructions are written in plain, accessible language.
examples.zh: 这些说明是用直白通俗的语言写的。

lemmas.def_en: express complaints, discontent, displeasure, or unhappiness
lemmas.def_zh: v. 抱怨；哀叹

examples.en: The instructions are written in plain, accessible language.
examples.zh: 这些说明是用直白通俗的语言写的。

lemmas.def_en: unmistakably (`plain' is often used informally for `plainly')
lemmas.def_zh: 清楚地, 明白地, 简单地, 朴素地, 直率地, 坦白地

examples.en: The warning label plainly states that the chemical is highly flammable.
examples.zh: 警告标签清楚地表明该化学品极度易燃。

lemmas.def_en: the state of being unmixed with other material
lemmas.def_zh: 平坦, 明白, 正直

examples.en: The sheer plainness of the village cottage added to its quiet charm.
examples.zh: 乡村小屋的极其简朴增添了其宁静的魅力。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 planus（平坦的），后引申为朴素的、直白的。

lemmas.def_en: a lawyer who pleads cases in court
lemmas.def_zh: n. 建议；法律顾问

examples.en: He sought legal counsel before signing the merger agreement.
examples.zh: 在签署合并协议之前，他寻求了法律顾问的意见。

lemmas.def_en: someone who gives advice about problems
lemmas.def_zh: n. 顾问；心理咨询师；辅导员

examples.en: She decided to see a career counselor to explore new options.
examples.zh: 她决定去向职业顾问咨询，以探索新的方向。

lemmas.def_en: someone who has supervisory duties at a summer camp
lemmas.def_zh: 顾问, 辅导员, 律师

examples.en: She decided to consult a career counsellor before making a job change.
examples.zh: 她决定在换工作之前先咨询一位职业顾问。

lemmas.def_en: give advice to
lemmas.def_zh: v. 建议；提供咨询

examples.en: He sought legal counsel before signing the merger agreement.
examples.zh: 在签署合并协议之前，他寻求了法律顾问的意见。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 consilium（商议、协商），引申为提供建议或法律代理。
family_guide.core_distinction: counsel 既可指建议，也可指法律顾问（单复数同形）；counselor 专门指提供专业指导或咨询的咨询师、顾问。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to electronics; concerned with or using devices that operate on principles governing the behavior of electrons
lemmas.def_zh: adj. 电子的；电子学的

examples.en: All electronic devices must be powered down during takeoff.
examples.zh: 起飞期间必须关闭所有电子设备。

lemmas.def_en: by electronic means
lemmas.def_zh: 电子地

examples.en: All official documents must be submitted electronically through the portal.
examples.zh: 所有官方文件都必须通过该门户网站以电子方式提交。

lemmas.def_en: the branch of physics that deals with the emission and effects of electrons and with the use of electronic devices
lemmas.def_zh: 电子学；电子器件，电子设备

examples.en: Japan has long been a global leader in consumer electronics.
examples.zh: 日本长期以来一直是消费电子领域的全球领导者。

family_guide.root_logic: electron（电子）+ -ic（形容词后缀），表示与电子技术、电路或数字化设备相关的。

lemmas.def_en: not wide
lemmas.def_zh: adj. 狭窄的；勉强的；目光短浅的

examples.en: The car barely managed to squeeze through the narrow alley.
examples.zh: 汽车勉强挤过了这条狭窄的胡同。

lemmas.def_en: make or become more narrow or restricted
lemmas.def_zh: v. （使）变窄；（使）收缩

examples.en: The car barely managed to squeeze through the narrow alley.
examples.zh: 汽车勉强挤过了这条狭窄的胡同。

lemmas.def_en: in a narrow manner; not allowing for exceptions
lemmas.def_zh: adv. 勉强地；狭隘地

examples.en: The driver narrowly avoided a crash with the oncoming truck.
examples.zh: 司机险之又险地避开了迎面驶来的卡车。

lemmas.def_en: the property of being narrow; having little width
lemmas.def_zh: 狭小, 小气

examples.en: The extreme narrowness of the alley prevented emergency vehicles from entering.
examples.zh: 小巷极其狭窄，阻止了紧急救援车辆进入。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自原始日耳曼语，本义指狭窄、空间紧凑，引申为范围有限或勉强的状态。

lemmas.def_en: a person of subnormal intelligence
lemmas.def_zh: 白痴，傻子

examples.en: Don't be an idiot; always wear a helmet when riding a bike.
examples.zh: 别傻了，骑自行车时一定要戴头盔。

lemmas.def_en: insanely irresponsible
lemmas.def_zh: 白痴的, 愚蠢的, 呆头呆脑的

examples.en: Driving at high speeds during a heavy snowstorm is utterly idiotic.
examples.zh: 在暴风雪中高速行驶是极其愚蠢的。

lemmas.def_en: in an idiotic manner
lemmas.def_zh: 白痴地

examples.en: He idiotically left his car keys inside the locked vehicle yesterday.
examples.zh: 他昨天愚蠢地把车钥匙落在了锁着车门的车里。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 idiōtēs（普通人、外行），后语义贬化为智力低下或缺乏常识的人。

lemmas.def_en: the underside of footwear or a golf club
lemmas.def_zh: 脚掌, 鞋底, 底部

examples.en: A sharp stone pierced the rubber sole of his running shoe.
examples.zh: 一块锋利的石头刺穿了他跑鞋的橡胶鞋底。

lemmas.def_en: not divided or shared with others
lemmas.def_zh: 唯一的, 仅有的, 单独的, 独身的

examples.en: A sharp stone pierced the rubber sole of his running shoe.
examples.zh: 一块锋利的石头刺穿了他跑鞋的橡胶鞋底。

lemmas.def_en: without any others being included or involved
lemmas.def_zh: 仅仅, 单独地

examples.en: He made the critical decision solely based on his personal intuition.
examples.zh: 他仅仅凭着个人的直觉做出了这个重大决定。

lemmas.def_en: put a new sole on
lemmas.def_zh: 上鞋底, 触底

examples.en: The cobbler agreed to resole my favorite pair of leather boots.
examples.zh: 鞋匠同意给我最喜欢的那双皮靴换上新鞋底。

family_guide.root_logic: 融合了拉丁语 solum（底部、脚底）与 solus（单独的、唯一的）两个词源。

lemmas.def_en: the domain ruled by an emperor or empress; the region over which imperial dominion is exercised
lemmas.def_zh: 帝国, 帝权

examples.en: The ancient empire expanded rapidly through trade and strategic military conquests.
examples.zh: 这个古代帝国通过贸易和战略性的军事征服迅速扩张。

lemmas.def_en: the male ruler of an empire
lemmas.def_zh: n. 皇帝，君主

examples.en: The emperor ruled over a vast territory spanning three continents.
examples.zh: 这位皇帝统治着横跨三大洲的辽阔疆域。

lemmas.def_en: a small tufted beard worn by Emperor Napoleon III
lemmas.def_zh: n. 帝国派（或纸张尺寸/胡子款式）

examples.en: The museum houses a priceless collection of imperial treasures.
examples.zh: 该博物馆收藏了无价的皇家珍宝。

lemmas.def_en: relating to or associated with an empire
lemmas.def_zh: adj. 帝国的；皇帝的

examples.en: The museum houses a priceless collection of imperial treasures.
examples.zh: 该博物馆收藏了无价的皇家珍宝。

lemmas.def_en: in an imperial manner
lemmas.def_zh: 帝王般地, 威严地, 庄严地

examples.en: The ancient monarch ruled imperially over a vast territory stretching across two continents.
examples.zh: 这位古代君王以帝王之威统治着横跨两大洲的辽阔疆域。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 imperium（最高权力、指挥权），引申为由单一主权统治的广大帝国或庞大商业版图。

lemmas.def_en: a quad with a square body
lemmas.def_zh: [计] 媒体用毕符

examples.en: The printer adjusted the text margins by adding one extra em.
examples.zh: 印刷工通过增加一个印刷字宽来调整正文边距。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自字母 M 的发音，在印刷和排版领域指等于当前字体字号宽度的度量单位。

lemmas.def_en: marked by dissimilarity
lemmas.def_zh: 不像, 和...不同

examples.en: Unlike his older brother, David prefers quiet evenings at home alone.
examples.zh: 与他的哥哥不同，大卫更喜欢独自在家度过安静的夜晚。

lemmas.def_en: marked by dissimilarity
lemmas.def_zh: 不像的, 不同的

examples.en: Unlike his older brother, David prefers quiet evenings at home alone.
examples.zh: 与他的哥哥不同，大卫更喜欢独自在家度过安静的夜晚。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 un-（不、非）+ like（像），核心语义为“不像、不同”。

lemmas.def_en: the organ of smell and entrance to the respiratory tract; the prominent part of the face of man or other mammals
lemmas.def_zh: 鼻子, 突出部分, 嗅觉

examples.en: The curious puppy pushed its wet nose against the cold glass.
examples.zh: 那只好奇的小狗把湿漉漉的鼻子贴在冰冷的玻璃上。

lemmas.def_zh: 好打听, 爱管闲事
lemmas.def_en: offensive inquisitiveness
search or inquire in a meddlesome way
lemmas.def_zh: 嗅到, 探出, 用鼻子触；闻, 嗅, 探听, 告密

examples.en: The curious puppy pushed its wet nose against the cold glass.
examples.zh: 那只好奇的小狗把湿漉漉的鼻子贴在冰冷的玻璃上。

lemmas.def_zh: 大鼻子的, 好管闲事的, 爱打听的
lemmas.def_en: offensively curious or inquisitive

examples.en: The nosy neighbor kept peeking through the curtains to see who was visiting us.
examples.zh: 爱管闲事的邻居一直透过窗帘张望，想看看到底是谁来拜访我们。

lemmas.def_en: offensively curious or inquisitive
lemmas.def_zh: 大鼻子的, (非正式)(贬)爱管闲事的, 爱探听的, 好打听的

examples.en: Our nosey neighbor constantly watches everyone who walks down the street.
examples.zh: 我们那个爱管闲事的邻居总是盯着街上走过的每一个人。

lemmas.def_en: having no nose
lemmas.def_zh: 无鼻子的, 无喷嘴的

examples.en: The ancient marble statue was badly damaged and left completely noseless.
examples.zh: 这座古老的大理石雕像严重受损，鼻子已经完全脱落了。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 nosu，指面部呼吸器官，动词引申为用鼻子嗅、探寻或小心翼翼地向前移动。

lemmas.def_en: deliver a quick blow to
lemmas.def_zh: 以拳重击, 开洞, 冲压；用拳猛击

examples.en: He reacted quickly enough to punch the attacking animal right away.
examples.zh: 他反应极快，立刻挥拳猛击扑上来的野兽。

lemmas.def_en: a hired hand who tends cattle and performs other duties on horseback
lemmas.def_zh: 电报凿孔机, 冲床工, 钻床工, (非正式)报务员, 牧人

examples.en: The experienced puncher worked carefully to stamp clean holes in metal.
examples.zh: 经验丰富的冲床工细心地在金属板上冲出规整的孔洞。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古法语 poinçon（打孔工具、刺针），后演化出用拳猛击或用工具打孔的动作。

lemmas.def_en: to move or cause to move in a sinuous, spiral, or circular course
lemmas.def_zh: 穿线于, 穿过, 通过, 用线穿成；穿过

examples.en: She tried patiently to thread the thin needle in the dim light.
examples.zh: 她在昏暗的光线下耐心地试着穿过细针的针眼。

lemmas.def_en: a fine cord of twisted fibers (of cotton or silk or wool or nylon etc.) used in sewing and weaving
lemmas.def_zh: 线, 丝, 纤维, 线索

examples.en: She tried patiently to thread the thin needle in the dim light.
examples.zh: 她在昏暗的光线下耐心地试着穿过细针的针眼。

lemmas.def_en: a blunt needle for threading ribbon through loops
lemmas.def_zh: 螺丝车床；穿线器

examples.en: A simple wire threader makes inserting thread into needles much easier.
examples.zh: 一个简易的金属穿线器能让穿针变得轻松许多。

lemmas.def_en: forming viscous or glutinous threads
lemmas.def_zh: 线制的, 像线的, 纤维性的

examples.en: The doctor felt a thready pulse in the patient's weak wrist.
examples.zh: 医生在病人虚弱的手腕上摸到了微弱如细丝的脉搏。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 thrǣd（扭转、纺织物），动词引申为穿线、穿行于狭小空间。

lemmas.def_en: capable of being molded or modeled (especially of earth or clay or other soft material)
lemmas.def_zh: 塑料的, 塑造的, 有可塑性的, 造型的, 易受影响的, 有创造力的

examples.en: We should minimize using single-use plastic bags to protect marine environments.
examples.zh: 我们应当尽量减少使用一次性塑料袋以保护海洋环境。

lemmas.def_en: generic name for certain synthetic or semisynthetic materials that can be molded or extruded into objects or films or filaments or used for making e.g. coatings and adhesives
lemmas.def_zh: 塑料, 可塑体, 可塑性物质

examples.en: We should minimize using single-use plastic bags to protect marine environments.
examples.zh: 我们应当尽量减少使用一次性塑料袋以保护海洋环境。

lemmas.def_en: the property of being physically malleable; the property of something that can be worked or hammered or shaped without breaking
lemmas.def_zh: 可塑性, 柔软性, 立体感

examples.en: The high plasticity of warm clay allows sculptors to shape complex figures.
examples.zh: 温热陶土的高可塑性使雕塑家能够塑造出复杂的形象。

lemmas.def_en: in a plastic manner
lemmas.def_zh: 可塑性

examples.en: Under intense pressure and heat, the metal began to deform plastically.
examples.zh: 在强压和高温下，这种金属开始发生塑性形变。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 plastikos（可塑的、塑造的），作名词特指人工合成的可塑塑料材料。

lemmas.def_en: a literary work based on the imagination and not necessarily on fact
lemmas.def_zh: 小说, 虚构故事

examples.en: She enjoys reading historical fiction before going to sleep each night.
examples.zh: 她喜欢每晚睡前读一些历史题材的虚构小说。

lemmas.def_en: prose writing that is not fictional
lemmas.def_zh: (非小说的)写实文学

examples.en: His latest work of nonfiction explores the history of modern space travel.
examples.zh: 他最新的写实文学作品探讨了现代太空旅行的历史。

lemmas.def_zh: 小说化
lemmas.def_en: a literary work based partly or wholly on fact but written as if it were fiction
related to or involving literary fiction
lemmas.def_zh: 虚构的, 编造的, 小说式的

examples.en: Sherlock Holmes is perhaps the most famous fictional detective in modern literature.
examples.zh: 夏洛克·福尔摩斯也许是现代文学中最著名的虚构侦探。

lemmas.def_zh: 假想的, 编造的, 虚伪的
lemmas.def_en: formed or conceived by the imagination

examples.en: The author used fictitious character names to protect the real people involved.
examples.zh: 作者使用了虚构的人名，以保护相关的真实当事人。

lemmas.def_en: not fictional
lemmas.def_zh: 非虚构

examples.en: The author based this compelling drama entirely on nonfictional historical accounts.
examples.zh: 作者将这部扣人心弦的剧作完全建立在真实的非虚构历史记录之上。

lemmas.def_zh: 虚构地; 假地
lemmas.def_en: in a false manner intended to mislead

lemmas.def_zh: 把...编成小说, 使小说化
lemmas.def_en: make into fiction

examples.en: The author decided to fictionalize her chaotic childhood memories in her debut novel.
examples.zh: 这位作者决定在她的处女作小说中将混乱的童年记忆虚构化。

lemmas.def_zh: 将（真实事情）编写成小说
lemmas.def_en: make into fiction

examples.en: The writer fictionalized the lives of his parents in his latest novel

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 fingere（塑造、虚构），核心语义是人为虚构、编造的事物或文学形式。

lemmas.def_en: being nothing more than specified
lemmas.def_zh: 仅仅的, 只不过的

examples.en: The entire project collapsed within a mere two weeks of starting.
examples.zh: 整个项目在启动后仅仅两周之内就彻底瓦解了。

lemmas.def_en: and nothing more
lemmas.def_zh: 只

examples.en: He claimed he was merely trying to help, but no one believed him.
examples.zh: 他声称自己只是想帮忙，但没人相信他。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 merus（纯粹的、未经稀释的），后语义弱化为“只不过、仅仅”。

lemmas.def_en: the process of taking in and expelling air during breathing
lemmas.def_zh: 呼吸, 气息, 瞬间

examples.en: Take a deep breath and try to relax before giving your speech.
examples.zh: 演讲前深呼吸一口气，尽量放松。
