lemmas.def_en: utter in a loud voice; talk in a loud voice (usually denoting characteristic manner of speaking)
lemmas.def_zh: 呼喊, 喊叫, 嚷；高喊

examples.en: You do not need to shout because I can hear you clearly.
examples.zh: 你不需要大声喊叫，因为我能听得很清楚。

lemmas.def_en: a loud utterance; often in protest or opposition
lemmas.def_zh: 呼喊, 喊声

examples.en: You do not need to shout because I can hear you clearly.
examples.zh: 你不需要大声喊叫，因为我能听得很清楚。

lemmas.def_en: someone who communicates vocally in a very loud voice
lemmas.def_zh: 高呼者, 喊叫者

examples.en: The angry shouter was promptly escorted out of the quiet town hall.
examples.zh: 愤怒的高呼者被立即护送出了安静的市政厅。

family_guide.root_logic: 拟声词起源，模拟大声呼喊的高亢音效。

lemmas.def_en: free from evil or guilt
lemmas.def_zh: 无罪的, 不懂事的, 无知的

examples.en: The jury firmly believed the young suspect was completely innocent of crime.
examples.zh: 陪审团坚信这位年轻的嫌疑人完全无罪。

lemmas.def_en: a person who lacks knowledge of evil
lemmas.def_zh: 天真的人, 笨蛋

examples.en: Do not be such an innocent; they are clearly taking advantage of you.
examples.zh: 别这么天真了；他们显然在占你便宜。

lemmas.def_en: the quality of innocent naivete
lemmas.def_zh: 无罪, 无知, 天真无邪

examples.en: The defense attorney presented conclusive evidence to prove her client's complete innocence.
examples.zh: 辩护律师出示了决定性证据，以证明其当事人的完全无罪。

lemmas.def_en: in a not unlawful manner
lemmas.def_zh: 纯洁地；无罪地

examples.en: The child smiled innocently, unaware of the chaos he had caused.
examples.zh: 那孩子天真地微笑着，完全没意识到自己惹下了乱子。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 in-（不、无）+ nocere（伤害），核心意为“没有害处、无辜的”。

lemmas.def_en: a senior member of the Christian clergy having spiritual and administrative authority; appointed in Christian churches to oversee priests or ministers; considered in some churches to be successors of the twelve Apostles of Christ
lemmas.def_zh: 主教, (国际象棋中的)象, 热果子酒

examples.en: He skillfully moved his bishop across the board to threaten my queen.
examples.zh: 他巧妙地将自己的主教棋子移过棋盘，威胁到了我的王后。

lemmas.def_zh: 主教的, 主教制度的, 英国国教的
lemmas.def_en: of or pertaining to or characteristic of the Episcopal church

examples.en: The local community gathered at the historic episcopal palace for the annual charity gala.
examples.zh: 当地社区聚集在历史悠久的主教宫邸参加年度慈善晚会。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 episkopos，由 epi-（在……上）+ skopos（注视、观察）组成，原指“监督者”，后专指教会主教。

lemmas.def_en: a form of entertainment that enacts a story by sound and a sequence of images giving the illusion of continuous movement
lemmas.def_zh: 照片, 图片, 影片

examples.en: She posted a quick pic of the sunset on her social media.
examples.zh: 她在社交媒体上发了一张夕阳的照片。

family_guide.root_logic: picture 的口语截短形式，用作名词指照片或影片。

lemmas.def_en: (linguistics) the form of a word after all affixes are removed
lemmas.def_zh: 茎, 干, 柄, 船首, 血统, 堵塞物

examples.en: Cut each flower stem at an angle before placing them into water.
examples.zh: 将每朵花的花茎斜着剪切后再插入水中。

lemmas.def_en: a worker who strips the stems from moistened tobacco leaves and binds the leaves together into books
lemmas.def_zh: 抽梗机, 去梗机, 抽梗工人, 炮棍, 导火线留孔针, 塞药棒, (非正式)乞丐

examples.en: The winery bought a new stemmer to process the harvested grapes quickly.
examples.zh: 酒庄购入了一台新去梗机，以迅速处理采摘的葡萄。

lemmas.def_en: grow out of, have roots in, originate in
lemmas.def_zh: 摘掉茎, 装柄于, 阻止, 堵住, 逆行；堵住, 逆行

examples.en: Cut each flower stem at an angle before placing them into water.
examples.zh: 将每朵花的花茎斜着剪切后再插入水中。

lemmas.def_en: not having a stem
lemmas.def_zh: 无茎的, 无梗的

examples.en: We served the wine in modern stemless glasses during the casual dinner.
examples.zh: 在便宴上，我们用现代风格的无梗杯盛酒。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自原始日耳曼语，本义为植物的“茎干”，引申为支撑物、起源或止住流动的动作。

lemmas.def_en: a state of extreme (usually irremediable) ruin and misfortune
lemmas.def_zh: 灾祸, 不幸, 彻底失败

examples.en: Poor planning turned what should have been a fun trip into a disaster.
examples.zh: 糟糕的规划让原本有趣的旅行变成了一场灾难。

lemmas.def_zh: 损失惨重的, 悲伤的
lemmas.def_en: (of events) having extremely unfortunate or dire consequences; bringing ruin; ; ; ; - Charles Darwin; - Douglas MacArthur

examples.en: The sudden flood had a disastrous effect on the entire farming region.
examples.zh: 突如其来的洪水对整个农业区造成了灾难性的影响。

lemmas.def_zh: 悲惨地
lemmas.def_en: in a disastrous manner

examples.en: the real value of the trust capital may be disastrously less than when the trust began

family_guide.root_logic: 源自意大利语，由 dis-（不良、相反）+ astro（星辰）组成，古人认为星位不正预示着“灾难”。

lemmas.def_en: intense and profound fear
lemmas.def_zh: 惊骇, 恐怖, 惨状

examples.en: She watched in absolute horror as the speeding car struck the lamppost.
examples.zh: 她惊骇万分地看着那辆飞驰的汽车撞向路灯。

lemmas.def_en: fill with apprehension or alarm; cause to be unpleasantly surprised
lemmas.def_zh: 使恐惧, 使震惊

examples.en: The graphic details of the violent crime continue to horrify the local community.
examples.zh: 这起暴力犯罪的生动细节依然令当地社区感到震惊与恐惧。

lemmas.def_en: in a horrifying manner
lemmas.def_zh: 令人恐惧地；叫人毛骨悚然地

examples.en: The speeding vehicle swerved horrifyingly close to the edge of the steep cliff.
examples.zh: 疾驰的车辆令人毛骨悚然地擦着陡峭悬崖的边缘急转弯。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 horrere（发抖、毛发竖立），引申为极度的恐惧或毛骨悚然的事物。

lemmas.def_en: at the same time but in another place
lemmas.def_zh: 同时, 于此时

examples.en: I will prepare dinner; meanwhile, you can finish up your homework upstairs.
examples.zh: 我去准备晚饭；与此同时，你可以在楼上做完作业。

family_guide.root_logic: 由 mean（中间的）+ while（一段时间）组成，字面为“在这期间”，用作副词表示“与此同时”。

lemmas.def_en: not contained in or deriving from the essential nature of something
lemmas.def_zh: 外国的, 相异的

examples.en: Such cold and ruthless behavior was completely alien to her gentle nature.
examples.zh: 这种冷酷无情的行为与她温柔的天性格格不入。

lemmas.def_en: a person who comes from a foreign country; someone who does not owe allegiance to your country
lemmas.def_zh: 外国人, 外侨

examples.en: Such cold and ruthless behavior was completely alien to her gentle nature.
examples.zh: 这种冷酷无情的行为与她温柔的天性格格不入。

lemmas.def_en: transfer property or ownership

examples.en: Such cold and ruthless behavior was completely alien to her gentle nature.
examples.zh: 这种冷酷无情的行为与她温柔的天性格格不入。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 alienus（属于他人的、外来的），核心意为“异质的、不熟悉的”。

lemmas.def_en: a football game in which two teams of 11 players try to kick or head a ball into the opponents' goal
lemmas.def_zh: 英式足球

examples.en: The local kids love playing soccer in the park after school finishes.
examples.zh: 当地的孩子们喜欢放学后在公园里踢英式足球。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自 association football（英式足球）中的 assoc- 加口语后缀 -er 构成。

lemmas.def_en: fear resulting from the awareness of danger
lemmas.def_zh: 惊恐, 警报, 警钟

examples.en: The sudden loud sound of the fire alarm woke everyone up instantly.
examples.zh: 火灾警报器的突然大响瞬间惊醒了所有人。

lemmas.def_en: a person who alarms others needlessly
lemmas.def_zh: 轻事重报者, 杞人忧天者

examples.en: Ignore his dire predictions; he has always been a total alarmist about politics.
examples.zh: 别理他的可怕预言；他在政治上向来是个危言耸听者。

lemmas.def_zh: 危言耸听
lemmas.def_en: needless warnings

examples.en: The government dismissed the economic warnings as mere political alarmism.
examples.zh: 政府认为这些经济警告纯属政治上的危言耸听。

lemmas.def_en: fill with apprehension or alarm; cause to be unpleasantly surprised
lemmas.def_zh: 使惊恐, 警告

examples.en: The sudden loud sound of the fire alarm woke everyone up instantly.
examples.zh: 火灾警报器的突然大响瞬间惊醒了所有人。

lemmas.def_en: in an alarming manner
lemmas.def_zh: 让人担忧地

examples.en: The water level in the reservoir has dropped alarmingly fast this month.
examples.zh: 水库的水位本月下降得惊人地快，令人担忧。

lemmas.def_zh: adj. 令人担忧的；令人恐慌的
lemmas.def_en: causing worry, fright, or fear of danger
lemmas.usage_note: 常修饰 rate, increase, speed 等词，如 at an alarming rate（以惊人的速度）。

examples.en: The deforestation of the rainforest is continuing at an alarming rate.
examples.zh: 热带雨林的乱砍滥伐正以令人担忧的速度持续进行。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古意大利语 all'arme（拿起武器！），原为军队遇袭时的警报呼号，引申为惊恐与警报器。

lemmas.def_en: a conditional conveyance of property as security for the repayment of a loan
lemmas.def_zh: 抵押, 约束性义务, 抵押借款

examples.en: They took out a thirty-year mortgage to buy their first family home.
examples.zh: 他们办理了三十年期的抵押贷款来购买首套家庭住房。

lemmas.def_en: the person who accepts a mortgage
lemmas.def_zh: 承受抵押人

examples.en: The bank, as the mortgagee, holds legal rights to the disputed property.
examples.zh: 作为抵押权受让人，银行拥有该争议房产的法定权利。

lemmas.def_en: the person who gives a mortgage in return for money to be repaid
lemmas.def_zh: 抵押人, 出押人

examples.en: The mortgagor must make monthly repayments on time to avoid potential foreclosure.
examples.zh: 出押人必须按时进行月度还款，以避免房产可能被没收。

lemmas.def_en: put up as security or collateral
lemmas.def_zh: 抵押, 以...作担保, 把...许给

examples.en: They took out a thirty-year mortgage to buy their first family home.
examples.zh: 他们办理了三十年期的抵押贷款来购买首套家庭住房。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古法语 mort（死）+ gage（质押），原指若借款还清或违约则质押物关系终结（“死”）。

lemmas.def_en: speak insincerely or without regard for facts or truths

examples.en: Stop trying to bullshit me and just admit you forgot the deadline.
examples.zh: 别再胡扯蒙我了，坦白承认你忘了截止日期吧。

family_guide.root_logic: 俚语复合词 bull（公牛/胡话）+ shit（排泄物），粗俗语，核心指“扯淡、胡说八道”。

lemmas.def_en: any of various large keen-sighted diurnal birds of prey noted for their broad wings and strong soaring flight
lemmas.def_zh: 鹰, 鹰状标饰

examples.en: The experienced golfer managed to eagle the final par-five hole to win the match.
examples.zh: 这位经验丰富的球手在最后一洞五杆洞打出双鹰球，赢得了比赛。

lemmas.def_zh: 小鹰
lemmas.def_en: a young eagle

examples.en: The mother eagle returned to the high mountain nest to feed her hungry eaglet.
examples.zh: 母鹰飞回高山上的巢穴，喂养饥饿的小鹰。

lemmas.def_en: shoot two strokes under par

examples.en: The experienced golfer managed to eagle the final par-five hole to win the match.
examples.zh: 这位经验丰富的球手在最后一洞五杆洞打出双鹰球，赢得了比赛。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 aquila（鹰），引申为高尔夫术语“鹰击”（低于标准杆两杆）。

lemmas.def_en: a line of approach
lemmas.def_zh: 大街, 途径, 林荫路

examples.en: We walked slowly down the broad avenue shaded by tall, leafy plane trees.
examples.zh: 我们沿着被高大茂密的梧桐树遮蔽的宽阔大道慢慢走着。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 advenire（到达），原指通往豪宅的“迎宾林道”，引申为宽阔大道或途径。

lemmas.def_en: worthless material that is to be disposed of
lemmas.def_zh: 垃圾, 废物

examples.en: She decided to trash all the outdated files to free up some space.
examples.zh: 她决定把所有过期的文件扔掉以腾出一些空间。

lemmas.def_en: the quality of being cheaply imitative of something better
lemmas.def_zh: 碎屑, 没用之物

examples.en: Critics were quick to dismiss the novel for the utter trashiness of its plot.
examples.zh: 批评家们很快就因小说情节的极度低劣而对其不屑一顾。

lemmas.def_en: dispose of (something useless or old)
lemmas.def_zh: 丢弃

examples.en: She decided to trash all the outdated files to free up some space.
examples.zh: 她决定把所有过期的文件扔掉以腾出一些空间。

lemmas.def_en: cheap and inferior; of no value
lemmas.def_zh: 碎屑的, 没用的, 垃圾似的

examples.en: He spent the rainy Sunday afternoon reading a trashy detective novel on the sofa.
examples.zh: 他在雨天的周日下午躺在沙发上看了一本低俗的侦探小说。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自中古英语，本义指树木修剪下的碎枝废料，引申为垃圾、废弃物及破坏、丢弃等行为。

lemmas.def_en: a British peer of the highest rank
lemmas.def_zh: 公爵

examples.en: The wealthy duke owned vast stretches of land across the northern countryside.
examples.zh: 这位富有的公爵在北部乡村拥有大片广袤的土地。

lemmas.def_en: the dignity or rank or position of a duke
lemmas.def_zh: 公爵领土, 公国, 公爵的地位

examples.en: He inherited the historic dukedom and all its responsibilities upon his father's death.
examples.zh: 他在父亲去世后继承了这一历史悠久的公国领地及其所有职责。

lemmas.def_zh: 公爵的, 象公爵的, 公爵领地的
lemmas.def_en: of or belonging to or suitable for a duke

examples.en: The historic ducal palace attracted thousands of eager tourists to the town everyday.
examples.zh: 这座历史悠久的公爵宫殿每天吸引成千上万名热切的游客前来。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 dux（领袖、统帅），演变为欧洲贵族等级中仅次于国王的高级爵位。

lemmas.def_en: the posterior part of the body of a vertebrate especially when elongated and extending beyond the trunk or main part of the body
lemmas.def_zh: 尾部, 后部, 辫子, 随员, 特务, 燕尾服, 踪迹, 限定继承(权)

examples.en: The detective was hired to tail the suspect without raising any suspicion.
examples.zh: 侦探受雇在不引起任何怀疑的情况下跟踪那名嫌疑人。

lemmas.def_en: the act of following someone secretly
lemmas.def_zh: 下脚, 嵌入墙中砖石突出部, 尾料

examples.en: The environmental agency inspected the toxic tailing left behind by the abandoned mine.
examples.zh: 环保机构检查了废弃矿井留下的有毒尾矿残留物。

lemmas.def_en: go after with the intent to catch
lemmas.def_zh: 为...装尾, 附于其后, 尾随, 使搭牢, 跟踪, 监视；跟踪, 船尾搁浅

examples.en: The detective was hired to tail the suspect without raising any suspicion.
examples.zh: 侦探受雇在不引起任何怀疑的情况下跟踪那名嫌疑人。

lemmas.def_en: not having a tail
lemmas.def_zh: 无尾的

examples.en: The Manx cat is a distinct domestic breed known for being completely tailless.
examples.zh: 曼岛猫是一种独特的家猫品种，以完全没有尾巴而闻名。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 tægl，本义为动物身体末端的尾巴，引申为尾部、末端及像尾巴一样尾随跟踪。

lemmas.def_en: examine minutely or intensely
lemmas.def_zh: 细看, 浏览, 扫描, 详细调查, 标出格律；押韵, 扫描

examples.en: The doctor arranged a quick scan to determine the full extent of her injury.
examples.zh: 医生安排了一次快速扫描，以确定她受伤的具体程度。

lemmas.def_en: the act of scanning; systematic examination of a prescribed region
lemmas.def_zh: 审视, 浏览, 扫描, 细查

examples.en: The doctor arranged a quick scan to determine the full extent of her injury.
examples.zh: 医生安排了一次快速扫描，以确定她受伤的具体程度。

lemmas.def_en: someone who scans verse to determine the number and prosodic value of the syllables
lemmas.def_zh: 扫描仪, 扫描盘, 审视者

examples.en: Please place your passport flat on the scanner so it can be verified.
examples.zh: 请将护照平放在扫描仪上，以便系统进行核验。

lemmas.def_en: analysis of verse into metrical patterns
lemmas.def_zh: 韵律分析

examples.en: The professor asked the students to perform a scansion of the Shakespearean sonnet.
examples.zh: 教授要求学生们对这首莎士比亚十四行诗进行韵律分析。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 scandere（攀爬、按韵律朗读），语义经由“仔细按音步分析诗句”发展为“细看”，现代技术中引申为“快速浏览”与“电子扫描”。
family_guide.core_distinction: scanner 指扫描硬件设备或执行扫描的人，不可与抽象动作 scan 混淆。

lemmas.def_en: a person or animal that is markedly unusual or deformed
lemmas.def_zh: 畸形人, 畸形物, 不正常的事物, 反复无常

examples.en: Don't freak out when you see the final bill; I can explain everything.
examples.zh: 看到最终账单时别惊慌，我可以解释这一切。

lemmas.def_en: lose one's nerve

examples.en: Don't freak out when you see the final bill; I can explain everything.
examples.zh: 看到最终账单时别惊慌，我可以解释这一切。

family_guide.root_logic: 词源不明，可能与反复无常或奇异斑纹有关，现代核心语义指向“反常的怪人怪事”或由反常引发的“极度情绪失控”。

lemmas.def_en: a precious or semiprecious stone incorporated into a piece of jewelry
lemmas.def_zh: 珠宝, 贵重物, 镶珠宝的饰物

examples.en: The artisan carefully jewel the golden crown with rare emeralds and polished sapphires.
examples.zh: 工匠用罕见的祖母绿和抛光的蓝宝石精心为金冠镶嵌宝石。

lemmas.def_en: an adornment (as a bracelet or ring or necklace) made of precious metals and set with gems (or imitation gems)
lemmas.def_zh: 珠宝, 珠宝类

examples.en: She prefers simple silver jewelry rather than heavy, flashy gold necklaces and rings.
examples.zh: 相比沉重俗气的金项链和戒指，她更喜欢简约的银饰。

lemmas.def_en: someone who makes jewelry
lemmas.def_zh: 宝石商, 宝石匠, 珠宝商

examples.en: The local jeweler carefully examined the diamond ring through his small magnifying loupe.
examples.zh: 当地的珠宝商通过他的小型放大镜仔细检查了那枚钻戒。

lemmas.def_en: someone who makes jewelry
lemmas.def_zh: 宝石商, 宝石匠, 珠宝商

examples.en: We took the vintage watch to a certified jeweller to replace its battery.
examples.zh: 我们把这块老式手表送到了一位持有认证的珠宝商那里更换电池。

lemmas.def_en: adorn or decorate with precious stones
lemmas.def_zh: 饰以珠宝, 镶以宝石

examples.en: The artisan carefully jewel the golden crown with rare emeralds and polished sapphires.
examples.zh: 工匠用罕见的祖母绿和抛光的蓝宝石精心为金冠镶嵌宝石。

lemmas.def_zh: adj. 镶有宝石的；佩戴珠宝的
lemmas.def_en: decorated or adorned with jewels
lemmas.usage_note: 常用于描述饰品、武器或奢华衣物，英式拼写常为 jewelled。

examples.en: The queen wore a richly jeweled crown during the ceremony.
examples.zh: 女王在仪式上佩戴了一顶镶满璀璨宝石的王冠。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 jocus（玩笑、游戏），经古法语转变为表示“小玩意、珍贵饰物”，核心指贵重宝石。
family_guide.core_distinction: jewel 是可数名词，指单颗宝石；jewelry 是不可数集合名词，泛指珠宝首饰总称。

lemmas.def_en: gather
lemmas.def_zh: 重整旗鼓, 集合, 恢复精神, 团结, 挖苦, 嘲笑

examples.en: The community decided to rally behind the local library to prevent its sudden closure.
examples.zh: 社区决定团结起来支持当地图书馆，防止其突然关闭。

lemmas.def_en: a large gathering of people intended to arouse enthusiasm
lemmas.def_zh: 重振旗鼓, 集合, 群众集会, 跌停回升

examples.en: Thousands of supporters gathered downtown for the political rally on Saturday morning.
examples.zh: 周六上午，数千名支持者聚集在市中心参加政治集会。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古法语 ralier（重新聚集），核心意象是将分散的力量再次集合起来，引申为集会、重振旗鼓与行情回升。

lemmas.def_en: bypass
lemmas.def_zh: 跳越, 跳读, 跳绳, 遗漏, 跳级；跳过, 遗漏

examples.en: You can skip the introductory chapter if you already understand the basics.
examples.zh: 如果你已经掌握了基础知识，可以跳过介绍章节。

lemmas.def_en: work as the skipper on a vessel

examples.en: He was hired to skipper a luxury yacht across the Mediterranean Sea.
examples.zh: 他受雇担任一艘穿越地中海的豪华游艇的船长。

lemmas.def_en: a student who fails to attend classes
lemmas.def_zh: 船长, 机长, 队长

examples.en: He was hired to skipper a luxury yacht across the Mediterranean Sea.
examples.zh: 他受雇担任一艘穿越地中海的豪华游艇的船长。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古诺斯语 skopa（轻跳、奔跑），核心动作是“轻快跳跃”，由此自然引申出“跳过中途某一步直接往前”。
family_guide.core_distinction: skip 为跳跃或跳过；skipper 则源自中低地德语，特指船长或领队。

lemmas.def_en: the audible part of a transmitted signal
lemmas.def_zh: [电] 声频

examples.en: The video quality was excellent, but the audio had noticeable background static.
examples.zh: 视频画质极佳，但音频有明显的背景杂音。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 audire（听），现代英语中作为词根或独立词专指声音的录制、传输与播放系统。

lemmas.def_en: beyond or deviating from the usual or expected
lemmas.def_zh: 好奇的, 求知的, 古怪的

examples.en: The curious child peeked through the keyhole to see what was happening.
examples.zh: 那个好奇的孩子透过钥匙孔窥探究竟发生了什么。

lemmas.def_en: showing curiosity
lemmas.def_zh: 好问的, 想知道的, 好追根究底的

examples.en: The inquisitive student raised her hand to ask several perceptive questions about the text.
examples.zh: 那个好学深思的学生举手，就课文提了几个深刻的问题。

lemmas.def_en: in a manner differing from the usual or expected
lemmas.def_zh: 好奇地

examples.en: She examined the ancient artifact curiously before showing it to her colleagues.
examples.zh: 在把这件古代文物给同事看之前，她好奇地端详着它。

lemmas.def_en: with curiosity
lemmas.def_zh: 过分好奇地; 好问地

examples.en: The puppy tilted its head and stared inquisitively at the strange mechanical toy.
examples.zh: 小狗歪着头，好奇地盯着那个奇怪的机械玩具。

lemmas.def_en: in an inquiring manner
lemmas.def_zh: 探询地；好奇地

examples.en: She raised an eyebrow inquiringly when her colleague suddenly walked in late.
examples.zh: 当同事突然迟到走进来时，她探询地挑了挑眉毛。

lemmas.def_en: a search for knowledge
lemmas.def_zh: 询问；调查

examples.en: The government launched a public inquiry into the cause of the rail accident.
examples.zh: 政府对那起铁路事故的原因展开了公开调查。

lemmas.def_en: a state in which you want to learn more about something
lemmas.def_zh: 好奇心；罕见而新奇的事物

examples.en: Children are driven by natural curiosity to explore the world around them.
examples.zh: 孩子们受天生好奇心的驱使去探索周围的世界。

lemmas.def_en: someone who asks a question
lemmas.def_zh: 询问者, 探究者, 调查者

examples.en: The receptionist politely directed every inquirer to the customer service desk down the hall.
examples.zh: 前台接待员礼貌地引导每一位询问者前往走廊尽头的客服台。

lemmas.def_en: a state of active curiosity
lemmas.def_zh: 好奇, 求知欲

examples.en: Her natural inquisitiveness drove her to explore the hidden corners of the old library.
examples.zh: 她天生的求知欲驱使她去探索这座古老图书馆的隐秘角落。

lemmas.def_en: inquire about
lemmas.def_zh: v. 询问，打听；调查

examples.en: I called the hotel to inquire about the room rates.
examples.zh: 我打电话给酒店询问房间价格。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 cura（关心、照料），经“过分关注”演变为现代的“好奇的”或因少见而令人“奇特的”。

lemmas.def_en: the back of a military formation or procession
lemmas.def_zh: 后面, 背后, 后方

examples.en: The peaceful garden is located at the rear of the main house.
examples.zh: 幽静的花园位于主房屋的后方。

lemmas.def_en: stand up on the hind legs, of quadrupeds
lemmas.def_zh: 养育, 培养, 饲养, 举起, 树立, 栽种；高耸, 暴跳

examples.en: The peaceful garden is located at the rear of the main house.
examples.zh: 幽静的花园位于主房屋的后方。

family_guide.root_logic: 多源词：作名词指“后方”（源自古法语 rere/拉丁语 retro）；作动词指“抚养、直立”（源自古英语 ræran，与 raise 同源）。

lemmas.def_en: flow off gradually
lemmas.def_zh: 排出, 喝光, 耗尽；排水, 流干

examples.en: The long and difficult project threatened to drain all our remaining financial resources.
examples.zh: 这项艰巨而漫长的工程恐将耗尽我们剩余的所有资金。

lemmas.def_en: emptying something accomplished by allowing liquid to run out of it
lemmas.def_zh: 排水

examples.en: Poor drainage caused the soccer field to flood heavily after the storm.
examples.zh: 暴雨过后，不良的排水设施导致足球场严重积水。

lemmas.def_en: not drained
lemmas.def_zh: 未排水的, 不排水的, 没有水流的

examples.en: The undrained swamp land became a breeding ground for thousands of mosquitoes.
examples.zh: 那片未排水的沼泽地成了成千上万蚊子的滋生地。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 drehnigean（吸出液体），核心指液体慢慢流尽的过程，引申为能量、财富等资源的消耗与排尽。
family_guide.core_distinction: drain 为动作或排水管本身；drainage 指抽象的“排水系统”或“排水过程”。

lemmas.def_en: any final competition to determine a championship
lemmas.def_zh: n. 季后赛；附加赛；决赛

examples.en: The team secured a spot in the playoffs after last night's victory.
examples.zh: 昨晚获胜后，该队锁定了季后赛席位。

family_guide.root_logic: 由 play（比赛）与 off（分出结果）组合而成，核心指通过附加比赛一决胜负。

lemmas.def_en: a science (or group of related sciences) dealing with the logic of quantity and shape and arrangement
lemmas.def_zh: n. 数学；数学运算

examples.en: Mathematics is essential for understanding physics and computer science.
examples.zh: 数学对于理解物理学和计算机科学至关重要。

lemmas.def_en: a person skilled in mathematics
lemmas.def_zh: 数学家

examples.en: The brilliant mathematician spent over a decade trying to solve the complex equation.
examples.zh: 这位才华横溢的数学家花了十多年时间试图解开这个复杂的方程。

lemmas.def_en: of or pertaining to or of the nature of mathematics
lemmas.def_zh: adj. 数学的；精确的

examples.en: He solved the problem using a complex mathematical model.
examples.zh: 他利用复杂的数学模型解决了这个问题。

lemmas.def_en: with respect to mathematics
lemmas.def_zh: 算术地

examples.en: His strategy was mathematically sound, but it failed completely in real life.
examples.zh: 他的策略在数学计算上无懈可击，但在现实中却彻底落空。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 manthanein（学习、求知），引申为以逻辑推理研究数与形的学科。
family_guide.core_distinction: mathematics 为名词（数学学科）；mathematical 为形容词（数学的、精确的）。

lemmas.def_en: associated with civil life or performed by persons who are not active members of the military
lemmas.def_zh: adj. 平民的；民用的 /

examples.en: The bomb caused extensive damage to civilian infrastructure.
examples.zh: 炸弹对民用基础设施造成了广泛破坏。

lemmas.def_en: a nonmilitary citizen
lemmas.def_zh: n. 平民；老百姓

examples.en: The bomb caused extensive damage to civilian infrastructure.
examples.zh: 炸弹对民用基础设施造成了广泛破坏。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 civilis（公民的），原指市民，后引申为与军人或警察相对的平民身份。
family_guide.core_distinction: civilian 可作形容词或名词，词形不变，均指平民的或平民本身。

lemmas.def_en: an analytic or interpretive literary composition
lemmas.def_zh: n. 随笔；短论 /

examples.en: She wrote a brilliant essay on climate change.
examples.zh: 她写了一篇关于气候变化的精彩文章。

lemmas.def_en: a writer of literary works
lemmas.def_zh: 随笔作家, 评论家

examples.en: The famous essayist published several thoughtful pieces on modern society and politics.
examples.zh: 这位著名的随笔作家发表了几篇关于现代社会与政治的深刻文章。

lemmas.def_en: make an effort or attempt
lemmas.def_zh: v. 尝试；企图

examples.en: She wrote a brilliant essay on climate change.
examples.zh: 她写了一篇关于气候变化的精彩文章。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 exagium（称量、权衡），演变为法语 essayer（尝试），引申为尝试表达观点的小品文或做出尝试。
family_guide.core_distinction: 作名词指随笔、短文；作动词为书面语，表示尝试或企图。

lemmas.def_en: be excessively hot
lemmas.def_zh: v. 油炸；油煎

examples.en: Fry the onions in a little olive oil until they are golden brown.
examples.zh: 用少量橄榄油将洋葱煎至金黄色。

lemmas.def_en: flesh of a medium-sized young chicken suitable for frying
lemmas.def_zh: 做油煎食物的人, 可供油炸的食品, 油炸锅

examples.en: Drop the seasoned chicken wings into the air fryer for ten minutes.
examples.zh: 将腌好的鸡翅放进空气炸锅里炸十分钟。

lemmas.def_en: flesh of a medium-sized young chicken suitable for frying
lemmas.def_zh: 做油炸食品的人, 煎锅

examples.en: He poured fresh vegetable oil into the frier before cooking the crispy chips.
examples.zh: 他在炸脆薯条之前往炸锅里倒了新鲜植物油。

lemmas.def_zh: adj. 油炸的；油煎的
lemmas.def_en: cooked in hot oil or fat
lemmas.usage_note: 常用于食物搭配，如 fried rice（炒饭）、fried chicken（炸鸡）。

examples.en: He ordered fried fish and chips for lunch.
examples.zh: 他午餐点了炸鱼加薯条。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 frigere（油煎、烘炒），指通过热油加热烹饪食物。

lemmas.def_en: (psychiatry) a relatively permanent state of worry and nervousness occurring in a variety of mental disorders, usually accompanied by compulsive behavior or attacks of panic
lemmas.def_zh: n. 焦虑；忧虑；渴望

examples.en: Waiting for the medical results caused her a great deal of anxiety.
examples.zh: 等待体检结果让她感到非常焦虑。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 angere（勒紧、使痛苦），形容内心被担忧束缚抽紧的焦虑状态。

lemmas.def_en: found in the ordinary course of events; ; ; - Anita Diamant
lemmas.def_zh: adj. 日常的；平常的；平凡的

examples.en: The app is designed to help users manage their everyday tasks.
examples.zh: 该应用程序旨在帮助用户管理日常任务。

lemmas.def_en: ordinariness as a consequence of being frequent and commonplace
lemmas.def_zh: 平淡无奇

examples.en: The gentle novel finds quiet beauty in the mundane everydayness of village life.
examples.zh: 这部温情的小说在乡村生活的平淡无奇中发现了宁静之美。

family_guide.root_logic: 由 every（每个）和 day（天）合写而成，专作定语，表示每天发生的或普通的。
family_guide.core_distinction: 注意 everyday 为形容词（日常的），与副词短语 every day（每天）不同。

lemmas.def_en: move deeply
lemmas.def_zh: v. 打扰；扰乱；使不安

examples.en: Please do not disturb him while he is focusing on his work.
examples.zh: 他专心工作时请不要打扰他。

lemmas.def_en: activity that is a malfunction, intrusion, or interruption
lemmas.def_zh: n. 骚乱；干扰；混乱

examples.en: The noise caused a serious disturbance in the neighborhood.
examples.zh: 噪音在社区内引起了严重的骚扰。

lemmas.def_en: untroubled by interference or disturbance
lemmas.def_zh: 未被扰乱的, 安静的, 镇定的

examples.en: She left the thick dust undisturbed on the ancient wooden desk for years.
examples.zh: 多年来，她一直没有碰旧木桌上那层厚厚的灰尘。

lemmas.def_en: in a disturbing manner
lemmas.def_zh: 动摇地；令人不安地

examples.en: The local river water levels dropped disturbingly fast during the unusually dry summer.
examples.zh: 在异常干旱的夏季，当地河流水位下降得令人不安。

family_guide.root_logic: 由 dis-（完全地）+ turbare（搅乱，源自 turba 骚乱）构成，核心概念是扰乱原有的平静。
family_guide.core_distinction: disturb 为动词（打扰）；disturbance 为名词（打扰、骚乱）。

lemmas.def_en: the preservation of mental and physical health by preventing or treating illness through services offered by the health profession
lemmas.def_zh: n. 医疗保健；医疗服务

examples.en: Access to quality healthcare should be a fundamental human right.
examples.zh: 获得优质医疗服务应当是一项基本人权。

family_guide.root_logic: 复合词 health（健康）+ care（照料），字面即“对健康的护理”，引申为医疗卫生保健体系。

lemmas.def_en: for a short time
lemmas.def_zh: adv. 不久；很快；简短地

examples.en: The plane will be landing shortly, so please fasten your seatbelts.
examples.zh: 飞机即将降落，请系好安全带。

family_guide.root_logic: 形容词 short（短的）加副词后缀 -ly，由空间或长度的短引申为时间跨度极短。

lemmas.def_en: the basic structure or features of a system or organization
lemmas.def_zh: n. 基础设施；公共建设

examples.en: The government plans to invest heavily in public transport infrastructure.
examples.zh: 政府计划大力投资公共交通基础设施。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 infra-（在下面，基础）+ structure（结构、建筑物），指支撑社会或系统运转的底层基础结构。

lemmas.def_en: final product; the things produced
lemmas.def_zh: n. 产量；输出；产出 /

examples.en: Industrial output increased by five percent this quarter.
examples.zh: 本季度工业产值增长了百分之五。

lemmas.def_en: to create or manufacture a specific amount
lemmas.def_zh: v. 输出（数据、信号等）

examples.en: Industrial output increased by five percent this quarter.
examples.zh: 本季度工业产值增长了百分之五。

family_guide.root_logic: 复合词 out（向外）+ put（放置），字面即“产出到外面”，指生产出来的数量或机器给出的数据。
family_guide.core_distinction: output 兼具名词和动词用法，过去式常同形。

lemmas.def_en: obscene terms for feces
lemmas.def_zh: n. 废话；胡说；垃圾 /

examples.en: Don't believe a word he says; it's all complete crap.
examples.zh: 别信他的鬼话，全是一派胡言。

lemmas.def_en: a plumbing fixture for defecation and urination
lemmas.def_zh: <鄙>厕所

examples.en: He hurried down the noisy hallway looking for the nearest crapper before boarding.
examples.zh: 登机前，他匆匆穿过喧闹的走廊寻找最近的厕所。

lemmas.def_en: very bad
lemmas.def_zh: adj. 糟糕的；劣质的

examples.en: I felt really crappy yesterday after catching a cold.
examples.zh: 昨天感冒后我感觉糟糕透了。

lemmas.def_en: have a bowel movement
lemmas.def_zh: v. 排便；拉屎

examples.en: Don't believe a word he says; it's all complete crap.
examples.zh: 别信他的鬼话，全是一派胡言。

family_guide.root_logic: 俚语词汇，原指排泄物，现代口语中泛指废话、劣质物品或倒霉事。
family_guide.core_distinction: crap 为名词（废话/垃圾）或动词；crappy 为派生形容词（糟糕的、劣质的）。

lemmas.def_en: leaping insect; male makes chirping noises by rubbing the forewings together
lemmas.def_zh: 蟋蟀, 板球

examples.en: We sat outside on the porch listening to a solitary cricket in the dark.
examples.zh: 我们坐在门廊外面，听着黑暗中一只孤单的蟋蟀鸣叫。

lemmas.def_en: an athlete who plays cricket
lemmas.def_zh: 板球队员, 玩板球者

examples.en: The talented young cricketer scored fifty runs in his international debut match yesterday.
examples.zh: 这位才华横溢的年轻板球手在昨天的国际首秀中拿下了五十分。

lemmas.def_en: play cricket

examples.en: We sat outside on the porch listening to a solitary cricket in the dark.
examples.zh: 我们坐在门廊外面，听着黑暗中一只孤单的蟋蟀鸣叫。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古法语，指蟋蟀（拟声）或板球运动（源自曲棍棒词根）。

lemmas.def_en: force somebody to do something
lemmas.def_zh: 强制, 施恩惠于, 使感激；施恩惠, 帮忙

examples.en: The polite librarian was more than happy to oblige when we asked for help.
examples.zh: 当我们请求帮助时，那位有礼貌的图书管理员非常乐意效劳。

lemmas.def_zh: 使负义务, 强使, 使感激, 施恩惠于
lemmas.def_en: force somebody to do something

examples.en: This contract does not obligate you to purchase any additional services later.
examples.zh: 该合同并不强求你日后购买任何额外服务。

lemmas.def_en: the social force that binds you to the courses of action demanded by that force; ; - John D.Rockefeller Jr
lemmas.def_zh: 义务, 责任, 约束, 契约, 恩惠, 债务

examples.en: Citizens feel a strong civic obligation to vote in every local municipal election.
examples.zh: 公民感到在每次地方市政选举中投票是一项强烈的公民义务。

lemmas.def_en: in accommodation
lemmas.def_zh: 亲切地

examples.en: The friendly taxi driver obligingly carried the heavy suitcases to our hotel door.
examples.zh: 热心的出租车司机热情地帮我们把沉重的行李箱提到酒店门口。

lemmas.def_zh: 未指定用途的, 无义务的
lemmas.def_en: not obligated

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 ligare（捆绑），引申为用道德、法律或恩惠来约束。
family_guide.core_distinction: oblige 强调迫使或施恩惠；obligation 强调法律或道义上的责任、义务。

lemmas.def_en: an expression consisting of one or more words forming a grammatical constituent of a sentence
lemmas.def_zh: 惯用语, 词组, 成语, 措词, 乐句

examples.en: You need to phrase your polite refusal carefully so nobody feels personally offended.
examples.zh: 你需要谨慎措辞来表达委婉的拒绝，以免冒犯到任何人。

lemmas.def_en: put into words or an expression
lemmas.def_zh: 用短语表达, 把(乐曲)分成短句

examples.en: You need to phrase your polite refusal carefully so nobody feels personally offended.
examples.zh: 你需要谨慎措辞来表达委婉的拒绝，以免冒犯到任何人。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to or functioning as a phrase
lemmas.def_zh: (含有)短语的, 成语的, 惯用语的, 用语上的, 乐句的

examples.en: Learning common phrasal verbs helps foreign students sound much more natural in conversation.
examples.zh: 学习常见的短语动词有助于外国学生在交谈中听起来更自然。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 phrazein（表达、诉说），指组织语言来表意。

lemmas.def_en: possessing or displaying courage; able to face and deal with danger or fear without flinching; - Herman Melville; - William Wordsworth
lemmas.def_zh: 勇敢的, 美好的, 华丽的

examples.en: Several firefighters made a brave rescue of the stranded family from the flood.
examples.zh: 几名消防员英勇地将受困的一家人从洪水中解救出来。

lemmas.def_en: face and withstand with courage
lemmas.def_zh: 勇敢地面对

examples.en: Several firefighters made a brave rescue of the stranded family from the flood.
examples.zh: 几名消防员英勇地将受困的一家人从洪水中解救出来。

lemmas.def_en: in a courageous manner
lemmas.def_zh: 勇敢地

examples.en: The young soldier bravely stood his ground despite the overwhelming enemy forces ahead.
examples.zh: 尽管面对压倒性的敌军，这位年轻士兵依然勇敢地坚守阵地。

lemmas.def_en: a quality of spirit that enables you to face danger or pain without showing fear
lemmas.def_zh: 勇敢, 华饰, 华丽

examples.en: The medal recognized her extraordinary braveness during the sudden downtown building collapse.
examples.zh: 这枚奖章表彰了她在市中心突发楼房倒塌事故中所表现出的非凡英勇。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自罗曼语族，原本指野蛮、勇猛，后演变为指无所畏惧。

lemmas.def_en: a piece of furniture with a writing surface and usually drawers or other compartments
lemmas.def_zh: 书桌, 办公桌, 工作台

examples.en: She neatly arranged her scattered papers before leaving her office desk tonight.
examples.zh: 今晚离开办公桌前，她把散落的文件整理得整整齐齐。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自中世纪拉丁语 desca（桌子），同源于 disc（圆盘），专指用于读写办公的桌台。

lemmas.def_en: well grounded in logic or truth or having legal force
lemmas.def_zh: 有确实根据的, 有法律效力的, 正当的, 正确的

examples.en: You must present a valid passport when passing through the international border control.
examples.zh: 通过国际边检站时，你必须出示有效护照。

lemmas.def_en: the quality of being valid and rigorous
lemmas.def_zh: 有效性, 正确性

examples.en: The committee questioned the legal validity of the contract signed without proper witnesses.
examples.zh: 委员会对在没有合适见证人情况下签署的合同的法律效力提出了质疑。

lemmas.def_en: with validity; in a valid manner
lemmas.def_zh: 有根据地, 正当地, 有效验地

examples.en: The committee validly determined the winner based on the contest's strict official rules.
examples.zh: 委员会根据比赛严格的官方规则正当地确定了获胜者。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 valere（强壮、有力量、有价值），引申为法律或逻辑上有效力。
family_guide.core_distinction: valid 为形容词（有效的、有说服力的）；validity 为名词（有效性、正确性）。

lemmas.def_en: sharply exact or accurate or delimited
lemmas.def_zh: 精确的, 严谨的, 明确的

examples.en: The scientist gave precise instructions on how to conduct the chemical experiment.
examples.zh: 这位科学家就如何进行化学实验给出了精确的指导。

lemmas.def_en: indicating exactness or preciseness
lemmas.def_zh: 精确地, 明确地, 刻板地, 拘泥地, 正好, 恰恰, 对, 正是如此, 确实如此, 不错

examples.en: The morning train arrived at the station at precisely eight o'clock today.
examples.zh: 今天早班火车恰好在八点整准时进站。

lemmas.def_en: clarity as a consequence of precision
lemmas.def_zh: 正确, 严谨, 古板

examples.en: Her work was always praised for its incredible preciseness and neatness.
examples.zh: 她的工作总是因其极高的严谨度和整洁度受到赞扬。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 praecidere（预先切断、削减），指切除多余部分达到精确。
family_guide.core_distinction: precise 为形容词表示精确无误；precisely 为副词表示精确地或恰好如此。

lemmas.def_en: coldness due to a cold environment
lemmas.def_zh: 寒冷, 寒意, 失意

examples.en: There was an autumn chill in the air as we walked outside.
examples.zh: 我们走到室外时，空气中已有一丝秋日的寒意。

lemmas.def_en: very hot and finely tapering pepper of special pungency
lemmas.def_zh: [建] 番椒, 冷

examples.en: The morning breeze felt chilly, so he zipped up his warm jacket.
examples.zh: 清晨的微风有些冷，于是他拉上了暖和的外套拉链。

lemmas.def_en: very hot and finely tapering pepper of special pungency
lemmas.def_zh: 红辣椒

examples.en: He added some chopped red chilli to give the soup extra flavor.
examples.zh: 他在汤里加了些切碎的红辣椒来增添风味。

lemmas.def_en: the property of being moderately cold
lemmas.def_zh: 寒气, 寒冷, 严寒

examples.en: The sudden chilliness in the room made everyone want to leave early.
examples.zh: 房间里突然泛起的寒意让所有人都想早点离开。

lemmas.def_en: depress or discourage
lemmas.def_zh: 使寒心, 冷冻；变冷

examples.en: There was an autumn chill in the air as we walked outside.
examples.zh: 我们走到室外时，空气中已有一丝秋日的寒意。

lemmas.def_zh: adj. 令人毛骨悚然的；令人胆寒的
lemmas.def_en: frightening, especially because it is connected with violence or danger
lemmas.usage_note: 常修饰 story, effect, reminder 等，强调心理上的恐惧或寒意。

examples.en: The documentary gave a chilling account of the serial killer's crimes.
examples.zh: 这部纪录片对连环杀手的罪行进行了令人毛骨悚然的叙述。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 cele（寒冷），引申为冷意、放松或使变冷。
family_guide.core_distinction: chill 可作名词（寒气）或动词（变冷、放松）；chilly 主要作形容词，罕用为名词（指寒冷）。

lemmas.def_en: get temporarily
lemmas.def_zh: 借, 借入, 借用；借

examples.en: Can I borrow your pencil for a minute to write this down?
examples.zh: 我能借你的铅笔用一下把这个记下来吗？

lemmas.def_en: the appropriation (of ideas or words etc) from another source
lemmas.def_zh: [经] 借款, 贷款

examples.en: The company increased its borrowing to fund the expensive new construction project.
examples.zh: 该公司增加了借款，以资助昂贵的新建设项目。

lemmas.def_en: someone who receives something on the promise to return it or its equivalent
lemmas.def_zh: 借用人, 剽窃者

examples.en: The bank carefully reviewed the borrower's credit score before approving the loan.
examples.zh: 银行在批准贷款前仔细审查了借款人的信用评分。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 borgian（以担保物借取），指临时借用属于他人的物品。
family_guide.core_distinction: borrow 为动词；borrowing 为其名词形式，指借贷行为、借款或借用词。

lemmas.def_en: a waterproof raincoat made of rubberized fabric
lemmas.def_zh: 防水胶布, (英)雨衣, 老兄, 老弟

examples.en: Don't forget to take your mac, as rain is forecast today.
examples.zh: 别忘了带上你的雨衣，因为今天预报有雨。

family_guide.root_logic: Mackintosh 的缩写，源自苏格兰发明家 Charles Macintosh 的名字，代指防水风衣。

lemmas.def_en: a group or class of persons enjoying superior intellectual or social or economic status
lemmas.def_zh: 精华, 精锐, 中坚分子

examples.en: Only the top athletes in the country are invited to this elite training.
examples.zh: 全国只有顶尖的运动员才会被邀请参加这项精英集训。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 eligere（挑选），经古法语转入英语，指社会或群体中被挑拔出的佼佼者。

lemmas.def_en: a cutting or thrusting weapon that has a long metal blade and a hilt with a hand guard
lemmas.def_zh: 刀, 剑, 战争, 武力, 剑状物

examples.en: The museum displays an ancient steel sword used by a legendary knight.
examples.zh: 该博物馆展出了一把传奇骑士曾使用过的古老钢剑。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自原始日耳曼语 swerdam，本义为伤害或切割，专指双刃长兵器。

lemmas.def_en: cooking utensil consisting of a wide metal vessel
lemmas.def_zh: 平锅, 浅盘, 盆地, 硬土层, 拍摄全景

examples.en: Heat some olive oil in a large pan over medium cooking heat.
examples.zh: 在中火加热的大平底锅中倒入一些橄榄油。

lemmas.def_en: make a sweeping movement
lemmas.def_zh: 上下左右移动, 摇镜头, 淘洗, 淘金

examples.en: Heat some olive oil in a large pan over medium cooking heat.
examples.zh: 在中火加热的大平底锅中倒入一些橄榄油。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语平底容器，引申出全景平移摄影及严厉批评（淘金洗滤杂质）之义。

lemmas.def_en: Italian open pie made of thin bread dough spread with a spiced mixture of e.g. tomato sauce and cheese
lemmas.def_zh: 比萨饼

examples.en: We ordered a large cheese pizza to celebrate the team's weekend victory.
examples.zh: 我们点了一份大号芝士比萨，以庆祝队伍在周末的胜利。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自意大利语，本义为发酵烘烤的面饼，现指比萨饼。

lemmas.def_en: displeasing to the senses
lemmas.def_zh: 丑陋的, 邪恶的, 险恶的, 不祥的

examples.en: They decided to tear down that ugly old wall near the garden.
examples.zh: 他们决定拆除花园附近那堵难看的老墙。

lemmas.def_en: qualities of appearance that do not give pleasure to the senses
lemmas.def_zh: 丑陋

examples.en: The sheer ugliness of the concrete building ruined the beautiful natural landscape.
examples.zh: 那栋混凝土建筑的丑陋外观破坏了美丽的自然风景。

lemmas.def_en: large sweet juicy hybrid between tangerine and grapefruit having a thick wrinkled skin
lemmas.def_zh: 牙买加丑橘（商标名称）

examples.en: She tried an ugli fruit for breakfast and enjoyed its sweet taste.
examples.zh: 她早餐尝了一个牙买加丑橘，很喜欢它清甜的味道。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古诺斯语 uggligr（可怕的），引申为外表丑陋、令人不快的。

lemmas.def_en: a subordinate or subsidiary associate; a person who is affiliated with another or with an organization

examples.en: The local hospital is an affiliate of a major national medical network.
examples.zh: 这家当地医院是全国一家大型医疗网络的附属机构。

lemmas.def_en: a social or business relationship
lemmas.def_zh: 联系, 从属关系

examples.en: She declared no formal political affiliation during the local council election.
examples.zh: 在地方议会选举期间，她声明自己没有任何正式的政治从属关系。

lemmas.def_en: keep company with; hang out with
lemmas.def_zh: 使紧密联系, 使附属, 接纳, 收养；发生联系, 参加

examples.en: The local hospital is an affiliate of a major national medical network.
examples.zh: 这家当地医院是全国一家大型医疗网络的附属机构。

lemmas.def_en: not affiliated
lemmas.def_zh: 无党派, 无组织的

examples.en: Several unaffiliated voters decided to back the independent candidate this year.
examples.zh: 几位无党派选民决定今年支持那位独立候选人。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 ad-（去）+ 词根 fili-（儿子），本义为收作养子，引申为使隶属、建立分支联系。
family_guide.core_distinction: affiliate 作名词指附属机构/会员；affiliation 指从属关系或所属阵营。

lemmas.def_en: be agreeable or acceptable to
lemmas.def_zh: 使适应, 调和, 通融, 容纳, 向...提供；适应

examples.en: The new conference hall can easily accommodate up to five hundred guests.
examples.zh: 这个新会议厅可以轻松容纳多达五百名宾客。

lemmas.def_en: making or becoming suitable; adjusting to circumstances
lemmas.def_zh: 膳宿, 预订铺位, 适应性调节, 调和, 贷款

examples.en: The travel package includes hotel accommodation and breakfast for three nights.
examples.zh: 该旅行套餐包含三晚的酒店住宿及早餐。

lemmas.def_en: helpful in bringing about a harmonious adaptation
lemmas.def_zh: 予以方便的, 肯通融的

examples.en: The central bank maintained an accommodative monetary policy to support growth.
examples.zh: 央行维持宽松的货币政策以支持经济增长。

lemmas.def_en: not accommodating
lemmas.def_zh: 不乐于助人的, 不随和的

examples.en: The hotel manager was unaccommodating when we asked for a later checkout.
examples.zh: 当我们要求延迟退房时，酒店经理显得很不通情达理。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 ad-（使）+ commod-（适宜），核心逻辑是“使适合”，引申为提供住宿、适应需求或容纳。

lemmas.def_en: socially or conventionally correct; refined or virtuous
lemmas.def_zh: 有分寸的, 得体的, 大方的

examples.en: Finding a decent apartment at an affordable price is quite difficult here.
examples.zh: 在这里找到一套租金适中且像样的公寓相当困难。

lemmas.def_en: the quality of conforming to standards of propriety and morality
lemmas.def_zh: 得体, 礼貌, 正派

examples.en: He did not even have the common decency to apologize for his mistake.
examples.zh: 他甚至连为自己的错误道歉的基本礼貌都没有。

lemmas.def_en: in a decent manner
lemmas.def_zh: 合适地；高雅地；正派地；亲切地

examples.en: All employees deserve to be treated decently and paid a fair wage.
examples.zh: 所有员工都应当受到得体的对待并获得合理的报酬。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 decere（适合、体面），表示合乎道德礼仪或达到相当水准。

lemmas.def_en: based on racial intolerance
lemmas.def_zh: [法] 种族主义的, 种族歧视

examples.en: The company fired the executive after he made unacceptable racist comments online.
examples.zh: 该高管在网上发表了不可接受的种族主义言论后被公司解雇。

lemmas.def_en: a person with a prejudiced belief that one race is superior to others
lemmas.def_zh: 种族主义者

examples.en: The company fired the executive after he made unacceptable racist comments online.
examples.zh: 该高管在网上发表了不可接受的种族主义言论后被公司解雇。

lemmas.def_en: the prejudice that members of one race are intrinsically superior to members of other races
lemmas.def_zh: 种族主义，种族歧视

examples.en: The organization is dedicated to eradicating all forms of racism in the workplace.
examples.zh: 该机构致力于消除职场中一切形式的种族歧视。

family_guide.root_logic: 词根 race（种族）+ -ist，涉及基于种族的偏见与歧视。

lemmas.def_en: the trace of a point whose direction of motion changes
lemmas.def_zh: 曲线, 弯曲, 曲线球

examples.en: The driver slowed down as the car approached a sharp mountain curve.
examples.zh: 当汽车接近一个急转弯时，司机放慢了车速。

lemmas.def_zh: 弯曲, 曲率
lemmas.def_en: (medicine) a curving or bending; often abnormal

examples.en: The engineer carefully calculated the curvature of the highway to ensure passenger safety.
examples.zh: 工程师仔细计算了公路的曲率，以确保乘客的安全。

lemmas.def_en: turn sharply; change direction abruptly
lemmas.def_zh: 弯, 使弯曲；成曲形

examples.en: The driver slowed down as the car approached a sharp mountain curve.
examples.zh: 当汽车接近一个急转弯时，司机放慢了车速。

lemmas.def_zh: 弯曲的；曲线美的（等于curvaceous）
lemmas.def_en: having curves

examples.en: Drivers should exercise extreme caution while navigating this steep and curvy mountain road tonight.
examples.zh: 今晚司机在这条陡峭多弯的山路上行驶时应格外小心。

lemmas.def_en: having curves
lemmas.def_zh: [网络] 丰满

examples.en: We drove carefully along the curvey coastal road during the heavy rain.
examples.zh: 暴雨期间，我们在蜿蜒的沿海公路上小心驾驶。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 curvus（弯曲），指弧度、曲折形状或轨迹。

lemmas.def_en: a musical percussion instrument; usually consists of a hollow cylinder with a membrane stretched across each end
lemmas.def_zh: 鼓, 鼓声

examples.en: The traditional parade began with the rhythmic beating of a large drum.
examples.zh: 传统游行在大型鼓点富有节奏的敲击声中开始。

lemmas.def_en: someone who plays a drum
lemmas.def_zh: 鼓手, 旅行推销员

examples.en: The talented drummer set an energetic tempo for the entire rock concert.
examples.zh: 这位才华横溢的鼓手为整场摇滚音乐会定下了充满活力的节奏。

lemmas.def_en: make a rhythmic sound
lemmas.def_zh: 击鼓, 作鼓声；打鼓奏出

examples.en: The traditional parade began with the rhythmic beating of a large drum.
examples.zh: 传统游行在大型鼓点富有节奏的敲击声中开始。

family_guide.root_logic: 拟声词，模仿敲击圆筒容器发出的咚咚声，引申为鼓状物或反复灌输。

lemmas.def_en: the state of having little or no money and few or no material possessions
lemmas.def_zh: 贫穷, 贫困, 缺乏

examples.en: The charity works tirelessly to alleviate poverty in remote rural communities.
examples.zh: 该慈善机构不知疲倦地工作，以缓解偏远农村社区的贫困状况。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 pauper（贫穷），表示物质匮乏或极度欠缺的状态。

lemmas.def_en: an informal term for a father; probably derived from baby talk
lemmas.def_zh: 私人秘书, (露天)扩音系统

examples.en: The manager asked his PA to reschedule all of his afternoon meetings.
examples.zh: 经理让他的私人秘书重新安排下午的所有会议。

family_guide.root_logic: papa 的儿语缩略形式，口语中对父亲的亲昵称呼。

lemmas.def_en: in or to another place
lemmas.def_zh: 在别处

examples.en: If we cannot find suitable housing here, we will have to look elsewhere.
examples.zh: 如果我们在这里找不到合适的住房，就只得去别处看看。

family_guide.root_logic: else（其他的）+ where（地方），复合构成副词，指去别处或在别处。

lemmas.def_en: the yield from plants in a single growing season
lemmas.def_zh: 农作物, 产量, 平头

examples.en: Heavy summer rains damaged the wheat crop and reduced the overall harvest.
examples.zh: 夏季的暴雨破坏了小麦作物，导致整体收成减少。

lemmas.def_en: cut short
lemmas.def_zh: 收割, 修剪, 种植；收获

examples.en: Heavy summer rains damaged the wheat crop and reduced the overall harvest.
examples.zh: 夏季的暴雨破坏了小麦作物，导致整体收成减少。

lemmas.def_en: not used for growing crops
lemmas.def_zh: 未种植的, 无收获的, 未收割的, 未采摘的, 未修剪的, 未剪短的

examples.en: The original photograph remained uncropped so that the entire background was clearly visible.
examples.zh: 原始照片保持未裁剪状态，因此整个背景都清晰可见。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语，原指鸟的‘嗉囊’或事物的‘顶端’，后引申为顶端生长的农作物及修剪动作。

lemmas.def_en: become more focus on an area of activity or field of study
lemmas.def_zh: 使特殊化, 列举, 特别指明, 限定...的范围；成为专家, 专攻

examples.en: After finishing medical school, she plans to specialize in pediatric surgery.
examples.zh: 医学院毕业后，她计划专攻小儿外科。

lemmas.def_en: devote oneself to a special area of work
lemmas.def_zh: 特加指明, 列举, 使专门化, 限定...的范围；vi. (使)特化, (使)专化；成为专家, 专务, 专攻, 专门研究, 逐条详述

examples.en: Many law firms now specialise in intellectual property and commercial contracts.
examples.zh: 现在许多律师事务所专门从事知识产权和商业合同业务。

lemmas.def_en: an expert who is devoted to one occupation or branch of learning
lemmas.def_zh: 专门医师, 专家

examples.en: You should see an orthopedic specialist to evaluate that persistent knee pain.
examples.zh: 你应该去看骨科专家，评估一下持续的膝盖疼痛。

lemmas.def_en: the act of specializing; making something suitable for a special purpose
lemmas.def_zh: 专业化, 特殊化, 专门化

examples.en: Increased specialization in the factory allowed workers to complete tasks much faster.
examples.zh: 工厂专业化分工的提高使工人们能更快地完成任务。

lemmas.def_zh: 专长, 专业
lemmas.def_en: the concentration of your efforts on a particular field of study or occupation

examples.en: Her academic specialism is eighteenth-century European literature, which she has studied for decades.
examples.zh: 她的学术专长是十八世纪欧洲文学，她对此已有数十年的研究。

lemmas.def_en: not specialized or modified for a particular purpose or function
lemmas.def_zh: 非专门化的, 无特定功能的

examples.en: Stem cells are unspecialized cells capable of developing into many different cell types.
examples.zh: 干细胞是能够发育成许多不同细胞类型的非特化细胞。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 species（种类），表示集中精力于某一特定领域或种类。

lemmas.def_en: not subject to change or variation especially in behavior
lemmas.def_zh: 稳定的, 不动摇的, 沉着的, 稳固的, 坚定的, 经常的

examples.en: He maintained a steady pace throughout the marathon to conserve his energy.
examples.zh: 他在整场马拉松比赛中保持平稳的步伐以保存体力。

lemmas.def_en: subject to change or variation
lemmas.def_zh: 不稳固的, 摇摆的, 不稳定的, 易变的, 不安定的, 不规则的, 古怪的, 无常的

examples.en: The toddler took a few unsteady steps before falling into his mother's arms.
examples.zh: 那个刚学步的孩子摇摇晃晃地走了几步，随后跌入了母亲怀中。

lemmas.def_en: make steady
lemmas.def_zh: 使稳定, 使坚定；变为沉着, 稳固

examples.en: He maintained a steady pace throughout the marathon to conserve his energy.
examples.zh: 他在整场马拉松比赛中保持平稳的步伐以保存体力。

lemmas.def_en: at a steady rate or pace
lemmas.def_zh: 稳定地, 无变化地, 有规则地

examples.en: The company's profits have risen steadily over the past five years.
examples.zh: 过去五年里，该公司的利润一直稳步增长。

lemmas.def_en: in an unsteady manner
lemmas.def_zh: 不稳固地, 不稳定地, 摇摆地

examples.en: The injured climber rose unsteadily to his feet and called for help.
examples.zh: 受伤的登山者摇晃着站起身来呼救。

lemmas.def_en: freedom from wavering or indecision; constancy of resolve or conduct
lemmas.def_zh: 稳健, 坚定, 不变

examples.en: The surgeon was widely praised for the remarkable steadiness of his hands.
examples.zh: 这位外科医生因其双手极为沉稳而广受赞誉。

lemmas.def_en: the quality of not being steady or securely fixed in place
lemmas.def_zh: [计] 不稳定性

examples.en: Extreme fatigue caused an obvious unsteadiness in her voice during the presentation.
examples.zh: 极度疲劳导致她在演讲时声音明显有些不稳。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古诺斯语，本义为‘站立牢固的’，引申出稳定、不动摇的含义。

lemmas.def_en: a commissioned military officer
lemmas.def_zh: 中尉, 助理人员, 副官

examples.en: The lieutenant ordered his soldiers to hold their ground until reinforcements arrived.
examples.zh: 中尉命令士兵们坚守阵地，直到增援部队赶到。

lemmas.def_en: the position of a lieutenant
lemmas.def_zh: 中尉之军衔

examples.en: After five years of exemplary service, he was finally promoted to a lieutenancy.
examples.zh: 经过五年的模范服役，他终于被提升为中尉军衔。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古法语 lieu（位置、地点）+ tenant（握持者），本义为‘替身’、‘代理人’，后定为军衔。

lemmas.def_en: break down, literally or metaphorically
lemmas.def_zh: 倒塌, 崩溃, 瓦解；使倒塌, 折叠

examples.en: The old wooden bridge began to collapse under the weight of the truck.
examples.zh: 老旧的木桥在卡车的重压下开始坍塌。

lemmas.def_en: an abrupt failure of function or complete physical exhaustion
lemmas.def_zh: 崩溃, 倒塌, 虚脱

examples.en: The old wooden bridge began to collapse under the weight of the truck.
examples.zh: 老旧的木桥在卡车的重压下开始坍塌。

lemmas.def_en: capable of collapsing or being collapsed
lemmas.def_zh: 可折叠的

examples.en: He packed a collapsible fishing rod that fit easily into his travel backpack.
examples.zh: 他带上了一根易于装入旅行背包的折叠鱼竿。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 col-（共同）+ lapse（滑落、坠落），核心意象为‘整体坍塌、崩溃’。

lemmas.def_en: engaged in or accustomed to close observation
lemmas.def_zh: 警觉的, 灵敏的, 留心的

examples.en: Security guards remained alert throughout the night to prevent any unauthorized entry.
examples.zh: 保安人员整夜保持警惕，以防止任何未经授权的进入。

lemmas.def_en: warn or arouse to a sense of danger or call to a state of preparedness
lemmas.def_zh: 使警觉, 通知, 使意识到

examples.en: Security guards remained alert throughout the night to prevent any unauthorized entry.
examples.zh: 保安人员整夜保持警惕，以防止任何未经授权的进入。

lemmas.def_en: the process of paying close and continuous attention
lemmas.def_zh: 警戒, 机敏

examples.en: Coffee can temporarily increase your mental alertness and focus during long study sessions.
examples.zh: 在长时间学习期间，咖啡可以暂时提高你的精神机敏度和专注力。

lemmas.def_en: in mentally perceptive and responsive way
lemmas.def_zh: 警觉地, 留意地

examples.en: The guard dog watched alertly as a stranger approached the front gate.
examples.zh: 当陌生人走近前门时，看门狗警觉地注视着。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自意大利语 all'erta（在岗哨上警惕地站着），核心概念为时刻戒备和警觉。

lemmas.def_en: feeling hunger; feeling a need or desire to eat food
lemmas.def_zh: 饥饿的, 荒年的, 渴望的, 不毛的

examples.en: After hiking for five hours, we were extremely hungry and exhausted.
examples.zh: 徒步五个小时后，我们感到极其饥饿和疲惫。

lemmas.def_en: in the manner of someone who is very hungry
lemmas.def_zh: 饥饿地; 渴望地, 贪婪地

examples.en: The stray cat ate the can of tuna hungrily within minutes.
examples.zh: 流浪猫在几分钟内狼吞虎咽地吃光了那罐金枪鱼。

lemmas.def_en: a physiological need for food; the consequence of food deprivation
lemmas.def_zh: 饥饿, 渴望, 饥荒

examples.en: After hiking all day, intense hunger drove us to the nearest village restaurant.
examples.zh: 徒步一整天后，强烈的饥饿感驱使我们走向最近的村落餐馆。

lemmas.def_en: feel the need to eat
lemmas.def_zh: 使挨饿；挨饿, 渴望

examples.en: After hiking all day, intense hunger drove us to the nearest village restaurant.
examples.zh: 徒步一整天后，强烈的饥饿感驱使我们走向最近的村落餐馆。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自 hunger（饥饿），形容因缺乏食物或其他需求而产生的强烈渴望。

lemmas.def_en: express or state indirectly
lemmas.def_zh: 暗示, 意味

examples.en: Are you trying to imply that I made a mistake in the report?
examples.zh: 你是在暗示我在报告中犯了错误吗？

lemmas.def_en: bring into intimate and incriminating connection
lemmas.def_zh: 使牵连其中，暗示与…有牵连

examples.en: The leaked documents implicate several senior officials in the scandal.
examples.zh: 泄露的文件表明数名高级官员卷入了这起丑闻。

lemmas.def_en: something that is inferred (deduced or entailed or implied)
lemmas.def_zh: 可能的影响，后果；暗示

examples.en: The proposed law has serious implications for free speech.
examples.zh: 这项拟议中的法律对言论自由有着重大的潜在影响。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 im-（进入）+ ply（折叠），字面义为‘折叠在内部’，引申为不直接说明而‘暗示’。

lemmas.def_en: make less severe or harsh or extreme
lemmas.def_zh: 修正, 变更, 修饰, 缓和, 减轻；被修改

examples.en: The architect had to modify the original design to reduce construction costs.
examples.zh: 建筑师不得不修改原始设计以降低施工成本。

lemmas.def_en: the act of making something different (as e.g. the size of a garment)
lemmas.def_zh: 修改，改变；修饰

examples.en: The software required a few modifications to run smoothly.
examples.zh: 该软件需要进行一些修改才能流畅运行。

lemmas.def_en: a content word that qualifies the meaning of a noun or verb
lemmas.def_zh: 修正的人, 修饰语

examples.en: In this sentence, the adjective acts as a modifier for the following noun.
examples.zh: 在这个句子中，该形容词充当后面名词的修饰语。

lemmas.def_en: not changed in form or character
lemmas.def_zh: 未更改的, 未变的

examples.en: The software ran smoothly using the unmodified default settings on the new computer.
examples.zh: 该软件在新电脑上使用未修改的默认设置运行得很顺畅。

lemmas.def_en: capable of being modified in form or character or strength (especially by making less extreme);  - Alexis Carrel
lemmas.def_zh: 可修正的, 可变更的, 可修饰的, 可缓和的

examples.en: The software license allows users to create easily modifiable templates for their projects.
examples.zh: 该软件许可证允许用户为他们的项目创建易于修改的模板。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 modi-（尺度、模式）+ -fy（使成为），引申为调整尺度以使其合度，即‘修改’。

lemmas.def_en: a message that tells the particulars of an act or occurrence or course of events; presented in writing or drama or cinema or as a radio or television program
lemmas.def_zh: 叙述, 故事

examples.en: Her latest novel weaves a compelling personal narrative through major historical events.
examples.zh: 她的最新小说将引人入胜的个人叙事融入重大历史事件中。

lemmas.def_en: someone who tells a story
lemmas.def_zh: n. 叙述者，讲述人；旁白员

examples.en: The unreliable narrator in the novel keeps readers guessing the truth.
examples.zh: 小说中不可靠的叙述者让读者不断猜测真相。

lemmas.def_en: a message that tells the particulars of an act or occurrence or course of events; presented in writing or drama or cinema or as a radio or television program
lemmas.def_zh: 叙述, 故事, 叙述文

examples.en: The documentary is elevated by the actor's deep and soothing voice narration.
examples.zh: 那位演员低沉而舒缓的声音叙述升华了这部纪录片。

lemmas.def_en: provide commentary for a film, for example
lemmas.def_zh: v. 叙述，讲述；解说

examples.en: The documentary is narrated by a well-known wildlife expert.
examples.zh: 这部纪录片由一位著名的野生动物专家解说。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 narrare（讲述、告知），指向事件的叙述方式或故事本身。

lemmas.def_en: the swift release of a store of affective force
lemmas.def_zh: 震颤, 激动, 刺激性, 一阵激动

examples.en: She felt a sudden thrill of excitement as the roller coaster dropped.
examples.zh: 当过山车俯冲而下时，她感到一阵突然的刺激与兴奋。

lemmas.def_en: a suspenseful adventure story or play or movie
lemmas.def_zh: 使人激动的东西, 使人毛骨悚然的东西, 使人毛骨悚然的小说

examples.en: The director is famous for creating psychological thrillers that keep audiences guessing.
examples.zh: 这位导演以创作让观众捉摸不透的心理惊悚片而闻名。

lemmas.def_en: cause to be thrilled by some perceptual input
lemmas.def_zh: 震颤, 颤抖, 激动；使激动, 使颤动

examples.en: She felt a sudden thrill of excitement as the roller coaster dropped.
examples.zh: 当过山车俯冲而下时，她感到一阵突然的刺激与兴奋。

lemmas.def_zh: adj. 令人兴奋的；扣人心弦的
lemmas.def_en: producing great excitement or pleasure
lemmas.usage_note: 常修饰 game, adventure, experience 等令人激动的活动或经历。

examples.en: It was a thrilling match that kept the fans on the edge of their seats.
examples.zh: 那是一场扣人心弦的比赛，让球迷们紧张不已。

family_guide.root_logic: 本义为‘刺穿、穿透’，引申为强烈的情感或快感如电流般贯穿全身。
family_guide.core_distinction: thrill 表示刺激感本身或使人兴奋；thriller 专指惊悚小说、惊悚电影等作品。

lemmas.def_en: a person who is under the protection or in the custody of another
lemmas.def_zh: 病房, 守卫, 保卫, 保护, 监护, 牢房, 行政区, 锁孔内的榫舌

examples.en: Doctors carefully monitored the recovery of every patient in the intensive care ward.
examples.zh: 医生们密切监测重症监护病房中每位患者的康复情况。

lemmas.def_en: a person who works in a prison and is in charge of prisoners
lemmas.def_zh: 看守, 守卫, 看门人

examples.en: The prison warder patrolled the corridor every hour during the night shift.
examples.zh: 监狱看守在夜班期间每小时巡视一次走廊。

lemmas.def_en: watch over or shield from danger or harm; protect
lemmas.def_zh: 使入病房, 守护, 保卫

examples.en: Doctors carefully monitored the recovery of every patient in the intensive care ward.
examples.zh: 医生们密切监测重症监护病房中每位患者的康复情况。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自日耳曼语系词根，核心义为‘看管、守卫’，引申出被监护的人、保护区病房及防御动作。

lemmas.def_en: the general atmosphere of a place or situation and the effect that it has on people
lemmas.def_zh: 滋味, 调味品

examples.en: Adding fresh garlic will enhance the natural flavor of the roasted vegetables.
examples.zh: 加入新鲜大蒜会提升烤蔬菜的天然风味。

lemmas.def_en: something added to food primarily for the savor it imparts
lemmas.def_zh: 调味料

examples.en: This bakery uses natural vanilla flavoring instead of artificial chemical substitutes.
examples.zh: 这家面包店使用天然香草调味料，而非人工化学替代品。

lemmas.def_en: something added to food primarily for the savor it imparts
lemmas.def_zh: 调味料

examples.en: She added a drop of peppermint flavouring to make the hot chocolate richer.
examples.zh: 她加了一滴薄荷调味料，让热巧克力口感更浓郁。

lemmas.def_en: lend flavor to
lemmas.def_zh: 加味于

examples.en: Adding fresh garlic will enhance the natural flavor of the roasted vegetables.
examples.zh: 加入新鲜大蒜会提升烤蔬菜的天然风味。

lemmas.def_en: lend flavor to
lemmas.def_zh: 给...调味, 给...增添风趣, 加香料, 加味于

examples.en: You can flavour the chicken soup with fresh rosemary and black pepper.
examples.zh: 你可以用新鲜迷迭香和黑胡椒给鸡汤调味。

lemmas.def_en: full of flavor
lemmas.def_zh: 充满...味道的, 可口的

examples.en: The chef prepared a flavorful tomato sauce simmered with Mediterranean herbs.
examples.zh: 厨师用慢火熬制地中海香草，调制出了一款风味浓郁的番茄酱。

lemmas.def_en: lacking taste or flavor or tang
lemmas.def_zh: <美>无味的, 无滋味的

examples.en: Without enough salt and spices, the boiled potatoes tasted completely flavorless.
examples.zh: 没有足够的盐和香料，煮土豆吃起来毫无滋味。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 flare（吹气、散发气味），演变指口感与气味结合所呈现的特定‘风味’。
family_guide.core_distinction: flavor 为美式拼写，flavour 为英式拼写。

lemmas.def_en: be the cause or source of
lemmas.def_zh: 出产, 给予, 让出, 放弃, 使屈服；出产, 屈服, 投降, 倒塌

examples.en: This modern agricultural technique will help farmers yield much higher annual crop outputs.
examples.zh: 这种现代农业技术将帮助农民产出更高的年农作物产量。

lemmas.def_en: production of a certain amount
lemmas.def_zh: 生产量, 投资收益

examples.en: This modern agricultural technique will help farmers yield much higher annual crop outputs.
examples.zh: 这种现代农业技术将帮助农民产出更高的年农作物产量。

lemmas.def_en: stubbornly unyielding; ; ; ; - T.S.Eliot
lemmas.def_zh: 不易弯曲的, 不屈的

examples.en: Despite fierce public criticism, the mayor remained unyielding in his original decision.
examples.zh: 尽管受到公众的强烈批评，市长依然坚持原定决定，毫不动摇。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语，本义为‘支付、回报’，后分化出‘产出结果’与放弃抗拒‘屈服、让步’两层核心逻辑。

lemmas.def_en: a long seat for more than one person
lemmas.def_zh: 长椅子

examples.en: The coach decided to bench the star player after a minor injury.
examples.zh: 在主力队员受了轻伤后，教练决定让他坐冷板凳。

lemmas.def_en: take out of a game; of players
lemmas.def_zh: [机] 台

examples.en: The coach decided to bench the star player after a minor injury.
examples.zh: 在主力队员受了轻伤后，教练决定让他坐冷板凳。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语benc，核心指供人坐或操作的长条台面，引申出司法席位及替补席。

lemmas.def_en: not exceptional in any way especially in quality or ability or size or degree
lemmas.def_zh: 平常的, 普通的, 平凡的

examples.en: She lived an ordinary life until an unexpected letter changed everything completely.
examples.zh: 她过着平凡的生活，直到一封意外的信彻底改变了一切。

lemmas.def_en: a judge of a probate court
lemmas.def_zh: 平常的人(或事)

examples.en: She lived an ordinary life until an unexpected letter changed everything completely.
examples.zh: 她过着平凡的生活，直到一封意外的信彻底改变了一切。

lemmas.def_en: the quality of being commonplace and ordinary
lemmas.def_zh: 平凡；平常(ordinary的变形)

examples.en: The subtle beauty of the novel lies in the ordinariness of daily life.
examples.zh: 这部小说的精妙之美在于它展现了日常生活的平凡。

lemmas.def_en: under normal conditions
lemmas.def_zh: 通常, 普通, 一般地

examples.en: I would not ordinarily agree to such terms, but time is running out.
examples.zh: 我通常不会同意这种条款，但现在时间不多了。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语ordo（秩序、常规），表示符合通常规律的、平淡无奇的状态。

lemmas.def_en: relative darkness caused by light rays being intercepted by an opaque body

examples.en: He used his hand to shade his tired eyes from the glaring sun.
examples.zh: 他用手遮住疲惫的双眼，挡住刺眼的阳光。

lemmas.def_en: relative darkness caused by light rays being intercepted by an opaque body

examples.en: it is much cooler in the shade
there's too much shadiness to take good photographs

lemmas.def_en: cast a shadow over

examples.en: He used his hand to shade his tired eyes from the glaring sun.
examples.zh: 他用手遮住疲惫的双眼，挡住刺眼的阳光。

lemmas.def_zh: 荫凉的, 成荫的, 阴暗的, 隐蔽的

examples.en: We sat down under a shady oak tree to enjoy our summer afternoon picnic.
examples.zh: 我们坐在荫凉的橡树下，享受夏日午后的野餐。

lemmas.def_en: (of pictures) not having shadow represented
lemmas.def_zh: 无遮蔽的, 声调无变化的

examples.en: The crops wilted quickly under the unshaded heat of the summer sun.
examples.zh: 在夏季毫无遮蔽的烈日炙烤下，庄稼很快枯萎了。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语sceadu，核心意象为遮挡光线形成的昏暗区域，引申出细微的色彩或含义差异。

lemmas.def_en: athletic facility equipped for sports or physical training
lemmas.def_zh: +体育馆, 体育训练, 体育课, 体操

examples.en: She goes to the local gym three times a week before work.
examples.zh: 她每周上班前去三次当地的健身房。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自gymnasium的缩写，词源与古希腊裸体锻炼场所相关，现代统指健身房或体育馆。

lemmas.def_en: make more intense, stronger, or more marked; ,
lemmas.def_zh: 化合, 和解, 妥协；使复合, 使化合

examples.en: High inflation rates will only compound the country's ongoing economic troubles further.
examples.zh: 高通胀率只会进一步加剧该国持续存在的经济困境。

lemmas.def_en: a whole formed by a union of two or more elements or parts
lemmas.def_zh: 混合物, 复合词, 化合物, 院子

examples.en: High inflation rates will only compound the country's ongoing economic troubles further.
examples.zh: 高通胀率只会进一步加剧该国持续存在的经济困境。

lemmas.def_en: composed of more than one part; compound flower heads"
lemmas.def_zh: 复合的, 混合的, 化合的

examples.en: High inflation rates will only compound the country's ongoing economic troubles further.
examples.zh: 高通胀率只会进一步加剧该国持续存在的经济困境。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语com-（一起）+ ponere（放置），核心逻辑为“放在一起构成复合体”。

lemmas.def_en: give entirely to a specific person, activity, or cause
lemmas.def_zh: 投入于, 献身

examples.en: He decided to devote his retirement years to protecting the endangered local wildlife.
examples.zh: 他决定将退休岁月奉献给保护当地濒危野生动物的事业。

lemmas.def_en: feelings of ardent love
lemmas.def_zh: 热爱, 投入

examples.en: Her deep devotion to music was evident in every single note she played.
examples.zh: 她对音乐的无比热爱体现在她弹奏的每一个音符中。

lemmas.def_en: an ardent follower and admirer
lemmas.def_zh: 爱好者, 献身者, 虔诚的宗教信徒

examples.en: As a lifelong devotee of jazz, he attends every local live concert.
examples.zh: 作为爵士乐的终身狂热爱好者，他参加当地的每一场现场音乐会。

lemmas.def_en: feelings of ardent love
lemmas.def_zh: 投身

examples.en: Her remarkable devotedness to the family inspired everyone in the whole neighborhood.
examples.zh: 她对家庭非凡的奉献精神激励了整个社区的每一个人。

lemmas.def_en: with devotion
lemmas.def_zh: 忠实地；一心一意地

examples.en: The loyal dog waited devotedly by the hospital entrance for its owner.
examples.zh: 那只忠诚的狗在医院门口一心一意地等待着它的主人。

lemmas.def_zh: adj. 忠诚的；深爱的；专心致志的
lemmas.def_en: extremely loving and loyal; giving a great deal of time and energy to something
lemmas.usage_note: 常作表语或定语，常用结构为 be devoted to sth/sb。

examples.en: He was a devoted father who spent every weekend with his children.
examples.zh: 他是一位慈爱的父亲，每个周末都陪伴着孩子们。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语de-（完全地）+ vovere（发誓、奉献），核心为彻底立誓奉献。
family_guide.core_distinction: devote为动词行为，devotion为其结果或表现出的忠诚品质。

lemmas.def_en: assign a name or title to
lemmas.def_zh: 指定, 指明, 称呼

examples.en: The committee will officially designate a new director during the meeting tomorrow morning.
examples.zh: 委员会将在明天上午的会议上正式任命一名新主任。

lemmas.def_en: identifying word or words by which someone or something is called and classified or distinguished from others
lemmas.def_zh: 指示, 指定, 命名

examples.en: The historic site received its official designation as a national monument last year.
examples.zh: 该历史遗址去年获得了国家纪念碑的官方认定。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语de-（强调）+ signare（标记），核心为“用标记标明”，引申为指定或任命。
family_guide.core_distinction: designate强调指定的动作，designation强调指定的结果、名称或头衔。

lemmas.def_en: a small handbook
lemmas.def_zh: 手册, 指南

examples.en: Please read the user manual carefully before operating this new coffee machine.
examples.zh: 在操作这台新咖啡机之前，请仔细阅读用户手册。

lemmas.def_en: by hand
lemmas.def_zh: 用手

examples.en: If the automatic system fails, operators must adjust the valve manually instead.
examples.zh: 如果自动系统出现故障，操作员必须手动调节阀门。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语manus（手），本指手部操作的，后特指便携的手工操作指南手册。

lemmas.def_en: drive around aimlessly but ostentatiously and at leisure
lemmas.def_zh: 巡航, 巡弋, 漫游

examples.en: We spent the sunny afternoon watching white yachts cruise slowly along the coast.
examples.zh: 我们在晴朗的午后看着白色的游艇沿着海岸缓缓漫游。

lemmas.def_en: a car in which policemen cruise the streets; equipped with radiotelephonic communications to headquarters
lemmas.def_zh: 巡洋舰, 巡航飞机, 警察巡逻车

examples.en: A police cruiser pulled up quietly beside the abandoned vehicle last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚，一辆警用巡逻车悄无声息地停在那辆废弃车辆旁。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语crux（十字），经荷兰语演变为“交错巡航”，核心指在水面或道路上漫游、巡航。

lemmas.def_en: spoil as if by poison
lemmas.def_zh: 毒害, 毒杀, 使中毒；放毒, 下毒

examples.en: The jealous prince tried to poison the king's evening wine.
examples.zh: 嫉妒的王子试图在国王的晚间美酒中下毒。

lemmas.def_en: any substance that causes injury or illness or death of a living organism
lemmas.def_zh: 毒药, 毒, 毒物, 有毒害的事物

examples.en: The jealous prince tried to poison the king's evening wine.
examples.zh: 嫉妒的王子试图在国王的晚间美酒中下毒。

lemmas.def_en: the physiological state produced by a poison or other toxic substance
lemmas.def_zh: 中毒

examples.en: Several diners were admitted to the hospital with acute food poisoning.
examples.zh: 几名用餐者因急性食物中毒被送往医院。

lemmas.def_en: someone who kills with poison
lemmas.def_zh: 放毒人, 毒死他人者

examples.en: The notorious poisoner used rare plant extracts to kill her victims.
examples.zh: 这名臭名昭著的下毒者使用罕见的植物提取物杀害受害者。

lemmas.def_en: having the qualities or effects of a poison
lemmas.def_zh: 有毒的, 恶毒的, 讨厌的

examples.en: Some brightly colored frogs in the rainforest secrete extremely poisonous venom.
examples.zh: 雨林中一些颜色鲜艳的青蛙会分泌剧毒的毒液。

lemmas.def_en: in a very malevolent manner
lemmas.def_zh: poisonous的变形

examples.en: He smiled poisonously before delivering the harsh, humiliating news.
examples.zh: 在宣布那个严酷且羞辱人的消息前，他恶毒地笑了笑。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语potio（饮剂、药水），原指毒药水，引申为一切致病有害物质及其施加行为。
family_guide.core_distinction: poisoning侧重中毒这一事件或过程，poisonous侧重自身带有毒性的性质。

lemmas.def_en: a set of questions or exercises evaluating skill or knowledge
lemmas.def_zh: 考试, 测验

examples.en: Students are studying late in the library for their final history exam.
examples.zh: 学生们正在图书馆学习到深夜，准备期末历史考试。

family_guide.root_logic: examination的常用口语截短词，核心指对知识或能力的正式检视与测试。

lemmas.def_en: side by side
lemmas.def_zh: 在旁边, 靠拢着

examples.en: A police patrol car pulled up alongside to inspect the broken vehicle.
examples.zh: 一辆警用巡逻车停在旁边检查抛锚的车辆。

family_guide.root_logic: 由along（沿着）+ side（侧面）复合而成，核心意象为“紧挨着一侧并行”。

lemmas.def_en: a hose that carries air under pressure
lemmas.def_zh: 航线, 航线的设备, 航空公司

examples.en: The international airline announced cheaper fares for long flights this winter.
examples.zh: 该国际航空公司宣布今年冬季长途航班将实行更优惠的票价。

lemmas.def_en: a commercial airplane that carries passengers
lemmas.def_zh: 班机, 大型客机

examples.en: The modern airliner landed smoothly despite the strong crosswinds.
examples.zh: 尽管遭遇强烈的侧风，这架现代大型客机依然平稳着陆。

family_guide.root_logic: 由air（空中）+ line（线路/航线）复合而成，指经营空中客货运输航线的公司。

lemmas.def_en: electronic equipment that converts sound into electrical signals that can be transmitted over distances and then converts received signals back into sounds
lemmas.def_zh: 电话, 电话机

examples.en: Please telephone our office tomorrow morning to confirm your appointment.
examples.zh: 请在明天早晨打电话给我们办公室以确认您的预约。

lemmas.def_en: get or try to get into communication (with someone) by telephone
lemmas.def_zh: 打电话

examples.en: Please telephone our office tomorrow morning to confirm your appointment.
examples.zh: 请在明天早晨打电话给我们办公室以确认您的预约。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语tele-（遥远）+ phone（声音），核心指“将声音传至远方的装置”。

lemmas.def_en: used of women's clothing; very short with hemline above the knee
lemmas.def_zh: 微型的

examples.en: The hotel room was equipped with a convenient mini refrigerator.
examples.zh: 该酒店房间配备了一台方便的微型冰箱。

lemmas.def_en: a very short skirt
lemmas.def_zh: 同类中的极小者, 微型汽车, 超短裙

examples.en: The hotel room was equipped with a convenient mini refrigerator.
examples.zh: 该酒店房间配备了一台方便的微型冰箱。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自miniature（微型模型）的截短词，核心表示超小型、微型的概念。

lemmas.def_en: catch sight of
lemmas.def_zh: 侦察, 找出, 发现；做密探, 侦查

examples.zh: 情报机构怀疑那位外国外交官实际上是一名间谍。

examples.en: A careful spier tracked the movement of the opposing army.
examples.zh: 一名细心的侦察者追踪了敌军的动向。

lemmas.def_en: (military) a secret agent hired by a state to obtain information about its enemies or by a business to obtain industrial secrets from competitors
lemmas.def_zh: 间谍, 侦探, 侦察

examples.en: Intelligence agencies suspected that the foreign diplomat was actually a spy.
examples.zh: 情报机构怀疑那位外国外交官实际上是一名间谍。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古法语 espier（窥视、暗中观察），核心义为秘密侦察或窥探。

lemmas.def_en: a special advantage or immunity or benefit not enjoyed by all
lemmas.def_zh: 特权, 特别恩典, 基本权利, 特免

examples.en: Good healthcare should be a basic right rather than a privilege.
examples.zh: 良好的医疗保健应该是一项基本权利，而非某种特权。

lemmas.def_en: bestow a privilege upon
lemmas.def_zh: 给与...特权, 特免

examples.en: Good healthcare should be a basic right rather than a privilege.
examples.zh: 良好的医疗保健应该是一项基本权利，而非某种特权。

lemmas.def_zh: adj. 享有特权的；荣幸的
lemmas.def_en: having special rights or advantages that other people do not have; feeling honored
lemmas.usage_note: 既可指享有优越社会经济地位（privileged background），也可表示感到荣幸（feel privileged to do sth）。

examples.en: She felt privileged to be invited to the prestigious conference.
examples.zh: 受邀参加这一盛会，她感到非常荣幸。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 privilegium（涉及个人的法律），引申为个人或少数人享有的“特权”。

lemmas.def_en: cause to run
lemmas.def_zh: 倒, 灌, 注, 倾泻, 诉说, 倾吐；倾泻, 蜂涌而来, 下大雨

examples.en: She carefully poured boiling water into the teapot to brew tea.
examples.zh: 她小心翼翼地把沸水倒进茶壶里泡茶。

family_guide.root_logic: 拟声词起源，指液体连续倾泻流出，后引申为大量涌出。

lemmas.def_en: have a certain weight
lemmas.def_zh: 称...重量, 衡量, 把...压弯, 考虑, 权衡, 起锚；称分量, 有意义, 重压, 起锚

examples.en: The doctor asked the patient to weigh herself on the scale.
examples.zh: 医生让病人站在体重秤上称一下自己的体重。

lemmas.def_en: an official who weighs and records the weight
lemmas.def_zh: 过秤员, 过磅员

examples.en: The official weigher recorded the exact mass of the grain cargo.
examples.zh: 官方过磅员记录了这批粮食货物的准确重量。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 wegan（搬运、称重），核心义为衡量重量或在心中权衡比较。

lemmas.def_en: a recognition of meritorious service

examples.zh: 公园里矗立起一座青铜纪念碑，以纪念牺牲的士兵。

examples.zh: 建立该博物馆是为了纪念这一悲惨的历史事件。

lemmas.def_en: address in a memorial
lemmas.def_zh: 提出请愿书, 纪念

examples.en: The city decided to memorialize the famous poet with a statue.
examples.zh: 该市决定用一座雕像来纪念这位著名诗人。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 memoria（记忆），用具象事物保留对过去人或事的纪念。

lemmas.def_en: a depository containing historical records and documents
lemmas.def_zh: 档案馆, 档案文件

examples.en: You should archive these old project files onto an external hard drive today.
examples.zh: 你今天应该把这些旧项目文件归档到外接硬盘上。

lemmas.def_en: a person in charge of collecting and cataloguing archives
lemmas.def_zh: 案卷保管员

examples.en: The chief archivist carefully restored the fragile eighteenth-century manuscript using special tools.
examples.zh: 主管档案管理员使用特殊工具仔细修复了那份脆弱的18世纪手稿。

lemmas.def_en: put into an archive
lemmas.def_zh: 把...存档

examples.en: You should archive these old project files onto an external hard drive today.
examples.zh: 你今天应该把这些旧项目文件归档到外接硬盘上。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to or contained in or serving as an archive
lemmas.def_zh: 档案的, 档案中的

examples.en: Historians spent several months examining archival materials stored in the university library.
examples.zh: 历史学家们花了几个月时间研究存放在大学图书馆中的档案资料。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 archeion（市政厅、官府公文），指保存原始记录与历史文献的场所或行为。

lemmas.def_en: make revisions in
lemmas.def_zh: 校订, 修正, 校正

examples.en: The editor asked the author to revise the final chapter before publication.
examples.zh: 编辑要求作者在出版前修改最后一章。

lemmas.def_en: the act of revising or altering (involving reconsideration and modification)
lemmas.def_zh: 校订, 修正, 修订本, 修订版

examples.en: After careful revision, the contract was ready for both parties to sign officially.
examples.zh: 经过仔细修改后，合同已准备好供双方正式签署。

lemmas.def_en: someone who puts text into appropriate form for publication
lemmas.def_zh: 修订者, 修改者, 修正者, 校对员, 再校员

examples.en: The reviser corrected several grammatical mistakes before sending the text to print.
examples.zh: 校订员在将文本送印前修正了几处语法错误。

lemmas.def_en: not improved or brought up to date
lemmas.def_zh: 未修订的,未订正的,未校订的,未修改的

examples.en: He mistakenly submitted the unrevised draft of his essay to the professor.
examples.zh: 他误将未经修改的论文初稿提交给了教授。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 re-（再）+ vise（看），本义为“再次审视”，引申为修订、复习。
family_guide.core_distinction: revise 侧重检查修改或复习知识；revision 是其对应的动作或修订本名词。

lemmas.def_en: not divisible by two
lemmas.def_zh: 奇数的, 古怪的, 剩余的, 零散的, 各种各样的, 少量的

examples.en: It struck me as odd that he left the party without saying goodbye.
examples.zh: 他没打招呼就离开了聚会，我觉得这很奇怪。

lemmas.def_en: eccentricity that is not easily explained
lemmas.def_zh: 奇异, 奇特, 怪人, 怪事, 怪僻

examples.en: The old clock in the town square was considered an architectural oddity.
examples.zh: 城镇广场上的那座老钟被认为是一座奇特的建筑。

lemmas.def_en: the parity of odd numbers (not divisible by two)
lemmas.def_zh: 奇怪, 古怪

examples.en: She noticed the oddness of his behavior immediately after he entered the room.
examples.zh: 他一走进房间，她就注意到了他行为的古怪之处。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古诺斯语 oddi（三角形、零头、奇数），引申出不合常规与奇怪之意。

lemmas.def_en: look at with fixed eyes
lemmas.def_zh: 注视, 凝视, 瞪视, 显眼；盯

examples.en: It is considered impolite to stare directly at strangers on public transit.
examples.zh: 在公共交通工具上直接盯着陌生人看被认为是不礼貌的。

lemmas.def_en: feature as the star
lemmas.def_zh: 以星状物装饰, 用星号标, 使成为明星；变成明星

examples.en: The director decided to star an unknown actor in the upcoming historical drama.
examples.zh: 导演决定让一位不知名的演员担任这部即将上映的历史剧的主演。

lemmas.def_en: a fixed look with eyes open wide
lemmas.def_zh: 凝视

examples.en: It is considered impolite to stare directly at strangers on public transit.
examples.zh: 在公共交通工具上直接盯着陌生人看被认为是不礼貌的。

lemmas.def_en: a viewer who gazes fixedly (often with hostility)
lemmas.def_zh: 斯塔勒（姓氏）

examples.en: Feeling uncomfortable under his gaze, she turned away from the rude starer.
examples.zh: 在他注视下感到不自在，她转身避开了那个无礼的凝视者。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 starian（凝视），与 stand/star 同源，指目光固定僵住的样子。
family_guide.core_distinction: stare 与 star 词源不同，star 作为动词意为“主演/闪耀”，属于形近混淆项。

lemmas.def_en: (used of opinions and actions) far beyond the norm
lemmas.def_zh: 激进的, 根本的, 基本的, 根的

examples.en: The new government proposed radical changes to the national healthcare system.
examples.zh: 新政府提出了对国家医疗体系的根本性改革。

lemmas.def_en: (chemistry) two or more atoms bound together as a single unit and forming part of a molecule
lemmas.def_zh: 激进分子, 词根, 基础, 根式, 根

examples.en: The new government proposed radical changes to the national healthcare system.
examples.zh: 新政府提出了对国家医疗体系的根本性改革。

lemmas.def_en: in a radical manner
lemmas.def_zh: 根本地, 完全地

examples.en: The new management radically changed the company's marketing strategy within two months.
examples.zh: 新管理层在两个月内彻底改变了公司的营销策略。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 radix（根），表示根本的、基础的，引申指激进的（从根本上变革的）。
family_guide.core_distinction: radical 可作形容词和名词；radically 是其程度副词，强调彻底或极端地。

lemmas.def_en: a message whose ingenuity or verbal skill or incongruity has the power to evoke laughter
lemmas.def_zh: 幽默, 诙谐, 心情

examples.en: She decided to humor him and listened patiently to his wild theory.
examples.zh: 她决定迁就他，耐心地听他讲那些荒谬的理论。

lemmas.def_en: someone who acts speaks or writes in an amusing way
lemmas.def_zh: 幽默家, 幽默作家

examples.en: The famous humorist published a collection of witty essays about modern life.
examples.zh: 这位著名的幽默作家出版了一本关于现代生活的机智散文集。

lemmas.def_en: put into a good mood
lemmas.def_zh: 迎合, 牵就, 顺应

examples.en: She decided to humor him and listened patiently to his wild theory.
examples.zh: 她决定迁就他，耐心地听他讲那些荒谬的理论。

lemmas.def_en: put into a good mood
lemmas.def_zh: 使满足, 迁就

examples.en: It is often better to humour an angry customer until they calm down.
examples.zh: 迁就愤怒的顾客直到他们平静下来，往往是更好的做法。

lemmas.def_en: full of or characterized by humor
lemmas.def_zh: 富幽默感的, 滑稽的, 诙谐的

examples.en: The speaker began his presentation with a humorous story about his childhood.
examples.zh: 演讲者以一个关于他童年的幽默故事开始了报告。

lemmas.def_en: lacking humor; - Truman Capote
lemmas.def_zh: 缺乏幽默感的, 非常严肃的, 一本正经的

examples.en: The strict supervisor was a humorless man who never tolerated any jokes.
examples.zh: 这位严厉的主管是个毫无幽默感的人，从不容忍任何玩笑。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to bodily fluids
lemmas.def_zh: 体液的, 由体液引起的, 温性的

examples.en: Ancient physicians believed that disease resulted from an imbalance in humoral fluids.
examples.zh: 古代医生认为疾病是由体液失衡引起的。

lemmas.def_en: in a humorous manner
lemmas.def_zh: 滑稽地；幽默地

examples.en: He humorously described his disastrous cooking attempt, making everyone in the room laugh.
examples.zh: 他幽默地描述了自己糟糕的下厨经历，逗得屋里的每个人哈哈大笑。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 humor（体液），古医学认为人体体液决定心境与气质，后演变出滑稽、风趣之意。
family_guide.core_distinction: humor 与 humour 仅为美式与英式拼写差异；humorous 为形容词。

lemmas.def_en: literature in metrical form
lemmas.def_zh: 诗歌，诗作；诗意

examples.en: She writes poetry to express her deepest emotions.
examples.zh: 她通过写诗来表达自己内心最深沉的情感。

lemmas.def_en: a writer of poems (the term is usually reserved for writers of good poetry)
lemmas.def_zh: 诗人

examples.en: The young poet spent the entire afternoon composing verses by the quiet lake.
examples.zh: 这位年轻诗人整个下午都在宁静的湖畔吟诗作对。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to poetry
lemmas.def_zh: 诗的, 诗意的, 诗人的

examples.en: Her description of the autumn leaves had a deeply poetic and gentle rhythm.
examples.zh: 她对秋叶的描写带有一种极其诗意且柔和的韵律。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to poetry
lemmas.def_zh: 诗的, 用诗写成的, 韵文的, 理想化了的

examples.en: She described the sunset in remarkably poetical language during her speech.
examples.zh: 她在演讲中用极富诗意的语言描绘了落日景象。

lemmas.def_en: in a poetic manner
lemmas.def_zh: 理想化地

examples.en: He spoke poetically about the sea, capturing the audience's full attention.
examples.zh: 他满怀诗意地谈论起大海，完全吸引了全场观众的注意力。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 poiein（制造、创作），本义为用语言构筑美感的人。
family_guide.core_distinction: poet 指创作者本身；poetic 指具有诗歌特质或风格。

lemmas.def_en: make senseless or dizzy by or as if by a blow
lemmas.def_zh: 使昏迷, 使震惊, 打昏

examples.en: The unexpected news seemed to stun the audience into a prolonged and heavy silence.
examples.zh: 这突如其来的消息似乎让全场观众震惊得陷入了长久的沉默。

lemmas.def_en: in a spectacular manner
lemmas.def_zh: 绝妙地; 极好地; 令人震惊地; 使人目瞪口呆地

examples.en: The actress looked stunningly beautiful in the vintage gown at the movie premiere.
examples.zh: 在电影首映式上，这位女演员身穿复古长裙显得美艳绝伦。

lemmas.def_en: a very attractive or seductive looking woman
lemmas.def_zh: 令人震惊的事物, 绝妙的东西, 出色的人

examples.en: Her latest novel is an absolute stunner that keeps readers glued until the end.
examples.zh: 她的最新小说绝对是一部令人惊叹的杰作，让读者欲罢不能。

lemmas.def_zh: adj. 目瞪口呆的；震惊得说不出话的
lemmas.def_en: very surprised or shocked, unable to react or speak
lemmas.usage_note: 多描述人的心理状态，常作表语，或后接 that / by / at 从句与短语。

examples.en: The audience sat in stunned silence after hearing the tragic news.
examples.zh: 听到这个悲惨的消息后，观众们震惊得一片死寂。

lemmas.def_zh: adj. 极漂亮的；令人震惊的
lemmas.def_en: extremely attractive or impressive
lemmas.usage_note: 常修饰容貌、景色或成就，如 a stunning view, stunning beauty。

examples.en: She looked absolutely stunning in her evening gown.
examples.zh: 她穿上晚礼服看起来美极了。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古法语 estoner（震聋、打昏），引申指精神上极度震惊或目瞪口呆。

lemmas.def_en: place troops or weapons in battle formation
lemmas.def_zh: 展开, 配置
