examples.en: The military decided to deploy modern rescue equipment to the flooded mountain area.
examples.zh: 军方决定将现代救援装备部署到遭受洪灾的山区。

lemmas.def_en: the distribution of forces in preparation for battle or work
lemmas.def_zh: [计] 展开

examples.en: The rapid deployment of the medical team saved hundreds of lives during the crisis.
examples.zh: 在危机期间迅速调配医疗队伍挽救了数百人的生命。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 displicare（展开、散开），原为军事布阵，后广泛用于资源或人员调度。
family_guide.core_distinction: deploy 是动词，deployment 是其对应的名词形式（部署行动）。

lemmas.def_en: make (a surface) shine
lemmas.def_zh: 擦亮, 擦去, 使完美；擦亮, 变得光亮

examples.en: You need to polish your presentation slides before tomorrow's meeting with the client.
examples.zh: 在明天与客户会面前，你需要润色一下演示文稿。

lemmas.def_en: the property of being smooth and shiny
lemmas.def_zh: 波兰人, 上光剂, 光泽, 优雅

examples.en: You need to polish your presentation slides before tomorrow's meeting with the client.
examples.zh: 在明天与客户会面前，你需要润色一下演示文稿。

lemmas.def_en: a power tool used to buff surfaces
lemmas.def_zh: 磨亮的人, 磨光器

examples.en: He used an electric shoe polisher to give his leather boots a bright shine.
examples.zh: 他用电动擦鞋器将皮靴擦得锃亮。

lemmas.def_en: not carefully reworked or perfected or made smooth by polishing
lemmas.def_zh: 未磨光的, 无光泽的, 未经润饰的

examples.en: Although his essay showed great creativity, the writing style was rough and unpolished.
examples.zh: 尽管他的文章展现了极高的创造力，但写作风格仍显粗糙、未经润色。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 polire（使光滑），本义为打磨摩擦，引申为修饰、精炼。

lemmas.def_en: make a hole, especially with a pointed power or hand tool
lemmas.def_zh: 训练, 钻孔

examples.en: The workers must drill several deep holes into the wall before mounting the shelf.
examples.zh: 工人们在安装架子前必须在墙上钻几个深孔。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 drill 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: denoting or deriving from or distinctive of the ways of living built up by a group of people; - J.F.Kennedy
lemmas.def_zh: 人种的, 种族的

examples.en: The vibrant festival offered a great opportunity to explore various ethnic food traditions.
examples.zh: 这个热闹的节日提供了一个探索各种少数族裔饮食传统的绝佳机会。

lemmas.def_en: a person who is a member of an ethnic group
lemmas.def_zh: [医] 人种的

examples.en: The vibrant festival offered a great opportunity to explore various ethnic food traditions.
examples.zh: 这个热闹的节日提供了一个探索各种少数族裔饮食传统的绝佳机会。

lemmas.def_en: an ethnic quality or affiliation resulting from racial or cultural ties
lemmas.def_zh: 种族划分

examples.en: The application form asks you to state your nationality and your self-identified ethnicity.
examples.zh: 申请表要求你注明自己的国籍和自主认同的种族归属。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 ethnos（民族、部落），核心表示具有共同文化、语言或血缘特征的特定人群群体属性。
family_guide.core_distinction: ethnic 侧重具有特定文化背景的“少数族裔个体”，ethnicity 指抽象的“种族身份或民族归属”。

lemmas.def_en: a projectile that is fired from a gun
lemmas.def_zh: 子弹，弹丸；项目符号

examples.en: The officer narrowly escaped injury when a bullet grazed his helmet.
examples.zh: 一颗子弹擦过这名警官的头盔，他险些受伤。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自法语 boulette（小球），指枪械发射的金属弹头，引申指排版中的项目符号。

lemmas.def_en: move slowly; in the case of people or animals with the body near the ground
lemmas.def_zh: v. 蹑手蹑脚地移动；爬行；不知不觉地产生

examples.en: I tried to creep up the stairs without waking my parents.
examples.zh: 我试图蹑手蹑脚地上楼，不吵醒父母。

lemmas.def_en: move slowly; in the case of people or animals with the body near the ground
lemmas.def_zh: v. 蹑手蹑脚地移动；爬行（creep的过去式和过去分词）

examples.en: Doubts crept into her mind as the deadline approached.
examples.zh: 随着截止日期的临近，疑虑悄悄爬上了她的心头。

lemmas.def_en: annoying and unpleasant
lemmas.def_zh: adj. 令人毛骨悚然的；诡异的

examples.en: There is a creepy old house at the end of our street.
examples.zh: 我们街道尽头有一座令人毛骨悚然的老房子。

lemmas.def_en: any plant (as ivy or periwinkle) that grows by creeping
lemmas.def_zh: 爬行者

examples.en: A thick green creeper slowly climbed up the ancient brick wall of the garden.
examples.zh: 一株茂密的绿色攀援植物慢慢爬上了花园古老的砖墙。

lemmas.def_en: an uneasy sensation as of insects creeping on your skin
lemmas.def_zh: 毛骨悚然

examples.en: The subtle creepiness of the abandoned house made the curious children hesitate to enter.
examples.zh: 那栋废弃房屋隐约透出的诡异气息，让好奇的孩子们不敢贸然进入。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 creopan，核心语义为‘贴地或缓慢、悄无声息地爬行’，后引申为令人毛骨悚然的怪异感受。

lemmas.def_en: narrow-leaved green herbage: grown as lawns; used as pasture for grazing animals; cut and dried as hay
lemmas.def_zh: 草, 草原, 牧场

examples.en: The children spent hours playing happily on the soft green grass in the park.
examples.zh: 孩子们在公园柔软的绿草地上快乐地玩耍了几个小时。

lemmas.def_en: shoot down, of birds
lemmas.def_zh: [医] 草, 禾本

examples.en: The children spent hours playing happily on the soft green grass in the park.
examples.zh: 孩子们在公园柔软的绿草地上快乐地玩耍了几个小时。

lemmas.def_en: abounding in grass
lemmas.def_zh: 草绿色的, 象草的, 长满草的

examples.en: We sat on a breezy grassy slope to enjoy the sunset over the valley.
examples.zh: 我们坐在微风徐徐的长满青草的斜坡上，欣赏山谷中的日落。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 græs，核心本义为“青草、草地”，后在英式俚语中引申出“告密”之意（可能源于草丛中的蛇潜伏象征背叛）。

lemmas.def_en: a strong hard building material composed of sand and gravel and cement and water
lemmas.def_zh: 凝结物, 混凝土

examples.en: The workers poured fresh concrete into the wooden frames to form the new foundation.
examples.zh: 工人们将新鲜的混凝土倒入木模中，以浇筑新的地基。

lemmas.def_en: the formation of stonelike objects within a body organ (e.g., the kidneys)
lemmas.def_zh: 凝固, 凝固物, 结石

examples.en: The patient underwent surgery to remove a painful concretion that had formed inside his kidney.
examples.zh: 该患者接受了手术，以取出其肾脏内部形成的令人疼痛的结石。

lemmas.def_en: the quality of being concrete (not abstract)
lemmas.def_zh: 具体性

examples.en: The clear concreteness of her proposal made it much easier for the board to approve.
examples.zh: 她提议中清晰明确的具体性使得董事会更容易予以批准。

lemmas.def_en: capable of being perceived by the senses; not abstract or imaginary
lemmas.def_zh: 具体的, 实在的, 混凝土的

examples.en: The workers poured fresh concrete into the wooden frames to form the new foundation.
examples.zh: 工人们将新鲜的混凝土倒入木模中，以浇筑新的地基。

lemmas.def_en: in concrete terms
lemmas.def_zh: 具体地

examples.en: The proposal explains concretely how the new policy will benefit small local businesses.
examples.zh: 该提案具体解释了新政策将如何使当地小企业受益。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 concrete 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: rub with a brush, or as if with a brush
lemmas.def_zh: 刷；擦过, 掠过

examples.en: She used a small comb to brush the dried mud off her shoes.
examples.zh: 她用一把小梳子刷掉了鞋上的干泥。

lemmas.def_en: a dense growth of bushes
lemmas.def_zh: 刷子, 毛笔, 争吵

examples.en: She used a small comb to brush the dried mud off her shoes.
examples.zh: 她用一把小梳子刷掉了鞋上的干泥。

lemmas.def_en: covered with or consisting of bushes or thickets; ; ; - Jack Beatty
lemmas.def_zh: 如毛刷的, 毛茸茸的, 矮林多的

examples.en: The fox darted into the brushy hillside and disappeared from our view completely.
examples.zh: 狐狸冲进灌木丛生的小山坡，完全从我们的视野中消失了。

lemmas.def_en: (of hair or clothing) not brushed
lemmas.def_zh: [网络] 没刷

examples.en: He rushed to the meeting with unbrushed hair and a wrinkled shirt.
examples.zh: 他顶着没梳理的头发、穿着褶皱的衬衫匆忙赶去开会。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 brush 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: relating to or concerned with electricity
lemmas.def_zh: 电的，用电的，与电相关的

examples.en: The fire was caused by an electrical fault in the basement.
examples.zh: 火灾是由地下室的一处电气故障引起的。

lemmas.def_en: by electricity
lemmas.def_zh: 电力地；有关电地

examples.en: The front gates are electrically powered and can be opened with a remote.
examples.zh: 大门是电动控制的，可以用遥控器打开。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自electric（电的）+-al（形容词后缀），核心语义为“与电相关的、电气的”。
family_guide.core_distinction: 与electric（直接带电的、以电驱动的，如electric car）相比，electrical更多指“与电有关的、电气科学或行业的”，如electrical engineering（电气工程）、electrical fault（电气故障）。

lemmas.def_en: move gently or carefully
lemmas.def_zh: 使安乐, 使安心, 减轻, 放松；减轻, 放松, 灵活地移动

examples.en: A hot bath will help to ease the persistent ache in your shoulders.
examples.zh: 泡个热水澡有助于缓解你肩膀上持续的酸痛。

lemmas.def_en: (law) the privilege of using something that is not your own (as using another's land as a right of way to your own land)
lemmas.def_zh: 缓和, 减轻, 便利设施

examples.en: The property agreement granted an easement allowing neighbors to cross the private driveway.
examples.zh: 该房产协议授予了一项地役权，允许邻居穿过私人车道。

lemmas.def_en: physical discomfort (as mild sickness or depression)
lemmas.def_zh: 不安

examples.en: A growing sense of unease filled the room as the bad news spread.
examples.zh: 随着坏消息的传开，屋子里弥漫着一种愈发强烈的焦躁不安。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ease 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a German member of Adolf Hitler's political party
lemmas.def_zh: 纳粹分子，极权主义者；专横霸道的人

examples.en: He acted like a grammar nazi, constantly correcting everyone's minor mistakes.
examples.zh: 他表现得像个语法纠察狂，总是不断纠正大家犯的细微错误。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自德语 Nationalsozialist（国家社会主义者）的口语缩略词，后引申指极权专制者或极度专横苛刻的人。

lemmas.def_en: an exile who flees for safety
lemmas.def_zh: 难民，避难者

examples.en: Thousands of refugees crossed the border to escape the escalating civil war.
examples.zh: 成千上万的难民越过边境，以逃离不断升级的内战。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自法语 réfugié，基于 refuge（避难、避难所），指逃离危险、寻求庇护的人。

lemmas.def_en: the land along the edge of a body of water
lemmas.def_zh: 海岸, 海滨, 斜撑柱

examples.en: We walked along the rocky shore collecting smooth sea glass in the evening.
examples.zh: 傍晚时分，我们沿着多石的海岸漫步，收集光滑的海玻璃。

lemmas.def_en: serve as a shore to
lemmas.def_zh: 把...送上岸, 支撑, 支持

examples.en: We walked along the rocky shore collecting smooth sea glass in the evening.
examples.zh: 傍晚时分，我们沿着多石的海岸漫步，收集光滑的海玻璃。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 shore 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: to incline or bend from a vertical position
lemmas.def_zh: 倚靠, 倾斜, 依赖；使倾斜

examples.en: Do not lean your wet umbrella against the newly painted living room wall.
examples.zh: 别把你湿漉漉的雨伞靠在刚粉刷好的客厅墙上。

lemmas.def_en: to incline or bend from a vertical position
lemmas.def_zh: lean的过去式和过去分词

examples.en: He leant over the wooden fence to get a better look at the garden.
examples.zh: 他探身靠在木栅栏上，以便更清楚地看看花园。

lemmas.def_en: lacking excess flesh; ; -Shakespeare
lemmas.def_zh: 瘦的, 贫乏的, 歉收的

examples.en: Do not lean your wet umbrella against the newly painted living room wall.
examples.zh: 别把你湿漉漉的雨伞靠在刚粉刷好的客厅墙上。

lemmas.def_en: an inclination to do something
lemmas.def_zh: 倾斜, 倾向, 爱好

examples.en: The politician has shown a strong leaning toward renewable energy policies this year.
examples.zh: 这位政治家今年表现出强烈的支持可再生能源政策的倾向。

lemmas.def_en: the quality of being meager; -George Eliot
lemmas.def_zh: 贫瘠, 无脂肪, 贫弱

examples.en: Athletes often strive for extreme leanness to improve their speed and endurance performance.
examples.zh: 运动员通常追求极低的体脂以提高速度和耐力表现。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 lean 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the relative magnitudes of two quantities (usually expressed as a quotient)
lemmas.def_zh: n. 比，比率，比例

examples.en: The ratio of students to teachers at this school is approximately ten to one.
examples.zh: 这所学校的师生比例大约是十比一。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 reri（计算、思考），核心含义为两数或两事物之间的数量对比关系。

lemmas.def_en: part of an organism consisting of an aggregate of cells having a similar structure and function
lemmas.def_zh: 薄的织物, 薄纱, 棉纸, 组织, 一套

examples.en: The doctor examined the damaged tissue under a microscope to detect any infection.
examples.zh: 医生在显微镜下检查受损组织以检测是否有感染。

lemmas.def_en: create a piece of cloth by interlacing strands of fabric, such as wool or cotton
lemmas.def_zh: [化] 组织

examples.en: The doctor examined the damaged tissue under a microscope to detect any infection.
examples.zh: 医生在显微镜下检查受损组织以检测是否有感染。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 texere（编织），核心语义为“编织物”，后引申指结构如织物般的“生物组织”及薄如编织物的“薄纸、纸巾”。

lemmas.def_en: a noisemaker (as at parties or games) that makes a loud noise when you blow through it
lemmas.def_zh: 角, 角质, 喇叭, 号角

examples.en: The angry driver pressed the horn repeatedly during the morning rush hour traffic.
examples.zh: 愤怒的司机在早高峰堵车期间不停地按喇叭。

lemmas.def_en: a state of sexual arousal
lemmas.def_zh: 角质, 硬质

examples.en: The excessive horniness of the skin on his heels caused painful cracks.
examples.zh: 他脚后跟皮肤过度角质化导致了疼痛的皲裂。

lemmas.def_en: stab or pierce with a horn or tusk
lemmas.def_zh: 用角触, 长角于

examples.en: The angry driver pressed the horn repeatedly during the morning rush hour traffic.
examples.zh: 愤怒的司机在早高峰堵车期间不停地按喇叭。

lemmas.def_en: feeling great sexual desire
lemmas.def_zh: 角的, 似角一样坚硬的, 角质的, 老茧的

examples.en: Working with rough tools for decades left him with horny and calloused hands.
examples.zh: 几十年来使用粗糙的工具让他双手布满了角质硬茧。

lemmas.def_en: having no horns
lemmas.def_zh: (动物等)无角的, 无号角的

examples.en: Farmers prefer raising hornless cattle because they are safer to handle in herds.
examples.zh: 农民更喜欢饲养无角牛，因为群养时它们更安全。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自原始印欧语，核心指动物头上突出的“角”，后引申为角质坚硬物、号角、喇叭及性冲动等意象。
family_guide.core_distinction: horn(名词/动词)侧重硬角、喇叭或顶撞动作；horny(形容词)多引申为角质的、粗糙的，口语中极常指性兴奋的。

lemmas.def_en: a person who has never had sex
lemmas.def_zh: 处女

examples.en: Hikers discovered a vast area of virgin forest that had never been explored.
examples.zh: 徒步旅行者发现了一大片从未被开发过的原始森林。

lemmas.def_en: the condition or quality of being a virgin
lemmas.def_zh: 处女身份, 处女贞洁, 童贞

examples.en: The historical novel explores the cultural importance placed on female virginity in medieval times.
examples.zh: 这部历史小说探讨了中世纪对女性童贞的文化重视。

lemmas.def_en: a legless rectangular harpsichord; played (usually by women) in the 16th and 17th centuries
lemmas.def_zh: [医] 处女的

examples.en: The musician played a delicate melody on the antique virginal in the museum.
examples.zh: 音乐家在博物馆里的这架古老小键琴上弹奏了一首优美的旋律。

lemmas.def_en: being used or worked for the first time
lemmas.def_zh: 处女的, 贞洁的, 纯洁的, 初始的, 纯的

examples.en: The hikers explored a vast expanse of virgin forest untouched by modern civilization.
examples.zh: 徒步旅行者探索了这片未受现代文明破坏的辽阔原始森林。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 virgo，核心意象为“纯洁、未经触碰、未经开垦的原始状态”。

lemmas.def_en: sweep across or over
lemmas.def_zh: 扫除, 掸去, 猛拉, 扫荡, 肃清, 冲走, 刮起, 环视, 掠过, 扫射；扫, 打扫, 袭击, 席卷, 扫视, 掠过

examples.en: Please sweep the fallen leaves off the front porch before the guests arrive.
examples.zh: 请在客人到来之前把前廊的落叶扫干净。

lemmas.def_en: sweep across or over
lemmas.def_zh: sweep的过去式和过去分词

examples.en: A sudden gust of wind swept the documents right off his outdoor desk.
examples.zh: 一阵突如其来的大风将户外桌上的文件直接吹飞了。

lemmas.def_en: a wide scope
lemmas.def_zh: 扫除, 打扫, 肃清, 视野, 范围, 全胜

examples.en: Please sweep the fallen leaves off the front porch before the guests arrive.
examples.zh: 请在客人到来之前把前廊的落叶扫干净。

lemmas.def_en: the act of cleaning with a broom
lemmas.def_zh: 扫除, 垃圾

examples.en: She disposed of the sweepings from the kitchen floor into the trash bin.
examples.zh: 她把从厨房地板上扫出的垃圾倒进了垃圾桶。

lemmas.def_en: an employee who sweeps (floors or streets etc.)
lemmas.def_zh: 清扫夫

examples.en: The city sweeper kept the downtown sidewalks clean during the early morning hours.
examples.zh: 城市清洁工在清晨时分保持着市中心人行道的整洁。

lemmas.def_en: in a sweeping manner
lemmas.def_zh: 扫荡地；彻底地

examples.en: The manager sweepingly dismissed all our suggestions without giving any valid reasons.
examples.zh: 经理未给出任何充分理由，便将我们所有的建议一概彻底驳回。

lemmas.def_en: not swept or having sweep
lemmas.def_zh: 未扫过的

examples.en: Dust gathered on the unswept floor of the abandoned cottage over the winter.
examples.zh: 整个冬天，废弃小屋那未清扫的地板上积满了灰尘。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语，核心动作是“大弧度、大范围地快速掠过或清理”。
family_guide.core_distinction: sweep作名词常指大范围的扫除或连绵的延伸；sweeping作动名词侧重清扫行为，作形容词时表示范围极广的或彻底的。

lemmas.def_en: to move or force, especially in an effort to get something open; :
lemmas.def_zh: 撬

examples.en: The burglar tried to jimmy the back door open with a metal crowbar.
examples.zh: 窃贼试图用一根金属撬棍把后门撬开。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自人名 James/Jimmy 的昵称化用法，小偷俚语中用作小型撬棍及撬锁撬门的行为。

lemmas.def_en: a short coat
lemmas.def_zh: 夹克, 外套, 护套

examples.en: He pulled on his heavy leather jacket to protect himself from the cold.
examples.zh: 他套上厚厚的皮夹克以抵御刺骨的寒冷。

lemmas.def_en: provide with a thermally non-conducting cover
lemmas.def_zh: 给...穿夹克, 给...装护套

examples.en: He pulled on his heavy leather jacket to protect himself from the cold.
examples.zh: 他套上厚厚的皮夹克以抵御刺骨的寒冷。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古法语 jaquet，本指贴身的短上衣，后引申为各种物品的“外皮、护套、封套”。

lemmas.def_en: an edible emulsion of fat globules made by churning milk or cream; for cooking and table use
lemmas.def_zh: 奶油, 黄油

examples.en: She spread a thick layer of creamy butter across the warm slice of toast.
examples.zh: 她在温热的吐司切片上涂了厚厚一层奶油。

lemmas.def_en: thick end of the handle
lemmas.def_zh: 粗大的一头, 烟头, 靶, 笑柄

examples.en: He stubbed out his cigarette butt in the metal tray on the table.
examples.zh: 他把烟头在桌上的金属烟灰缸里掐灭了。

lemmas.def_en: a small storeroom for storing foods or wines
lemmas.def_zh: 配膳室

examples.en: The steward retrieved a fresh bottle of wine from the college's historic buttery.
examples.zh: 管家从学院历史悠久的食品储藏室里取来了一瓶新酒。

lemmas.def_en: spread butter on
lemmas.def_zh: 涂黄油于

examples.en: She spread a thick layer of creamy butter across the warm slice of toast.
examples.zh: 她在温热的吐司切片上涂了厚厚一层奶油。

lemmas.def_en: lie adjacent to another or share a boundary
lemmas.def_zh: [医] 对核

examples.en: He stubbed out his cigarette butt in the metal tray on the table.
examples.zh: 他把烟头在桌上的金属烟灰缸里掐灭了。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 boutyron（牛油），本义为黄油，动词引申为涂黄油或比喻“阿谀奉承”。

lemmas.def_en: meant or adapted for an occasion or use
lemmas.def_zh: 适当的, 相配的

examples.en: This quiet riverside park is a suitable location for our annual family picnic.
examples.zh: 这个宁静的河畔公园很适合用来举办我们一年一度的家庭野餐。

lemmas.def_en: not meant or adapted for a particular purpose
lemmas.def_zh: 不适合的

examples.en: His casual clothes were completely unsuitable for such a formal job interview.
examples.zh: 他这身休闲装束对于如此正式的求职面试来说完全不合适。

lemmas.def_en: the quality of having the properties that are right for a specific purpose
lemmas.def_zh: 适合, 适当

examples.en: The committee is evaluating the suitability of the candidate for the leadership role.
examples.zh: 委员会正在评估该候选人担任这一领导职务的适任性。

lemmas.def_en: the quality of having the wrong properties for a specific purpose
lemmas.def_zh: 不适当, 不相称, 不适合

examples.en: The survey highlighted the unsuitability of the rocky terrain for new residential construction.
examples.zh: 这项调查突显出这片岩石地形不适合用于建造新的住宅。

family_guide.root_logic: 来自 suit（适合，相称）+ -able（能……的），核心含义为“符合特定条件或场合的”。

lemmas.def_en: an enlarged and muscular saclike organ of the alimentary canal; the principal organ of digestion
lemmas.def_zh: 胃, 食欲, 欲望, 肚子

examples.en: He felt an uncomfortable pain in his stomach after eating the spicy food.
examples.zh: 吃完辛辣食物后，他感到胃部一阵难受的疼痛。

lemmas.def_en: bear to eat
lemmas.def_zh: 吃下, 忍受

examples.en: He felt an uncomfortable pain in his stomach after eating the spicy food.
examples.zh: 吃完辛辣食物后，他感到胃部一阵难受的疼痛。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 stomachos（食道、胃），生理上指消化器官，心理和比喻上引申为容忍、承受能力。

lemmas.def_en: urgently needed; absolutely necessary
lemmas.def_zh: 生命的, 重要的, 充满活力的, 生死攸关的, 致命的

examples.en: Regular exercise and adequate sleep are vital to maintaining your overall health.
examples.zh: 规律的锻炼和充足的睡眠对于保持你的整体健康至关重要。

lemmas.def_zh: 不可缺少的, 责无旁贷的, 绝对必要的
lemmas.def_en: not to be dispensed with; essential

examples.en: A reliable internet connection has become an indispensable tool for modern remote workers.
examples.zh: 可靠的网络连接已成为现代远程工作者不可或缺的工具。

lemmas.def_en: an energetic style
lemmas.def_zh: 活力, 生命力

examples.en: The energetic music brought a youthful vitality to the entire community festival.
examples.zh: 充满活力的音乐给整个社区节日带来了一股青春的朝气。

lemmas.def_zh: 不可缺少, 责无旁贷
lemmas.def_en: the quality possessed by something that you cannot possibly do without
the state of being vitalized and filled with life
lemmas.def_zh: 赋予生命

examples.en: The city launched a grand project for the vitalization of the declining industrial district.
examples.zh: 该市启动了一项重大工程，旨在振兴这个日益衰退的工业区。

lemmas.def_en: to a vital degree
lemmas.def_zh: 与生命有关地, 致命地, 紧要地

examples.en: Clean drinking water is vitally important for the survival of the isolated village.
examples.zh: 洁净的饮用水对这个偏远村庄的生存至关重要。

lemmas.def_en: give life to
lemmas.def_zh: 赋予生命, 给予活力, 使有生气

examples.en: The coach introduced new training methods to vitalize the tired and discouraged team.
examples.zh: 教练引入了新的训练方法，让疲惫气馁的队伍恢复了活力。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 vita（生命），核心逻辑指“与生命休戚相关的”，引申为至关重要、充满生机的。

lemmas.def_en: the text of a popular song or musical-comedy number
lemmas.def_zh: 抒情诗, 歌词

examples.en: She sat at the piano, inspired to lyric a song about her hometown.
examples.zh: 她坐在钢琴前，灵感迸发，为一首关于家乡的歌曲作词。

lemmas.def_en: a person who writes the words for songs
lemmas.def_zh: 抒情诗人, 歌曲作者

examples.en: The talented lyricist collaborated with several pop singers to create memorable, chart-topping hits.
examples.zh: 这位才华横溢的词作者与数位流行歌手合作，创作了多首难忘的榜首金曲。

lemmas.def_en: expressing deep emotion
lemmas.def_zh: 抒情的

examples.en: She sat at the piano, inspired to lyric a song about her hometown.
examples.zh: 她坐在钢琴前，灵感迸发，为一首关于家乡的歌曲作词。

lemmas.def_en: write lyrics for (a song)

examples.en: She sat at the piano, inspired to lyric a song about her hometown.
examples.zh: 她坐在钢琴前，灵感迸发，为一首关于家乡的歌曲作词。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 lyra（里拉琴），原指配琴歌唱的抒情诗歌，后拓展为歌词及抒情风格的创作。

lemmas.def_en: something that is an indulgence rather than a necessity
lemmas.def_zh: 奢侈, 豪华

examples.en: After weeks of camping, having a warm shower felt like an absolute luxury.
examples.zh: 在野营数周之后，能洗个热水澡感觉是一件极其奢侈的事。

lemmas.def_en: wealth as evidenced by sumptuous living
lemmas.def_zh: 奢侈;豪华

examples.en: Guests were immediately impressed by the sheer luxuriousness of the hotel's marble lobby.
examples.zh: 酒店大理石大堂所展现出的极致奢华立刻给客人们留下了深刻印象。

lemmas.def_en: displaying luxury and furnishing gratification to the senses
lemmas.def_zh: 豪华的, 奢侈的, 放纵的

examples.en: They spent their anniversary at a luxurious beachfront resort overlooking the blue sea.
examples.zh: 他们在一座俯瞰碧海的豪华海滨度假村里度过了结婚纪念日。

lemmas.def_zh: 繁茂的, 丰富的, 肥沃的, 华丽的
lemmas.def_en: marked by complexity and richness of detail

examples.en: Tropical rains nourished the luxuriant vegetation covering the steep slopes of the island.
examples.zh: 热带雨水滋养了覆盖岛屿陡峭山坡的茂密植被。

lemmas.def_en: in an indulgently luxurious manner
lemmas.def_zh: 豪华地；奢侈地

examples.en: The living room was luxuriously furnished with soft velvet sofas and antique decorations.
examples.zh: 客厅布置得十分奢华，摆放着柔软的天鹅绒沙发和古董装饰品。

lemmas.def_zh: 蔚然
lemmas.def_en: in an abundant and luxuriant manner

examples.en: whiskers grew luxuriantly from his ample jowls

lemmas.def_en: become extravagant; indulge (oneself) luxuriously
lemmas.def_zh: 繁茂, 过奢侈生活, 沉溺

examples.en: On quiet Sunday mornings, she loved to luxuriate in a warm bubble bath.
examples.zh: 在宁静的周日早晨，她喜欢尽情沉浸在温暖的泡泡浴中享受。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 luxus（过剩、放纵），核心语义为超出日常必需的昂贵享受与奢华状态。
family_guide.core_distinction: luxury 是名词，指奢侈品或奢华享受；luxurious 是其形容词形式，描述具体事物豪华、舒适的特征。

lemmas.def_en: provoking horror; ; ; ; - Winston Churchill
lemmas.def_zh: 可怕的, 遭透的, 极讨厌的

examples.en: The travelers were forced to cancel their trip because of the horrible weather.
examples.zh: 由于糟糕的天气，旅客们不得不取消了他们的行程。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 horrere（毛发直立、打战、颤抖）+ -ible，核心意指“令人毛骨悚然、感到可怕讨厌的”。

lemmas.def_en: to a severe or serious degree
lemmas.def_zh: 严重地, 恶劣地, 极度地

examples.en: The old stone bridge was badly damaged during the severe storm last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚的暴风雨使那座老石桥遭到了严重破坏。

family_guide.root_logic: 由形容词 bad（坏的、严重的）+ 副词后缀 -ly 构成，表示程度严重或方式低劣。

lemmas.def_en: put in effect
lemmas.def_zh: 实践, 履行, 实行, 完成, 结束, 满足

examples.en: The dedicated employee worked long hours to fulfill all terms of the contract.
examples.zh: 这名敬业的员工加班加点工作，以履行合同中的所有条款。

lemmas.def_en: put in effect
lemmas.def_zh: 实践, 履行, 实行, 完成, 结束, 满足

examples.en: She hoped that graduating from medical school would fulfil her lifelong dream of helping others.
examples.zh: 她希望从医学院毕业能实现自己一生助人的梦想。

lemmas.def_en: a feeling of satisfaction at having achieved your desires
lemmas.def_zh: 履行, 结束, 完成, 实现, 满意, 称心

examples.en: Volunteering at the animal shelter gave him a deep sense of personal fulfillment.
examples.zh: 在动物收容所当志愿者带给他一种深刻的个人满足感。

lemmas.def_en: a feeling of satisfaction at having achieved your desires
lemmas.def_zh: 履行, 结束, 完成, 实现, 满意, 称心

examples.en: The successful launch of the project marked the fulfilment of years of hard work.
examples.zh: 项目的成功启动标志着多年辛勤付出的圆满达成。

lemmas.def_en: of persons; marked by failure to realize full potentialities
lemmas.def_zh: [法] 未实现的, 未履行的, 未完成的

examples.en: Despite his professional success, he often felt haunted by his unfulfilled artistic ambitions.
examples.zh: 尽管事业有成，但他常常因未实现的艺术抱负而感到遗憾。

family_guide.root_logic: 由 full（满）+ fill（填）复合而成，字面即“填满”，引申为实现愿望、履行职责或完成诺言。
family_guide.core_distinction: fulfill 为美式拼写，fulfil 为英式拼写，二者语义完全相同。

lemmas.def_en: keep constant through physical or chemical reactions or evolutionary change
lemmas.def_zh: 保存, 使(能量等)守恒

examples.en: During the summer drought, residents were urged to conserve water wherever possible.
examples.zh: 在夏季干旱期间，居民们被呼吁尽可能节约用水。

lemmas.def_en: an occurrence of improvement by virtue of preventing loss or injury or other change
lemmas.def_zh: 保护, 保存

examples.en: The national park was originally established for the conservation of endangered wildlife species.
examples.zh: 该国家公园最初是为保护濒危野生动物物种而设立的。

lemmas.def_en: someone who works to protect the environment from destruction or pollution
lemmas.def_zh: 自然资源保护论者

examples.en: A dedicated conservationist spoke passionately about protecting the ancient rainforest from illegal logging.
examples.zh: 一位敬业的自然资源保护论者慷慨陈词，呼吁保护原始雨林免受非法采伐。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 con-（共同、完全）+ serve（保持、守护），核心在于“完整保留并保护好某物免受损耗”。
family_guide.core_distinction: conserve 是动词，侧重“节约保护”的动作；conservation 是其名词形式，多指具体的“生态保护、能源节约”领域或行为。

lemmas.def_en: remove, usually with some force or effort; also used in an abstract sense
lemmas.def_zh: (费力地)取出, 采掘, 榨取, 摘录, 吸取

examples.en: Scientists developed a new, efficient technique to extract natural oil from flower petals.
examples.zh: 科学家们开发出一种从花瓣中提取天然精油的高效新技术。

lemmas.def_en: a solution obtained by steeping or soaking a substance (usually in water)
lemmas.def_zh: 榨出物, 精汁, 摘录, 选段

examples.en: Scientists developed a new, efficient technique to extract natural oil from flower petals.
examples.zh: 科学家们开发出一种从花瓣中提取天然精油的高效新技术。

lemmas.def_en: the process of obtaining something from a mixture or compound by chemical or physical or mechanical means
lemmas.def_zh: 抽出, 取出, 拔出术, 抽出物

examples.en: The dentist assured her that the tooth extraction would be completely painless.
examples.zh: 牙医向她保证，这次拔牙手术将是完全无痛的。

lemmas.def_en: an instrument for extracting tight-fitting components
lemmas.def_zh: 抽出器, 拔取的人, 抽出者

examples.en: We bought a powerful juice extractor to make fresh fruit smoothies every morning.
examples.zh: 我们买了一台强力榨汁机，每天早晨制作新鲜的水果冰沙。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 ex-（向外）+ tract（拉、引），核心逻辑为“拉出、抽离”。
family_guide.core_distinction: extract 作名词指提取出的物质或摘录；extraction 指抽离、拔除的过程或血统、家世。

lemmas.def_en: completely unclothed
lemmas.def_zh: 裸体的, 无装饰的, 无保护的, 赤贫的

examples.en: The tiny island was completely naked, offering no shelter from the storm.
examples.zh: 那座小岛光秃秃的，无法提供任何遮风避雨的庇护。

lemmas.def_en: the state of being without clothing or covering of any kind
lemmas.def_zh: 裸, 明显, 赤身裸体

examples.en: The stark nakedness of the winter trees created a hauntingly beautiful scene.
examples.zh: 冬日树木光秃秃的景象营造出一种凄美的氛围。

lemmas.def_en: in an exposed manner; without protection or defense
lemmas.def_zh: 裸体地；露出地

examples.en: The company's new policy nakedly prioritizes profit over employee safety.
examples.zh: 该公司的新政策赤裸裸地将利润置于员工安全之上。

family_guide.root_logic: 日耳曼语源，指人或物体“未受覆盖、没有伪装”的原始状态。

lemmas.def_en: an architectural product or work
lemmas.def_zh: 建筑学, 建筑式样

examples.en: She moved to Rome to study classical architecture and historic preservation.
examples.zh: 她搬到罗马去学习古典建筑学和历史文物保护。

family_guide.root_logic: arch-（主要的/统领的）+ tecture（建造/技术），核心指“主导营造的学问与格局”。

lemmas.def_en: done by or characteristic of individuals acting together
lemmas.def_zh: 集体的, 聚集的, 共同的

examples.en: The success of the project was due to a collective team effort.
examples.zh: 该项目的成功归功于整个团队的集体努力。

lemmas.def_en: in conjunction with; combined
lemmas.def_zh: 集合, 聚合性, 共同, 集体主义, 集团, 集体

examples.en: The board members collectively decided to reject the hostile takeover bid.
examples.zh: 董事会成员一致决定拒绝这项敌意收购要约。

lemmas.def_en: members of a cooperative enterprise
lemmas.def_zh: [医] 集体的, 集合的

examples.en: The success of the project was due to a collective team effort.
examples.zh: 该项目的成功归功于整个团队的集体努力。

lemmas.def_en: the organization of a nation or economy on the basis of collectivism
lemmas.def_zh: 集体化

examples.en: Forced collectivization of agriculture led to widespread food shortages in the region.
examples.zh: 强行推行农业集体化导致该地区出现了大范围的粮食短缺。

lemmas.def_en: bring under collective control; of farms and industrial enterprises
lemmas.def_zh: 使集体化

examples.en: The revolutionary government tried to collectivize all private farms within two years.
examples.zh: 革命政府试图在两年内将所有私有农场实行集体化。

family_guide.root_logic: col-（共同）+ lect（收集、挑选）+ -ive，核心是“集合成一体的”。

lemmas.def_en: recognize or perceive the difference
lemmas.def_zh: 区别, 差别待遇

examples.en: It is illegal to discriminate against job applicants on the basis of gender.
examples.zh: 在求职过程中因性别而歧视应聘者是违法的。

lemmas.def_en: unfair treatment of a person or group on the basis of prejudice
lemmas.def_zh: 差别, 岐视, 辨别力

examples.en: New legislation was introduced to fight racial discrimination in the housing market.
examples.zh: 新法规的出台旨在消除住房市场上的种族歧视。

lemmas.def_en: a person who (or that which) differentiates
lemmas.def_zh: 辨别者, 鉴别器

examples.en: The frequency discriminator converts phase shifts into readable voltage signals.
examples.zh: 鉴频器将相移转换为可读取的电压信号。

lemmas.def_zh: 有辨识力的, 有差别的
lemmas.def_en: being biased or having a belief or attitude formed beforehand

examples.en: The union protested against the company's discriminatory hiring policies based on age.
examples.zh: 工会对公司基于年龄的歧视性雇佣政策提出了抗议。

lemmas.def_en: capable of making fine distinctions
lemmas.def_zh: 有识别力的, 区别的, 形成差别的

examples.en: A good critic possesses the discriminative ability to recognize exceptional talent immediately.
examples.zh: 优秀的评论家拥有敏锐的鉴别力，能立即识拔非凡的人才。

lemmas.def_en: not discriminating
lemmas.def_zh: 无鉴别力的, 不加区别的

examples.en: He had an undiscriminating appetite and ate whatever food was served.
examples.zh: 他从不挑食，桌上端上什么就吃什么。

family_guide.root_logic: dis-（分开）+ crimin（判断）+ -ate，核心是由“分清界限”引申到“差别对待”。
family_guide.core_distinction: discriminate 为动词；discrimination 为名词形式，多含负面的“歧视”或中性的“鉴别力”。

lemmas.def_en: bend one's knee or body, or lower one's head
lemmas.def_zh: 用弓拉琴, 弯成弓形

examples.en: The violinist lifted her bow and began to play a haunting melody.
examples.zh: 女小提琴手拉起琴弓，开始演奏一曲萦绕人心的旋律。

lemmas.def_en: a knot with two loops and loose ends; used to tie shoelaces
lemmas.def_zh: 弓, 眼睛框；鞠躬, 屈服

examples.en: The violinist lifted her bow and began to play a haunting melody.
examples.zh: 女小提琴手拉起琴弓，开始演奏一曲萦绕人心的旋律。

lemmas.def_en: erect in posture
lemmas.def_zh: 不弯的, 不屈服的

examples.en: Despite facing severe criticism, the prime minister remained completely unbowed.
examples.zh: 尽管面临严厉批评，首相依然毫不屈服。

family_guide.root_logic: 古英语词源，核心意象为“弯曲”，可指身体前倾弯曲或弯曲的器物。
family_guide.core_distinction: 注意读音差异：鞠躬/船头时读作 /baʊ/；弓/蝴蝶结时读作 /bəʊ/。

lemmas.def_en: man-made equipment that orbits around the earth or the moon
lemmas.def_zh: 人造卫星

examples.en: The weather satellite transmitted real-time images of the approaching tropical hurricane.
examples.zh: 气象卫星传输了正在逼近的热带飓风的实时图像。

lemmas.def_en: broadcast or disseminate via satellite
lemmas.def_zh: [医] 伴行静脉, 陪静脉, 陪病部, 随体, 卫星

examples.en: The weather satellite transmitted real-time images of the approaching tropical hurricane.
examples.zh: 气象卫星传输了正在逼近的热带飓风的实时图像。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语“随从、侍从”，天文学中借指“环绕主星转动的伴星”，后泛指人造卫星及卫星体系。

lemmas.def_en: favoring or promoting progress
lemmas.def_zh: 前进的, 累进的, 进步的

examples.en: The city council adopted a progressive approach to reducing greenhouse emissions.
examples.zh: 市议会采取了先进的方法来减少温室气体排放。

lemmas.def_en: old-fashioned and out of date
lemmas.def_zh: 不进步的, 落后的

examples.en: Critics described the administration's outdated economic policies as fundamentally unprogressive.
examples.zh: 批评人士称该政府过时的经济政策在根本上是不思进取的。

lemmas.def_en: advancing in amount or intensity
lemmas.def_zh: 进步, 先进, 向前进, 不断前进, 累进, 渐进, 逐渐, 渐次, 主张进步, 进行性

examples.en: His chronic joint pain grew progressively worse over the long winter months.
examples.zh: 在漫长的冬季里，他的慢性关节痛逐渐恶化。

lemmas.def_en: a tense of verbs used in describing action that is on-going
lemmas.def_zh: 改革论者, 进步论者

examples.en: The young progressive gave an inspiring speech about urgent educational and healthcare reforms.
examples.zh: 这位年轻的进步人士发表了关于教育和医疗紧迫改革的鼓舞人心的演讲。

lemmas.def_en: advancement toward better conditions or policies or methods
lemmas.def_zh: 先进性

examples.en: The company is widely recognized for the technological progressiveness of its manufacturing processes.
examples.zh: 该公司的制造工艺因其技术先进性而受到广泛认可。

lemmas.def_en: advancement toward better conditions or policies or methods
lemmas.def_zh: 累进税; 进展性

examples.en: Economists debated the optimal progressivity of the income tax system during the annual summit.
examples.zh: 经济学家在年度峰会上辩论了个人所得税制度的最佳累进性。

family_guide.root_logic: pro-（向前）+ gress（走、步）+ -ive，核心为“持续向前迈进的”。

lemmas.def_en: throw away as refuse
lemmas.def_zh: 倾倒, 倾销；倒垃圾, 倾销商品

examples.en: Illegal factories often dump toxic chemical waste into the river under cover of night.
examples.zh: 非法工厂经常在夜幕掩护下将有毒化学废物倾倒入河中。

lemmas.def_en: resembling a garbage dump
lemmas.def_zh: 矮胖的, 粗短的

examples.en: He bought a dumpy wooden cabinet that surprisingly held an immense amount of books.
examples.zh: 他买了一个矮胖的木柜，出人意料地能装下大量的书。

lemmas.def_en: truck whose contents can be emptied without handling; the front end of the platform can be pneumatically raised so that the load is discharged by gravity
lemmas.def_zh: 垃圾车, 卸货车, 自动倾卸车, 清洁工人, 倾卸者, 倾销者

examples.en: A yellow dumper truck carefully backed up to unload heavy gravel at the site.
examples.zh: 一辆黄色自卸卡车小心翼翼地倒车，在施工现场卸下厚重的碎石。

family_guide.root_logic: 可能源自斯堪的纳维亚语，核心意象是“重重地抛掷、倾倒弃物”。

lemmas.def_en: an unknown and unpredictable phenomenon that causes an event to result one way rather than another
lemmas.def_zh: 财富, 运气, 兴隆, 大量财产, 好运, 命运

examples.en: She inherited a massive family fortune and immediately decided to invest it in education.
examples.zh: 她继承了一大笔家族财产，并立即决定将其投资于教育事业。

lemmas.def_en: unnecessary and unforeseen trouble resulting from an unfortunate event
lemmas.def_zh: 不幸, 灾祸, 坏运气

examples.en: He handled his sudden misfortune with remarkable courage, inspiring all of his close friends.
examples.zh: 他以极大的勇气应对突如其来的不幸，鼓舞了所有挚友。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自罗马命运女神 Fortuna，核心从不可控的“命运/机遇”引申为好运带来的“巨额财富”。

lemmas.def_en: a mechanism that can move automatically
lemmas.def_zh: 机械人, 自动机械, 机械般工作的人

examples.en: The medical robot assisted the senior surgeon throughout the delicate six-hour cardiac operation.
examples.zh: 医疗机器人在长达六小时的精细心脏手术中全程协助主治医生。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自捷克语 robota（强迫劳役、奴役），由捷克作家恰佩克的戏剧引入英语，特指代替人力的自动化机械。

lemmas.def_en: an event (or a course of events) that will inevitably happen in the future
lemmas.def_zh: 命运, 运气

examples.en: She accepted her difficult fate calmly and resolved to make the best of it.
examples.zh: 她平静地接受了自己艰难的命运，并决心充分利用现有的一切。

lemmas.def_en: make fat or plump
lemmas.def_zh: [计] 文件分配表

examples.en: Technicians had to format and FAT the drive before installing the embedded operating system.
examples.zh: 技术人员在安装嵌入式操作系统前必须对驱动器进行格式化并建立FAT文件表。

lemmas.def_en: having momentous consequences; of decisive importance; - Saturday Rev
lemmas.def_zh: 宿命的, 重大的, 决定性的

examples.en: That fateful decision altered the course of her entire professional career for decades.
examples.zh: 那个决定性的抉择改变了她整个职业生涯数十年的发展轨迹。

lemmas.def_en: in a prophetically fateful manner
lemmas.def_zh: 宿命地, 决定性地

examples.en: Their paths crossed fatefully at a small train station in the middle of winter.
examples.zh: 在隆冬时节的一个小火车站里，他们的命运宿命般地交织在了一起。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 fari（说），核心是“神所言定之事”，即不可逆转的终局或定数。
family_guide.core_distinction: 注意与形近词 fat（脂肪/发胖）区分，fat(v.) 非 fate 词族派生词，属于形近混淆项。

lemmas.def_en: the activity of worshipping
lemmas.def_zh: 崇拜, 礼拜, 尊敬

examples.en: Ancient civilizations conducted grand rituals dedicated to the worship of the radiant sun god.
examples.zh: 古代文明曾举行盛大的仪式，专门用于崇拜光芒四射的太阳神。

lemmas.def_en: a person who has religious faith
lemmas.def_zh: 礼拜者, 崇拜者, 爱慕者

examples.en: The humble worshipper knelt silently on the cold marble floor to offer earnest prayers.
examples.zh: 这位谦卑的礼拜者静静地跪在冰冷的大理石地面上虔诚祈祷。

lemmas.def_en: someone who admires too much to recognize faults
lemmas.def_zh: 参加礼拜者, 崇拜者

examples.en: Each devout worshiper brought a small candle to place gently at the sacred altar.
examples.zh: 每位虔诚的朝拜者都带来了一支小蜡烛，轻轻放在神圣的祭坛上。

lemmas.def_en: love unquestioningly and uncritically or to excess; venerate as an idol
lemmas.def_zh: 参加礼拜；崇拜, 尊敬

examples.en: Ancient civilizations conducted grand rituals dedicated to the worship of the radiant sun god.
examples.zh: 古代文明曾举行盛大的仪式，专门用于崇拜光芒四射的太阳神。

lemmas.def_en: showing adoration
lemmas.def_zh: 崇拜的, 尊敬的, 尊贵的

examples.en: The crowd looked up with worshipful eyes as the revered leader approached the podium.
examples.zh: 当受人尊敬的领袖走向讲台时，人群投以崇敬的目光。

family_guide.root_logic: 由 worth（价值、尊贵）+ -ship（状态）演变而来，核心指“给予至高无上的尊奉”。

lemmas.def_en: maintain (a theory, thoughts, or feelings)
lemmas.def_zh: 庇护, 藏匿, (使)入港停泊

examples.en: It is dangerous to harbor deep resentment toward others for things beyond your control.
examples.zh: 对无法掌控的事情心存对极大的怨恨是非常危险的。

lemmas.def_en: secretly shelter (as of fugitives or criminals)
lemmas.def_zh: 庇护, 藏匿, (使)入港停泊

examples.en: The captain decided to harbour his fishing boat safely before the severe storm hit.
examples.zh: 在猛烈的暴风雨来临之前，船长决定将渔船安全停泊进港。

lemmas.def_en: a sheltered port where ships can take on or discharge cargo
lemmas.def_zh: 港, 避难所

examples.en: It is dangerous to harbor deep resentment toward others for things beyond your control.
examples.zh: 对无法掌控的事情心存对极大的怨恨是非常危险的。

lemmas.def_en: (nautical) a place of refuge (as for a ship)
lemmas.def_zh: 停泊处, 避难所

examples.en: The quiet bay provided safe harborage for local vessels during the fierce coastal gale.
examples.zh: 在猛烈的沿海大风期间，宁静的海湾为当地船只提供了安全的避风处。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语，原指军队驻扎的避风港或隐蔽所，引申为物理上的港口避风，以及心理上的心怀、包庇。
family_guide.core_distinction: harbor为美式拼写，harbour为英式拼写。

lemmas.def_en: a measured portion of medicine taken at any one time
lemmas.def_zh: 剂量, 服用量

examples.en: Make sure not to exceed the recommended dose of this medication under any circumstances.
examples.zh: 无论在任何情况下，请确保不要超过该药物的推荐剂量。

lemmas.def_en: the quantity of an active agent (substance or radiation) taken in or absorbed at any one time
lemmas.def_zh: 剂量, 用量, 配药

examples.en: Do not exceed the recommended daily dosage without consulting your doctor first.
examples.zh: 在咨询医生之前，切勿超过每日推荐剂量。

lemmas.def_en: treat with an agent; add (an agent) to
lemmas.def_zh: 给药, (用药)医治；服药

examples.en: The nurse will dose the patient with antibiotics every eight hours today.
examples.zh: 护士今天将每隔八小时给病人服用一次抗生素。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语dosis（给予、赠品），最初指“给予病人的药物量”，引申为剂量及给药行为。
family_guide.core_distinction: dose强调一次服用的确定量；dosage指按时间或规律分配的给药剂量或用法。

lemmas.def_en: mark as different
lemmas.def_zh: 区别, 辨别

examples.en: It is difficult to distinguish the real antique from the clever fake.
examples.zh: 很难区分这件真正的古董和逼真的仿品。

lemmas.def_en: not worthy of notice
lemmas.def_zh: 未经区分的, 未被注意到的, 普通的, 平凡的

examples.en: He led an undistinguished career as a clerk before retiring quietly last year.
examples.zh: 他在去年悄然退休前，一直做着一份平庸的文员工作。

lemmas.def_en: a discrimination between things as different and distinct
lemmas.def_zh: 区别；差别；卓越；殊荣

examples.en: She served with great distinction throughout her diplomatic career.
examples.zh: 在她的整个外交生涯中，她表现卓越、屡获殊荣。

family_guide.root_logic: 由前缀 dis-（分开）和词根 stinguere（刺、戳、标记）组成，字面意为“戳开做标记”，引申为区分、辨别及因卓越而脱颖而出。

lemmas.def_en: relating or belonging to or characteristic of a municipality
lemmas.def_zh: 市政的, 自治区的, 内政的

examples.en: The municipal government decided to invest in modernizing the public transport network.
examples.zh: 市政府决定投资对公共交通网络进行现代化改造。

lemmas.def_en: an urban district having corporate status and powers of self-government
lemmas.def_zh: 自治区, 市当局, 市民

examples.en: The local municipality provides free recycling services for all residential neighborhoods here.
examples.zh: 当地市政当局为这里所有的居民区提供免费回收服务。

lemmas.def_en: by municipality
lemmas.def_zh: 市政方面

examples.en: This historic park is municipally owned and maintained by local tax funds.
examples.zh: 这座历史悠久的公园归市政所有，由当地税收资金维护。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 municipium（自治市），指承担公共责任与义务的公民社区，引申为市政的、地方自治的。
family_guide.core_distinction: municipal为形容词修饰市政属性；municipality为名词指代自治市或市政当局本身。

lemmas.def_en: an automaton that resembles a human being
lemmas.def_zh: 机器人

examples.en: Scientists designed an advanced android capable of showing realistic human facial expressions.
examples.zh: 科学家设计了一款能够展现逼真人脸表情的高级机器人。

family_guide.root_logic: 由词根 andro-（人，男性）与后缀 -oid（具有……外形的）组合而成，本义为“像人一样的物体”，现专指仿生人形机器人。

lemmas.def_en: lightly throw to see which side comes up
lemmas.def_zh: 掷, 弹, 轻击, 空翻；用指轻弹, 抽打, 蹦跳

examples.en: He decided to flip a coin to choose between the two job offers.
examples.zh: 他决定抛硬币来在两份工作录用中做出抉择。

lemmas.def_en: a shoe for swimming; the paddle-like front is an aid in swimming (especially underwater)
lemmas.def_zh: 鳍状肢, (潜水用)脚蹼

examples.en: He strapped on each flipper securely before diving into the clear ocean.
examples.zh: 在潜入清澈的海洋之前，他牢牢系紧了每只脚蹼。

family_guide.root_logic: 拟声词，模拟轻快翻转或弹击的声音，引申为快速翻动、抛掷或态度的骤变。

lemmas.def_en: include in scope; include as part of something broader; have as one's sphere or territory
lemmas.def_zh: 拥抱, 互相拥抱, 包含, 收买；拥抱

examples.en: The warm embrace of his family helped him recover from the loss.
examples.zh: 家人的温暖拥抱帮助他从伤痛中恢复过来。

lemmas.def_en: the act of clasping another person in the arms (as in greeting or affection)
lemmas.def_zh: 拥抱

examples.en: The warm embrace of his family helped him recover from the loss.
examples.zh: 家人的温暖拥抱帮助他从伤痛中恢复过来。

lemmas.def_en: the act of clasping another person in the arms (as in greeting or affection)
lemmas.def_zh: 拥抱; 环绕; 领会

examples.en: Her embracement of new technologies transformed the company's daily workflow completely.
examples.zh: 她对新技术的接纳与推行彻底改变了公司的日常工作流程。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 em-（进入）+ brachium（手臂），字面意为“搂入怀中”，引申为拥抱、欣然接受及包容包含。

lemmas.def_en: insulting terms of address for people who are stupid or irritating or ridiculous
lemmas.def_zh: 屁眼儿, 肛门；令人讨厌的人

examples.en: That asshole cut me off in traffic without even using a blinker.
examples.zh: 那个混蛋在路上加塞插到我前面，甚至连转向灯都不打。

family_guide.root_logic: 俚语复合词，由 ass（屁股）和 hole（孔）组成，最初指肛门解剖部位，后演变为指代极度自私、粗鲁或讨厌之人的侮辱性脏话。

lemmas.def_en: United States diplomat and jurist who negotiated peace treaties with Britain and served as the first chief justice of the United States Supreme Court (1745-1829)
lemmas.def_zh: 鸟, 喋喋不休的人, 傻瓜

examples.en: A noisy blue jay perched on the branch outside my bedroom window.
examples.zh: 一只吵闹的蓝松鸦停在我卧室窗外的树枝上。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自通俗拉丁语，模仿松鸦喧闹刺耳的鸣叫声，现指鸦科松鸦类鸟类。

lemmas.def_en: payment for insurance
lemmas.def_zh: 额外补贴, 奖金, 奖赏, 保险费

examples.en: Paying a higher monthly premium guarantees full coverage for your rental car.
examples.zh: 每月支付更高的保费可以保证你的租车享有全额保险。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 praemium（奖赏、特权），由 prae-（在先）+ emere（拿取）构成，指先拿到的优质奖励，引申为保险费、溢价及额外津贴。

lemmas.def_en: put in motion or move to act
lemmas.def_zh: 使活动, 使激活, 正式建成；有活力

examples.en: Please click the link in your email to activate your new account.
examples.zh: 请点击电子邮件中的链接以激活您的新账户。

lemmas.def_en: stimulation of activity in an organism or chemical
lemmas.def_zh: 活化, 激活

examples.en: The activation of the security alarm immediately alerted the local police station.
examples.zh: 安全警报的触发立即惊动了当地警察局。

lemmas.def_en: (biology) any agency bringing about activation; a molecule that increases the activity of an enzyme or a protein that increases the production of a gene product in DNA transcription
lemmas.def_zh: 活化剂, 催化剂, 触媒剂

examples.en: Add the chemical activator to the mixture to speed up the reaction.
examples.zh: 将化学活化剂添加到混合物中以加速反应。

lemmas.def_zh: adj. 活化的；激活的
lemmas.def_en: made active or chemically reactive
lemmas.usage_note: 多用于科技、环保或化学语境，常见如 activated carbon/charcoal（活性炭）。

examples.en: The filter contains activated carbon to remove impurities from the water.
examples.zh: 该滤芯含有活性炭，用于去除水中的杂质。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 actus（行动），后缀 -ate 表示“使……”，核心逻辑为“使处于运作或活动状态”。
family_guide.core_distinction: activate是动词促成行动；activation是名词指促动过程或状态。

lemmas.def_en: advocating or engaged in activism

examples.en: The young environmental activist spoke passionately about reducing single-use plastic waste.
examples.zh: 这位年轻的环保激进分子热情地谈论减少一次性塑料垃圾。

lemmas.def_en: a militant reformer
lemmas.def_zh: 激进主义分子

examples.en: The young environmental activist spoke passionately about reducing single-use plastic waste.
examples.zh: 这位年轻的环保激进分子热情地谈论减少一次性塑料垃圾。

lemmas.def_zh: 激进主义, 行动主义, 能动论
lemmas.def_en: a policy of taking direct and militant action to achieve a political or social goal

examples.en: Her passionate environmental activism inspired many local students to join the conservation campaign.
examples.zh: 她对环保行动的热情激励了许多当地学生加入保护环境的活动。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自 active（活跃的），后缀 -ist 表示倡导者或践行者，指为推动社会、政治变革而积极采取行动的人或相关姿态。
family_guide.core_distinction: activist(n.)指积极行动者本人；activist(adj.)作定语修饰行动主义性质的举动或团体。

lemmas.def_en: give an incentive for action
lemmas.def_zh: 激励, 鼓动, 提示

examples.en: The unexpected question might prompt him to reconsider his entire career choice.
examples.zh: 这个意想不到的问题可能会促使他重新考虑自己的职业选择。

lemmas.def_en: with little or no delay
lemmas.def_zh: 敏捷地, 迅速地

examples.en: She arrived promptly at eight o'clock for her morning job interview today.
examples.zh: 今天早晨，她准时于八点到达参加求职面试。

lemmas.def_en: someone who assists a performer by providing the next words of a forgotten speech
lemmas.def_zh: 提词员, 激励者, 唤起者

examples.en: The theater prompter whispered the forgotten line from behind the heavy curtain.
examples.zh: 剧院提词员在厚重的幕布后低声提示那句被遗忘的台词。

lemmas.def_en: the characteristic of doing things without delay
lemmas.def_zh: 敏捷, 机敏

examples.en: Her promptness in replying to emails was greatly appreciated by the entire team.
examples.zh: 她及时回复邮件的做法受到了整个团队的高度赞赏。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 prompere（拿出来），词根意为“准备就绪的、在眼前的”，引申为促使、催促及迅速不拖延。
family_guide.core_distinction: prompt作动词指激发或催促行动；promptly为副词强调时间上的毫无延误。

lemmas.def_en: the possibility of future success
lemmas.def_zh: 景色, 展望

examples.en: The prospect of traveling abroad for work excited the young marketing manager.
examples.zh: 出国工作的前景让这位年轻的营销经理感到兴奋。

lemmas.def_en: someone who explores an area for mineral deposits
lemmas.def_zh: 勘探者, 采矿者

examples.en: The lone prospector searched the mountain streams hoping to find traces of gold.
examples.zh: 那位孤独的探矿者在山间溪流中搜寻，希望能找到金子的痕迹。

lemmas.def_en: search for something desirable
lemmas.def_zh: 勘探, 勘察；勘探, 有前途

examples.en: The prospect of traveling abroad for work excited the young marketing manager.
examples.zh: 出国工作的前景让这位年轻的营销经理感到兴奋。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 pro-（向前）+ specere（看），字面意为“向前看”，引申为眼前的景象、未来的前景，以及动词勘探寻找矿藏。
family_guide.core_distinction: prospect(n.)主要指未来的可能性或前景；prospect(v.)特指探勘矿藏或寻找商业机会。

lemmas.def_en: governmental provision of economic assistance to persons in need
lemmas.def_zh: n. 福利，幸福，康宁

examples.en: The government introduced new reforms to improve child welfare.
examples.zh: 政府推行了新改革以改善儿童福利。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语‘well(好)+fare(前行、过活)’，核心意为‘过得好、繁荣福祉’。

lemmas.def_en: proceed somewhere despite the risk of possible dangers
lemmas.def_zh: 敢于, 冒...的危险；冒险

examples.en: They decided to venture into the dense forest despite the approaching storm.
examples.zh: 尽管暴风雨即将来临，他们还是决定冒险深入密林。

lemmas.def_en: any venturesome undertaking especially one with an uncertain outcome
lemmas.def_zh: 冒险, 风险

examples.en: They decided to venture into the dense forest despite the approaching storm.
examples.zh: 尽管暴风雨即将来临，他们还是决定冒险深入密林。

lemmas.def_en: a merchant who undertakes a trading venture (especially a venture that sends goods overseas)
lemmas.def_zh: 冒险者, 投机者

examples.en: The brave venturer invested all his savings into the newly discovered territory.
examples.zh: 那位勇敢的冒险家将所有积蓄都投资到了新发现的领域。

lemmas.def_en: disposed to venture or take risks
lemmas.def_zh: 好冒险的, 大胆的, 不顾一切的

examples.en: Her venturous spirit pushed her to explore remote regions of the world.
examples.zh: 她那富有冒险精神的个性促使她去探索世界上偏远的地区。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自 adventure 的去首音截短词，核心意为‘伴随危险或不确定性的冒险尝试’。

lemmas.def_en: signal going into an electronic system
lemmas.def_zh: 输入, 输入电路

examples.en: We need valuable input from local residents before making the final decision.
examples.zh: 在做出最终决定之前，我们需要当地居民提供宝贵的意见。

lemmas.def_zh: [计] 输入

examples.en: He spent the entire afternoon inputting the financial data into the system.
examples.zh: 他花了整整一个下午将财务数据输入系统。

lemmas.def_en: enter (data or a program) into a computer
lemmas.def_zh: 输入

examples.en: We need valuable input from local residents before making the final decision.
examples.zh: 在做出最终决定之前，我们需要当地居民提供宝贵的意见。

family_guide.root_logic: 复合词‘in(入)+put(放)’，核心意为‘投入、输入的信息或资源’。

lemmas.def_en: refrain from harming
lemmas.def_zh: 节约, 省掉, 宽恕；节约, 省用, 剩下, 饶恕, 赦免

examples.en: Could you spare a few minutes to discuss the new project proposal?
examples.zh: 你能抽出几分钟时间来讨论一下新项目的提案吗？

lemmas.def_en: furnish with spars
lemmas.def_zh: 装圆材于；拳斗, 争论

examples.en: The two political candidates continued to spar over economic policies during the debate.
examples.zh: 两位政治候选人在辩论中继续就经济政策进行争论。

lemmas.def_en: thin and fit
lemmas.def_zh: 多余的, 备用的, 空闲的, 节约的, 瘦的

examples.en: Could you spare a few minutes to discuss the new project proposal?
examples.zh: 你能抽出几分钟时间来讨论一下新项目的提案吗？

lemmas.def_en: very generous
lemmas.def_zh: 不吝惜的, 慷慨的, 大方的, 严厉的, 不留情的, 不宽恕的

examples.en: The critic was unsparing in his review of the director's latest film.
examples.zh: 那位评论家对这位导演的最新电影进行了毫不留情的批评。

lemmas.def_en: to a meager degree or in a meager manner
lemmas.def_zh: 节约地, 爱惜地, 吝惜地, 少量地, 贫乏地

examples.en: You should use this expensive spice sparingly so the bottle lasts longer.
examples.zh: 你应该节约使用这种昂贵的香料，这样可以用得更久。

lemmas.def_en: in a scathing and unsparing manner
lemmas.def_zh: 不宽恕地, 慷慨地

examples.en: The charity unsparingly distributed food and medical supplies to the flood victims.
examples.zh: 该慈善机构毫不吝惜地向洪水灾民分发了食物和医疗用品。

lemmas.def_en: in a spare manner
lemmas.def_zh: 缺乏着, 节俭地, 瘦瘦地

examples.en: The author lived in a sparely furnished room with only a desk and bed.
examples.zh: 作者住在一间陈设简陋的房间里，里面只有一张书桌和一张床。

lemmas.def_en: the property of being scanty or scattered; lacking denseness
lemmas.def_zh: 缺乏, 贫乏, 瘦弱

examples.en: Critics praised the elegant spareness of the architect's modern interior design.
examples.zh: 评论家对这位建筑师现代室内设计的简洁与空灵大加赞赏。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自日耳曼语，核心意为‘节约、宽恕’，引申出‘未使用的、备用的’。

lemmas.def_en: utter a sudden loud cry
lemmas.def_zh: 叫喊, 大叫, (齐声)呐喊欢呼；喊叫着说

examples.en: She had to yell above the noise of the traffic to be heard.
examples.zh: 她不得不盖过车辆的噪音大声喊叫，才能让人听见。

lemmas.def_en: a loud utterance; often in protest or opposition
lemmas.def_zh: 叫声, 喊声, 呐喊

examples.en: She had to yell above the noise of the traffic to be heard.
examples.zh: 她不得不盖过车辆的噪音大声喊叫，才能让人听见。

lemmas.def_en: someone who communicates vocally in a very loud voice
lemmas.def_zh: yell的变形

examples.en: The coach was known as a loud yeller during intense basketball matches.
examples.zh: 这位教练在激烈的篮球比赛中是出了名的大嗓门吼叫者。

family_guide.root_logic: 拟声词来源，模拟大声呼叫的动作，核心意为‘扯着嗓子大喊’。

lemmas.def_en: directions for making something
lemmas.def_zh: 食谱, 处方, 秘诀

examples.en: Hard work and dedication are the essential recipe for long-term career success.
examples.zh: 努力工作和专注奉献是取得长期职业成功的关键秘诀。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 recipere（接受），原为处方开头的祈使词‘取（药材）’，引申为制作指南。

lemmas.def_en: a mobile mass of muscular tissue covered with mucous membrane and located in the oral cavity
lemmas.def_zh: 舌, 语言能力, 讲话方式, 语言

examples.en: He bit his tongue accidentally while chewing his dinner in a hurry.
examples.zh: 他匆忙吃晚餐咀嚼时，不小心咬到了自己的舌头。

lemmas.def_en: articulate by tonguing, as when playing wind instruments
lemmas.def_zh: 舔, 斥责, 发...的音；使用舌头, 吹管乐器

examples.en: He bit his tongue accidentally while chewing his dinner in a hurry.
examples.zh: 他匆忙吃晚餐咀嚼时，不小心咬到了自己的舌头。

lemmas.def_en: lacking a tongue
lemmas.def_zh: 没有舌头的, 缄默的, 哑的

examples.en: The witness remained completely tongueless throughout the tense interrogation by police.
examples.zh: 在警方紧张的审讯中，这名证人始终保持沉默。

family_guide.root_logic: 古英语固有词，本义为‘舌头’，引申为‘语言、言语能力’及‘用舌头舔/吹奏’等动作。

lemmas.def_en: an administrative unit of government
lemmas.def_zh: 局, 办公处

examples.en: She reported the lost documents directly to the local investigation bureau yesterday.
examples.zh: 她昨天直接向当地调查局报告了文件丢失的情况。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自法语，原指铺有粗毛呢布的写字台，后转指处理公务的‘办公室、局、署’。

lemmas.def_en: any of various long-tailed rodents similar to but larger than a mouse
lemmas.def_zh: 鼠, 卑鄙的人, 破坏者, 变节者

examples.en: A giant sewer rat scurried across the dark alley behind the restaurant.
examples.zh: 一只巨大的下水道老鼠窜过了餐馆后面的黑暗小巷。

lemmas.def_en: a disloyal person who betrays or deserts his cause or religion or political party or friend etc.
lemmas.def_zh: 捕鼠者, 叛变者

examples.en: Terriers were originally bred as exceptional ratters to clear barns of pests.
examples.zh: 梗犬最初被培育为出色的捕鼠犬，用来清除谷仓害虫。

lemmas.def_en: desert one's party or group of friends, for example, for one's personal advantage
lemmas.def_zh: 捕鼠, 变节；弄蓬松

examples.en: A giant sewer rat scurried across the dark alley behind the restaurant.
examples.zh: 一只巨大的下水道老鼠窜过了餐馆后面的黑暗小巷。

lemmas.def_en: of or characteristic of rats
lemmas.def_zh: 像老鼠的, 鼠臭的, 破烂的, 易怒的

examples.en: He tossed his ratty old sneakers into the trash before the move.
examples.zh: 搬家前，他把他那双破烂的旧运动鞋扔进了垃圾桶。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自西日耳曼语指‘大鼠’，因其偷食、逃窜的特性引申为‘背叛、告密’。

lemmas.def_en: to strive with determination
lemmas.def_zh: 马背突然拱起, 反对, 吹牛, 闲聊；马背突然拱起将骑手摔下, 反对, 用碱水洗

examples.en: The young horse began to buck wildly when the saddle was adjusted.
examples.zh: 当鞍座被调整时，那匹年轻的马开始疯狂地拱背跃起。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自名词雄鹿（buck），因雄鹿跳跃、顶角或猛烈抗拒的本能，引申出‘猛然跃起、抵抗’之意。

lemmas.def_en: walk heavily
lemmas.def_zh: 盖章于, 顿足, 贴上邮票, 铭刻, 捣碎, 扑灭；捣碎, 跺脚

examples.en: The officer will stamp your passport once your visa application is approved.
examples.zh: 一旦你的签证申请获得批准，官员就会在你的护照上盖章。

lemmas.def_en: a workman whose job is to form or cut out by applying a mold or die (either by hand or by operating a stamping machine)
lemmas.def_zh: 盖印人, 打印器, 印章

examples.en: The clerk used a heavy metal stamper to mark each official document.
examples.zh: 职员用一个厚重的金属印章在每份官方文件上做标记。

family_guide.root_logic: 日耳曼语源，指‘用力下踩’的动作，引申为‘盖印、贴邮票、给…盖上烙印’。

lemmas.def_en: imagine; conceive of; see in one's mind
lemmas.def_zh: 想象, 设想, 相信, 喜爱；想象, 幻想

examples.en: They decided to celebrate their anniversary at a very fancy downtown restaurant.
examples.zh: 他们决定在市中心一家非常高档的餐厅庆祝他们的周年纪念日。

lemmas.def_en: not plain; decorative or ornamented
lemmas.def_zh: 想象的, 精美的, 新奇的, 奇特的, 高价的, 特级的

examples.en: They decided to celebrate their anniversary at a very fancy downtown restaurant.
examples.zh: 他们决定在市中心一家非常高档的餐厅庆祝他们的周年纪念日。

lemmas.def_en: indulging in or influenced by fancy
lemmas.def_zh: 奇怪的, 稀奇的, 想像的

examples.en: Her novel was filled with fanciful creatures that lived in cloud castles.
examples.zh: 她的小说充满了生活在云中城堡的奇幻生物。

lemmas.def_en: a person having a strong liking for something
lemmas.def_zh: 空想家, 育种者, 爱好者

examples.en: As a dedicated pigeon fancier, he spent all his weekends attending shows.
examples.zh: 作为一名狂热的养鸽爱好者，他整个周末都在参加展览。

lemmas.def_en: in a fanciful manner
lemmas.def_zh: 富于幻想地; 梦想地

examples.en: The ballroom was fancifully decorated with thousands of twinkling fairy lights.
examples.zh: 宴会厅装饰得极富梦幻色彩，挂着数千盏闪烁的小彩灯。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自 fantasy 的缩约形式，核心意为‘想象、心仪’，作形容词引申为‘花哨的、昂贵的’。

lemmas.def_en: turn on or around an axis or a center
lemmas.def_zh: 使旋转, 使转动, 使轮流；旋转, 循环

examples.en: Farmers rotate their crops each season to preserve vital nutrients in the soil.
examples.zh: 农民们每季轮作作物，以保留土壤中的关键养分。

lemmas.def_en: the act of rotating as if on an axis
lemmas.def_zh: 旋转, 循环, 轮流

examples.en: The earth completes one full rotation on its tilted axis every twenty-four hours.
examples.zh: 地球每二十四小时在其倾斜的地轴上完成一次完整的自转。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 rota（轮子），核心意为‘像轮子一样转动、交替轮换’。
family_guide.core_distinction: rotate 为动词‘旋转、轮换’；rotation 为名词‘旋转、轮换期’。

lemmas.def_en: relating to or marked by communism
lemmas.def_zh: [法] 共产主义的, 共产党的

examples.en: The veteran activist has been a dedicated communist party member for forty years.
examples.zh: 这位资深活动家四十年来一直是一名尽职的共产党员。

lemmas.def_en: relating to or marked by communism
lemmas.def_zh: 共产主义的, 共产主义者的

examples.en: The regime implemented communistic policies that abolished all private land ownership.
examples.zh: 该政权推行了废除所有土地私有制的共产主义政策。

lemmas.def_en: a member of the communist party
lemmas.def_zh: 共产主义者, 共产党员

examples.en: The veteran activist has been a dedicated communist party member for forty years.
examples.zh: 这位资深活动家四十年来一直是一名尽职的共产党员。

lemmas.def_en: a form of socialism that abolishes private ownership
lemmas.def_zh: 共产主义

examples.en: The professor dedicated his lecture to the rise and fall of communism in Eastern Europe.
examples.zh: 教授将讲座重点放在东欧共产主义的兴起与衰退上。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 communis（共同的、公有的），指主张财产公有的意识形态及其追随者。

lemmas.def_en: come to the boiling point and change from a liquid to vapor
lemmas.def_zh: 煮沸, 激动

examples.en: You need to boil the water thoroughly before adding the pasta noodles.
examples.zh: 在放入意大利面之前，你需要把水彻底煮沸。

lemmas.def_en: sealed vessel where water is converted to steam
lemmas.def_zh: 煮器, 汽锅, 锅炉

examples.en: Our central heating stopped working because the basement boiler broke down suddenly.
examples.zh: 由于地下室的锅炉突然坏了，我们的集中供暖停止了运作。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 bullire（起泡），核心意为‘液体受热起泡、沸腾’。
family_guide.core_distinction: boil 为动词‘沸腾、煮沸’；boiler 为名词加后缀 -er，指‘锅炉、热水器’。

lemmas.def_en: (Judeo-Christian and Islamic religions) chief spirit of evil and adversary of God; tempter of mankind; master of Hell
lemmas.def_zh: 魔鬼

examples.en: Legend says the cunning devil tempted travelers into making dangerous bargains.
examples.zh: 传说狡猾的魔鬼会引诱旅行者进行危险的交易。

lemmas.def_en: wicked and cruel behavior
lemmas.def_zh: 邪恶, 魔界, 恶魔研究, 妖术, 魔法, 开玩笑, 恶作剧, 狂放, 残暴

examples.en: The abandoned castle was rumored to be a site of dark ancient devilry.
examples.zh: 传闻这座废弃的城堡是古代黑暗妖术的发生地。

lemmas.def_en: reckless or malicious behavior that causes discomfort or annoyance in others
lemmas.def_zh: 魔鬼似的行径, 怪现象, 怪事, 开玩笑, 恶作剧, 捣蛋

examples.en: The mischievous boy had a glint of pure devilment in his dark eyes.
examples.zh: 那个淘气的男孩黑黝黝的眼睛里闪烁着纯粹的恶作剧光芒。

lemmas.def_en: cause annoyance in; disturb, especially by minor irritations
lemmas.def_zh: 折磨, 戏弄

examples.en: Legend says the cunning devil tempted travelers into making dangerous bargains.
examples.zh: 传说狡猾的魔鬼会引诱旅行者进行危险的交易。

lemmas.def_zh: 恶魔的, 恶毒的, 凶暴的, 恶魔似的, (非正式)非常可憎的
lemmas.def_en: showing the cunning or ingenuity or wickedness typical of a devil

examples.en: The villain revealed a diabolic plot to disable the entire city's power grid.
examples.zh: 反派透露了一个破坏整座城市电网的恶毒阴谋。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语diabolos（诽谤者、魔鬼），引申指邪恶化身、精力充沛或顽皮之人，动词指折磨或加辣烹调。

lemmas.def_en: informal abbreviation of `representative'
lemmas.def_zh: 棱纹平布, 浪荡子, 名声

examples.en: The sudden scandal ruined his professional rep within the competitive sales industry.
examples.zh: 这起突发丑闻毁掉了他在竞争激烈的销售行业中的职业声誉。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自representative（代表）或reputation（声誉）等词的口语缩写。

lemmas.def_en: promote the growth of
lemmas.def_zh: 养育, 抚育, 培养, 鼓励, 抱(希望)

examples.en: The teacher tried to foster a love of reading in all her young students.
examples.zh: 这位老师努力培养所有年幼学生对阅读的热爱。

lemmas.def_en: encouragement; aiding the development of something
lemmas.def_zh: 领养, 收养, 养子身份

examples.en: He spent most of his early childhood in fosterage before finding a permanent home.
examples.zh: 在找到永久的家之前，他的童年早期大多在寄养中度过。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语fostor（抚养、养育），核心逻辑为提供滋养以促进成长。

lemmas.def_en: a structure that provides privacy and protection from danger
lemmas.def_zh: 庇护所, 避难所, 庇护, 隐蔽处, 掩蔽

examples.en: Volunteers worked through the stormy night to provide warm shelter for the homeless people.
examples.zh: 志愿者们在暴风雨之夜通宵工作，为无家可归者提供温暖的庇护所。

lemmas.def_en: provide shelter for
lemmas.def_zh: 庇护, 保护, 隐匿；躲避

examples.en: Volunteers worked through the stormy night to provide warm shelter for the homeless people.
examples.zh: 志愿者们在暴风雨之夜通宵工作，为无家可归者提供温暖的庇护所。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自中古英语，可能与古英语盾牌护卫队相关，核心义为提供保护或隐蔽的处所。

lemmas.def_en: confess to a punishable or reprehensible deed, usually under pressure
lemmas.def_zh: 承认, 坦白, 忏悔, 供认

examples.en: He decided to confess his true feelings to her before she moved away forever.
examples.zh: 他决定在她永远搬走之前，向她坦白自己的真实感情。

lemmas.def_en: an admission of misdeeds or faults
lemmas.def_zh: 承认, 坦白, 招供

examples.en: The police obtained a full written confession from the suspect after hours of questioning.
examples.zh: 经过数小时的讯问，警方从嫌疑人那里获得了一份完整的书面供词。

lemmas.def_en: a priest who hears confession and gives absolution
lemmas.def_zh: 供认者, 忏悔者, 忏悔神父, 在遭迫害时声明坚守信仰的教徒

examples.en: The troubled young man visited his confessor every Sunday to seek spiritual inner peace.
examples.zh: 这个心烦意乱的年轻人每周日都会去见他的忏悔神父，以寻求内心的安宁。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀con-（彻底）+ -fess（说话），核心义为彻底坦白、承认。

lemmas.def_en: a company that performs a public service; subject to government regulation
lemmas.def_zh: 功用, 有用之物, 实用, 公用事业, 实用程序

examples.en: The new software combines ease of use with exceptional overall utility for everyday tasks.
examples.zh: 这款新软件将易用性与应对日常任务的卓越实用性结合在一起。

lemmas.def_en: the act of using
lemmas.def_zh: 利用

examples.en: Efficient fuel utilization is a key factor in reducing modern automotive travel costs.
examples.zh: 高效的燃料利用是降低现代汽车出行成本的关键因素。

lemmas.def_en: put into service; make work or employ for a particular purpose or for its inherent or natural purpose
lemmas.def_zh: 利用

examples.en: We must utilize our existing resources effectively to finish the urgent project on time.
examples.zh: 我们必须有效利用现有资源，按时完成这个紧急项目。

lemmas.def_en: put into service; make work or employ for a particular purpose or for its inherent or natural purpose
lemmas.def_zh: 利用, 运用, 使用

examples.en: The local council aims to utilise renewable energy sources to power public transport.
examples.zh: 地方议会旨在利用可再生能源为公共交通提供动力。

lemmas.def_zh: 有效用的, 实利主义的, 功利主义的
lemmas.def_en: having a useful function

examples.en: The office furniture was strictly utilitarian, designed entirely for durability rather than beauty.
examples.zh: 这些办公家具纯属实用型，完全是出于耐用性而非美观度设计的。

lemmas.def_zh: 有用的；有益的
lemmas.def_en: being of use or service

examples.en: The designer focused on creating utile furniture for small urban apartments.
examples.zh: 这位设计师专注于为城市小公寓打造实用家具。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语utilis（有用的），引申为实用价值或公共基础事业。

lemmas.def_en: put at risk
lemmas.def_zh: 打桩, 用桩撑, 下赌注, 资助；打赌

examples.en: Several ambitious investors were willing to stake significant capital on the risky new startup.
examples.zh: 几位雄心勃勃的投资者愿意在这家高风险的初创企业上下重注投入资金。

lemmas.def_en: (law) a right or legal share of something; a financial involvement with something
lemmas.def_zh: 桩, 炮烙刑, 木柱, 赌注, 奖金

examples.en: Several ambitious investors were willing to stake significant capital on the risky new startup.
examples.zh: 几位雄心勃勃的投资者愿意在这家高风险的初创企业上下重注投入资金。

family_guide.root_logic: 本义为木桩，后引申为赛马木桩上的赌金，再扩展为涉及的利害关系与冒险押注。

lemmas.def_en: fastener consisting of a metal ring for lining a small hole to permit the attachment of cords or lines
lemmas.def_zh: 环, 圈, 弯曲部分, 循环

examples.en: She tied the blue ribbon into a neat loop on top of the gift.
examples.zh: 她在礼物上方把蓝色丝带系成了一个整齐的圆环。

lemmas.def_en: move in loops
lemmas.def_zh: 使成环, 以圈结, 以环连结；打环, 翻筋斗

examples.en: She tied the blue ribbon into a neat loop on top of the gift.
examples.zh: 她在礼物上方把蓝色丝带系成了一个整齐的圆环。

lemmas.def_en: consisting of or covered with or having loops
lemmas.def_zh: 多圈的, 呆头呆脑的, 糊涂的

examples.en: After staying awake for two days straight, she felt completely dizzy and delightfully loopy.
examples.zh: 连续两天没睡之后，她感到头晕目眩，整个人都晕头转向的。

family_guide.root_logic: 原指弯曲的形状，引申为圆环、回路及反复循环的动作。

lemmas.def_en: a small contrasting part of something
lemmas.def_zh: 片, 补缀, 碎片, 斑, 傻瓜

examples.en: He wore an old woolen jacket with a brown leather patch on each elbow.
examples.zh: 他穿着一件旧羊毛夹克，两只手肘上各有一块棕色皮补丁。

lemmas.def_en: unevenness in quality or performance
lemmas.def_zh: 补缀的性质[状态]; 云斑

examples.en: The patchiness of the cellular network coverage frustrated travelers driving across the remote desert.
examples.zh: 蜂窝网络覆盖的不均匀让驾车穿越偏远沙漠的旅行者感到沮丧。

lemmas.def_en: to join or unite the pieces of
lemmas.def_zh: 补缀, 掩饰, 拼凑, 平息

examples.en: He wore an old woolen jacket with a brown leather patch on each elbow.
examples.zh: 他穿着一件旧羊毛夹克，两只手肘上各有一块棕色皮补丁。

lemmas.def_en: irregular or uneven in quality, texture, etc.
lemmas.def_zh: 补缀的, 凑合的, 不调和的, 散落的, 斑驳的, 不完全的

examples.en: His memory of the chaotic accident remained quite patchy even after several days had passed.
examples.zh: 几天过去了，他对那场混乱事故的记忆仍然十分零碎。

lemmas.def_en: in spots
lemmas.def_zh: 不规则地, 散落地

examples.en: The freshly cleared grass grew back patchily across the muddy backyard during late autumn.
examples.zh: 深秋时节，泥泞的后院里新清理过的草零零散散地重新长了出来。

family_guide.root_logic: 本义指修补用的布片或小块材料，引申为斑块、小块土地或补丁程序。

lemmas.def_en: (sports) the act of swinging or striking at a ball with a club or racket or bat or cue or hand
lemmas.def_zh: 笔划, 打, 中风, 抚, 摩, 冲程

examples.en: She gently began to stroke the purring cat behind its ears to calm it.
examples.zh: 她开始温柔地抚摸那只打呼噜的猫的耳后，让它平静下来。

lemmas.def_en: touch lightly and repeatedly, as with brushing motions
lemmas.def_zh: 划尾桨, 抚, 摩, 划去

examples.en: She gently began to stroke the purring cat behind its ears to calm it.
examples.zh: 她开始温柔地抚摸那只打呼噜的猫的耳后，让它平静下来。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自strike（击打），引申为一击、笔划、抚摩以及突发的心脑血管击打（中风）。

lemmas.def_en: look searchingly
lemmas.def_zh: 凝视, 窥视, 费力地看, 隐现；与...同等, 封为贵族

examples.en: The driver had to peer carefully through the thick fog to spot road signs.
examples.zh: 司机不得不透过浓雾仔细凝视，以辨认路标。

lemmas.def_en: a person who is of equal standing with another in a group
lemmas.def_zh: 同等的人, 匹敌, 贵族

examples.en: The driver had to peer carefully through the thick fog to spot road signs.
examples.zh: 司机不得不透过浓雾仔细凝视，以辨认路标。

lemmas.def_en: eminent beyond or above comparison
lemmas.def_zh: 无比的, 出类的, 无双的

examples.en: The soprano received a standing ovation for her peerless performance in the tragic opera.
examples.zh: 这位女高音因其在这部悲剧歌剧中举世无双的精彩表演而赢得了全场起立鼓掌。

family_guide.root_logic: 作动词指费力凝视；作名词源自拉丁语par（对等），指同辈、地位相等的人。

lemmas.def_en: a sizeable hole (usually in the ground)
lemmas.def_zh: 深坑, 矿井, 果核, 地窖, 深渊, 绝境, 陷阱

examples.en: The workers accidentally uncovered a deep gravel pit during the heavy highway construction project.
examples.zh: 工人们在繁重的公路建设项目中意外发现了一个深砾石坑。

lemmas.def_en: set into opposition or rivalry
lemmas.def_zh: 窖藏, 使凹下, 使有麻点, 去...之核, 使留疤痕, 使相斗, 使竞争；起凹点, 凹陷

examples.en: The workers accidentally uncovered a deep gravel pit during the heavy highway construction project.
examples.zh: 工人们在繁重的公路建设项目中意外发现了一个深砾石坑。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语pytt（深坑），引申为矿井、果核，动词引申为挖坑或使……对立抗衡。

lemmas.def_zh: 任何人, 无论谁

examples.en: Whoever left their jacket in the conference room can pick it up at reception.
examples.zh: 把夹克留在会议室的人都可以去前台领取。

family_guide.root_logic: who（谁）+ -ever（无论），表示泛指的“任何人”或“无论谁”。

lemmas.def_en: a game resembling ice hockey that is played on an open field; two opposing teams use curved sticks try to drive a ball into the opponents' net
lemmas.def_zh: 冰球, 曲棍球

examples.en: The boys spent every winter afternoon playing ice hockey on the frozen lake.
examples.zh: 男孩们整个冬天的下午都在冰冻的湖面上打冰球。

family_guide.root_logic: 词源不详，可能与古法语曲柄杖有关，指使用球棍击球的曲棍球或冰球运动。

lemmas.def_en: without doubt (used to reinforce an assertion)

examples.en: She was furious at his rude behavior, and she had every right alright.
examples.zh: 她对他的无礼行为感到愤怒，而且她完全有理由这么做。

family_guide.root_logic: 由all right演变而来的非正式合写形式，语义完全对等，用于口语表达赞同或状况良好。

lemmas.def_en: happening at a time subsequent to a reference time
lemmas.def_zh: adv. 后来，之后

examples.en: We went out for a nice dinner and went to the theater afterwards.
examples.zh: 我们出去吃了顿丰盛的晚餐，之后又去看了戏剧。

family_guide.root_logic: 由 after（在……之后）加副词后缀 -wards（朝……方向）构成，指时间上的往后推移。

lemmas.def_en: very recently
lemmas.def_zh: adv. 最近，新近

examples.en: The newly appointed manager decided to restructure the entire sales team.
examples.zh: 新任命的经理决定重组整个销售团队。

family_guide.root_logic: 由形容词 new 派生出副词 newly，表示时间上最近或状态的新近形成。

lemmas.def_en: the branch of social science that deals with the production and distribution and consumption of goods and services and their management
lemmas.def_zh: n. 经济学；经济状况

examples.en: She decided to major in economics to better understand global trade patterns.
examples.zh: 她决定主修经济学，以更好地理解全球贸易模式。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 oikonomia（家政管理），引申指管理社会资源产出与分配的科学。

lemmas.def_en: as the agent of or on someone's part (usually expressed as  rather than )
lemmas.def_zh: n. 利益，代表

examples.en: The lawyer spoke on behalf of the victims during the press conference.
examples.zh: 律师在新闻发布会上代表受害者发了言。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自中古英语 bi halve（在……旁边/一侧），引申指代表某方利益或立场。

lemmas.def_en: reduce or cause to be reduced from a solid to a liquid state, usually by heating
lemmas.def_zh: v. （使）融化，消融

examples.en: The spring sun was warm enough to melt the thick snow on the roof.
examples.zh: 春天的阳光足够温暖，融化了屋顶上的厚雪。

lemmas.def_en: reduce or cause to be reduced from a solid to a liquid state, usually by heating
lemmas.def_zh: melt的过去分词

examples.en: The intense heat from the eruption has molten the surrounding rocks into lava.
examples.zh: 火山喷发产生的酷热已将周围的岩石融化成了熔岩。

lemmas.def_en: reduced to liquid form by heating
lemmas.def_zh: 熔化的, 炽热的, 铸造的

examples.en: The intense heat from the eruption has molten the surrounding rocks into lava.
examples.zh: 火山喷发产生的酷热已将周围的岩石融化成了熔岩。

lemmas.def_en: not melted
lemmas.def_zh: 未融(或熔)化的,未融合的,未消散的

examples.en: Patches of unmelted snow still lingered in the deep shadows of the mountain.
examples.zh: 山间背阴深处仍残留着一片片未融化的积雪。

lemmas.def_en: a worker who melts substances (metal or wax etc.)
lemmas.def_zh: 熔炉, 熔化器, 熔炼工, 炉工, 炼钢工

examples.en: The skilled melter carefully monitored the furnace temperature throughout his evening shift.
examples.zh: 熟练的熔炼工在整个晚班期间都仔细监控着炉温。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 meltan，核心语义为物体受热由固态化为液态，molten 为其古老且常保留作特指高温融态的派生形式。
family_guide.core_distinction: melt 为常用动词（可作不及物或及物）；molten 作形容词通常特指岩石、玻璃或金属等经极高热量熔化成的灼热液态，不用于普通冰雪融化。

lemmas.def_en: to move (the head or body) quickly downwards or away
lemmas.def_zh: 没入水中, 闪避；猛按...入水, 躲避

examples.en: You need to duck your head when walking through that low wooden doorway.
examples.zh: 穿过那扇低矮的木门时，你必须低下头闪避。

lemmas.def_en: small wild or domesticated web-footed broad-billed swimming bird usually having a depressed body and short legs
lemmas.def_zh: 鸭子

examples.en: You need to duck your head when walking through that low wooden doorway.
examples.zh: 穿过那扇低矮的木门时，你必须低下头闪避。

lemmas.def_zh: 小鸭子
lemmas.def_en: flesh of a young domestic duck

examples.en: A tiny duckling hurried across the pond to catch up with its mother.
examples.zh: 一只小鸭子匆忙穿过池塘去追赶它的母亲。

family_guide.root_logic: 拟声兼动作拟态词，原本指像鸭子一样潜水，后引申为迅速低头弯腰以避开障碍或猛击。
family_guide.core_distinction: duck (n.) 指动物“鸭子”，duck (v.) 引申指“迅速低下头身”或“回避（问题）”。

lemmas.def_en: an administrator in charge of a division of a university or college
lemmas.def_zh: n. （大学的）学院院长，系主任；（教会的）主任牧师

examples.en: The dean addressed the incoming freshmen during the orientation ceremony.
examples.zh: 院长在开学迎新典礼上向大一新生致辞。

lemmas.def_en: the position or office of a dean
lemmas.def_zh: 院长职位(或职权)

examples.en: During his deanship, the faculty introduced several innovative degree programs for students.
examples.zh: 在他担任院长期间，该学院为学生开设了数个创新学位项目。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自晚期拉丁语 decanus（十人长），后演变为教会神职头衔，现广泛指大学分院院长或资历最深者。

lemmas.def_en: a diplomat of the highest rank; accredited as representative from one country to another
lemmas.def_zh: n. 大使，使节；形象代表

examples.en: She was officially appointed as the country's new ambassador to France.
examples.zh: 她被正式任命为该国新任驻法国大使。

lemmas.def_en: the post of ambassador
lemmas.def_zh: 大使的职位

examples.en: She was finally rewarded with an ambassadorship to France after years of service.
examples.zh: 经过多年的奉职，她最终获得了出任驻法国大使的职位。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to or characteristic of ambassadors
lemmas.def_zh: 大使的, 大使一级的

examples.en: The lavish banquet was held inside the grand ambassadorial residence downtown.
examples.zh: 奢华的宴会在市中心宏伟的大使官邸内举行。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 ambactus（仆役，信使），借由古法语演变为国家或元首派出的最高级别常驻外交代表。

lemmas.def_en: ruin completely
lemmas.def_zh: v. 打破，弄碎；突击搜捕；（使）破产

examples.en: The police bust a major smuggling operation in the port area last night.
examples.zh: 警方昨晚在港口地区捣毁了一个重大走私窝点。

lemmas.def_en: an informal form of address for a man
lemmas.def_zh: 庞然大物, 非凡的人, 闹饮, 驯马人, 小家伙, 小鬼, 炸弹, 巨型炸弹

examples.en: Listen here, buster, you cannot talk to the customers in that rude tone.
examples.zh: 听着，小家伙，你不能用那种粗鲁的语气和顾客说话。

lemmas.def_en: (of a woman's body) having a large bosom and pleasing curves
lemmas.def_zh: 大胸脯的, 胸部丰满的

examples.en: The busty actress found it hard to find tailored dresses that fit properly.
examples.zh: 这位胸部丰满的女演员发现很难找到合身的定制礼服。

family_guide.root_logic: 原为 burst（爆裂）的方言变体，常指破损、突击搜查或宣告破产等剧烈破坏状态。

lemmas.def_en: a commissioned military officer in the United States Army or Air Force or Marines who ranks above a lieutenant colonel and below a brigadier general
lemmas.def_zh: n. （陆军、空军或海军陆战队的）上校

examples.en: The colonel ordered his troops to hold their positions until reinforcements arrived.
examples.zh: 上校命令部队坚守阵地，直到援军赶到。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自意大利语 colonnella（专栏，纵队之长），指统领一个纵队或团的军官（注意读音中带有 /r/ 音）。

lemmas.def_en: reestablish on a new, usually improved, basis or make new or like new
lemmas.def_zh: v. 更新，延长……的有效期；重新开始

examples.en: You need to renew your passport before booking an international flight.
examples.zh: 在预订国际航班之前，你需要先换发护照。

lemmas.def_en: the conversion of wasteland into land suitable for use of habitation or cultivation
lemmas.def_zh: 更新, 革新, 复兴, 恢复, 修补, 补充, 继续, 重订, 重申, 续借

examples.en: Urban renewal projects have completely transformed the historic neighborhood into an arts hub.
examples.zh: 城市更新项目已将这个历史悠久的街区彻底改造成了艺术中心。

family_guide.root_logic: 由前缀 re-（再，重新）加 new（新的）构成，核心意义是让事物恢复到原有的新鲜或有效状态。
family_guide.core_distinction: renew 为动词动作；renewal 为其名词形式，指更新或延续的过程或期限。

lemmas.def_en: the scene of any event or action (especially the place of a meeting)
lemmas.def_zh: n. （活动、会议或赛事的）举办地点，场地

examples.en: The stadium was chosen as the primary venue for the upcoming music festival.
examples.zh: 该体育场被选为即将举行的音乐节的主场地。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古法语 venir（来），本义指集合前来的地方，引申为举办各类公众活动、会议或比赛的场所。

lemmas.def_en: provoking fear terror
lemmas.def_zh: adj. 恐怖的，吓人的

examples.en: Walking through the dark forest alone at night was a scary experience.
examples.zh: 夜间独自穿行于黑暗的森林是一段吓人的经历。

lemmas.def_en: in an alarming manner
lemmas.def_zh: 可怕地

examples.en: His uncanny impression of the former president was scarily accurate and hilarious.
examples.zh: 他对前总统不可思议的模仿可怕地逼真且令人捧腹。

family_guide.root_logic: 由动词 scare（使害怕）加形容词后缀 -y 构成，指事物本身具备引起恐惧的特征。

lemmas.def_en: a licensed medical practitioner
lemmas.def_zh: n. （尤指内科）医生，医师

examples.en: You should consult your physician before starting any rigorous exercise routine.
examples.zh: 在开始任何剧烈运动锻炼前，你都应该先咨询你的主治医生。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古法语 fisicien，最初指通晓自然物理科学的人，后特指依据科学方法看病开药的内科医生。

lemmas.def_en: issue commands or orders for
lemmas.def_zh: v. 开（药），配（处方）；规定

examples.en: The doctor decided to prescribe a short course of antibiotics for the infection.
examples.zh: 医生决定为感染症状开一个短疗程的抗生素。

lemmas.def_en: directions prescribed beforehand; the action of prescribing authoritative rules or directions
lemmas.def_zh: 处方, 命令, 指定

examples.en: The pharmacist carefully verified the doctor's prescription before dispensing the strong medication.
examples.zh: 药剂师在分发这种强效药物之前仔细核对了医生的处方。

lemmas.def_en: pertaining to giving directives or rules
lemmas.def_zh: 规定的, 指定的, 规范的

examples.en: Some teachers prefer a prescriptive grammar approach rather than letting students explore freely.
examples.zh: 一些教师更倾向于规范性的语法教学，而不是让学生自由探索。

lemmas.def_en: purchasable without a doctor's prescription
lemmas.def_zh: 未经医生处方可以买到的

examples.en: You can buy simple pain relievers over the counter without any nonprescription restrictions.
examples.zh: 你可以在柜台直接购买普通止痛药，没有任何非处方限制。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 pre-（在前面，预先）加词根 scribe（写），原指预先写下指示或法规，特指医生提前写下服药处方。
family_guide.core_distinction: prescribe 是动词动作；prescription 为其派生的名词，指开具的处方单或所开的药方本身。

lemmas.def_en: a licensed medical practitioner
lemmas.def_zh: 医生；文件

examples.en: I need to see the doc for a quick checkup.
examples.zh: 我需要去看医生做个快速体检。

family_guide.root_logic: doctor（医生）或document（文件）的口语缩写形式。

lemmas.def_en: gossip (usually a mixture of truth and untruth) passed around by word of mouth
lemmas.def_zh: 谣言, 传闻

examples.en: The latest rumor suggests that the tech company is planning a massive merger.
examples.zh: 最新的传闻表明这家科技公司正计划进行大规模合并。

lemmas.def_en: tell or spread rumors
lemmas.def_zh: 谣传

examples.en: The latest rumor suggests that the tech company is planning a massive merger.
examples.zh: 最新的传闻表明这家科技公司正计划进行大规模合并。

lemmas.def_en: tell or spread rumors
lemmas.def_zh: 谣传

examples.en: Local villagers rumour that the abandoned mansion on the hill is haunted.
examples.zh: 当地村民谣传山上的废弃豪宅正在闹鬼。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语rumorem（喧闹、传闻），指未经证实而在人群中流传的流言。

lemmas.def_en: a branch of knowledge
lemmas.def_zh: 训练, 纪律

examples.en: Maintaining strict discipline during intense military training is essential for group safety.
examples.zh: 在严苛的军事训练中保持严明的纪律对集体安全至关重要。

lemmas.def_en: develop (children's) behavior by instruction and practice; especially to teach self-control
lemmas.def_zh: 训练, 惩罚

examples.en: Maintaining strict discipline during intense military training is essential for group safety.
examples.zh: 在严苛的军事训练中保持严明的纪律对集体安全至关重要。

lemmas.def_en: relating to discipline in behavior
lemmas.def_zh: 纪律的，惩戒的

examples.en: The employee faced disciplinary action following a serious breach of safety rules.
examples.zh: 该员工因严重违反安全规定而面临纪律处分。

lemmas.def_en: not subjected to discipline
lemmas.def_zh: 未受过训练的, 训练不足的, 不遵守纪律的

examples.en: The undisciplined puppy chewed through the expensive leather shoes while everyone slept.
examples.zh: 那只未受规训的小狗趁大家睡觉时咬坏了昂贵的皮鞋。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语discipulus（门徒、学习者），核心在于通过指导、规范形成受控的“秩序”与“自制”。

lemmas.def_en: use or manipulate to one's advantage
lemmas.def_zh: 开发, 利用, 开拓, 剥削

examples.en: The daring rescue mission was hailed as an extraordinary military exploit by the press.
examples.zh: 那次大胆的救援行动被媒体称赞为非凡的军事功绩。

lemmas.def_en: a notable achievement
lemmas.def_zh: 功绩, 勋绩

examples.en: The daring rescue mission was hailed as an extraordinary military exploit by the press.
examples.zh: 那次大胆的救援行动被媒体称赞为非凡的军事功绩。

lemmas.def_en: the act of making some area of land or water more profitable or productive or useful
lemmas.def_zh: 开发, 开采, 剥削

examples.en: Strict labor laws were introduced to prevent the unfair exploitation of factory workers.
examples.zh: 出台严格的劳动法是为了防止对工厂工人的不公剥削。

lemmas.def_en: a person who uses something or someone selfishly or unethically
lemmas.def_zh: 剥削者

examples.en: The landlord was condemned as a greedy exploiter who overcharged impoverished tenants.
examples.zh: 该房东被谴责为向贫困租客索取过高费用的贪婪剥削者。

lemmas.def_en: tending to exploit or make use of
lemmas.def_zh: 开发的, 剥削的, (糟蹋地)利用的

examples.en: Activists protested against the multinational company's exploitative practices in developing nations.
examples.zh: 活动人士抗议这家跨国公司在发展中国家的剥削性行径。

lemmas.def_en: tending to exploit or make use of
lemmas.def_zh: 开发资源的, 剥削的

examples.en: Critics argued that the new contract was heavily exploitive and harmful to freelance writers.
examples.zh: 批评人士认为，新合同具有严重的剥削性，损害了自由撰稿人的利益。

lemmas.def_en: undeveloped or unused
lemmas.def_zh: 未被利用的,未经开发的

examples.en: The remote valley is known for its vast, unexploited reserves of clean natural gas.
examples.zh: 这个偏远山谷以其储量巨大且尚未开采的清洁天然气闻名。
