family_guide.root_logic: 源自古法语，原指“达成的成就”，后引申出“充分利用资源”，进一步贬义化为“剥削”。
family_guide.core_distinction: exploit 强调利用行为或英勇事迹，exploitation 侧重开采、利用的抽象行为或不公正的剥削状态。

lemmas.def_en: haunt like a ghost; pursue
lemmas.def_zh: 迷住, 使困扰

examples.en: He began to obsess over minor details, losing sight of the project's main objective.
examples.zh: 他开始过分纠结于次要细节，忽略了项目的主要目标。

lemmas.def_en: an irrational motive for performing trivial or repetitive actions, even against your will
lemmas.def_zh: 困扰, 困扰人的情绪

examples.en: Her growing obsession with physical fitness led her to train intensely for five hours daily.
examples.zh: 她对保持身材日益痴迷，导致她每天高强度训练五小时。

lemmas.def_en: a person who has obsessions

examples.en: As a perfectionist and obsessive, he continually rearranged the books until they lined up perfectly.
examples.zh: 作为完美主义者和强迫症患者，他不断重排书籍，直到它们整齐排列。

lemmas.def_en: extreme compulsiveness
lemmas.def_zh: 执念

examples.en: Her extreme obsessiveness with cleanliness meant that the kitchen had to be sanitized constantly.
examples.zh: 她对清洁的极度执念意味着厨房必须时刻保持消毒。

lemmas.def_en: in a compulsive manner
lemmas.def_zh: 过分地；着迷地, 着魔似地

examples.en: Throughout the evening, he checked his phone obsessively for any reply from his manager.
examples.zh: 整整一晚，他都着魔似地频繁查看手机，等待经理的回复。

lemmas.def_en: characterized by or constituting an obsession
lemmas.def_zh: 摆脱不了的

examples.en: The patient displayed obsessional behaviors, repeatedly checking the locked door every few minutes.
examples.zh: 该患者表现出强迫行为，每隔几分钟就反复检查门是否锁好。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语obsidere（包围、固守），语义由“外在围困”演变为思想被某事“紧紧缠绕、挥之不去”。

lemmas.def_en: an argument opposed to a proposal
lemmas.def_zh: 反对者, 反对票, 肺结核

examples.en: The young scholar spent the entire evening conning the ancient manuscript line by line.
examples.zh: 年轻的学者花了一整晚逐行精读研究这份古老手稿。

lemmas.def_en: deprive of by deceit
lemmas.def_zh: 精读, 仔细研究, 默记

examples.en: The young scholar spent the entire evening conning the ancient manuscript line by line.
examples.zh: 年轻的学者花了一整晚逐行精读研究这份古老手稿。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自confidence（信任）的缩写，引申为“利用信任进行欺诈”。

lemmas.def_en: become imbued
lemmas.def_zh: 吸收, 使全神贯注, 同化, 买进, 理解, 承受, 忍受, 承担

examples.en: The sponge can quickly absorb large amounts of liquid without dripping all over the floor.
examples.zh: 这块海绵能迅速吸收大量液体，不会滴落得满地都是。

lemmas.def_en: (chemistry) a process in which one substance permeates another; a fluid permeates or is dissolved by a liquid or solid
lemmas.def_zh: 吸收, 专心, 全神贯注

examples.en: Her deep absorption in the classical novel made her completely unaware of the approaching storm.
examples.zh: 她全神贯注于那部古典小说，完全没有察觉到暴风雨的来临。

lemmas.def_en: a material having capacity or tendency to absorb another substance
lemmas.def_zh: 吸收剂

examples.en: The cleanup crew spread an industrial absorbent across the highway to soak up the spilled oil.
examples.zh: 清理人员在公路上铺撒了一种工业吸收剂以吸附泄漏的机油。

lemmas.def_en: (physics) material in a nuclear reactor that absorbs radiation
lemmas.def_zh: 吸收器

examples.en: Engineers installed a heavy-duty shock absorber to minimize vibrations generated by the machine.
examples.zh: 工程师安装了一个重型减震吸收器，以最大限度减少机器产生的震动。

lemmas.def_en: the property of being absorbent
lemmas.def_zh: 吸收性, 吸光度

examples.en: Paper towels with high absorbency are far more effective at cleaning up heavy kitchen spills.
examples.zh: 吸水性高的纸巾在清理厨房重油污泼溅时要有效得多。

lemmas.def_en: (physics) the property of a body that determines the fraction of the incident radiation or sound flux absorbed or absorbable by the body
lemmas.def_zh: 吸收性, 吸收率

examples.en: The dark coating increases the thermal absorptivity of the panels, maximizing heat collection efficiency.
examples.zh: 深色涂层提高了面板的吸热率，从而最大化集热效率。

lemmas.def_en: capable of being absorbed or taken in through the pores of a surface
lemmas.def_zh: 可吸收的, 容易被吸收的

examples.en: The surgeon stitched the incision with absorbable sutures that dissolve naturally over time.
examples.zh: 外科医生用可吸收缝合线缝合了切口，缝线会随时间自然溶解。

lemmas.def_en: having power or capacity or tendency to absorb or soak up something (liquids or energy etc.)
lemmas.def_zh: 吸收性的, 有吸收力的

examples.en: This specialized cotton fabric has remarkable absorptive properties, making it ideal for workout gear.
examples.zh: 这种特制棉质面料具有出色的吸附性能，非常适合做运动装备。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀ab-（离去）+ sorbere（吸入），本义为“彻底吸尽”，引申至吸收光热、知识或全神贯注。

lemmas.def_en: wear out completely
lemmas.def_zh: 抽完, 用尽, 耗尽, 使精疲力尽；排气

examples.en: Working double shifts throughout the busy holiday season will eventually exhaust even the strongest workers.
examples.zh: 在繁忙的假期连续上两班，最终即便是最强壮的工人也会精疲力竭。

lemmas.def_en: extreme fatigue
lemmas.def_zh: 抽空, 耗尽, 疲惫, 筋疲力尽

examples.en: After hiking thirty miles through the rugged mountains, she collapsed onto her bed from exhaustion.
examples.zh: 在崎岖的山区徒步三十英里后，她因极度疲惫瘫倒在床上。

lemmas.def_zh: adj. 精疲力竭的；耗尽的
lemmas.def_en: extremely tired; completely used up
lemmas.usage_note: 强调能量或体力见底，极度疲惫；修饰事物时表示资源枯竭。

examples.en: After working for sixteen hours straight, he was completely exhausted.
examples.zh: 连续工作了十六个小时后，他彻底精疲力竭了。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀ex-（出）+ haurire（抽干），核心语义为“将内部所有的东西抽空、耗尽”。

lemmas.def_en: become one
lemmas.def_zh: 使合并, 使消失, 吞没；合并, 渐渐消失

examples.en: The two small tech startups decided to merge into a single powerful company.
examples.zh: 这两家小型科技初创公司决定合并为一家实力雄厚的大公司。

lemmas.def_en: the combination of two or more commercial companies
lemmas.def_zh: 合并, 归并

examples.en: The merger between the two retail giants surprised many Wall Street analysts.
examples.zh: 两家零售巨头之间的合并让许多华尔街分析师感到意外。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语mergere（浸入、沉没），引申为两股水流汇入彼此，现泛指合并、交融。
family_guide.core_distinction: merge 指动作过程，merger 指企业或组织合并的法律/商业事件。

lemmas.def_en: having or showing determination and energetic pursuit of your ends
lemmas.def_zh: 侵略的, 挑畔的, 进取的

examples.en: The sales team launched an aggressive marketing campaign to win new clients.
examples.zh: 销售团队发起了一场激进的营销活动以争取新客户。

lemmas.def_zh: 好斗的
lemmas.def_en: tough and callous by virtue of experience
not aggressive; not given to fighting or assertiveness
lemmas.def_zh: 不侵略的, 不侵犯的

examples.en: The lab breed is known for its nonaggressive nature around young children.
examples.zh: 该实验室培育的犬种因对幼儿不具攻击性而闻名。

lemmas.def_en: not aggressive; not given to fighting or assertiveness
lemmas.def_zh: 不具攻击性的

examples.en: His unaggressive manner made him popular among his more competitive colleagues.
examples.zh: 他毫无侵略性的处事态度让他在竞争激烈的同事中颇受欢迎。

lemmas.def_en: in an aggressive manner
lemmas.def_zh: (贬)侵略, 侵犯, 寻衅, (褒)敢作敢为, 有进取心, (武器)攻击性, 过分, 放肆

examples.en: The company aggressively expanded into overseas markets over the last three years.
examples.zh: 该公司在过去三年中积极进取，大力开拓海外市场。

lemmas.def_en: a disposition to behave aggressively
lemmas.def_zh: n. 侵略，攻击性行为

examples.en: The pact was designed to prevent unprovoked military aggression.
examples.zh: 该条约旨在防止毫无由头的军事侵略。

lemmas.def_zh: 侵略者, 挑畔者
lemmas.def_en: someone who attacks
the quality of being bold and enterprising
lemmas.def_zh: (贬)侵略, 侵犯, 寻衅, (褒)敢作敢为, 有进取心, (武器)攻击性, 过分, 放肆

examples.en: His sudden aggressiveness during the negotiation alarmed the other business partners.
examples.zh: 他在谈判中突如其来的攻击性让其他商业伙伴感到震惊。

lemmas.def_en: a policy of not initiating hostilities
lemmas.def_zh: 不侵略

examples.en: The two neighboring countries signed a formal nonaggression pact last month.
examples.zh: 这两个邻国上个月签署了一项正式的互不侵犯条约。

lemmas.def_zh: 好斗
lemmas.def_en: a natural disposition to be hostile

examples.en: His natural pugnacity often created unnecessary friction during calm team negotiations.
examples.zh: 他天生好斗的性格在平静的团队谈判中常常引发不必要的摩擦。

lemmas.def_zh: 挑畔, 侵犯, 侵略
lemmas.def_en: take the initiative and go on the offensive

examples.en: The treaty explicitly forbids member nations to aggress against their neighbors.
examples.zh: 该条约明确禁止成员国侵犯其邻国。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语aggredi（攻击、迈向），包含“具有进攻击性”和“主动进取”的双重意向。

lemmas.def_en: permission to do something
lemmas.def_zh: 同意, 许可

examples.en: You must obtain written parental consent before joining the field trip.
examples.zh: 参加实地考察旅行前，你必须获得父母的书面许可。

lemmas.def_en: give an affirmative reply to; respond favorably to
lemmas.def_zh: 同意, 赞同

examples.en: You must obtain written parental consent before joining the field trip.
examples.zh: 参加实地考察旅行前，你必须获得父母的书面许可。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀con-（共同）+ sentire（感知、感受），字面为“感同身受”，引申为彼此达成意见一致。

lemmas.def_en: domestic swine
lemmas.def_zh: 猪, 猪肉, 贪婪的人, 猪一样的人

examples.en: The farmer raised a prize pig that won first place at the county fair.
examples.zh: 农夫饲养的一头名优猪在县集市上赢得了第一名。

lemmas.def_en: a young pig
lemmas.def_zh: 小猪

examples.en: The little girl carefully dropped her spare coins into her piggy bank.
examples.zh: 小女孩小心翼翼地把零钱投进了她的小猪储蓄罐里。

lemmas.def_zh: 小猪, 猪仔
lemmas.def_en: a young pig

examples.en: A newborn piglet scrambled eagerly toward its mother to find a warm nursing spot.
examples.zh: 刚出生的小猪急切地爬向母猪，寻找温暖的吃奶位置。

lemmas.def_en: live like a pig, in squalor
lemmas.def_zh: 生小猪, 象猪般地生活

examples.en: The farmer raised a prize pig that won first place at the county fair.
examples.zh: 农夫饲养的一头名优猪在县集市上赢得了第一名。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自中古英语pigge，原指小猪，后作为动物统称，比喻行为贪吃、邋遢的人或行为。

lemmas.def_en: call upon in supplication; entreat
lemmas.def_zh: 乞求, 乞讨, 请求

examples.en: The desperate mother had to beg for financial help to save her child.
examples.zh: 绝望的母亲不得不恳求经济援助来拯救她的孩子。

lemmas.def_zh: 赤贫, 行乞
lemmas.def_en: a solicitation for money or food (especially in the street by an apparently penniless person)

examples.en: Decades of war and drought reduced thousands of proud families to utter beggary.
examples.zh: 数十年的战争和干旱使成千上万原本体面的家庭沦入赤贫。

family_guide.root_logic: 可能源自宗教修会“托钵乞讨者”（Beguine），核心动作为“恳求、乞求施舍”。

lemmas.def_en: a reason for wanting something done
lemmas.def_zh: 目的, 缘故, 理由

examples.en: For the sake of your health, you should stop eating junk food daily.
examples.zh: 为了你的健康着想，你应该停止每天吃垃圾食品。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语sacu（争吵、诉讼、原因），现代仅用于固定搭配表示“缘故、利益”。

lemmas.def_en: at risk of or subject to experiencing something usually unpleasant
lemmas.def_zh: 有义务的, 应负责的, 有...倾向的

examples.en: Drivers who cause traffic accidents are liable for all the medical expenses.
examples.zh: 引发交通事故的司机必须对所有的医疗费用承担责任。

lemmas.def_en: the state of being legally obliged and responsible
lemmas.def_zh: 责任, 债务, 倾向

examples.en: The company accepted full legal liability for the defective equipment it sold.
examples.zh: 该公司对其售出的缺陷设备承担了全部法律责任。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自盎格鲁-法语lier（捆绑、约束），指在法律上“受约束要负责”或倾向于发生某事。
family_guide.core_distinction: liable 侧重法律责任或不良倾向，liability 是其抽象名词状态，亦特指财务上的“负债”。

lemmas.def_en: knock against with force or violence
lemmas.def_zh: 碰撞，颠簸

examples.en: The car bumped along the rough mountain road.
examples.zh: 汽车在崎岖的山路上颠簸前行。

lemmas.def_en: a glass filled to the brim (especially as a toast)
lemmas.def_zh: （汽车的）保险杠

examples.en: The crash damaged the rear bumper of his car.
examples.zh: 这次撞车事故损坏了他汽车的后保险杠。

lemmas.def_en: the texture of a surface that has many bumps
lemmas.def_zh: 崎岖不平

examples.en: The extreme bumpiness of the unpaved mountain road made several passengers feel nauseous.
examples.zh: 崎岖不平的山路让好几个乘客感到恶心头晕。

lemmas.def_en: causing or characterized by jolts and irregular movements
lemmas.def_zh: 颠簸的, 崎岖不平的

examples.en: Our small plane hit turbulence, making the final descent very bumpy.
examples.zh: 我们的小型飞机遇上了气流，导致最后的降落过程非常颠簸。

family_guide.root_logic: 拟声词，模拟物体轻微碰撞或颠簸发出的沉闷声音。

lemmas.def_en: provide with headquarters
lemmas.def_zh: 将总部设在

examples.en: The tech giant decided to headquarter its European operations in Dublin.
examples.zh: 这家科技巨头决定将其欧洲业务总部设在都柏林。

family_guide.root_logic: 来自 head（首脑）+ quarter（驻地），指设立总部或将指挥部设于某地。

lemmas.def_en: a ceremony at which a dead person is buried or cremated
lemmas.def_zh: 葬礼，丧事

examples.en: Hundreds of people attended the funeral to pay their respects.
examples.zh: 数百人参加了葬礼以表达哀思。

lemmas.def_en: of or for or relating to a funeral
lemmas.def_zh: 葬礼的, 埋葬的

examples.en: Archaeologists recently uncovered several precious funerary urns from the ancient tomb.
examples.zh: 考古学家最近从该古墓中发掘出了几只珍贵的随葬骨灰瓮。

lemmas.def_zh: 送葬的, 适合葬礼的, 悲哀的
lemmas.def_en: suited to or suggestive of a grave or burial

examples.en: A funereal silence fell over the room as the bad news was announced.
examples.zh: 坏消息宣布时，房间里陷入了一片肃穆的死寂。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 funus（丧葬仪式），专指埋葬或火化逝者的仪式。

lemmas.def_en: the period during which something is functional (as between birth and death)
lemmas.def_zh: 一生，终生；使用寿命

examples.en: It was the kind of opportunity that comes along once in a lifetime.
examples.zh: 这是那种一生难得一遇的良机。

family_guide.root_logic: 复合词 life（生命）+ time（时间），指一个人或事物存在存续的完整时间跨度。

lemmas.def_en: a splendid assemblage (especially of famous people)
lemmas.def_zh: 星系；银河系；群英

examples.en: Astronomers have discovered a distant galaxy billions of light-years away.
examples.zh: 天文学家发现了一个数十亿光年外的遥远星系。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to a galaxy (especially our galaxy the Milky Way)
lemmas.def_zh: 乳汁的, 银河的, 极大的

examples.en: Telescopes captured images of dust clouds swirling around the galactic center.
examples.zh: 望远镜捕捉到了围绕银河系中心盘旋的星际尘埃云图像。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 gala（乳汁），最初特指像牛奶洒在夜空的“银河”，后泛指星系。

lemmas.def_en: being ten more than twenty

examples.en: About thirty employees attended the mandatory safety workshop on Monday morning.
examples.zh: 大约三十名员工参加了周一上午举行的强制性安全培训研讨会。

lemmas.def_en: the cardinal number that is the product of ten and three

examples.en: About thirty employees attended the mandatory safety workshop on Monday morning.
examples.zh: 大约三十名员工参加了周一上午举行的强制性安全培训研讨会。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 thritig，由 three（三）演变而来，表示基数词三十。

lemmas.def_en: a formal message requesting something that is submitted to an authority
lemmas.def_zh: 请愿, 诉状, 陈情书, 申请, 祈求, 祷文

examples.en: Local residents started a petition calling for a new traffic light at the intersection.
examples.zh: 当地居民发起了一项请愿，呼吁在这个十字路口安装新红绿灯。

lemmas.def_en: one praying humbly for something
lemmas.def_zh: 请愿人, 诉愿人, (离婚案)原告

examples.en: The petitioner submitted hundreds of local signatures to the supreme court yesterday.
examples.zh: 诉愿人昨天向最高法院提交了数百个当地居民的签名。

lemmas.def_en: write a petition for something to somebody; request formally and in writing
lemmas.def_zh: 正式请求, 恳求, 请愿

examples.en: Residents plan to petition the council for a safer pedestrian crossing.
examples.zh: 居民们计划向市政委员会请愿，要求修建更安全的人行横道。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 petere（寻求、请求），指正式向官方或权威机构提出书面诉求。

lemmas.def_zh: 然而，反之

examples.en: Some people like city life, whereas others prefer the quiet countryside.
examples.zh: 有些人喜欢城市生活，而另一些人则更喜欢宁静的乡村。

family_guide.root_logic: 由 where（在……处）+ as（正如）合成，用于引出对比状语，强调两事物的反差。

lemmas.def_en: in the recent past
lemmas.def_zh: 近来，最近

examples.en: I haven't seen much of him lately because of his busy schedule.
examples.zh: 因为他日程繁忙，我最近很少见到他。

family_guide.root_logic: late（晚的，近来的）+ -ly（副词后缀），表示时间距离现在很近。

lemmas.def_en: fill with distaste
lemmas.def_zh: 使厌恶，使作呕

examples.en: The cruel treatment of the animals disgusted everyone present.
examples.zh: 对动物的残酷虐待令在场的每个人都感到作呕。

lemmas.def_en: in a disgusting manner or to a disgusting degree
lemmas.def_zh: 讨厌地

examples.en: The kitchen counter was disgustingly sticky after the wild birthday party.
examples.zh: 疯狂的生日派对过后，厨房台面脏得令人作呕。

lemmas.def_en: with disgust
lemmas.def_zh: 厌烦地

examples.en: He pushed the plate away disgustedly after finding a hair in it.
examples.zh: 发现菜里有一根头发后，他满脸厌恶地推开了盘子。

lemmas.def_en: extreme unpalatability to the mouth
lemmas.def_zh: disgusting的变形

examples.en: The sheer disgustingness of the abandoned apartment shocked the new cleaner.
examples.zh: 那间废弃公寓的恶心程度让新来的保洁员大为震惊。

lemmas.def_zh: adj. 厌恶的；反感的
lemmas.def_en: feeling or showing strong disapproval or disgust
lemmas.usage_note: 常用于描述人的感受，常与介词 at / with / by 搭配。

examples.en: I was disgusted by the terrible working conditions in the factory.
examples.zh: 我对工厂里恶劣的工作环境感到极其反感。

lemmas.def_zh: adj. 令人恶心的；令人作呕的
lemmas.def_en: extremely unpleasant or unacceptable; causing disgust
lemmas.usage_note: 修饰令人反感的人、行为、气味或食物。

examples.en: The kitchen had a disgusting smell of rotten meat.
examples.zh: 厨房里有一股令人作呕的腐肉味。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 dis-（不，逆）+ gust（品尝，源自拉丁语 gustus），字面为“倒胃口”，引申为极度厌恶。

lemmas.def_en: give new life or energy to
lemmas.def_zh: 再现，重新创造；娱乐消遣

examples.en: The museum uses virtual reality to recreate ancient Rome.
examples.zh: 博物馆利用虚拟现实技术重现了古罗马风貌。

lemmas.def_en: an activity that diverts or amuses or stimulates
lemmas.def_zh: 消遣，娱乐

examples.en: Parks provide spaces for sport and recreation for all citizens.
examples.zh: 公园为全体市民提供了开展体育和娱乐活动的场所。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to recreation
lemmas.def_zh: 休闲的，娱乐的

examples.en: The lake is used for various recreational activities such as fishing and boating.
examples.zh: 该湖泊用于垂钓和划船等多种休闲娱乐活动。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 re-（重新）+ create（创造），字面为重塑精力，引申为休养娱乐或重新创造。
family_guide.core_distinction: recreation 侧重消遣、娱乐活动；recreate 作及物动词时常表示“重现/重新创造”，作不及物动词时表示“娱乐”。

lemmas.def_en: make a resonant sound, like artillery
lemmas.def_zh: 急速发展, 发隆隆声；使兴旺, 发隆隆声

examples.en: Online grocery deliveries began to boom during the long winter months.
examples.zh: 在漫长的冬季里，线上杂货配送业务开始迅猛发展。

lemmas.def_en: a deep prolonged loud noise
lemmas.def_zh: 繁荣, 隆隆声

examples.en: Online grocery deliveries began to boom during the long winter months.
examples.zh: 在漫长的冬季里，线上杂货配送业务开始迅猛发展。

family_guide.root_logic: 拟声词，模拟低沉洪亮的轰鸣声，引申指经济或声势的迅猛爆发和繁荣。

lemmas.def_en: a workplace for the conduct of scientific research
lemmas.def_zh: 实验室，化验室

examples.en: The new vaccine is currently undergoing rigorous testing in the laboratory.
examples.zh: 这种新疫苗目前正在实验室接受严格测试。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 laborare（劳动、劳作），即进行科研“劳作”与实验的场所。

lemmas.def_en: a particular environment or walk of life
lemmas.def_zh: n. 领地，势力范围；领域；域名

examples.en: Physics is outside my domain of expertise.
examples.zh: 物理学超出了我的专业领域。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 dominus（主人），本义为领主的领地，后引申为专业领域或网络域名。

lemmas.def_en: a document granting an inventor sole rights to an invention
lemmas.def_zh: 专利权, 许可证, 执照, 专利品, 素质

examples.en: The company applied for a new patent to protect its design.
examples.zh: 该公司申请了一项新专利以保护其设计。

lemmas.def_en: the inventor to whom a patent is issued
lemmas.def_zh: 专利权所有人

examples.en: The patentee licensed the manufacturing rights to a reputable foreign firm.
examples.zh: 专利权人将制造权许可给了一家信誉良好的外国公司。

lemmas.def_en: the openness (lack of obstruction) of a bodily passage or duct
lemmas.def_zh: 明显

examples.en: The medical team checked the patency of the patient's major airway.
examples.zh: 医疗团队检查了患者主要呼吸道的通畅程度。

lemmas.def_en: obtain a patent for
lemmas.def_zh: 取得...的专利权, 请准专利

examples.en: The company applied for a new patent to protect its design.
examples.zh: 该公司申请了一项新专利以保护其设计。

lemmas.def_en: unmistakably (`plain' is often used informally for `plainly')
lemmas.def_zh: 明显地, 公然地

examples.en: His explanation for the financial loss was patently false to everyone.
examples.zh: 他对财务亏损的解释在所有人看来都显然是假的。

lemmas.def_en: (of devices and processes) not protected by patent
lemmas.def_zh: 未获专利权的

examples.en: Rival firms quickly copied the unpatented features of the smart gadget.
examples.zh: 竞争对手迅速仿制了这款智能设备尚未取得专利的特性。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 patere（敞开），最初指君主颁发的“公开信件”（letters patent），现指公开技术方案以换取专有权。

lemmas.def_en: a barrier that serves to enclose an area
lemmas.def_zh: 围墙, 栅栏, 买卖赃物的人, 剑术

examples.en: They put up a wooden fence around the garden this spring.
examples.zh: 今年春天，他们在花园周围立起了一圈木栅栏。

examples.zh: 这名娴熟的击剑选手以一次迅猛的突刺拿下了制胜分。

lemmas.def_en: enclose with a fence

examples.en: They put up a wooden fence around the garden this spring.
examples.zh: 今年春天，他们在花园周围立起了一圈木栅栏。

family_guide.root_logic: 来自 defence（防御）的缩略形式，核心语义为“防御、围合设施”。

lemmas.def_en: a document attesting to the truth of certain stated facts
lemmas.def_zh: 证书, 证明书

examples.zh: 她把教师资格证书装裱起来，挂在墙上。

lemmas.def_en: the act of certifying or bestowing a franchise on
lemmas.def_zh: 证明

examples.en: You must complete the rigorous training course to earn your official teaching certification.
examples.zh: 你必须完成严格的培训课程，才能获得正式的教师资格认证。

lemmas.def_en: present someone with a certificate
lemmas.def_zh: 发给证明书, 用证书批准, 用证书证明

examples.en: She framed her teaching certificate and hung it on the wall.
examples.zh: 她把教师资格证书装裱起来，挂在墙上。

lemmas.def_en: provide evidence for; stand as proof of; show by one's behavior, attitude, or external attributes
lemmas.def_zh: （通过官方或文件）证明；发证书认可

examples.en: The laboratory was certified to carry out advanced testing.
examples.zh: 该实验室获得了开展高级检测的资质认证。

lemmas.def_zh: [法] 证明者

examples.en: The official certifier reviewed all the safety documents before approving the building.
examples.zh: 官方认证员在批准该建筑前审查了所有的安全文件。

lemmas.def_en: fit to be certified as insane (and treated accordingly)
lemmas.def_zh: 可证明的, 可保证的

examples.en: His erratic behavior led some colleagues to joke that he was practically certifiable.
examples.zh: 他不稳定的行为让一些同事开玩笑说他简直该送精神病院了。

lemmas.def_en: lacking requisite official documentation or endorsement
lemmas.def_zh: [法] 未经证明的, 无证明书的

examples.en: The company was fined heavily for employing uncertified electricians on the site.
examples.zh: 该公司因在工地上雇用未经认证的电工而被处以巨额罚款。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 certus（确定的）+ fic-（做），核心语义为“确证事物的正式文书”。

lemmas.def_en: group of aircraft operating together under the same ownership
lemmas.def_zh: 舰队, 港湾, 小河

examples.en: The logistics firm operates a vast fleet of delivery vans nationwide.
examples.zh: 这家物流公司在全国范围内运营着庞大的送货车队。

lemmas.def_en: rapidity of movement
lemmas.def_zh: 快速, 无常

examples.en: The fleetness of the deer allowed it to escape the predator.
examples.zh: 鹿的敏捷步伐使它得以逃脱捕食者的追捕。

lemmas.def_en: moving very fast
lemmas.def_zh: 快速的, 敏捷的, 浅的, 短暂的

examples.en: The logistics firm operates a vast fleet of delivery vans nationwide.
examples.zh: 这家物流公司在全国范围内运营着庞大的送货车队。

lemmas.def_en: move along rapidly and lightly; skim or dart
lemmas.def_zh: 疾驰, 飞逝, 掠过；消磨, 变换船(或船员)的位置

examples.en: The logistics firm operates a vast fleet of delivery vans nationwide.
examples.zh: 这家物流公司在全国范围内运营着庞大的送货车队。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 fleot（浮动的船只、流水），核心义从“漂浮移动”分化为“船队/车队”和“飞逝的”。

lemmas.def_en: station where transport vehicles load or unload passengers or goods
lemmas.def_zh: 终端机, 终点, 末端, 极限, 终点站

examples.en: Passengers waited anxiously in the crowded international terminal for delayed flights.
examples.zh: 乘客们在拥挤的国际航站楼焦急等待延误的航班。

lemmas.def_en: at the end
lemmas.def_zh: 在末端, 末尾, 每期

examples.en: Doctors confirmed that the patient was terminally ill with advanced cancer.
examples.zh: 医生证实该患者已处于晚期癌症的绝症阶段。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 terminus（边界、终点），引申为线路或阶段的末端。

lemmas.def_en: a written agreement between two states or sovereigns
lemmas.def_zh: 条约, 谈判

examples.en: Both nations signed a historic treaty to reduce carbon emissions significantly.
examples.zh: 两国签署了一份大幅减少碳排放的历史性条约。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 tractare（商讨、处理），经法文传入，专指国家间经过商谈达成的“正式条约”。

lemmas.def_en: continuing in time or space without interruption; - James Jeans
lemmas.def_zh: 连续的, 继续的, 连续不断的

examples.en: The continuous rain disrupted our travel plans for the entire long weekend.
examples.zh: 连绵不断的雨打乱了我们整个长假的旅行计划。

lemmas.def_en: at every point
lemmas.def_zh: 不断地, 连续地

examples.en: The machine operates continuously day and night to meet the high production demand.
examples.zh: 该机器日夜不停地运转，以满足高产量的需求。

lemmas.def_en: uninterrupted connection or union
lemmas.def_zh: 连续性；连贯性；持续

examples.en: The company needs leadership continuity to successfully complete the merger.
examples.zh: 公司需要领导层的连续性以顺利完成并购。

lemmas.def_zh: 连续统一体, 连续统, 闭联集
lemmas.def_en: a continuous nonspatial whole or extent or succession in which no part or portion is distinct or distinguishable from adjacent parts

examples.en: Mental health should be viewed as a broad continuum rather than a simple label.
examples.zh: 心理健康应该被视为一个广泛的连续体，而不是简单的标签。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 con-（共同）+ tenere（保持），表示连接在一起、中途无停顿的连续状态。
family_guide.core_distinction: continuous 强调无间断的连续；continual 则侧重频频发生但有间隔的重复。

lemmas.def_en: beyond what is ordinary or usual; highly unusual or exceptional or remarkable
lemmas.def_zh: 非常的, 特别的, 非凡的

examples.en: She showed extraordinary courage by speaking out against injustice during the meeting.
examples.zh: 在会议上公开反对不公，表现出了她非凡的勇气。

lemmas.def_en: extremely
lemmas.def_zh: 非凡, 破例, 特别, 非常, 离奇, 使人惊奇, 惊人, 特命, 特派

examples.en: The young pianist delivered an extraordinarily moving performance that impressed everyone present.
examples.zh: 这位年轻的钢琴家带来了极其动人的演奏，打动了在场的每一个人。

family_guide.root_logic: 由 extra-（超出）+ ordinary（寻常的）构成，字面即“超越寻常”，表示极其非凡的。

lemmas.def_en: the liquid part that can be extracted from plant or animal tissue by squeezing or cooking
lemmas.def_zh: 汁, 活力, 体液

examples.en: Drinking fresh orange juice every morning gives him a boost of healthy energy.
examples.zh: 每天早晨喝新鲜橙汁能让他充满健康的活力。

lemmas.def_zh: 多汁, 有趣
lemmas.def_en: a juicy appetizingness

lemmas.def_zh: 多汁液的, 生动的, 多水分的
lemmas.def_en: full of juice

examples.en: She picked a fresh, juicy peach directly from the sunny backyard tree.
examples.zh: 她直接从阳光明媚的后院树上摘下了一只新鲜多汁的桃子。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 ius（肉汤、汁液），指植物果实压榨出的汁水或事物的本质、能量。

lemmas.def_en: ludicrous, foolish
lemmas.def_zh: 愚蠢的, 糊涂的

examples.en: Don't worry about making silly mistakes while learning a brand new foreign language.
examples.zh: 在学习一门全新的外语时，别担心犯愚蠢的错误。

lemmas.def_en: a ludicrous folly
lemmas.def_zh: 愚蠢, 糊涂

examples.en: The children's harmless silliness brought much-needed laughter into the quiet living room.
examples.zh: 孩子们无伤大雅的傻闹为安静的客厅带来了急需的笑声。

family_guide.root_logic: 语义经历戏剧性演变：古英语中本义为“幸运的、被祝福的”，后演变为“无辜的/幼稚的”，最终定格为“愚蠢的”。

lemmas.def_en: make a compromise; arrive at a compromise
lemmas.def_zh: 妥协处理；危害

examples.en: After hours of intense debate, both sides finally agreed on a fair compromise.
examples.zh: 经过数小时激烈的辩论，双方最终达成了一项公平的妥协。

lemmas.def_en: a middle way between two extremes
lemmas.def_zh: 妥协, 折中, 折中方案, 和解

examples.en: After hours of intense debate, both sides finally agreed on a fair compromise.
examples.zh: 经过数小时激烈的辩论，双方最终达成了一项公平的妥协。

lemmas.def_en: not making concessions
lemmas.def_zh: 不让步的, 不妥协的, 坚定的

examples.en: Her uncompromising attitude toward work quality earned her deep respect from all colleagues.
examples.zh: 她对工作质量毫不妥协的态度赢得了所有同事的深深敬意。

lemmas.def_en: in an uncompromising manner
lemmas.def_zh: 坚决地, 不妥协地

examples.en: The director remained uncompromisingly honest when delivering feedback to the struggling actor.
examples.zh: 这位导演在向苦苦挣扎的演员提供反馈时，始终保持极其坦诚。

family_guide.root_logic: 由 com-（共同）+ promise（承诺），原指双方共同承诺遵从仲裁，引申为“互相让步以和解”，进一步引申为“妥协导致的损害”。

lemmas.def_en: the process of combustion of inflammable materials producing heat and light and (often) smoke
lemmas.def_zh: 火焰, 火舌, 热情, 光辉

examples.en: A tiny flickering flame illuminated the dark corners of the ancient stone cellar.
examples.zh: 微弱摇曳的火焰照亮了古老石窖的阴暗角落。

lemmas.def_en: shine with a sudden light
lemmas.def_zh: 焚烧, 用火焰给...灭菌, 用火焰传送(信号), 点燃, 激动；燃烧, 爆发, 闪耀

examples.en: A tiny flickering flame illuminated the dark corners of the ancient stone cellar.
examples.zh: 微弱摇曳的火焰照亮了古老石窖的阴暗角落。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 flamma（火焰），指肉眼可见的火舌，常比喻强烈的激情或网络攻击言论。

lemmas.def_en: the person who plays that position on a football team

examples.zh: 新经理决定在本月立即着手解决公司的财务困境。

lemmas.def_en: a football player who tackles the ball carrier
lemmas.def_zh: 做抓和揪动作的人

examples.en: The opposing tackler brought down the fast runner right before the final goal line.
examples.zh: 对方的阻截队员在终点球线前及时扑倒了那名飞毛腿跑者。

lemmas.def_en: accept as a challenge
lemmas.def_zh: 固定, 处理, 抓住；扭倒

examples.en: The new manager decided to tackle the company's financial difficulties immediately this month.
examples.zh: 新经理决定在本月立即着手解决公司的财务困境。

lemmas.def_en: be composed of
lemmas.def_zh: 包含；由……组成

examples.en: The committee comprises ten members from diverse backgrounds.
examples.zh: 该委员会由来自不同背景的十名成员组成。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自法语 comprendre（包含），核心语义为‘包含、由……组成’。

lemmas.def_en: get or gather together
lemmas.def_zh: 汇编，编译

examples.en: We need to compile all the sales data before the meeting.
examples.zh: 我们需要在会议前把所有的销售数据汇编起来。

lemmas.def_en: something that is compiled (as into a single book or file)
lemmas.def_zh: 汇编物，精选辑

examples.en: Her latest album is a compilation of her greatest hits.
examples.zh: 她的最新专辑是其最畅销金曲的精选辑。

lemmas.def_en: a person who compiles information (as for reference purposes)
lemmas.def_zh: 编辑者

examples.en: The software developer updated the system compiler to enhance overall code execution efficiency.
examples.zh: 软件开发人员更新了系统编译器，以提高整体代码的执行效率。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 compilare（搜集、掠夺），核心逻辑是‘将分散的资料汇集在一起整理成册’。

lemmas.def_en: make a mess of, destroy or ruin
lemmas.def_zh: 破坏；溺爱；变质

examples.en: Rain threatened to spoil the outdoor wedding.
examples.zh: 阴雨天气有可能会破坏这场室外婚礼。

lemmas.def_en: make a mess of, destroy or ruin
lemmas.def_zh: （spoil的过去式/过去分词）宠坏的，变质的

examples.en: He behaves like a spoilt child whenever he doesn't get his way.
examples.zh: 只要不顺心，他的表现就宛如一个被宠坏的孩子。

lemmas.def_en: a candidate with no chance of winning but who may draw enough votes to prevent one of the leading candidates from winning
lemmas.def_zh: 剧透；扰流板

examples.en: Be careful not to include any spoilers in your movie review.
examples.zh: 注意不要在你的影评中包含任何剧透。

lemmas.def_en: the amount that has spoiled
lemmas.def_zh: 变质, 糟蹋, 损耗, 损坏

examples.en: Proper food refrigeration helps prevent rapid bacterial spoilage and extends fresh shelf life.
examples.zh: 适当冷藏食物有助于防止细菌快速变质并延长保鲜期。

lemmas.def_zh: 强夺, 掠夺, 毁灭文件
lemmas.def_en: (law) the intentional destruction of a document or an alteration of it that destroys its value as evidence

examples.en: The lawyer accused the defense of deliberate spoliation of crucial digital evidence.
examples.zh: 律师指控辩方故意销毁了至关重要的电子证据。

lemmas.def_en: not left to spoil
lemmas.def_zh: 未损坏的；未宠坏的

examples.en: Tourists fell in love with the remote island's completely unspoiled natural beaches.
examples.zh: 游客们爱上了这座偏远岛屿完全未受破坏的天然海滩。

lemmas.def_en: not left to spoil
lemmas.def_zh: 未受损害的, 未受破坏的, 未宠坏的

examples.en: The quaint mountain village remains wonderfully unspoilt despite the recent influx of visitors.
examples.zh: 尽管最近游客大量涌入，这座古朴的山村依然保持着绝佳的原貌。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 spoliare（掠夺、剥夺），引申为‘破坏完整性’或‘因过分溺爱而毁坏性格’。
family_guide.core_distinction: spoilt 多用作过去式/分词或形容词（被宠坏的）；spoiler 常指剧透或汽车扰流板。

lemmas.def_en: clear or deep perception of a situation
lemmas.def_zh: 洞察力；深刻见解

examples.en: The book offers a fascinating insight into human psychology.
examples.zh: 这本书对人类心理学提供了深刻而引人入胜的见解。

lemmas.def_en: shrewdness shown by keen insight
lemmas.def_zh: insightful的变形

examples.en: Her remarkable insightfulness allowed her to spot hidden market trends well before competitors.
examples.zh: 她非凡的洞察力使她能够早于竞争对手发现隐藏的市场趋势。

lemmas.def_en: exhibiting insight or clear and deep perception; ; -R.C.Angell
lemmas.def_zh: 有深刻见解的, 富有洞察力的

examples.en: The professor gave an insightful lecture on how artificial intelligence shapes modern economics.
examples.zh: 教授就人工智能如何塑造现代经济做了一场见解深刻的讲座。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 in-（向内）+ sight（视力、眼光），核心语义指‘看透事物内部本质的能力’。

lemmas.def_en: of or associated with or requiring the use of the mind
lemmas.def_zh: 智力的, 用脑力的, 聪明的

examples.en: Chess is an intellectual game that requires deep concentration and strategic thinking.
examples.zh: 国际象棋是一项需要高度专注和战略思维的脑力游戏。

lemmas.def_en: a person who uses the mind creatively
lemmas.def_zh: 有知识者, 知识分子, 凭理智做事者

examples.en: Chess is an intellectual game that requires deep concentration and strategic thinking.
examples.zh: 国际象棋是一项需要高度专注和战略思维的脑力游戏。

lemmas.def_zh: 智力, 出众的才华, 知识分子
lemmas.def_en: knowledge and intellectual ability

examples.en: Her sharp intellect allowed her to solve complex scientific puzzles with ease.
examples.zh: 她敏锐的智力使她能轻松解开复杂的科学难题。

lemmas.def_en: in an intellectual manner
lemmas.def_zh: 智力上；知性上；理智地

examples.en: She found the university lecture intellectually stimulating and engaged in lively debate.
examples.zh: 她觉得大学的讲座在知性上很有启发性，并参与了热烈讨论。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 intellegere（理解、领悟），指与‘纯粹智力、理性思考’相关。

lemmas.def_en: move through by or as by digging
lemmas.def_zh: 掘隧道，穿过

examples.en: Workers had to tunnel through solid rock to build the highway.
examples.zh: 工人们不得不凿穿坚硬的岩石以修建这条公路。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古法语 tonnelle（圆桶），因早期地下通道形状像桶而引申为‘地道’及‘掘地道’。

lemmas.def_en: a partiality that prevents objective consideration of an issue or situation
lemmas.def_zh: 偏见, 斜纹

examples.en: The investigator tried not to let personal bias influence his final decision.
examples.zh: 调查人员尽量不让个人偏见影响他的最终决定。

lemmas.def_en: influence in an unfair way
lemmas.def_zh: 使有偏见

examples.en: The investigator tried not to let personal bias influence his final decision.
examples.zh: 调查人员尽量不让个人偏见影响他的最终决定。

lemmas.def_en: characterized by a lack of partiality
lemmas.def_zh: 没有偏见的

examples.en: A judge must remain completely unbiased while listening to both sides of the case.
examples.zh: 法官在倾听案情双方陈述时必须保持完全公正。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古法语 biais（倾斜的），本指滚球运动中的偏重，引申为‘认知上的偏向或偏见’。

lemmas.def_en: a quality of spirit that enables you to face danger or pain without showing fear
lemmas.def_zh: 勇气，胆量

examples.en: It takes courage to speak out against injustice.
examples.zh: 站出来反对不公需要巨大的勇气。

lemmas.def_en: a quality of spirit that enables you to face danger or pain without showing fear
lemmas.def_zh: 勇敢, 无畏

examples.en: The firefighter was awarded a medal for his incredible courageousness during the rescue.
examples.zh: 该消防员因在救援中表现出的非凡勇敢而被授予奖章。

lemmas.def_en: possessing or displaying courage; able to face and deal with danger or fear without flinching; - Herman Melville; - William Wordsworth
lemmas.def_zh: 勇敢的，无畏的

examples.en: The firefighters made a courageous attempt to rescue the trapped family.
examples.zh: 消防员们做出了英勇的尝试去营救被困的一家人。

lemmas.def_en: in a courageous manner
lemmas.def_zh: 勇敢地

examples.en: She courageously spoke out against corruption despite facing threats from her colleagues.
examples.zh: 尽管面临同事的威胁，她依然勇敢地公开反对腐败。

family_guide.root_logic: 词根 cour- 源自拉丁语 cor（心），核心逻辑是以‘心之力’面对危险或恐惧。

lemmas.def_en: a person who cares for persons or property
lemmas.def_zh: 监护人；保护者

examples.en: Her aunt was appointed as her legal guardian after her parents died.
examples.zh: 父母去世后，她的姑姑被指定为她的法定监护人。

lemmas.def_en: attention and management implying responsibility for safety
lemmas.def_zh: 监护, 保护, 守护

examples.en: The aunt was granted legal guardianship of the children after their parents died.
examples.zh: 父母去世后，姑姑获得了这些孩子的法定监护权。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古法语 guarder（保护、看守）加人称后缀 -ian，核心语义指‘行使看护职责的人’。

lemmas.def_en: an edible tuber native to South America; a staple food of Ireland
lemmas.def_zh: 马铃薯，土豆

examples.en: Potatoes are a staple food in many Western diets.
examples.zh: 土豆是许多西方饮食中的主食。

family_guide.root_logic: 借自泰诺语 batata（甘薯），后传入欧洲专指‘马铃薯’。

lemmas.def_en: the head of the Roman Catholic Church
lemmas.def_zh: 罗马教皇，教宗

examples.en: Thousands of pilgrims gathered in Rome to see the Pope.
examples.zh: 数千名朝圣者聚集在罗马觐见教皇。

lemmas.def_zh: 罗马教皇的, 教皇制度的
lemmas.def_en: proceeding from or ordered by or subject to a pope or the papacy regarded as the successor of the Apostles

examples.en: Thousands of pilgrims gathered in Rome to hear the annual papal address.
examples.zh: 成千上万的朝圣者齐聚罗马聆听教皇的年度演讲。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 pappas（父亲的儿语称呼），演变为天主教对教皇的尊称。

lemmas.def_en: a regular payment to a person that is intended to allow them to subsist without working
lemmas.def_zh: 养老金, 退休金, 津贴, 年金, 抚恤金, 膳宿学校, 膳宿费

examples.en: He relies on a modest monthly pension to cover his basic living expenses.
examples.zh: 他依靠微薄的月度养老金来支付基本生活费用。

lemmas.def_en: the beneficiary of a pension fund
lemmas.def_zh: 领取抚恤金者, (英国剑桥大学的)自费生, 为金钱所收买的人, 帮佣

examples.en: Every Tuesday, the local cinema offers discounted movie tickets for every pensioner.
examples.zh: 每周二，当地电影院都会为所有领取养老金者提供特价电影票。

lemmas.def_en: the beneficiary of a pension fund

examples.en: Every registered pensionary receives a monthly stipend from the company's retirement trust fund.
examples.zh: 每位登记在册的养老金领取者每月都会从公司的退休信托基金中收到一笔津贴。

lemmas.def_en: grant a pension to
lemmas.def_zh: 发给退休金, 用津贴拉拢

examples.en: He relies on a modest monthly pension to cover his basic living expenses.
examples.zh: 他依靠微薄的月度养老金来支付基本生活费用。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 pendere（称重、支付），原指定期付款，现专指‘退休养老金’。

lemmas.def_en: a slight indication
lemmas.def_zh: 线索, 暗示

examples.en: The detective found a vital clue hidden beneath the dusty wooden floorboards.
examples.zh: 侦探在布满灰尘的木质地板下发现了一条关键线索。

lemmas.def_en: roll into a ball
lemmas.def_zh: 暗示, 提供线索

examples.en: The detective found a vital clue hidden beneath the dusty wooden floorboards.
examples.zh: 侦探在布满灰尘的木质地板下发现了一条关键线索。

lemmas.def_en: totally uninformed about what is going on; not having even a clue from which to infer what is occurring
lemmas.def_zh: 一无所知的，愚蠢的

examples.en: He was completely clueless about how to operate the machinery.
examples.zh: 他对于如何操作这台机器完全一窍不通。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 cleowen（线团），原指忒修斯迷宫依靠线团脱困，引申为‘破案或解题的线索’。

lemmas.def_en: not anywhere; in or at or to no place
lemmas.def_zh: 无处, 到处都无

examples.en: I searched the entire house, but my missing car keys were nowhere to be found.
examples.zh: 我找遍了整个屋子，但到处都找不到我遗失的车钥匙。

lemmas.def_en: an insignificant place

examples.en: I searched the entire house, but my missing car keys were nowhere to be found.
examples.zh: 我找遍了整个屋子，但到处都找不到我遗失的车钥匙。

family_guide.root_logic: 复合词 no（无）+ where（地点），核心逻辑为‘任何地方都不存在’。

lemmas.def_en: take part in a rebellion; renounce a former allegiance
lemmas.def_zh: 造反, 反抗, 抵抗, 反感

examples.en: Teenagers often rebel against strict parental rules in search of greater independence.
examples.zh: 青少年常常反抗父母的严格规矩以寻求更大的独立性。

lemmas.def_en: `Johnny' was applied as a nickname for Confederate soldiers by the Federal soldiers in the American Civil War; `greyback' derived from their grey Confederate uniforms
lemmas.def_zh: 叛徒, 反叛者

examples.en: Teenagers often rebel against strict parental rules in search of greater independence.
examples.zh: 青少年常常反抗父母的严格规矩以寻求更大的独立性。

lemmas.def_en: refusal to accept some authority or code or convention
lemmas.def_zh: 叛乱；反抗；反叛

examples.en: The army quickly crushed the rebellion in the southern province.
examples.zh: 军队迅速平息了南部省份的叛乱。

lemmas.def_zh: 造反, 难以控制
lemmas.def_en: intentionally contemptuous behavior or attitude

lemmas.def_zh: 造反的, 反抗的
lemmas.def_en: resisting control or authority

examples.en: Her rebellious attitude often caused unnecessary conflict with teachers during high school.
examples.zh: 读高中时，她叛逆的态度经常引发与老师之间不必要的冲突。

lemmas.def_zh: 造反地, 难以控制地
lemmas.def_en: in a rebellious manner

examples.en: he rejected her words rebelliously

family_guide.root_logic: 以 rebel 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a living organism characterized by voluntary movement
lemmas.def_zh: n. 野兽，牲畜；残忍/野蛮的人；(俚)极厉害的人或物

examples.en: The new off-road truck is an absolute beast on rough terrain.
examples.zh: 这辆新越野卡车在崎岖地形上绝对是个庞然大物。珍兽一般的存在。/性能极其强悍。

lemmas.def_zh: 兽性, 兽行, 兽欲
lemmas.def_en: the stupid brutal quality of a beast
the quality of being deliberately mean
lemmas.def_zh: 兽性, 酩酊大醉, 贪食, 粗鲁, 淫猥, 残暴

examples.en: The documentary exposed the utter beastliness of conditions inside the illegal puppy mill.
examples.zh: 这部纪录片揭露了非法幼犬繁殖场内部令人发指的恶劣状况。

lemmas.def_en: very unpleasant
lemmas.def_zh: 野兽的, 残忍的, 令人厌憎的

examples.en: We had to cancel the outdoor picnic due to the beastly cold weather yesterday.
examples.zh: 由于昨天糟糕透顶的寒冷天气，我们不得不取消户外野餐。

lemmas.def_zh: 似野兽的, 残忍的, 卑劣的
lemmas.def_en: resembling a beast; showing lack of human sensibility

examples.en: The prisoners were subjected to bestial conditions that violated basic human dignity.
examples.zh: 囚犯们遭受了践踏基本人类尊严的残忍待遇。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古法语 beste 及拉丁语 bestia，指与人类（理智、文明）相对的“野兽、牲畜”，引申为残暴野蛮之人，现代俚语中常指某方面的顶尖能手或庞然大物。

lemmas.def_en: of or located in the lower part of a town, or in the business center
lemmas.def_zh: 市中心的

examples.en: She bought an apartment in the downtown area to shorten her daily commute.
examples.zh: 她在市中心区买了一套公寓，以缩短每天的通勤时间。

lemmas.def_en: the central area or commercial center of a town or city
lemmas.def_zh: 市中心区

examples.en: She bought an apartment in the downtown area to shorten her daily commute.
examples.zh: 她在市中心区买了一套公寓，以缩短每天的通勤时间。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 downtown 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a form of football played with an oval ball
lemmas.def_zh: n. 橄榄球运动，拉格比足球

examples.en: He suffered a serious shoulder injury during a rugby match.
examples.zh: 他在一场橄榄球比赛中肩部严重受伤。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自英格兰沃里克郡的拉格比公学（Rugby School），该校被认为是现代橄榄球运动的发源地。

lemmas.def_en: hit hard
lemmas.def_zh: 打碎, 粉碎, 击溃, 使破产, 使裂变, 使用假硬币；碎裂, 猛撞, 破产, 扣球, 杀球

examples.en: The clumsy waiter accidentally dropped the tray and smashed several wine glasses.
examples.zh: 笨拙的服务员不小心滑落托盘，摔碎了几个酒杯。

lemmas.def_en: a vigorous blow
lemmas.def_zh: 打碎, 粉碎, 打碎时哗啦声, 猛击, 扣球, 杀球, 经营失败, 破产, 硬币, 假硬币

examples.en: The clumsy waiter accidentally dropped the tray and smashed several wine glasses.
examples.zh: 笨拙的服务员不小心滑落托盘，摔碎了几个酒杯。

lemmas.def_en: a person who smashes something
lemmas.def_zh: 打碎者, 善于叩球者, 摔跟头, (非正式)出色的人, 使用假钞票者, 收买脏物者

examples.en: Her latest novel turned out to be an absolute smasher among young readers.
examples.zh: 她的最新小说在年轻读者中被证明是一部极大的杰作。

lemmas.def_en: with a loud crash
lemmas.def_zh: 极好地

examples.en: The charity gala went smashingly and raised thousands of dollars for the hospital.
examples.zh: 慈善晚会举办得极其成功，为医院筹集了数千美元。

lemmas.def_zh: adj. 极好的；棒极了的
lemmas.def_en: extremely good, impressive, or attractive
lemmas.usage_note: 主要为英式口语用法，常用于赞美派对、时间或外表，如 a smashing time / idea。

examples.en: We had a smashing holiday in the south of France.
examples.zh: 我们在法国南部度过了一个棒极了的假期。

family_guide.root_logic: 拟声词，模拟物体猛烈撞击或破碎的声音，核心意象为“粉碎、猛烈撞击、大获成功”。

lemmas.def_en: let for money
lemmas.def_zh: 出租, 租出, 租得

examples.en: They decided to lease a small office in the city center for their startup.
examples.zh: 他们决定在市中心租一间小办公室用于创业。

lemmas.def_zh: 承租人, 租地人, 租屋人
lemmas.def_en: a tenant who holds a lease

examples.en: The lessee agreed to pay the rent on the first day of every month.
examples.zh: 承租人同意在每月第一天支付租金。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 lease 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: terminate before completion
lemmas.def_zh: 使流产；中途终止，夭折

examples.en: The pilot decided to abort the mission due to severe weather conditions.
examples.zh: 由于恶劣的天气条件，飞行员决定中止任务。

lemmas.def_en: termination of pregnancy
lemmas.def_zh: 人工流产，堕胎；（计划等的）失败

examples.en: The government introduced new legislation to expand access to safe abortion services.
examples.zh: 政府出台了新法规，以扩大获得安全堕胎服务的途径。

lemmas.def_en: a person (who should be a doctor) who terminates pregnancies
lemmas.def_zh: 为人堕胎者

examples.en: Historical records describe the secretive practices of the nineteenth-century abortionist.
examples.zh: 历史记录描述了十九世纪堕胎者的秘密行医经历。

lemmas.def_en: failing to accomplish an intended result
lemmas.def_zh: 流产的, 堕胎的, 失败的

examples.en: After an abortive attempt to climb the peak, the team retreated to camp.
examples.zh: 在一次登顶失败后，探险队退回了营地。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 abortare（早产、流产），核心语义为‘在发育或完成前异常中止’，引申为使计划或行动中途夭折。
family_guide.core_distinction: abort 是动词，既指生理流产也广泛用于航天、军事或计算机中‘中止计划/任务’；abortion 是名词，现代主要特指医学上的‘人工流产’，作‘计划失败/落空’解已较少见。

lemmas.def_en: a room or building equipped with one or more toilets
lemmas.def_zh: 坐便器；洗手间，厕所；梳妆（旧）

examples.en: Excuse me, could you tell me where the toilet is?
examples.zh: 打扰一下，请问洗手间在哪里？

family_guide.root_logic: 源自法语 toile（布料），原指梳妆用的小布，后引申为梳妆打扮，最终具体化为洗手间及坐便器。

lemmas.def_en: cause to arise
lemmas.def_zh: v. 引诱；引起，导致；催产

examples.en: Nothing could induce me to undertake such a risky venture again.
examples.zh: 没有什么能诱使我再次冒这样的险。

lemmas.def_zh: 引导, 使入门, 引入, 使就职
lemmas.def_en: place ceremoniously or formally in an office or position

examples.en: The prestigious sports committee decided to induct the legendary coach into the hall of fame.
examples.zh: 著名的体育委员会决定接纳这位传奇教练进入名人堂。

lemmas.def_en: a formal entry into an organization or position or office
lemmas.def_zh: n. 就职仪式；入职培训；归纳法；催产；感应（现象）

examples.en: New employees are required to attend a two-day induction course.
examples.zh: 新员工必须参加为期两天的入职培训课程。

lemmas.def_en: a positive motivational influence
lemmas.def_zh: 诱因, 动机, 吸引力, 刺激物

examples.en: The company offered a generous signing bonus as an inducement to new recruits.
examples.zh: 公司提供了丰厚的签约奖金以吸引新员工。

lemmas.def_zh: 应召入伍的士兵
lemmas.def_en: a person inducted into an organization or social group

examples.en: Ty Cobb and Babe Ruth were 1936 inductees in the National Baseball Hall of Fame

lemmas.def_en: an agent capable of activating specific genes
lemmas.def_zh: 引诱者, 诱导物

examples.en: Scientists identified the specific chemical inducer that triggers cell division in the plant.
examples.zh: 科学家确定了触发植物细胞分裂的特定化学诱导物。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 inducere（in- 向内，引向 + ducere 引导），核心逻辑是“引进来、导向某种状态”，引申为引诱、诱导以及因果上的引起或归纳。

lemmas.def_en: you advance to the next round in a tournament without playing an opponent
lemmas.def_zh: interj. 再会, 回头见

examples.en: She waved and said bye before rushing to catch the morning train.
examples.zh: 在匆忙赶早班火车前，她挥手说了声再见。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bye 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an evil supernatural being
lemmas.def_zh: n. 恶魔，魔鬼；精力过人的人；心魔

examples.en: He spent years trying to conquer the personal demons that drove him to drink.
examples.zh: 他花了好几年时间试图战胜导致他酗酒的内心心魔。

lemmas.def_en: to represent as diabolically evil
lemmas.def_zh: 妖魔化

examples.en: The persistent demonization of the opposition party damaged the peace talks.
examples.zh: 对反对党的持续妖魔化破坏了和谈。

lemmas.def_en: extremely evil or cruel; expressive of cruelty or befitting hell
lemmas.def_zh: 恶魔的, 有魔力的

examples.en: The actor wore a demonic mask that terrified everyone in the audience.
examples.zh: 演员戴着一副恶魔面具，吓坏了在场的所有观众。

lemmas.def_en: make into a demon
lemmas.def_zh: 使成为魔鬼

examples.en: It is completely unfair to demonize an entire community for a single incident.
examples.zh: 仅仅因为单一一件事就妖魔化整个群体是极其不公的。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 daimon（神灵、守护神），在基督教语境中演变为“恶魔、邪灵”，引申为极具破坏力的人、事物或内心的心魔。

lemmas.def_en: cause friction
lemmas.def_zh: 搔, 抓, 挖出, 擦, 刮, 乱涂, 勾抹掉；搔, 抓, 发刮擦声, 勉强糊口

examples.en: The cat began to scratch at the wooden door to be let inside.
examples.zh: 那只猫开始抓木门，想要进屋。

lemmas.def_en: causing abrasion
lemmas.def_zh: 潦草的, 刺痛的, 发痒的, 凑合的, 发擦刮声的, 乖戾的

examples.en: This cheap wool sweater feels horribly scratchy against my bare skin.
examples.zh: 这件廉价的羊毛衫贴着我裸露的皮肤，感觉刺痒难受。

lemmas.def_en: a workman who uses a tool for scratching
lemmas.def_zh: 抓扒者, 抓扒工具

examples.en: He bought a wooden back scratcher to reach the itchy spot on his spine.
examples.zh: 他买了一个木制挠背扒，用来挠脊柱上发痒的地方。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 scratch 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: draw someone's attention away from something
lemmas.def_zh: 分散（注意力）；使分心

examples.en: Don't let minor details distract you from your main goal.
examples.zh: 不要让细枝末节分散你对主要目标的注意力。

lemmas.def_en: mental turmoil
lemmas.def_zh: 分散注意力的事物；分心；娱乐消遣

examples.en: Turn off your phone to avoid unnecessary distractions while studying.
examples.zh: 学习时把手机关掉，以避免不必要的干扰。

lemmas.def_en: in a distracted manner
lemmas.def_zh: 心烦意乱地

examples.en: She stirred her lukewarm coffee distractedly while staring out the foggy window.
examples.zh: 她一边心烦意乱地搅动着温咖啡，一边凝视着起雾的窗外。

lemmas.def_zh: adj. 心神不定的；分心的
lemmas.def_en: unable to concentrate because your attention is diverted
lemmas.usage_note: 多用作表语或前置定语，描述由于焦虑或外界干扰导致精神不集中。

examples.en: He gave a distracted nod, his eyes still fixed on the screen.
examples.zh: 他心不在焉地点了点头，眼睛仍盯着屏幕。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 dis-（分离开）+ trahere（拉），核心逻辑为“把注意力或心思从某处拉开”。

lemmas.def_en: be of different opinions
lemmas.def_zh: v. 不同意，持不同意见；不符，不一致

examples.en: I strongly disagree with the decision to cut the department's budget.
examples.zh: 我强烈反对削减该部门预算的决定。

lemmas.def_en: a conflict of people's opinions or actions or characters
lemmas.def_zh: n. 意见不合，分歧；争论；不一致

examples.en: There is widespread disagreement among experts about the long-term effects of the policy.
examples.zh: 专家们对该政策的长期影响存在广泛分歧。

family_guide.root_logic: 由否定前缀 dis-（不，相反）和 agree（同意，一致）构成，核心逻辑为“意见或看法不一致”。

lemmas.def_en: oppose, as in hostility or a competition
lemmas.def_zh: v. 面对，正视；与……对质

examples.en: She decided to confront her fears and speak in public.
examples.zh: 她决定勇敢面对内心的恐惧，公开发表讲话。

lemmas.def_en: a bold challenge
lemmas.def_zh: n. 对抗，冲突；正面对质

examples.en: Diplomats are trying to avoid a military confrontation between the two nations.
examples.zh: 外交官们正努力避免两国之间发生军事冲突。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to confrontation
lemmas.def_zh: 挑衅的; 对抗的

examples.en: His confrontational style of communication often alienates his colleagues during meetings.
examples.zh: 他在会议中那具有挑衅性的沟通风格常常疏远同事。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 front-（前额、脸面），前缀 con-（共同，引申为相对），核心逻辑是“迎面相对”，引申为勇敢面对或正面对抗。

lemmas.def_en: send out rays or waves
lemmas.def_zh: 辐射；散发；流露

examples.en: The sun radiates heat and light to the Earth.
examples.zh: 太阳向地球辐射热量和光线。

lemmas.def_en: energy that is radiated or transmitted in the form of rays or waves or particles
lemmas.def_zh: 辐射；放射线

examples.en: He received radiation therapy for cancer.
examples.zh: 他接受了癌症放射治疗。

lemmas.def_en: any object that radiates energy
lemmas.def_zh: 暖气装置, 散热器, 辐射体

examples.en: He placed his damp gloves on the radiator to dry after coming indoors.
examples.zh: 进屋后，他把潮湿的手套放在暖气片上烘干。

lemmas.def_zh: 光辉, 发光, 容光焕发
lemmas.def_en: the amount of electromagnetic radiation leaving or arriving at a point on a surface

examples.en: The bride smiled happily, her face glowing with unmistakable beauty and genuine radiance.
examples.zh: 新娘幸福地微笑着，脸上洋溢着显而易见的美丽与真挚的光彩。

lemmas.def_zh: 发光的, 明亮的, 辐射的, 容光焕发的
lemmas.def_en: radiating or as if radiating light

examples.zh: 该提案获得了董事会的压倒性通过。

lemmas.def_en: a keyboard instrument that is played by depressing keys that cause hammers to strike tuned strings and produce sounds

lemmas.def_en: a person who plays the piano
lemmas.def_zh: 钢琴家, 钢琴演奏者

examples.en: The talented pianist received a standing ovation after performing the challenging classical piece flawlessly.
examples.zh: 这位才华横溢的钢琴家在完美演奏了那首高难度古典乐曲后，赢得了全场起立鼓掌。

lemmas.def_zh: 钢琴的; 钢琴家的; 擅长弹奏钢琴的

family_guide.root_logic: 源自意大利语 pianoforte，简写为 piano（轻柔的），因其能弹奏出轻柔强弱分明的音响而得名。

lemmas.def_zh: adj. 使人致残的；使丧失能力的

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 fraus（欺骗、伤害），指通过欺诈手段获取利益的非法行为或骗子。

lemmas.def_en: give an injection to
lemmas.def_zh: 注射；注入，引入

examples.en: The government plans to inject billions into the struggling economy.
examples.zh: 政府计划向陷入困境的经济注入数十亿资金。

lemmas.def_en: the forceful insertion of a substance under pressure
lemmas.def_zh: 注射；注射剂；充值投入

examples.en: The patient was given a painkilling injection before the operation.
examples.zh: 病人在手术前被打了一针止痛剂。

lemmas.def_en: a contrivance for injecting (e.g., water into the boiler of a steam engine or particles into an accelerator etc.)
lemmas.def_zh: 注射者, 注射器, 注水器

examples.en: The mechanic carefully cleaned the fuel injector to restore the engine's original performance.
examples.zh: 技工仔细清理了燃油喷射器，以恢复发动机原本的性能。

lemmas.def_en: (used of drugs) capable of being injected
lemmas.def_zh: [医] 可注射的

examples.en: The clinic keeps a large supply of injectable vaccines stored securely in the refrigerator.
examples.zh: 该诊所将大量可注射疫苗安全地存放在冰箱中备用。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 in-（进入）+ ject（扔、投掷），即把液体推入体内，核心为注射、注入。
family_guide.core_distinction: inject 为动词动作，injection 为名词注射行为或针剂。

lemmas.def_en: (law) a gift of personal property by will
lemmas.def_zh: 遗产，遗留物

examples.en: The ancient ruins are part of the cultural legacy of the civilization.
examples.zh: 这些古代遗址是该文明文化遗产的一部分。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 legare（以遗嘱委派），核心指前人留传下来的有形财产或无形影响。

lemmas.def_en: make strong or stronger
lemmas.def_zh: 加强，增强，巩固

examples.en: Regular exercise can significantly strengthen your immune system.
examples.zh: 规律的锻炼可以显著增强你的免疫系统。

lemmas.def_en: a device designed to provide additional strength
lemmas.def_zh: 助力器

examples.en: She applied a liquid nail strengthener daily to repair her weak and brittle nails.
examples.zh: 她每天涂抹液体指甲强化剂，以修复脆弱易断的指甲。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自 strength（力量）+ -en（使变得），即增强力量或巩固关系。

lemmas.def_en: put in the place of another; switch seemingly equivalent items
lemmas.def_zh: 代替；替代, 取代, 代用

examples.en: A substitute teacher took over the advanced mathematics class while Mrs. Davis was ill.
examples.zh: 在戴维斯老师生病期间，一名代课老师接管了高等数学课。

lemmas.def_en: a person or thing that takes or can take the place of another
lemmas.def_zh: 代理, 代理人, 代用品, 代替者, 代替物

examples.en: A substitute teacher took over the advanced mathematics class while Mrs. Davis was ill.
examples.zh: 在戴维斯老师生病期间，一名代课老师接管了高等数学课。

lemmas.def_en: an event in which one thing is substituted for another
lemmas.def_zh: 代替, 替换, 代替物

examples.en: The coach made a tactical substitution during the second half to protect their lead.
examples.zh: 教练在下半场进行了战术性换人，以保住他们的领先优势。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 sub-（在下面、代替）+ stitut（站立、放置），即站在替代的位置上。

lemmas.def_en: feel admiration for
lemmas.def_zh: 钦佩，欣赏，赞美

examples.en: I truly admire her dedication to helping homeless children.
examples.zh: 我由衷敬佩她帮助流浪儿童的奉献精神。

lemmas.def_en: a feeling of delighted approval and liking
lemmas.def_zh: 钦佩，赞赏

examples.en: He looked at the masterpiece with undeniable admiration.
examples.zh: 他满怀由衷的赞叹注视着那幅杰作。

lemmas.def_en: a person who backs a politician or a team etc.
lemmas.def_zh: 钦佩者, 仰慕者, 求爱者

examples.en: She received a beautiful bouquet of roses from an anonymous admirer.
examples.zh: 她收到了一位匿名仰慕者送来的漂亮玫瑰花束。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 ad-（去、朝向）+ mire（惊奇），原指惊奇地注视，后演变为钦佩、欣赏。
family_guide.core_distinction: admire 为动词，admiration 为名词形式（敬佩之情）。

lemmas.def_en: combat to overcome an opposing tendency or force
lemmas.def_zh: 摔跤，角力；努力解决（难题）

examples.en: The committee is still wrestling with the complicated financial issues.
examples.zh: 委员会仍在全力应对复杂的财务问题。

lemmas.def_en: combatant who tries to throw opponent to the ground
lemmas.def_zh: 摔跤运动员

examples.en: The heavyweight wrestler won the championship match in just two rounds.
examples.zh: 这位重量级摔跤手仅用两回合就赢得了冠军赛。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 wræstan（扭转），核心指通过扭打搏斗，引申为同困难搏斗。
family_guide.core_distinction: wrestle 为动作动词，wrestler 为实施该动作的人（摔跤手）。

lemmas.def_en: designed for or capable of a particular function or use
lemmas.def_zh: 实用的；运转正常的

examples.en: The new office furniture is functional rather than decorative.
examples.zh: 这批新办公家具注重实用性而非装饰性。

lemmas.def_en: not having or performing a function
lemmas.def_zh: [医]无功能的

examples.en: The old fireplace in the living room is purely nonfunctional and decorative.
examples.zh: 客厅里的那个旧壁炉完全没有实用功能，只是起装饰作用。

lemmas.def_en: capable of serving a purpose well
lemmas.def_zh: 功能；实用性

examples.en: The latest update adds voice control functionality to the app.
examples.zh: 最新的更新为该应用增加了语音控制功能。

lemmas.def_en: with respect to function
lemmas.def_zh: 官能, 有功能, 职务, 机能, 在起作用, 从使用/实用的观点设计, 函数

examples.en: Although the two devices look completely different, they are functionally identical.
examples.zh: 尽管这两个设备外观完全不同，但它们在功能上是一样的。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自 function（功能、作用），核心表示“实用的、起作用的”。

lemmas.def_en: line that is the commercial organization responsible for operating a system of transportation for trains that pull passengers or freight
lemmas.def_zh: 铁路；强迫迅速通过（或做成某事）

examples.en: The committee was accused of trying to railroad the controversial bill through parliament.
examples.zh: 该委员会被指责企图强行在议会迅速通过这项有争议的法案。

lemmas.def_en: compel by coercion, threats, or crude means
lemmas.def_zh: 铁路；强迫迅速通过（或做成某事）

examples.en: The committee was accused of trying to railroad the controversial bill through parliament.
examples.zh: 该委员会被指责企图强行在议会迅速通过这项有争议的法案。

family_guide.root_logic: 由 rail（铁轨）+ road（道路）构成的复合词，引申为雷厉风行强行推进行动。

lemmas.def_en: a structure or object that impedes free movement
lemmas.def_zh: 障碍；屏障

examples.en: Language differences should not be a barrier to international trade.
examples.zh: 语言差异不应成为国际贸易的障碍。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古法语 barriere（横木、路障），核心表示“阻碍流通或通行的界限”。

lemmas.def_en: rectangular block of clay baked by the sun or in a kiln; used as a building or paving material
lemmas.def_zh: 砖块；可靠牢固的人/物

examples.en: His extensive field research provided the building bricks for the entire theory.
examples.zh: 他广泛的实地调研为整个理论奠定了基石。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古法语 brique（块、砖），引申指像砖块一样结实耐用或构成基础的事物。

lemmas.def_en: functioning in a supporting capacity
lemmas.def_zh: 补足的, 追加的

examples.en: The professor provided supplemental reading materials before the final examination.
examples.zh: 教授在期末考试前提供了补充阅读材料。

lemmas.def_zh: 补足的, 补充的, 追加的
lemmas.def_en: functioning in a supporting capacity

examples.en: The teacher provided supplementary materials to help us prepare for the final exam.
examples.zh: 老师提供了补充材料，帮助我们准备期末考试。

lemmas.def_en: moving and bending with ease
lemmas.def_zh: 柔软的，灵活的；使变柔软

examples.en: Regular yoga practice helps keep your muscles supple.
examples.zh: 坚持练习瑜伽有助于保持肌肉柔软灵活。

lemmas.def_en: textual matter that is added onto a publication; usually at the end
lemmas.def_zh: 补充（物）；增刊；补充

examples.en: He takes vitamin supplements to improve his immune system.
examples.zh: 他服用维生素补充剂来增强免疫力。

lemmas.def_en: a quantity added (e.g. to make up for a deficiency)
lemmas.def_zh: 增补, 补足, 补充

examples.en: Daily vitamin supplementation can help improve your overall immune system health.
examples.zh: 每日补充维生素有助于改善你的整体免疫系统健康。

lemmas.def_en: the gracefulness of a person or animal that is flexible and supple
lemmas.def_zh: 易弯曲, 柔软, 顺从

examples.en: Regular stretching exercises will greatly improve the suppleness of your joints.
examples.zh: 经常做拉伸运动会大大改善你关节的柔韧性。

lemmas.def_en: add as a supplement to what seems insufficient
lemmas.def_zh: 补充（物）；增刊；补充

examples.en: He takes vitamin supplements to improve his immune system.
examples.zh: 他服用维生素补充剂来增强免疫力。

lemmas.def_en: make pliant and flexible
lemmas.def_zh: 柔软的，灵活的；使变柔软

examples.en: Regular yoga practice helps keep your muscles supple.
examples.zh: 坚持练习瑜伽有助于保持肌肉柔软灵活。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 supplex（顺从的、柔顺的），通过借词与词义交叉演化出“柔软灵活”与“补充填补”两条语义线。
family_guide.core_distinction: supple 表示柔韧灵活；supplement 表示补充或增刊，二者现代词义差异明显。

lemmas.def_en: reproduce someone's behavior or looks
lemmas.def_zh: 模拟；模仿

examples.en: The training program simulates realistic combat conditions for the pilots.
examples.zh: 该训练项目为飞行员模拟了逼真的实战环境。

lemmas.def_en: the act of imitating the behavior of some situation or some process by means of something suitably analogous (especially for the purpose of study or personnel training)
lemmas.def_zh: 模拟；仿真

examples.en: Computer simulations can accurately predict the trajectory of the hurricane.
examples.zh: 计算机模拟能够精准预测飓风的移动轨迹。

lemmas.def_en: a machine that simulates an environment for the purpose of training or research
lemmas.def_zh: 模拟器

examples.en: Student drivers spent hours practicing on the flight simulator before flying real planes.
examples.zh: 飞行学员在驾驶真实飞机之前，在飞行模拟器上练习了数小时。

lemmas.def_zh: adj. 模拟的；人造的；假的
lemmas.def_en: made to look or feel like something else; artificial or imitated
lemmas.usage_note: 常修饰 conditions, leather, flight 等，表示模仿真实环境或人造材料。

examples.en: The astronauts practiced the landing procedure under simulated conditions.
examples.zh: 宇航员在模拟条件下演练了着陆程序。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 simulare（仿造、假装），核心表示“模仿真实系统的运行过程”。
family_guide.core_distinction: simulation 是模拟的过程或技术；simulator 是用于模拟的操作设备或软件。

lemmas.def_en: a city in southern England to the northwest of London; site of Oxford University
lemmas.def_zh: 牛津鞋；牛津布

examples.en: He wore a pair of polished black oxfords to the formal dinner.
examples.zh: 他穿着一双擦得锃亮的黑色牛津鞋去参加正式晚宴。

family_guide.root_logic: 地名 Oxford（牛津），引申指源自牛津大学或具有该地传统风格的事物（如鞋、布料）。

lemmas.def_en: a conversation between two persons
lemmas.def_zh: 对话；对话框

examples.en: A dialog appeared on the screen asking for user confirmation.
examples.zh: 屏幕上弹出一个对话框，请求用户确认。

lemmas.def_en: a conversation between two persons
lemmas.def_zh: 对话；对白；正式会谈

examples.en: The novel received praise for its witty and natural dialogue.
examples.zh: 这部小说因其机智自然的对白而广受赞誉。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 dialogos（对话、交谈），dia-（穿过、在……之间）+ logos（言语）。
family_guide.core_distinction: dialog 为美式拼写，dialogue 为英式及传统拼写，现代语境中 dialog 常特指计算机人机交互窗口。

lemmas.def_en: the place designated as the end (as of a race or journey)
lemmas.def_zh: 目的地；终点

examples.en: The tropical island has become a popular vacation destination for European tourists.
examples.zh: 这座热带岛屿已成为欧洲游客的热门度假目的地。

lemmas.def_en: decree or designate beforehand
lemmas.def_zh: 注定, 预定

examples.en: His immense talent and determination seemed to destine him for international musical stardom.
examples.zh: 他出众的才华和坚定的决心似乎注定他会成为国际乐坛巨星。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 destinare（确定、注定），核心表示“预先设定的终点或目标”。

lemmas.def_en: immunogen consisting of a suspension of weakened or dead pathogenic cells injected in order to stimulate the production of antibodies
lemmas.def_zh: 疫苗

examples.en: Scientists worked tirelessly to develop an effective vaccine against the virus.
examples.zh: 科学家们不知疲倦地工作，以研发出针对该病毒的有效疫苗。

lemmas.def_en: taking a vaccine as a precaution against contracting a disease
lemmas.def_zh: 接种疫苗

examples.en: Universal vaccination has eliminated many fatal infectious diseases worldwide.
examples.zh: 普及疫苗接种已经在全球范围内消灭了许多致命的传染病。

lemmas.def_en: a medical practitioner who inoculates people against diseases
lemmas.def_zh: 接种员

examples.en: The trained vaccinator gently administered the flu shot to the nervous child.
examples.zh: 训练有素的接种员温柔地给紧张的孩子注射了流感疫苗。

lemmas.def_en: perform vaccinations or produce immunity in by inoculation
lemmas.def_zh: 预防接种

examples.en: Doctors strongly recommend that parents vaccinate their children against infectious diseases.
examples.zh: 医生强烈建议父母为孩子接种预防传染病的疫苗。

lemmas.def_en: not vaccinated
lemmas.def_zh: 未注苗的；未接种的

examples.en: Unvaccinated travelers may face strict quarantine restrictions upon entering the country.
examples.zh: 未接种疫苗的旅客入境时可能会面临严格的隔离限制。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 vaccinus（来自母牛的），因早期从牛痘制备天花疫苗而得名。
family_guide.core_distinction: vaccine 指疫苗本身制剂；vaccination 指接种疫苗的动作或过程。

lemmas.def_en: relating to or designed for or using the singing voice
lemmas.def_zh: 发声的；直言不讳的；声乐部分

examples.en: She has been a vocal critic of the proposed tax reform.
examples.zh: 她一直是这项拟议税制改革的直言不讳的批评者。

lemmas.def_en: music intended to be performed by one or more singers, usually with instrumental accompaniment
lemmas.def_zh: 发声的；直言不讳的；声乐部分

examples.en: She has been a vocal critic of the proposed tax reform.
examples.zh: 她一直是这项拟议税制改革的直言不讳的批评者。

lemmas.def_en: the sound made by the vibration of vocal folds modified by the resonance of the vocal tract
lemmas.def_zh: 发声, 元音化

examples.en: Birds use complex vocalization patterns to communicate and warn off predators.
examples.zh: 鸟类使用复杂的发声模式进行交流并警告捕食者。

lemmas.def_en: in a vocal manner
lemmas.def_zh: 用声音, 用口头

examples.en: Several local residents vocally opposed the construction of the new highway.
examples.zh: 几位当地居民明确口头反对修建这条新公路。

lemmas.def_en: utter with vibrating vocal chords
lemmas.def_zh: 使发声, 使发成元音；发声, 练声, 元音化

examples.en: He found it difficult to vocalize his true feelings during the meeting.
examples.zh: 他发现在会议期间很难用言语表达自己的真实感受。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 vox（声音），核心表示“用声音表达的”或“直言不讳的”。

lemmas.def_en: take up or begin anew
lemmas.def_zh: 重新开始；恢复；（求职）简历

examples.en: The peace talks are scheduled to resume tomorrow morning.
examples.zh: 和谈定于明天上午恢复进行。

lemmas.def_en: short descriptive summary (of events)
lemmas.def_zh: 重新开始；恢复；（求职）简历

examples.en: The peace talks are scheduled to resume tomorrow morning.
examples.zh: 和谈定于明天上午恢复进行。

lemmas.def_en: beginning again
lemmas.def_zh: 取回, 恢复, 再开始

examples.en: Both nations agreed on the resumption of diplomatic talks next month.
examples.zh: 两国均同意下个月恢复外交会谈。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 resumere（重新拾起）；作名词源自法语 résumé（概括、摘要）。
family_guide.core_distinction: 动词读作 /rɪˈzjuːm/ 表示继续；名词读作 /ˈrezəmeɪ/ 专指求职简历或概要。

lemmas.def_en: coming next after the fifth and just before the seventh in position
lemmas.def_zh: 第六的；六分之一的

examples.en: He finished in sixth place in the marathon.
examples.zh: 他在马拉松比赛中获得了第六名。

lemmas.def_en: in the sixth place

examples.en: Sixthly, we must evaluate the environmental impact before making a decision.
examples.zh: 第六，在做出决定之前我们必须评估环境影响。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 seox（六），加上序数词后缀 -th 构成，核心义为“第六的”。

lemmas.def_en: capital of Germany located in eastern Germany
lemmas.def_zh: 柏林轿车（一种旧式四轮马车）

examples.en: The royal family traveled in an elegant berlin drawn by four horses.
examples.zh: 王室成员乘坐由四匹马拉着的优雅柏林四轮马车出行。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自地名柏林（Berlin），历史上曾引申指一种在柏林首创的四轮双座双门大马车。

lemmas.def_en: being one more than three
lemmas.def_zh: 罗马数字四的；第四的

examples.en: Please refer to Chapter IV for further details.
examples.zh: 欲知更多详情，请参阅第四章。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自罗马数字符号“IV”，由表示 5 的 V 减去左边的 I（1）构成，代表数字四。

lemmas.def_zh: 当……的时候；然而，尽管

examples.en: She listened politely whilst he explained the situation.
examples.zh: 他解释情况时，她礼貌地倾听着。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自中古英语 whiles（当……之时），后加副词后缀 -t 演变而来，是 while 的英式/书面语变体。

lemmas.def_en: not easy to believe
lemmas.def_zh: 难以置信地；极其，非常

examples.en: The team worked incredibly hard to meet the deadline.
examples.zh: 为了赶上截止日期，团队工作极其拼命。

family_guide.root_logic: 由 in-（不）+ cred（相信）+ -ible（可……的）+ -ly 构成，字面为“难以置信地”，引申为“极其”。

lemmas.def_en: (used to introduce a logical conclusion) from that fact or reason or as a result
lemmas.def_zh: 因此，所以；从现在起

examples.en: The cost of transport is a major factor, hence the high price.
examples.zh: 运输成本是主要因素，因此价格高昂。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 heonan（从这里），引申为因果关系上的“因此”或时间上的“今后”。

lemmas.def_en: an indefinitely short time
lemmas.def_zh: 片刻，瞬间（口语）

examples.en: Hang on a mo, I'll be right with you.
examples.zh: 等一会儿，我马上就来。

family_guide.root_logic: 为 moment（片刻，瞬间）的非正式口语缩写，常用于英式英语中表示极短的时间。

lemmas.def_en: rub with a circular motion
lemmas.def_zh: 擦，擦净；消除

examples.en: Please wipe the table after dinner.
examples.zh: 吃完晚饭后请把桌子擦干净。

lemmas.def_en: a worker who wipes
lemmas.def_zh: 揩擦的人, 刮水器, 接触电刷

examples.en: He had to replace the broken windshield wiper during the heavy rainstorm.
examples.zh: 暴雨期间他不得不更换那个坏掉的挡风玻璃雨刮器。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 wīpian，本义为“擦拭、抹去”，引申出彻底消除或清理的动作。

lemmas.def_en: having a quality that thrusts itself into attention
lemmas.def_zh: 突出的；著名的，显著的

examples.en: She played a prominent role in the negotiations.
examples.zh: 她在谈判中发挥了举足轻重的作用。

lemmas.def_en: in a prominent way
lemmas.def_zh: 显著地

examples.en: The company's new logo was prominently displayed at the exhibition booth.
examples.zh: 该公司的全新标志在展位上被显著地展示出来。

lemmas.def_zh: 突起, 突出, 显著, 突出物, 凸出
lemmas.def_en: the state of being prominent: widely known or eminent

examples.en: The young talented artist quickly rose to national prominence after her first exhibition.
examples.zh: 这位才华横溢的年轻艺术家在首展后迅速在全国声名鹊起。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 pro-（向前）+ minere（伸出，突出）+ -ent，核心语义为“向前伸出的、显眼的”。

lemmas.def_en: the attire worn in a play or at a fancy dress ball
lemmas.def_zh: 装束, 服装

examples.en: She wore an elaborate historical costume to the annual Halloween party.
examples.zh: 她穿着一套精致的历史服装参加了一年一度的万圣节派对。

lemmas.def_en: someone who designs or supplies costumes (as for a play or masquerade)
lemmas.def_zh: 做服装的人, 服装商

examples.en: The theatrical costumer carefully adjusted the actor's jacket before the show.
examples.zh: 戏剧服装师在演出前仔细调整了演员的夹克。

lemmas.def_en: dress in a costume

examples.en: She wore an elaborate historical costume to the annual Halloween party.
examples.zh: 她穿着一套精致的历史服装参加了一年一度的万圣节派对。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 consuetudo（风俗、习惯），在法语演变中指特定风俗、时代或戏剧所穿的“服装”。

lemmas.def_en: a sweet yellow liquid produced by bees
lemmas.def_zh: 蜂蜜, 甜蜜, 爱人

examples.en: She spread some golden honey over her toast for breakfast.
examples.zh: 她早餐时在吐司上涂抹了一些金黄色的蜂蜜。

lemmas.def_en: of something having the color of honey
lemmas.def_zh: 蜂蜜似的, 甜蜜的, 甘美的

examples.en: She spread some golden honey over her toast for breakfast.
examples.zh: 她早餐时在吐司上涂抹了一些金黄色的蜂蜜。

lemmas.def_en: sweeten with honey
lemmas.def_zh: 加蜜使甜, 对...说甜言蜜语；说甜言蜜语, 奉承

examples.en: She tried to honey her boss with compliments before asking for a raise.
examples.zh: 在要求加薪之前，她试图用恭维话奉承老板。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 hunig，本义为蜜蜂所酿的甘甜之物，引申出甜言蜜语、黄色调及亲昵称呼。

lemmas.def_en: a word picture of a person's appearance and character
lemmas.def_zh: 肖像，画像；详细的描绘

examples.en: The artist painted a lifelike portrait of the president.
examples.zh: 艺术家为总统画了一幅栩栩如生的肖像。

lemmas.def_en: a word picture of a person's appearance and character
lemmas.def_zh: 描绘, 描写, 画像, 肖像

examples.en: His portrayal of the troubled detective won high praise from critics.
examples.zh: 他对那位陷入困境的侦探的演绎赢得了评论家的赞誉。

lemmas.def_zh: 肖像绘制(法), 肖像画, 描写
lemmas.def_en: a word picture of a person's appearance and character

examples.en: Her mastery of portraiture captured the subtle emotions of each royal subject perfectly.
examples.zh: 她精湛的肖像画技艺完美捕捉了每位王室成员的微妙情感。

lemmas.def_zh: 肖像画家, 人像摄影师
lemmas.def_en: a painter or drawer of portraits

examples.en: The famous portraitist spent weeks capturing the subtle expression in the sitter's eyes.
examples.zh: 这位著名的肖像画家花了几周时间捕捉模特眼中微妙的神情。

lemmas.def_en: a painter or drawer of portraits
lemmas.def_zh: 肖像画家, 描画者, 记述者

examples.en: The talented actor became a famous portrayer of complex historical figures.
examples.zh: 这位才华横溢的演员成为了著名复杂历史人物的刻画者。

lemmas.def_en: portray in words
lemmas.def_zh: 描绘, 描写, 描绘...的肖像

examples.en: The historical novel portrays the daily struggles of ordinary working people.
examples.zh: 这部历史小说描绘了普通劳动者的日常抗争。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 pro-（向前）+ traire（拉、画），字面为“勾勒画出”，特指对人物面貌或特征的刻画。

lemmas.def_en: (physics) a device that attracts iron and produces a magnetic field
lemmas.def_zh: 磁铁，磁体；有吸引力的人或物

examples.en: The warm climate makes the city a magnet for tourists.
examples.zh: 温暖的气候使这座城市成为吸引游客的胜地。

lemmas.def_en: the extent or degree to which something is magnetized
lemmas.def_zh: 磁化

examples.en: The rapid magnetization of the iron core caused the temperature to rise quickly.
examples.zh: 铁芯的迅速磁化导致温度急剧上升。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to or caused by magnetism
lemmas.def_zh: 磁的，有磁性的；有魅力的

examples.en: He has a magnetic personality that draws people to him.
examples.zh: 他有一种极具吸引力的个性，吸引着周围的人。

lemmas.def_en: not capable of being magnetized
lemmas.def_zh: [电] 非磁性

examples.en: Surgeons prefer nonmagnetic tools to avoid accidental movement near scanning equipment.
examples.zh: 外科医生偏好使用非磁性工具，以避免在扫描设备附近发生意外位移。

lemmas.def_en: make magnetic
lemmas.def_zh: 使带磁力, 吸引；受磁

examples.en: You can magnetize a steel needle by stroking it with a strong bar magnet.
examples.zh: 你可以用强力条形磁铁摩擦钢针使其带磁。

lemmas.def_en: by the use of magnetism
lemmas.def_zh: 有磁力地；有吸引力地

examples.en: The high-speed train is magnetically levitated above the tracks to reduce friction.
examples.zh: 这列高速列车在轨道上方磁悬浮运行，以减少摩擦。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古希腊地名 Magnesia（产磁石之地），引申指具有磁性或强大吸引力的人与物。
family_guide.core_distinction: magnet 为名词（磁铁，有吸引力的人/物）；magnetic 为形容词（有磁性的，有魅力的）。

lemmas.def_en: finely ground tobacco wrapped in paper; for smoking
lemmas.def_zh: 香烟，纸烟

examples.en: He stepped outside to light a cigarette.
examples.zh: 他走到室外去点了一支香烟。

family_guide.root_logic: 词根 cigar（雪茄）+ 缩小后缀 -ette（小的），字面即“小雪茄”，指机制的卷烟、香烟。

lemmas.def_en: a drumbeat or bugle call that signals the military to return to their quarters
lemmas.def_zh: 归营号, 连续有节奏的敲击, 文身, 矮种马

examples.en: He decided to get a small dragon tattoo on his shoulder yesterday.
examples.zh: 他昨天决定在肩膀上纹一个小龙文身。

lemmas.def_en: stain (skin) with indelible color
lemmas.def_zh: 连续有节奏地敲, 刺花纹于；作连续有节奏的敲击

examples.en: He decided to get a small dragon tattoo on his shoulder yesterday.
examples.zh: 他昨天决定在肩膀上纹一个小龙文身。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自波利尼西亚语 tatau（敲击打入印记），指刺破皮肤注入颜料留下的永久性图案。

lemmas.def_en: a document incorporating an institution and specifying its rights; includes the articles of incorporation and the certificate of incorporation
lemmas.def_zh: 特许状, 执照, 宪章

examples.en: The United Nations charter outlines the fundamental principles of international relations.
examples.zh: 《联合国宪章》概述了国际关系的基本准则。

lemmas.def_en: hold under a lease or rental agreement; of goods and services
lemmas.def_zh: 特许, 发给特许执照

examples.en: The United Nations charter outlines the fundamental principles of international relations.
examples.zh: 《联合国宪章》概述了国际关系的基本准则。

lemmas.def_en: not chartered
lemmas.def_zh: 不合规则的

examples.en: The crew sailed into unchartered waters without any reliable modern navigation equipment.
examples.zh: 船员们在没有可靠现代导航设备的情况下，驶入了未绘入图表的未知水域。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语chartula（小纸片、凭单），引申为具有法律效力的特许状、宪章，后衍生出租用协议。

lemmas.def_en: come between so as to be hindrance or obstacle
lemmas.def_zh: 妨碍, 冲突, 干涉, 抵触

examples.en: Please do not interfere in other people's private matters without being asked.
examples.zh: 在未经允许的情况下，请不要干涉他人的私事。

lemmas.def_en: a policy of intervening in the affairs of other countries
lemmas.def_zh: 冲突, 干涉

examples.en: Radio interference made it impossible for the pilot to hear the control tower.
examples.zh: 无线电干扰使得飞行员无法听清控制塔的声音。

lemmas.def_en: a foreign policy of staying out of other countries' disputes
lemmas.def_zh: 不干扰

examples.en: The country maintained a strict policy of noninterference regarding its neighbors' conflicts.
examples.zh: 该国在邻国冲突问题上奉行严格的不干涉政策。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语inter-（在……之间）和ferire（打击、碰撞），核心语义为横插一手导致阻碍或冲突。
family_guide.core_distinction: interfere为动词；interference为其名词形式，常指干涉行为或信号干扰。

lemmas.def_en: an informal term for a father; probably derived from baby talk
lemmas.def_zh: 爸爸

examples.en: The little boy ran across the yard to hug his daddy tightly.
examples.zh: 小男孩穿过院子，紧紧抱住了他的爸爸。

family_guide.root_logic: 拟声幼儿语，源自儿童模仿发出的双唇辅音“da”，为father的亲昵称呼。

lemmas.def_en: make mention of
lemmas.def_zh: 评论, 注意；评论, 谈论

examples.en: She made a brief remark about the weather before starting the presentation.
examples.zh: 她在开始演讲前简短地对天气做了一番评论。

lemmas.def_en: a statement that expresses a personal opinion or belief or adds information
lemmas.def_zh: 评论, 注意

examples.en: She made a brief remark about the weather before starting the presentation.
examples.zh: 她在开始演讲前简短地对天气做了一番评论。

family_guide.root_logic: re-（再，强调）+ mark（标记、注意），本指在言语中加以注意并指出，引申为发表意见、评论。

lemmas.def_en: a former copper coin of Pakistan and India
lemmas.def_zh: 安娜（女子名）

examples.en: Anna always enjoys drinking a warm cup of herbal tea before sleeping.
examples.zh: 安娜总是喜欢在睡觉前喝一杯热腾腾的草药茶。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自印地语ānā，为旧时印度和巴基斯坦的细分货币单位（1卢比的十六分之一）。

lemmas.def_en: move obliquely or sideways, usually in an uncontrolled manner
lemmas.def_zh: 使滑动, 偷偷放入；滑动, 滑落, 不知不觉陷入, 偷偷地走

examples.en: Children love to slide down the snowy hill on their plastic sleds.
examples.zh: 孩子们喜欢用塑料雪橇从积雪覆盖的山坡上滑下来。

lemmas.def_en: move obliquely or sideways, usually in an uncontrolled manner
lemmas.def_zh: slide的过去式和过去分词

examples.en: The coin slid across the polished table and fell directly onto the floor.
examples.zh: 硬币滑过光滑的桌面，直接掉落在了地上。

lemmas.def_en: a small flat rectangular piece of glass on which specimens can be mounted for microscopic study
lemmas.def_zh: 滑, 滑道, 山崩, 雪崩, 幻灯片

examples.en: Children love to slide down the snowy hill on their plastic sleds.
examples.zh: 孩子们喜欢用塑料雪橇从积雪覆盖的山坡上滑下来。

lemmas.def_zh: [电] 滑动器
lemmas.def_en: a person who slips or slides because of loss of traction

examples.en: Use the volume slider on the screen to adjust the sound output level.
examples.zh: 使用屏幕上的音量滑动器来调节声音输出级别。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自原始日耳曼语，核心语义为平滑、连续地沿表面滑动或悄悄滑落。
family_guide.core_distinction: slide为原形动词/名词；slid为slide的过去式和过去分词形式。

lemmas.def_en: predatory arachnid with eight legs, two poison fangs, two feelers, and usually two silk-spinning organs at the back end of the body; they spin silk to make cocoons for eggs or traps for prey
lemmas.def_zh: 蜘蛛, 设圈套者

examples.en: A tiny black spider was spinning its web in the kitchen corner.
examples.zh: 一只黑色的小蜘蛛正在厨房角落里织网。

lemmas.def_en: relating to or resembling a member of the class Arachnida
lemmas.def_zh: 蜘蛛一般的, 细长足的, 蜘蛛网一般的

examples.en: The old letter was written in a faint, spidery handwriting hard to read.
examples.zh: 这封旧信是用难以辨认的微弱细长字迹书写的。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语spīthre，与spin（纺织）同源，直指这种以“纺丝结网”为特征的八足生物。

lemmas.def_en: the branch of philosophy that analyzes inference
lemmas.def_zh: 逻辑, 逻辑学, 推理的方法, 推理, 逻辑性

examples.en: There was no clear logic behind his sudden decision to quit his job.
examples.zh: 他突然辞职的决定背后没有任何清晰的逻辑。

lemmas.def_en: a person skilled at symbolic logic
lemmas.def_zh: 论理学者, 逻辑学家

examples.en: The renowned logician spent years analyzing paradoxes and complex formal languages.
examples.zh: 这位著名的逻辑学家花了很多年时间分析悖论和复杂的公理语言。

lemmas.def_zh: 物流师；军需官；后勤人员
lemmas.def_en: a person skilled at symbolic logic

examples.en: A skilled military logistician ensures that troops receive supplies and medical gear on time.
examples.zh: 一名经验丰富的军事后勤人员确保部队按时收到补给和医疗设备。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语logos（言辞、理性、秩序），指规范思维、论证与推理的科学规律。

lemmas.def_en: a large-scale farming enterprise
lemmas.def_zh: 农业

examples.en: Modern agriculture relies heavily on technology to increase crop yields and efficiency.
examples.zh: 现代农业严重依赖技术来提高农作物产量和效率。

lemmas.def_en: someone concerned with the science or art or business of cultivating the soil
lemmas.def_zh: 农学家

examples.en: The agriculturist introduced a new crop rotation method to improve the soil quality.
examples.zh: 这位农学家引入了一种新的轮作方法以改善土壤质量。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语ager（田地）+ cultura（耕作、培养），字面即“田地耕作”，指农耕与农牧业。

lemmas.def_en: any amazing or wonderful occurrence
lemmas.def_zh: 奇迹, 奇事

examples.en: It was an absolute miracle that everyone survived the terrible plane crash.
examples.zh: 每个人都在那场可怕的空难中幸存下来，这简直是个奇迹。

lemmas.def_en: being or having the character of a miracle
lemmas.def_zh: 奇迹的, 不可思议的

examples.en: Doctors were amazed by the patient's miraculous recovery from the severe illness.
examples.zh: 医生们对该患者从重病中奇迹般的康复感到惊讶。

lemmas.def_en: in a miraculous manner
lemmas.def_zh: 超自然, 非凡, 不可思议, 令人惊叹, 象奇迹一样, 奇迹般, 能创造奇迹

examples.en: The lost child was miraculously found safe in the dense forest after two days.
examples.zh: 走失的孩子在两天后奇迹般地在密林中被安全找到。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语mirari（惊奇、赞叹），核心指令人惊奇、违背常理的神奇造化或不可思议之事件。

lemmas.def_en: squeeze (someone) tightly in your arms, usually with fondness
lemmas.def_zh: 紧抱, 坚持, 使沾沾自喜

examples.en: She stepped forward to hug her old friend warmly at the airport terminal.
examples.zh: 她在机场航站楼走上前去热情地拥抱了她的老朋友。

lemmas.def_en: a person who hugs
lemmas.def_zh: 极端派; 割理

examples.en: The miner identified a hidden hugger in the coal seam before proceeding further.
examples.zh: 矿工在继续深入开采前确认了煤层中的一处隐蔽割理。

family_guide.root_logic: 可能源自古诺斯语hugga（安慰），核心动作是紧抱以示亲爱、温暖与抚慰。

lemmas.def_en: a public act of violence by an unruly mob
lemmas.def_zh: 暴动, 喧闹, 放纵

examples.en: Angry citizens threatened to riot if the corrupt mayor refused to step down.
examples.zh: 愤怒的市民威胁说，如果腐败的市长拒绝下台，他们将发起暴动。

lemmas.def_en: troublemaker who participates in a violent disturbance of the peace; someone who rises up against the constituted authority
lemmas.def_zh: 暴民, 暴徒, 纵情享乐者

examples.en: Police quickly arrested the rioter who was throwing rocks at the storefronts.
examples.zh: 警方迅速逮捕了那名向沿街店面投掷石块的暴徒。

lemmas.def_en: take part in a riot; disturb the public peace by engaging in a riot
lemmas.def_zh: 发动, 暴动, 纵情, 放荡；浪费, 挥霍

examples.en: Angry citizens threatened to riot if the corrupt mayor refused to step down.
examples.zh: 愤怒的市民威胁说，如果腐败的市长拒绝下台，他们将发起暴动。

lemmas.def_en: produced or growing in extreme abundance
lemmas.def_zh: 引起骚扰的, 暴乱的, 放荡的

examples.en: The students threw a riotous party that kept the entire neighborhood awake all night.
examples.zh: 学生们举办了一场喧闹放纵的派对，让整个街区彻夜未眠。

lemmas.def_en: in a tumultuous and riotous manner
lemmas.def_zh: 骚动地, 暴乱地

examples.en: The flowers bloomed riotously across the hillside during the first warm week of spring.
examples.zh: 在初春暖和的第一周里，漫山遍野的花朵肆意盛开。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古法语riote（争辩、喧闹），核心语义为打破秩序的群体性暴力骚乱或狂欢喧嚣。

lemmas.def_en: an overwhelming feeling of fear and anxiety
lemmas.def_zh: 恐慌, 惊慌

examples.en: Try not to panic when the fire alarm suddenly starts ringing loudly.
examples.zh: 当火警警报突然大声响起时，尽量不要惊慌。

lemmas.def_en: be overcome by a sudden fear
lemmas.def_zh: 使惊慌, 使狂热；惊慌

examples.en: Try not to panic when the fire alarm suddenly starts ringing loudly.
