examples.zh: 当火警警报突然大声响起时，尽量不要惊慌。

lemmas.def_en: thrown into a state of intense fear or desperation
lemmas.def_zh: 恐慌的, 惊慌失措的

examples.en: He felt panicky when he realized his passport was missing from his bag.
examples.zh: 当他意识到包里的护照不见了时，他感到惊慌失措。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊神话牧神潘（Pan），相传其出没能引起人群无名的大恐慌，指突如其来的强烈惊恐。

lemmas.def_en: impressive in appearance
lemmas.def_zh: 高贵的, 高尚的, 贵族的, 辉煌的

examples.en: The young knight was born into a wealthy and noble European family.
examples.zh: 这位年轻的骑士出生在一个富裕而高贵的欧洲家族。

lemmas.def_en: a titled peer of the realm
lemmas.def_zh: 贵族

examples.en: The young knight was born into a wealthy and noble European family.
examples.zh: 这位年轻的骑士出生在一个富裕而高贵的欧洲家族。

lemmas.def_en: a privileged class holding hereditary titles
lemmas.def_zh: 贵族, 高尚, 贵族阶级

examples.en: She showed true nobility of character by forgiving those who had wronged her.
examples.zh: 她通过原谅那些冤枉她的人，展现了真正高尚的品格。

lemmas.def_en: the quality of elevation of mind and exaltation of character or ideals or conduct
lemmas.def_zh: 高贵, 高洁, 高尚

examples.en: Everyone admired the nobleness of his selfless sacrifice for the poor community.
examples.zh: 每个人都钦佩他为贫困社区无私奉献的高尚品质。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语nobilis（知名的、高贵的），涵盖社会地位上的“贵族身份”与品格上的“崇高伟大”。
family_guide.core_distinction: noble作形容词指高尚的、高贵的；作名词指拥有贵族头衔的人。

lemmas.def_en: any of various edible seeds of plants of the family Leguminosae used for food
lemmas.def_zh: 豆子

examples.en: She prepared a warm bowl of soup made with black beans and vegetables.
examples.zh: 她做了一碗用黑豆和蔬菜熬成的热汤。

lemmas.def_en: a baseball deliberately thrown at the batter's head
lemmas.def_zh: 托架

examples.en: The mechanic adjusted the metal beaner to properly secure the heavy industrial frame.
examples.zh: 机械师调整了金属托架，以妥善固定沉重的工业框架。

lemmas.def_en: hit on the head, especially with a pitched baseball
lemmas.def_zh: [化] 油嘴; 豆

examples.en: She prepared a warm bowl of soup made with black beans and vegetables.
examples.zh: 她做了一碗用黑豆和蔬菜熬成的热汤。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自原始日耳曼语，本义指豆类作物种子，美式俚语引申指人头或击中某人头部。

lemmas.def_en: literature in metrical form
lemmas.def_zh: 诗, 韵文, 诗句

examples.en: He recited a beautiful verse from a love poem during the wedding ceremony.
examples.zh: 他在婚礼仪式上朗诵了一首情诗中优美的诗句。

lemmas.def_zh: 诗律, 作诗
lemmas.def_en: a metrical adaptation of something (e.g., of a prose text)

examples.en: The young poet practiced classical versification by studying ancient Greek meters.
examples.zh: 这位年轻诗人通过研究古希腊格律来练习古典作诗法。

lemmas.def_en: a writer who composes rhymes; a maker of poor verses (usually used as terms of contempt for minor or inferior poets)
lemmas.def_zh: 诗人, 将散文改成韵文的人, 拙劣诗人

examples.en: The local versifier published a small booklet of rhyming couplets for the town festival.
examples.zh: 当地的打油诗人为小镇节日出版了一本押韵对句的小册子。

lemmas.def_en: compose verses or put into verse
lemmas.def_zh: 用诗表达；作诗

examples.en: He recited a beautiful verse from a love poem during the wedding ceremony.
examples.zh: 他在婚礼仪式上朗诵了一首情诗中优美的诗句。

lemmas.def_en: not having had extensive practice
lemmas.def_zh: 不精通的, 不熟练的

examples.en: She was completely unversed in legal matters and decided to hire a lawyer.
examples.zh: 她对法律事务完全不熟悉，因此决定聘请一名律师。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 vertere（转动），原指犁地时回转的一垄地，引申为一行诗，进而泛指诗歌或使其熟练。

lemmas.def_en: the organization that is the governing authority of a political unit
lemmas.def_zh: 政权，政体；管理制度

examples.en: The reformist regime introduced policies to combat bureaucratic corruption.
examples.zh: 这个改革派政权出台了打击官僚腐败的政策。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 regere（统治、管理），引申为特定的政治制度、政权或管理养生方案。

lemmas.def_en: a state of extreme confusion and disorder
lemmas.def_zh: 混乱，无秩序状态

examples.en: The sudden subway strike plunged the entire city into chaos.
examples.zh: 突如其来的地铁罢工让整座城市陷入混乱。

lemmas.def_en: lacking a visible order or organization
lemmas.def_zh: 混乱的，毫无秩序的

examples.en: Rescue workers struggled to operate in the chaotic aftermath of the storm.
examples.zh: 救援人员在暴风雨过后一片狼藉的混乱局面中艰难开展工作。

lemmas.def_en: in a wild and confused manner
lemmas.def_zh: 混乱地

examples.en: Traffic moved chaotically through the intersection after the power failure disabled the traffic lights.
examples.zh: 停电导致红绿灯瘫痪后，十字路口的交通陷入混乱。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语，原指宇宙形成前的原始混沌裂隙，现代引申为毫无秩序的极端混乱状态。
family_guide.core_distinction: chaos为不可数名词，表示混乱状态；chaotic为其形容词形式，描述混乱无序的特征。

lemmas.def_en: an animal skin made smooth and flexible by removing the hair and then tanning
lemmas.def_zh: 皮革, 皮制品, 马镫的皮带

examples.en: The angry man threatened to leather the thief with his heavy leather belt.
examples.zh: 愤怒的男子威胁要用他厚重的皮带抽打那个小偷。

lemmas.def_en: whip with a leather strap
lemmas.def_zh: 覆以皮革, 鞭苔, 抽打

examples.en: The angry man threatened to leather the thief with his heavy leather belt.
examples.zh: 愤怒的男子威胁要用他厚重的皮带抽打那个小偷。

lemmas.def_en: resembling or made to resemble leather; tough but pliable
lemmas.def_zh: 皮似的, 皮质的, 皮般吞坚韧的

examples.en: Years of working under the harsh sun had given him tough, leathery skin.
examples.zh: 多年在烈日下劳作使他的皮肤变得粗糙坚韧。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自原始日耳曼语，本义为加工过的兽皮，动词可引申为用皮带抽打或覆以皮革。

lemmas.def_en: a unit of area (4840 square yards) used in English-speaking countries
lemmas.def_zh: 英亩（土地面积单位，约合4047平方米）

examples.en: They bought a modest farmstead surrounded by fifty acres of pasture.
examples.zh: 他们买下了一座被50英亩牧场所环绕的朴素农庄。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自原始印欧语核心词，原指耕地、田野，后被标准化为土地面积单位“英亩”。

lemmas.def_en: a particular environment or walk of life
lemmas.def_zh: 竞技场，舞台，斗争场所

examples.en: She decided to leave academia and enter the cutthroat political arena.
examples.zh: 她决定离开学术界，踏入竞争残酷的政治舞台。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 harena（沙子），古罗马角斗场铺沙用以吸收鲜血，引申为竞技场或活动舞台。

lemmas.def_en: extreme mental distress
lemmas.def_zh: 拷问, 苦闷

examples.en: The dictator was accused of using severe torture to crush his political opponents.
examples.zh: 这名独裁者被指控使用严刑拷打来镇压政敌。

lemmas.def_en: someone who inflicts severe physical pain (usually for punishment or coercion)
lemmas.def_zh: 拷问者, 虐待者

examples.en: The cruel torturer showed no mercy to the captured soldiers in the dungeon.
examples.zh: 地牢里冷酷的拷打者对被俘的士兵毫无同情心。

lemmas.def_en: torment emotionally or mentally
lemmas.def_zh: 拷问, 曲解, 折磨, 使弯曲

examples.en: The dictator was accused of using severe torture to crush his political opponents.
examples.zh: 这名独裁者被指控使用严刑拷打来镇压政敌。

lemmas.def_en: extremely painful
lemmas.def_zh: 折磨人的, 极端痛苦的

examples.en: The marathon runners endured a torturous climb up the steep and rocky mountain.
examples.zh: 马拉松选手们忍受着折磨，艰难地攀登着陡峭多石的山坡。

lemmas.def_en: in a very painful manner
lemmas.def_zh: torturous的变形

examples.en: The old clock ticked torturously slowly while she waited for the critical test results.
examples.zh: 在她等待关键的化验结果时，老钟表折磨人地缓慢滴答作响。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 torquere（扭曲、绞缠），引申为施加肉体折磨或精神上的痛苦纠缠。

lemmas.def_en: the part of the alimentary canal between the stomach and the anus
lemmas.def_zh: 剧情, 内容, 内脏, 肚子, 海峡, 勇气

examples.en: Firefighters watched the fierce blaze rapidly gut the entire interior of the building.
examples.zh: 消防员眼睁睁看着大火迅速烧毁了整座大楼的内部。

examples.en: The gutted remains of the historic warehouse stood quietly by the dark river.
examples.zh: 那座被烧空的历史仓库废墟静静地伫立在昏暗的河边。

lemmas.def_en: a channel along the eaves or on the roof; collects and carries away rainwater
lemmas.def_zh: 排水沟, 槽, 贫民区

examples.en: Heavy autumn rain washed fallen yellow leaves directly into the street gutter.
examples.zh: 秋天的暴雨将落下的黄叶直接冲进了街边的排水沟。

lemmas.def_zh: 去内脏

examples.en: The gutting of fresh fish was done quickly by the harbor workers every dawn.
examples.zh: 每天拂晓，港口工人们都会迅速完成新鲜鱼类的宰杀去内脏工作。

lemmas.def_en: empty completely; destroy the inside of
lemmas.def_zh: 取出内脏, 毁坏...的内部

examples.en: Firefighters watched the fierce blaze rapidly gut the entire interior of the building.
examples.zh: 消防员眼睁睁看着大火迅速烧毁了整座大楼的内部。

lemmas.def_en: burn unsteadily, feebly, or low; flicker
lemmas.def_zh: 开沟于；流

examples.en: Heavy autumn rain washed fallen yellow leaves directly into the street gutter.
examples.zh: 秋天的暴雨将落下的黄叶直接冲进了街边的排水沟。

lemmas.def_en: marked by courage and determination in the face of difficulties or danger; robust and uninhibited; ; -Judith Crist
lemmas.def_zh: 有勇气的, 有力量的

examples.en: The young entrepreneur made a gutsy move by launching her startup during a recession.
examples.zh: 这位年轻的企业家在经济衰退期开办公司，展现了十足的魄力。

family_guide.root_logic: 原指腹腔、肠道等内脏器官，引申为勇气、直觉，动词指取出内脏或洗劫/毁坏建筑物内部。

lemmas.def_en: blockage consisting of an object designed to fill a hole tightly
lemmas.def_zh: 塞子, 栓, 插头

examples.en: He used a rubber plug to seal the hole and stop water leaking out.
examples.zh: 他用一个橡胶塞堵住漏洞，防止水流出来。

lemmas.def_en: someone who is an active supporter and advocate
lemmas.def_zh: 填塞物, 苦干的人, 宣传员

examples.en: Though not the most talented player, he was a determined plugger who never quit.
examples.zh: 虽然不是最有天赋的选手，但他是一个从不放弃的苦干者。

lemmas.def_en: fill or close tightly with or as if with a plug
lemmas.def_zh: 插入, 塞住, 接插头；被塞住

examples.en: He used a rubber plug to seal the hole and stop water leaking out.
examples.zh: 他用一个橡胶塞堵住漏洞，防止水流出来。

lemmas.def_en: pull the plug of (electrical appliances) and render inoperable
lemmas.def_zh: 拔开...的塞子, 拔去...的插头, 除掉...的障碍物

examples.en: Always unplug the electric kettle from the wall socket before cleaning it with water.
examples.zh: 用水清洁电水壶之前，请务必将其从墙壁插座上拔下。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自低地德语，核心意象为“插入小块材料以封堵缝隙”，引申为电源插头、插塞及推销宣传。

lemmas.def_en: very imposing or impressive; surpassing the ordinary (especially in size or scale)
lemmas.def_zh: 史诗的, 叙事诗的

examples.en: The poet spent twenty years writing an epic poem about the ancient war.
examples.zh: 这位诗人花了二十年时间撰写了一部关于古代战争的史诗。

lemmas.def_en: constituting or having to do with or suggestive of a literary epic
lemmas.def_zh: 叙事诗的, 英勇的

examples.en: The director captured the epical struggle of the pioneers across the wild western frontier.
examples.zh: 导演生动捕捉了拓荒者横穿狂野西部边疆时的史诗般艰辛历程。

lemmas.def_en: a long narrative poem telling of a hero's deeds
lemmas.def_zh: 史诗, 叙事诗

examples.en: The poet spent twenty years writing an epic poem about the ancient war.
examples.zh: 这位诗人花了二十年时间撰写了一部关于古代战争的史诗。

lemmas.def_zh: 史诗, 叙事诗
lemmas.def_en: a body of poetry that conveys the traditions of a society by treating some epic theme

examples.en: The ancient national epos tells heroic stories of legendary warriors defending their sacred homeland.
examples.zh: 这部古代民族史诗讲述了传奇勇士保卫神圣家园的英勇故事。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 epos（话语、诗歌），引申为叙述英雄伟业的史诗，形容词表示史诗般的、壮丽的。
family_guide.core_distinction: epic作名词指史诗文学作品；作形容词指规模宏大、壮观非凡的。

lemmas.def_en: one of the inherent cognitive or perceptual powers of the mind
lemmas.def_zh: 官能，能力；大学院系；全体教职工

examples.en: The law school faculty voted unanimously in favor of the new curriculum.
examples.zh: 法学院全体教职员工一致投票赞成推行新课程方案。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 facultas（能力、容易），引申为天赋能力、大学的院系及全体教职人员。

lemmas.def_en: common to or shared by two or more parties
lemmas.def_zh: 相互的，彼此的；共有的

examples.en: Their long partnership was founded on mutual respect and shared ambitions.
examples.zh: 他们长久的合作关系建立在相互尊重与共同抱负的基础之上。

lemmas.def_en: in a mutual or shared manner
lemmas.def_zh: 相互地，互助地

examples.en: Both countries signed a treaty aimed at achieving mutually beneficial trade.
examples.zh: 两国签署了一项旨在实现互利贸易的条约。

lemmas.def_en: a reciprocality of sentiments
lemmas.def_zh: 相互关系, 相关

examples.en: A successful partnership depends on a sense of mutuality and genuine shared respect.
examples.zh: 成功的伙伴关系取决于相互信任感和发自内心的彼此尊重。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 mutuus（互相的、借贷），核心表示双方或多方之间“相互对等的交换或共有”。
family_guide.core_distinction: mutual为形容词；mutually为副词，常修饰形容词或动词表示“相互地”。

lemmas.def_en: leniency and compassion shown toward offenders by a person or agency charged with administering justice
lemmas.def_zh: n. 仁慈，宽容；幸运

examples.en: The judge showed mercy and reduced the prisoner's sentence.
examples.zh: 法官展现了仁慈，减轻了囚犯的刑期。

lemmas.def_zh: 梅西埃（男子名）

examples.en: Mercier examined the ancient French manuscript carefully under the bright library lamp.
examples.zh: 梅西埃在图书馆明亮的灯光下仔细查阅了那份古老的法文手稿。

lemmas.def_en: feelings of extreme heartlessness
lemmas.def_zh: 冷酷无情

examples.en: The brutal winter exposed the mercilessness of nature in this frozen region.
examples.zh: 残酷的严冬展现了这片冰冻之地的大自然之冷酷无情。

lemmas.def_en: showing or giving mercy
lemmas.def_zh: 仁慈的, 慈悲的

examples.en: The merciful judge decided to give the young offender a second chance.
examples.zh: 仁慈的法官决定给这名年轻罪犯一次改过自新的机会。

lemmas.def_en: having or showing no mercy
lemmas.def_zh: 无慈悲心的, 残忍的

examples.en: The soldiers had to endure a long march under the merciless desert sun.
examples.zh: 士兵们不得不在沙漠无情的烈日下进行长途行军。

lemmas.def_en: having or showing no mercy
lemmas.def_zh: 不慈悲的, 无情的, 残忍的

examples.en: The dictator was notorious for his unmerciful treatment of any political opponents.
examples.zh: 这位独裁者因对任何政治对手都残酷无情而臭名昭著。

lemmas.def_en: without pity; in a merciless manner
lemmas.def_zh: 无情地, 残忍地

examples.en: The critics mercilessly attacked the director's latest film in all their reviews.
examples.zh: 影评人在所有评论中都毫不留情地抨击了这位导演的最新电影。

lemmas.def_en: in a compassionate manner
lemmas.def_zh: 仁慈地

examples.en: Mercifully, the rain stopped just before the outdoor wedding ceremony began.
examples.zh: 幸运的是，就在户外婚礼仪式开始前，雨停了。

lemmas.def_en: without pity; in a merciless manner
lemmas.def_zh: 不仁慈地；残酷地

examples.en: The older boys mocked his clumsy accent unmercifully on the playground.
examples.zh: 大男孩们在操场上无情地嘲笑他笨拙的口音。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 merces（报酬、恩惠），在中世纪引申为自上而下的仁慈与宽恕。

lemmas.def_en: any plant that crowds out cultivated plants
lemmas.def_zh: n. 杂草，野草；大麻

examples.en: The committee plans to weed out unqualified applicants early in the process.
examples.zh: 委员会计划在流程早期剔除不合格的申请人。

lemmas.def_zh: 除草者
lemmas.def_en: a farmhand hired to remove weeds

examples.en: The gardener used a sharp hand weeder to remove dandelions from the lawn.
examples.zh: 园丁用一把锋利的手持除草器清理草坪上的蒲公英。

lemmas.def_en: clear of weeds
lemmas.def_zh: v. 除草；剔除

examples.en: The committee plans to weed out unqualified applicants early in the process.
examples.zh: 委员会计划在流程早期剔除不合格的申请人。

lemmas.def_en: abounding with or resembling weeds
lemmas.def_zh: 尽是杂草的, 似杂草的, 瘦弱的, 蔓生的

examples.en: After months of complete neglect, the backyard became an overgrown, weedy mess.
examples.zh: 经过几个月的彻底荒废，后院变成了一片杂草丛生的荒地。

lemmas.def_en: free from weeds
lemmas.def_zh: 无杂草的

examples.en: The dedicated gardener spent hours keeping her vegetable patches perfectly weedless.
examples.zh: 这位敬业的园丁花了好几个小时让她种植的蔬菜地里毫无杂草。

family_guide.root_logic: 原指野草，引申指除去杂草或淘汰不良成分的行为。

lemmas.def_en: an outline or synopsis of a play (or, by extension, of a literary work)
lemmas.def_zh: n. 可能发生的情况，推测的局面；剧本大纲

examples.en: In the worst-case scenario, the company might have to file for bankruptcy.
examples.zh: 在最坏的情况下，公司可能不得不申请破产。

family_guide.root_logic: 借自意大利语，源自拉丁语 scaena（舞台、场景），指推演出的局面或剧本。

lemmas.def_en: practices that are handed down from the past by tradition
lemmas.def_zh: n. 遗产，传统（多指文化、历史等）

examples.en: The historic town was designated a UNESCO World Heritage site.
examples.zh: 这座历史名城被列为联合国教科文组织世界遗产。

family_guide.root_logic: 来自拉丁语 heres（继承人），指代代相传的文化、历史或财产。

lemmas.def_en: being everywhere equidistant and not intersecting
lemmas.def_zh: adj. 平行的；类似的

examples.en: There are striking parallels between the two historical events.
examples.zh: 这两起历史事件之间有着惊人的相似之处。

lemmas.def_en: something having the property of being analogous to something else
lemmas.def_zh: n. 平行线；极相似之人或事

examples.en: There are striking parallels between the two historical events.
examples.zh: 这两起历史事件之间有着惊人的相似之处。

lemmas.def_en: be parallel to
lemmas.def_zh: v. 与……平行；比得上

examples.en: There are striking parallels between the two historical events.
examples.zh: 这两起历史事件之间有着惊人的相似之处。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 para（并列）+ allelon（互相），核心逻辑是“两条线互相对应延伸”。

lemmas.def_en: someone who has exceptional intellectual ability and originality
lemmas.def_zh: n. 天才，天赋；特质

examples.en: His strategic genius transformed a small startup into a global giant.
examples.zh: 他的战略天才将一家小型初创企业变成了全球巨头。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语，原指与生俱来的守护神或天性，后引申为卓越的天资与天才。

lemmas.def_en: the residue that remains when something is burned
lemmas.def_zh: n. 灰，灰烬；骨灰

examples.en: The volcano erupted, spewing smoke and ash into the sky.
examples.zh: 火山喷发，将浓烟和火山灰喷向天空。

lemmas.def_en: convert into ashes
lemmas.def_zh: v. 弹烟灰；使化为灰烬

examples.en: The volcano erupted, spewing smoke and ash into the sky.
examples.zh: 火山喷发，将浓烟和火山灰喷向天空。

lemmas.def_zh: 灰的, 覆盖着灰的, 苍白的
lemmas.def_en: of a light grey

examples.en: He turned visibly pale, with an ashy complexion following the sudden terrible shock.
examples.zh: 遭受突如其来的剧烈震惊后，他的脸色明显变得惨白。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自日耳曼语词根，指可燃物完全燃烧后残留的粉末状遗迹。

lemmas.def_en: make impure
lemmas.def_zh: v. 污染，玷污

examples.en: Toxic waste continues to pollute the local river.
examples.zh: 有毒废物继续污染着当地的河流。

lemmas.def_en: undesirable state of the natural environment being contaminated with harmful substances as a consequence of human activities
lemmas.def_zh: n. 污染；污染物

examples.en: Air pollution levels in the capital have reached record highs.
examples.zh: 首都的空气污染水平已创下历史新高。

lemmas.def_en: waste matter that contaminates the water or air or soil
lemmas.def_zh: 污染物质

examples.en: Industrial factories release this toxic chemical pollutant directly into the local river.
examples.zh: 工业工厂将这种有毒化学污染物直接排放到当地河流中。

lemmas.def_en: a person or organization that causes pollution of the environment
lemmas.def_zh: 污染者, 污染物质

examples.en: The government imposed heavy fines on the corporate polluter for dumping chemical waste.
examples.zh: 政府对倾倒化学废物的企业污染者处以巨额罚款。

lemmas.def_en: free from admixture with noxious elements; clean
lemmas.def_zh: 未被污染的, 清洁的, 未被玷污的, 清白的

examples.en: We hiked high into the mountains to breathe the pure, unpolluted air.
examples.zh: 我们徒步深入高山，去呼吸纯净未受污染的空气。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 polluere（玷污、使肮脏），由 pro-（向前）+ luere（冲洗）派生而来的反义引申。

lemmas.def_en: greatly pleasing or entertaining
lemmas.def_zh: adj. 美味的，可口的；令人愉悦的

examples.en: She prepared a delicious dinner for her visiting guests.
examples.zh: 她为来访的客人准备了一顿丰盛美味的晚餐。

lemmas.def_en: in a very pleasurable manner
lemmas.def_zh: 美味地, 芬香地

examples.en: The freshly baked bread smelled deliciously warm as it came out of the oven.
examples.zh: 刚出炉的面包散发着诱人温暖的香气。

lemmas.def_en: extreme appetizingness
lemmas.def_zh: 美味；怡人；芬芳

examples.en: The chef took great pride in the sheer deliciousness of his signature dessert.
examples.zh: 厨师对他招牌甜点的极致美味感到非常自豪。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 deliciae（快乐、愉悦），核心概念是“让人极度愉悦的享受”。

lemmas.def_en: (often followed by `from') not alike; different in nature or quality
lemmas.def_zh: adj. 清晰的，明显的；截然不同的

examples.en: There has been a distinct improvement in his academic performance.
examples.zh: 他的学习成绩有了明显的提高。

lemmas.def_en: clear to the mind; with distinct mental discernment
lemmas.def_zh: adv. 清楚地，明显地；确定地

examples.en: I distinctly remember turning off the oven before leaving.
examples.zh: 我清楚地记得离开前关掉了烤箱。

lemmas.def_en: the quality of being sharp and clear
lemmas.def_zh: 不同, 明显

examples.en: The distinctness of each musical note was lost in the noisy concert hall.
examples.zh: 在嘈杂的音乐厅里，每个音符的清晰度都丧失了。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 dis-（分开）+ stinguere（刺、戳记），原指用刺孔做记号区分，引申为清晰可分的。

lemmas.def_en: any physical damage to the body caused by violence or accident or fracture etc.
lemmas.def_zh: n. 精神创伤；外伤，损伤

examples.en: Children who experience severe trauma may need long-term therapy.
examples.zh: 经历严重创伤的儿童可能需要长期心理治疗。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to a physical injury or wound to the body
lemmas.def_zh: adj. 痛苦的，创伤性的；令人极度不安的

examples.en: Divorce can be a deeply traumatic experience for everyone involved.
examples.zh: 离婚对所有当事人来说都可能是一段极痛苦的经历。

lemmas.def_en: inflict a trauma upon
lemmas.def_zh: 使受损伤, 使受精神创伤

examples.en: The sudden car accident could deeply traumatize the young child for years.
examples.zh: 那场突如其来的车祸可能会给年幼的孩子造成多年的严重精神创伤。

lemmas.def_en: inflict a trauma upon
lemmas.def_zh: 使受精神创伤; 使受外伤

examples.en: Witnessing such brutal street violence is enough to traumatise any normal person.
examples.zh: 目睹如此残暴的街头暴力足以让任何正常人产生心理创伤。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 trauma（伤口、创伤），医学上指肉体损伤，现代多引申为心理创伤。

lemmas.def_en: the state of being absent
lemmas.def_zh: n. 缺席，不在；缺乏，不存在

examples.en: In the absence of clear instructions, the team had to improvise.
examples.zh: 在缺乏明确指示的情况下，团队只得随机应变。

lemmas.def_en: one that is absent or not in residence
lemmas.def_zh: 缺席者, 不在者

examples.en: The teacher called the home of every frequent absentee this afternoon.
examples.zh: 老师今天下午给每一位经常缺勤的学生家里打了电话。

lemmas.def_en: not being in a specified place
lemmas.def_zh: 缺席的, 不在的, 缺乏的, 漫不经心的

examples.en: Two key members of our project team were absent from the meeting.
examples.zh: 我们项目团队中的两名核心成员缺席了会议。

lemmas.def_en: go away or leave
lemmas.def_zh: 使缺席

examples.en: Two key members of our project team were absent from the meeting.
examples.zh: 我们项目团队中的两名核心成员缺席了会议。

lemmas.def_en: in an absentminded or preoccupied manner
lemmas.def_zh: 心不在焉地

examples.en: He stirred his black coffee absently while thinking about the upcoming interview.
examples.zh: 他一边心不在焉地搅着黑咖啡，一边想着即将到来的面试。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 ab-（离开）+ esse（存在），直译为“不在场、不存在”。

lemmas.def_en: especially a leaf of grass or the broad portion of a leaf as distinct from the petiole
lemmas.def_zh: n. 刀刃，刀片；草叶；桨叶，叶片

examples.en: The chef sharpened the blade before slicing the meat.
examples.zh: 厨师切肉前把刀刃磨快了。

family_guide.root_logic: 日耳曼语源，原指扁平的叶子，引申为各类扁薄锋利的工具或部件。

lemmas.def_en: susceptible to attack
lemmas.def_zh: adj. 脆弱的，易受伤害的；有弱点的

examples.en: Infants and the elderly are particularly vulnerable to the virus.
examples.zh: 婴儿和老年人特别容易受到该病毒的侵害。

lemmas.def_en: the state of being vulnerable or exposed
lemmas.def_zh: n. 脆弱，易损性；弱点，漏洞

examples.en: Security experts discovered a critical vulnerability in the software.
examples.zh: 安全专家在软件中发现了一个严重漏洞。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 vulnerare（伤害、弄伤），意为“容易受伤的”。

lemmas.def_en: in a state of sleep
lemmas.def_zh: adj. 睡着的，熟睡的

examples.en: The baby was fast asleep in her crib.
examples.zh: 婴儿在她的婴儿床里熟睡着。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 a-（处于……状态）+ sleep（睡眠），指处于睡眠状态。

lemmas.def_en: the quality of being secluded from the presence or view of others
lemmas.def_zh: n. 隐私，私密；独处

examples.en: She moved to the countryside in search of greater privacy.
examples.zh: 为了寻求更多的隐私，她搬到了乡下。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自 private（私人的），名词后缀 -cy 表示状态或性质，指不被打扰的私人状态。

lemmas.def_en: a pesticide in suspension or solution; intended for spraying
lemmas.def_zh: n. 浪花；喷雾；喷剂

examples.en: A fine spray of sea water cooled her face.
examples.zh: 一层细腻的海水浪花让她的脸感到凉爽。

lemmas.def_en: a worker who applies spray to a surface
lemmas.def_zh: 喷水车, 喷枪, 喷雾器

examples.en: He used a small plastic sprayer to mist water over the delicate house plants.
examples.zh: 他用一个小型塑料喷雾器给娇嫩的室内植物喷水。

lemmas.def_en: be discharged in sprays of liquid
lemmas.def_zh: v. 喷射；喷洒

examples.en: A fine spray of sea water cooled her face.
examples.zh: 一层细腻的海水浪花让她的脸感到凉爽。

family_guide.root_logic: 拟声词根，模拟液体飞溅分散的动作与形态。

lemmas.def_en: a shoulder firearm with a long barrel and a rifled bore
lemmas.def_zh: n. 步枪，来福枪

examples.en: He carried a hunting rifle slung over his shoulder.
examples.zh: 他肩上挂着一把猎枪。

lemmas.def_en: steal goods; take as spoils
lemmas.def_zh: v. 抢劫；盗取

examples.en: He carried a hunting rifle slung over his shoulder.
examples.zh: 他肩上挂着一把猎枪。

family_guide.root_logic: 名词指膛线枪（源于法文膛线意），动词源自古法语，指快速翻找、搜刮。

lemmas.def_en: a hollow globule of gas (e.g., air or carbon dioxide)
lemmas.def_zh: n. 气泡，水泡；泡沫

examples.en: Children love blowing soap bubbles in the park.
examples.zh: 孩子们喜欢在公园里吹肥皂泡。

lemmas.def_en: a public fountain to provide a jet of drinking water
lemmas.def_zh: 饮用喷泉

examples.en: The thirsty children lined up by the school bubbler after gym class ended.
examples.zh: 体育课结束后，口渴的孩子们在学校的饮用喷泉旁排起了长队。

lemmas.def_en: form, produce, or emit bubbles
lemmas.def_zh: v. 起泡；冒泡

examples.en: Children love blowing soap bubbles in the park.
examples.zh: 孩子们喜欢在公园里吹肥皂泡。

lemmas.def_zh: 多泡的, 起泡的
lemmas.def_en: emitting or filled with bubbles as from carbonation or fermentation

examples.en: She poured a glass of cold, bubbly champagne to celebrate the unexpected promotion.
examples.zh: 她倒了一杯冰凉起泡的香槟，以庆祝这次意外的升职。

family_guide.root_logic: 拟声词，模拟水泡破裂或沸腾的声音，指气泡或产生气泡。

lemmas.def_en: strike or drive against with a heavy impact
lemmas.def_zh: v. 猛撞，猛击；塞紧

examples.en: The truck rammed into the back of a parked car.
examples.zh: 卡车猛烈撞上了一辆停放着的汽车的后部。

lemmas.def_en: a tool for driving something with force
lemmas.def_zh: 撞槌, 推弹器

examples.en: The construction workers used a heavy pneumatic rammer to compact the loose soil.
examples.zh: 建筑工人们使用重型气动捣固机压实松散的土壤。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自公羊（ram）用角猛力顶撞的行为，引申为猛击、撞击。

lemmas.def_en: specify as a condition or requirement in a contract or agreement; make an express demand or provision in an agreement
lemmas.def_zh: v. 具体说明，明确指出，详细列举

examples.en: Please specify your dietary requirements when booking.
examples.zh: 预订时请具体说明您的饮食要求。

lemmas.def_en: not stated explicitly or in detail
lemmas.def_zh: 未特别指出的, 未特别提到的

examples.en: The manager was suddenly dismissed from his position for an unspecified ethical violation.
examples.zh: 该经理因一项未明确指出的道德违规行为被突然解职。

lemmas.def_en: a detailed description of design criteria for a piece of work
lemmas.def_zh: n. 规格，说明书；详述，明确规定

examples.en: The engine was built to the client's exact specification.
examples.zh: 这台发动机是严格按照客户的规格要求制造的。

lemmas.def_en: someone who draws up specifications giving details (as for obtaining a patent)
lemmas.def_zh: 说明符；指示语；区分符

examples.en: In this programming language, a type specifier is required before every variable name.
examples.zh: 在这门编程语言中，每个变量名前都必须加上类型说明符。

family_guide.root_logic: 词根 spec-（看、外观）+ -ify（使……），指明确具体细节使之可见。

lemmas.def_en: engage in plotting or enter into a conspiracy, swear together
lemmas.def_zh: v. 密谋，图谋；合力促成（坏结果）

examples.en: They conspired to overthrow the government.
examples.zh: 他们密谋推翻政府。

lemmas.def_en: a secret agreement between two or more people to perform an unlawful act
lemmas.def_zh: n. 阴谋，密谋，共谋

examples.en: He was arrested on charges of criminal conspiracy.
examples.zh: 他因涉嫌刑事共谋而被捕。

lemmas.def_zh: 同谋者, 阴谋者, 反叛者
lemmas.def_en: a member of a conspiracy

examples.en: Police arrested another conspirator involved in the plot against the high-ranking official.
examples.zh: 警方逮捕了另一名参与密谋针对高级官员的同谋者。

lemmas.def_zh: 阴谋的, 阴谋者的
lemmas.def_en: relating to or characteristic of conspiracy or conspirators

examples.en: a conspiratorial whisper
the discovery of possible conspirative codes

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 con-（共同）+ spire（呼吸），本义“同呼吸”，引申为串通密谋。
family_guide.core_distinction: conspire 为动词；conspiracy 为其名词形式，指阴谋勾当。

lemmas.def_en: edible seeds or roots or stems or leaves or bulbs or tubers or nonsweet fruits of any of numerous herbaceous plant
lemmas.def_zh: n. 蔬菜；植物人

examples.en: Fresh fruit and vegetables are essential for a healthy diet.
examples.zh: 新鲜水果和蔬菜对健康饮食必不可少。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 vegetare（赋有活力、生长），原指有生命的植物，后专指蔬菜。

lemmas.def_en: female of domestic cattle:
lemmas.def_zh: n. 母牛，奶牛

examples.en: The farmer led the cow into the barn.
examples.zh: 农夫把母牛牵进了谷仓。

lemmas.def_en: a person who shows fear or timidity
lemmas.def_zh: 懦弱的人, 胆小的人

examples.en: He felt like a coward for running away instead of helping his injured friend.
examples.zh: 他觉得自己像个懦夫，在受伤的朋友面前选择了逃跑而不是相助。

lemmas.def_en: the trait of lacking courage
lemmas.def_zh: 懦弱, 胆怯

examples.en: His cowardliness during the unexpected crisis cost him the absolute respect of his entire team.
examples.zh: 他在突发危机中的懦弱让他彻底失去了整个团队的尊重。

lemmas.def_en: subdue, restrain, or overcome by affecting with a feeling of awe; frighten (as with threats)
lemmas.def_zh: v. 恐吓；威吓

examples.en: The farmer led the cow into the barn.
examples.zh: 农夫把母牛牵进了谷仓。

lemmas.def_zh: 畏缩, 退缩, 抖缩
lemmas.def_en: crouch or curl up

examples.en: The frightened puppy began to cower under the bed during the loud thunderstorm.
examples.zh: 在嘈杂的雷雨中，受到惊吓的小狗开始蜷缩在床底下。

lemmas.def_en: lacking courage; ignobly timid and faint-hearted; - P.B.Shelley
lemmas.def_zh: 怯懦的, 懦弱的；胆小的

examples.en: Running away from your responsibilities is a cowardly thing to do.
examples.zh: 逃避责任是一种怯懦的行为。

family_guide.root_logic: 名词为母牛；动词源自古诺尔斯语，指被恐吓得像牲畜般顺从。

lemmas.def_en: Englishman and Egyptologist who in 1922 discovered and excavated the tomb of Tutankhamen (1873-1939)
lemmas.def_zh: n. 赶大车的人，马车夫，运货工人

examples.en: The carter loaded heavy sacks of grain onto his wagon.
examples.zh: 车夫把沉重的粮食口袋装上大车。

lemmas.def_en: a heavy open wagon usually having two wheels and drawn by an animal
lemmas.def_zh: n. 手推车，大车；（商场等的）购物车

examples.en: He loaded the groceries into the cart and wheeled it away.
examples.zh: 他把食品杂货装进购物车并推走了。

lemmas.def_en: the work of taking something away in a cart or truck and disposing of it
lemmas.def_zh: 运输, 运费

examples.en: The final invoice includes an extra charge of fifty dollars for local cartage.
examples.zh: 最终发票包含五十美元的本地搬运运费。

lemmas.def_en: draw slowly or heavily
lemmas.def_zh: v. 艰难运送；慢拉

examples.en: He loaded the groceries into the cart and wheeled it away.
examples.zh: 他把食品杂货装进购物车并推走了。

family_guide.root_logic: cart（大车、手推车）+ -er（人），原指赶大车的人或货运车夫。

lemmas.def_en: a substance that is fluid at room temperature and pressure
lemmas.def_zh: n. 液体，流体

examples.en: Make sure you drink plenty of fluids when you have a cold.
examples.zh: 感冒时一定要多喝液体。

lemmas.def_en: the property of flowing easily
lemmas.def_zh: 流动性, 流质, 流状

examples.en: The dancer moved with impressive fluidity, shifting effortlessly between complex postures.
examples.zh: 舞者动作流畅自如，在复杂的姿势间轻松切换。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自 flu-（流动）+ -id（属性后缀），指具有流动性的物质。

lemmas.def_en: influence or control shrewdly or deviously
lemmas.def_zh: v. 熟练操作；操纵，摆布（他人或局势）

examples.en: He knew how to manipulate the media to his advantage.
examples.zh: 他知道如何利用和操纵媒体来为自己谋利。

lemmas.def_en: exerting shrewd or devious influence especially for one's own advantage
lemmas.def_zh: n. 操纵，控制；熟练操作

examples.en: The scandal revealed widespread manipulation of the stock market.
examples.zh: 这起丑闻揭露了对股票市场的广泛操纵。

lemmas.def_en: an agent that operates some apparatus or machine
lemmas.def_zh: 操作者, 机械手

examples.en: He is a skilled manipulator who easily convinces others to do his work.
examples.zh: 他是个老练的操控者，总能轻易说服别人替他干活。

lemmas.def_en: skillful in influencing or controlling others to your own advantage
lemmas.def_zh: 处理的, 巧妙处理的, 操纵的

examples.en: Her manipulative behavior slowly drove away all of her close friends.
examples.zh: 她爱操纵人的行为慢慢赶走了所有亲近的朋友。

lemmas.def_en: in an artfully manipulative manner
lemmas.def_zh: manipulative的变形

examples.en: He acted manipulatively to gain an unfair advantage in the negotiation.
examples.zh: 他在谈判中耍手段，以获取不公平的优势。

family_guide.root_logic: 词根 mani-（手）+ pul-（充满、操作），原指用手操作，引申为暗中操控、操纵。
family_guide.core_distinction: manipulate 为动词；manipulation 为其动作或状态的名词形式。

lemmas.def_en: move faster
lemmas.def_zh: v. 加速，促进

examples.en: The government plans to accelerate the pace of economic reforms.
examples.zh: 政府计划加快经济改革的步伐。

lemmas.def_en: an increase in rate of change
lemmas.def_zh: n. 加速，加速度

examples.en: The sports car boasts impressive acceleration, going from zero to sixty in three seconds.
examples.zh: 这辆跑车拥有惊人的加速度，三秒内即可破百。

lemmas.def_en: a pedal that controls the throttle valve
lemmas.def_zh: 加速剂, 加速器, 油门

examples.en: She pressed down on the accelerator and the car surged forward instantly.
examples.zh: 她踩下油门，汽车瞬间向前飞驰而去。

lemmas.def_en: tending to increase velocity
lemmas.def_zh: 加速的, 促进的

examples.en: The new economic policy had an accelerative effect on local job creation.
examples.zh: 这项新经济政策对当地就业的创造起到了加速促进作用。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 celer（快），前缀 ad- 表示加强或方向，核心语义为“加快、加速”。
family_guide.core_distinction: accelerate 是动词表示加速；acceleration 是其名词形式，指加速行为或物理学上的加速度。

lemmas.def_en: having no personal preference
lemmas.def_zh: adj. 中立的；中性的 /

examples.en: Switzerland remained neutral during both World Wars.
examples.zh: 瑞士在两次世界大战期间都保持中立。

lemmas.def_en: one who does not side with any party in a war or dispute
lemmas.def_zh: n. 中立国；空档

examples.en: Switzerland remained neutral during both World Wars.
examples.zh: 瑞士在两次世界大战期间都保持中立。

lemmas.def_en: nonparticipation in a dispute or war
lemmas.def_zh: n. 中立，中立状态

examples.en: The country has pledged to maintain its armed neutrality.
examples.zh: 该国承诺保持武装中立。

lemmas.def_zh: 中立主义者
lemmas.def_en: an advocate of neutrality in international affairs

examples.en: During the fierce debate, the seasoned diplomat remained a neutralist, refusing to take sides.
examples.zh: 在激烈的辩论中，这位经验丰富的外交官保持中立，拒绝偏向任何一方。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 neuter（既非此亦非彼），核心语义为“不偏不倚的、中间状态的”。

lemmas.def_en: a rocket carrying a warhead of conventional or nuclear explosives; may be ballistic or directed by remote control
lemmas.def_zh: n. 导弹，投掷物

examples.en: The military successfully intercepted the incoming missile.
examples.zh: 军方成功拦截了来袭的导弹。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 mittere（投掷、发射），核心语义为“被投射出去的武器”。

lemmas.def_en: a base hit at which the batter stops safely at third base
lemmas.def_zh: n. 三倍数；三垒安打

examples.en: The company aims to triple its revenue over the next five years.
examples.zh: 该公司旨在未来五年内将营收增加至三倍。

lemmas.def_zh: 三个相似物之一, 一式三份(中之一), 三倍
lemmas.def_en: one of three copies; any of three things that correspond to one another exactly

examples.en: Please sign all three copies so each party receives an official triplicate.
examples.zh: 请在三份副本上都签字，以便每方各持一份正式副本。

lemmas.def_en: increase threefold
lemmas.def_zh: v. 增至三倍 /

examples.en: The company aims to triple its revenue over the next five years.
examples.zh: 该公司旨在未来五年内将营收增加至三倍。

lemmas.def_en: having three units or components or elements
lemmas.def_zh: adj. 三倍的 /

examples.en: The company aims to triple its revenue over the next five years.
examples.zh: 该公司旨在未来五年内将营收增加至三倍。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 triplus，由 tri-（三）和 plicare（折叠）构成，核心语义为“三倍的、由三个部分组成的”。

lemmas.def_en: dazzlingly beautiful
lemmas.def_zh: adj. 极其漂亮的，华丽的，极好的

examples.en: She looked absolutely gorgeous in her wedding dress.
examples.zh: 她穿着婚纱看起来美艳动人。

lemmas.def_en: in an impressively beautiful manner
lemmas.def_zh: 华美地；辉煌地

examples.en: The grand ballroom was gorgeously decorated with fresh flowers and crystal chandeliers.
examples.zh: 宏伟的宴会厅装饰得十分华美，摆满了鲜花和水晶吊灯。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古法语 gorgias（华丽的、优雅的），最初与颈部装饰有关，核心语义演变为“极其漂亮的、华丽的”。

lemmas.def_en: the main organ of photosynthesis and transpiration in higher plants
lemmas.def_zh: n. 叶子；（书的）一张 /

examples.en: I sat in the waiting room, leafing through an old magazine.
examples.zh: 我坐在候诊室里，随手翻阅着一本旧杂志。

lemmas.def_zh: 小叶, 传单
lemmas.def_en: a thin triangular flap of a heart valve

examples.en: Volunteers handed out a leaflet about the upcoming community charity event.
examples.zh: 志愿者们分发了一份关于即将举行的社区慈善活动的传单。

lemmas.def_en: look through a book or other written material
lemmas.def_zh: v. 翻阅

examples.en: I sat in the waiting room, leafing through an old magazine.
examples.zh: 我坐在候诊室里，随手翻阅着一本旧杂志。

lemmas.def_en: having or covered with leaves
lemmas.def_zh: 叶茂盛的, 多叶的, 叶状的

examples.en: They enjoyed a quiet stroll through the leafy streets of the old neighborhood.
examples.zh: 他们在那条绿树成荫的老街区街道上悠闲漫步。

lemmas.def_en: having no leaves
lemmas.def_zh: 无叶的

examples.en: The leafless branches of the trees looked stark against the cold winter sky.
examples.zh: 在清冷的冬日天空下，光秃秃的树枝显得格外苍凉。

family_guide.root_logic: 日耳曼语源，本义为植物的叶子，引申为书籍的“一页”，作动词时指“翻阅”。

lemmas.def_en: a collection of objects laid on top of each other
lemmas.def_zh: n. 一堆；桩 /

examples.en: He piled the dry wood neatly by the fireplace.
examples.zh: 他把干木柴整齐地堆在壁炉旁。

lemmas.def_en: a column of wood or steel or concrete that is driven into the ground to provide support for a structure
lemmas.def_zh: n. 桩，桩基，打桩工程

examples.en: Steel piling was driven deep into the riverbed to support the bridge.
examples.zh: 钢桩被深深打入河床以支撑桥梁。

lemmas.def_en: arrange in stacks
lemmas.def_zh: v. 堆积，叠放

examples.en: He piled the dry wood neatly by the fireplace.
examples.zh: 他把干木柴整齐地堆在壁炉旁。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 pila（柱子、石墩），一脉演变为“打入地下的桩”，另一脉演变为“堆叠在一起的物体”。
family_guide.core_distinction: pile 作名词常指一堆东西或单根桩；piling 专指工程中成批打入地下的打桩基础或板桩结构。

lemmas.def_en: soft silky fibers from cotton plants in their raw state
lemmas.def_zh: n. 棉花，棉布 /

examples.en: It took him a while to cotton on to what they were really doing.
examples.zh: 他过了好一会儿才明白他们到底在干什么。

lemmas.def_en: take a liking to
lemmas.def_zh: v. 领悟；讨好（常与 to/on 连用）

examples.en: It took him a while to cotton on to what they were really doing.
examples.zh: 他过了好一会儿才明白他们到底在干什么。

lemmas.def_en: resembling cotton; as soft as cotton
lemmas.def_zh: 象棉样的, 起毛的, 柔软的

examples.en: Soft, cottony clouds drifted lazily across the bright blue afternoon sky.
examples.zh: 柔软如棉的白云在晴朗的午后蓝天中缓缓飘过。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自阿拉伯语 quṭn，本义指棉花，引申动词短语 cotton to/on 表示“理解”或“喜欢上”。

lemmas.def_en: an established ceremony prescribed by a religion
lemmas.def_zh: n. （宗教等）仪式，典礼

examples.en: The tribe performs ancient rites to mark the arrival of spring.
examples.zh: 该部落举行古老的仪式来庆祝春天的到来。

lemmas.def_en: any customary observance or practice
lemmas.def_zh: n. 仪式，例行公事，老规矩

examples.en: Morning coffee has become an essential daily ritual for her.
examples.zh: 早晨喝咖啡已成为她日常生活中不可或缺的例行习惯。

lemmas.def_en: in a ceremonial manner
lemmas.def_zh: 按照仪式地

examples.en: The monks ritually chanted ancient verses before beginning their daily morning meal.
examples.zh: 僧侣们在开始每日晨餐前，都会按规程念诵古老的经文。

lemmas.def_en: make or evolve into a ritual
lemmas.def_zh: 使仪式化

examples.en: Families often ritualize holiday traditions to help strengthen their emotional bonds.
examples.zh: 家庭通常会将节日传统仪式化，以此来增进彼此的情感。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 ritus（宗教仪式、惯例），核心语义为“固定规范的仪式”。
family_guide.core_distinction: rite 侧重于具有宗教或传统意义的“典礼、仪式”（如成人礼）；ritual 既指仪式本身，也可泛指日常刻板的“例行习惯、程序”。

lemmas.def_en: that which is perceived or known or inferred to have its own distinct existence (living or nonliving)
lemmas.def_zh: n. 实体，独立存在体

examples.en: The two companies will merge to form a single commercial entity.
examples.zh: 两家公司将合并为一个独立的商业实体。

lemmas.def_en: the state of not existing
lemmas.def_zh: 不存在, 非实在, 虚无

examples.en: He felt like a complete nonentity at the massive corporate headquarters.
examples.zh: 在庞大的公司总部里，他觉得自己完全是个微不足道的人。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 ens（存在，esse 的现在分词），核心语义为“客观存在的独立实体”。

lemmas.def_en: small Old World songbird with a reddish breast
lemmas.def_zh: n. 知更鸟，欧亚鸲

examples.en: A robin perched on the fence, singing a cheerful tune.
examples.zh: 一只知更鸟落在篱笆上，欢快地鸣叫着。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自法语人名 Robin（Robert 的昵称），后拟人化用于指代胸部呈红褐色的知更鸟。

lemmas.def_en: get rid of
lemmas.def_zh: v. 脱落，摆脱，流出（眼泪、血）

examples.en: Trees shed their leaves in autumn to conserve water.
examples.zh: 树木在秋天落叶以保持水分。

lemmas.def_zh: 使流出, 放射, 脱落, 散发, 摆脱；流出, 散布, 脱落

examples.en: The dog had shedded a noticeable amount of fur on the living room rug.
examples.zh: 这只狗在客厅的地毯上脱落了大量明显的毛发。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 scādan（分开、驱逐），核心语义为“脱落、脱去、流出”。

lemmas.def_en: drop a hint; intimate by a hint
lemmas.def_zh: v. 暗示，示意

examples.en: He hinted that major changes were coming to the management team.
examples.zh: 他暗示管理团队即将发生重大变动。

lemmas.def_zh: n. 暗示，提示；微量，少许
lemmas.def_en: a slight or indirect indication or suggestion; a very small amount of something
lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，常与 of 连用表示微量或少许迹象，如 a hint of a smile（一丝微笑）。

examples.en: He dropped a broad hint that he would be leaving the company soon.
examples.zh: 他明确暗示自己很快就会离开公司。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 hentan（抓住），引申为用间接的话语让人“抓住”线索，核心语义为“暗示”。

lemmas.def_en: the passage to the stomach and lungs; in the front part of the neck below the chin and above the collarbone
lemmas.def_zh: n. 喉咙，咽喉

examples.en: She cleared her throat before beginning her speech.
examples.zh: 她在开始演讲前清了清嗓子。

lemmas.def_en: sounding as if pronounced low in the throat
lemmas.def_zh: 喉音的, 嘶哑的

examples.en: She answered the phone with a low, throaty voice after just waking up.
examples.zh: 刚睡醒的她用低沉微哑的嗓音接听了电话。

family_guide.root_logic: 日耳曼语源，指连接口腔和胃或肺部的通道，核心语义为“喉咙、咽喉”。

lemmas.def_en: the heading or caption of a newspaper article
lemmas.def_zh: n. 大字标题，头条新闻 /

examples.en: The scandal made headlines around the world.
examples.zh: 这起丑闻成为了世界各地的头条新闻。

lemmas.def_en: a performer who receives prominent billing
lemmas.def_zh: (报纸)写标题的记者

examples.en: The famous rock band was chosen as the main headliner for the festival.
examples.zh: 这支著名的摇滚乐队被选为该音乐节的领衔主打嘉宾。

lemmas.def_en: publicize widely or highly, as if with a headline
lemmas.def_zh: v. 给……加标题；担任主角

examples.en: The scandal made headlines around the world.
examples.zh: 这起丑闻成为了世界各地的头条新闻。

family_guide.root_logic: 复合词 head（头部）+ line（行），原指报纸页面顶部的加粗大字，引申为“头条新闻”或担任主角。

lemmas.def_en: a juvenile between the onset of puberty and maturity
lemmas.def_zh: 青少年（13至19岁）

examples.en: As a teenager, she spent hours listening to music.
examples.zh: 还是个青少年的时候，她会花几个小时听音乐。

family_guide.root_logic: 由表示十位数的teen与表示年龄的age及人称后缀-er构成，指13至19岁的青少年。

lemmas.def_en: a company emblem or device
lemmas.def_zh: 商标；标识；徽标

examples.en: The company redesigned its iconic logo last year.
examples.zh: 该公司去年重新设计了其标志性的商标。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语logos（言语、词），现代缩写自logotype，指代表品牌的标识图形。

lemmas.def_en: loss due to not showing up
lemmas.def_zh: 违约, 不履行责任, 缺席, 默认值

examples.en: If you forget your password, the system will revert to its default settings.
examples.zh: 如果你忘记了密码，系统将恢复至其默认设置。

lemmas.def_en: someone who fails to make a required appearance in court
lemmas.def_zh: 不履行义务者, 缺席者, 违反军规者

examples.en: The court sent a final warning notice to the persistent tax defaulter.
examples.zh: 法院向该长期拖欠税款者寄送了最后的警告通知。

lemmas.def_en: fail to pay up
lemmas.def_zh: 疏怠职责, 缺席, 拖欠, 默认

examples.en: If you forget your password, the system will revert to its default settings.
examples.zh: 如果你忘记了密码，系统将恢复至其默认设置。

family_guide.root_logic: 由de-（离开/缺乏）加fault（失败、欠缺）构成，核心指未履行义务或初始预设状态。

lemmas.def_zh: 写实主义, 现实, 实在论
lemmas.def_en: the attribute of accepting the facts of life and favoring practicality and literal truth

examples.en: The novel won praise for depicting working-class life with raw and honest realism.
examples.zh: 这部小说因以真实直接的现实主义手法描绘工人阶级生活而赢得赞誉。

lemmas.def_en: a philosopher who believes that universals are real and exist independently of anyone thinking of them
lemmas.def_zh: 现实主义者

examples.en: She is a realist who looks at problems objectively.
examples.zh: 她是一个客观审视问题的现实主义者。

lemmas.def_en: aware or expressing awareness of things as they really are
lemmas.def_zh: 现实的；实事求是的；逼真的

examples.en: We need to set realistic goals for this project.
examples.zh: 我们需要为这个项目设定现实可行的目标。

lemmas.def_en: not realistic
lemmas.def_zh: 不切实际的；虚幻的

examples.en: Expecting perfection from day one is unrealistic.
examples.zh: 指望从第一天起就十全十美是不切实际的。

lemmas.def_en: in a realistic manner
lemmas.def_zh: 写实地, 逼真地, 现实地

examples.en: Realistically speaking, we cannot finish this entire project within a single week.
examples.zh: 现实地讲，我们不可能在一周之内完成这整个项目。

lemmas.def_en: in an unrealistic manner
lemmas.def_zh: 不切实际地；不现实地

examples.en: The manager set unrealistically high targets that no one could possibly meet.
examples.zh: 经理设定了极不切实际的高目标，根本没人能够达成。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语res（事物），衍生出对客观事实的感知与描绘。
family_guide.core_distinction: realistic强调基于实际、现实可行的；unrealistic指不切实际的。

lemmas.def_en: a tube through which a bullet travels when a gun is fired
lemmas.def_zh: 桶

examples.en: Workers loaded a heavy wooden barrel of wine onto the delivery truck.
examples.zh: 工人们把一个沉重的木制葡萄酒桶搬上了送货卡车。

lemmas.def_en: put in barrels
lemmas.def_zh: 装入桶内

examples.en: Workers carefully barreled the freshly distilled whiskey for several years of aging.
examples.zh: 工人们小心地将新蒸馏的威士忌装入桶中陈酿数年。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自中世纪拉丁语，原指盛装液体的圆桶，引申为管状物及像失控桶般疾驰。

lemmas.def_en: a medium that disseminates moving pictures
lemmas.def_zh: 电影院；电影艺术

examples.en: She has a deep passion for Italian cinema.
examples.zh: 她对意大利电影艺术怀有极大的热情。

lemmas.def_en: of or pertaining to or characteristic of the cinema
lemmas.def_zh: 电影的；具有电影质感的

examples.en: The video game features stunning, cinematic visuals.
examples.zh: 这款电子游戏拥有令人惊叹的电影级视觉效果。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语kinema（运动），与电影放映和银幕艺术密切相关。
family_guide.core_distinction: cinema指电影艺术或电影院；cinematic指具有电影视听风格的。

lemmas.def_en: denoting a quantity consisting of 12 items or units
lemmas.def_zh: 十二；十二个

examples.en: There are twelve months in a year.
examples.zh: 一年有十二个月。

family_guide.root_logic: 古英语词，构词逻辑为“二剩余（超过十的二）”，即数字十二。

lemmas.def_en: be silly or tease one another
lemmas.def_zh: 开玩笑；戏弄；善意嘲弄

examples.en: Don't get upset; I was only joshing you.
examples.zh: 别生气，我只是跟你开个玩笑。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自美式俚语，词源不详，意为友好而轻松地开玩笑或取笑。

lemmas.def_zh: 应该；应当

examples.en: You ought to see a doctor about that persistent cough.
examples.zh: 你那咳嗽老是不好，应该去看看医生。

family_guide.root_logic: 古英语中owe（拥有、欠）的过去式，演变为表达义务、责任或合理推断的情态动词。

lemmas.def_en: a game played with rackets by two or four players who hit a ball back and forth over a net that divides the court
lemmas.def_zh: 网球；网球运动

examples.en: They played a game of tennis this afternoon.
examples.zh: 他们今天下午打了一场网球。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古法语tenez（接球！），为发球时的警告呼喊，后发展为网球运动。

lemmas.def_en: a geological formation consisting of an underground enclosure with access from the surface of the ground or from the sea
lemmas.def_zh: 洞, 穴

examples.en: Hikers found shelter in a dark cave when the sudden storm struck.
examples.zh: 暴风雨骤降时，徒步旅行者在一个黑暗的山洞里找到了庇护所。

lemmas.def_en: hollow out as if making a cave or opening
lemmas.def_zh: 凹陷, 塌落；挖洞, 使凹陷, 损坏...的基础

examples.en: Hikers found shelter in a dark cave when the sudden storm struck.
examples.zh: 暴风雨骤降时，徒步旅行者在一个黑暗的山洞里找到了庇护所。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语cavus（空洞），既指天然岩洞，也引申为因压力而塌陷或屈服。

lemmas.def_en: give, sell, or transfer to another
lemmas.def_zh: 处理；布置；使倾向于

examples.en: Man proposes, God disposes.
examples.zh: 谋事在人，成事在天。

lemmas.def_en: the power to use something or someone
lemmas.def_zh: 丢弃；清理；处置权

examples.en: The safe disposal of radioactive waste remains a challenge.
examples.zh: 放射性废物的安全处置仍是一个难题。

lemmas.def_en: your usual mood
lemmas.def_zh: 性情, 处置, 处理, 布置

examples.en: Her cheerful disposition always brings positive energy to the entire office team.
examples.zh: 她开朗的性情总是为整个办公室团队带来正能量。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀dis-（分开、有秩序地）加pose（放置），引申出安排、处理及清除等义。
family_guide.core_distinction: dispose为动词，常见搭配为dispose of（处理、扔掉）；disposal为名词，指清除、支配权。

lemmas.def_en: relating to the condition of immunity
lemmas.def_zh: 免疫的；免受影响的；免除的

examples.en: No one is immune to criticism.
examples.zh: 没有人能免受批评。

lemmas.def_en: the state of not being susceptible
lemmas.def_zh: 免疫力；豁免权

examples.en: Vaccines help build immunity against deadly viruses.
examples.zh: 疫苗有助于建立对致命病毒的免疫力。

family_guide.root_logic: 拉丁语前缀im-（免除）加munis（职责、公共义务），原指免税免赋，引申为免除疾病或侵害。
family_guide.core_distinction: immune为形容词（免疫的、免受影响的）；immunity为名词（免疫力、豁免权）。

lemmas.def_en: causing inconvenience
lemmas.def_zh: 笨拙的；令人尴尬的

examples.en: There was an awkward silence after his blunt remark.
examples.zh: 他直言不讳的话说完后，现场陷入了一阵尴尬的沉默。

lemmas.def_en: in an awkward manner
lemmas.def_zh: 笨拙地；无技巧地

examples.en: He bumped into the podium awkwardly as he walked up to speak.
examples.zh: 他走上台准备发言时笨拙地撞到了讲台上。

lemmas.def_en: unskillfulness resulting from a lack of training
lemmas.def_zh: 笨拙, 不熟练, 不灵活, 不好使, 麻烦, 使用不便, 难处理, 尴尬, 棘手, 难应付

examples.en: A few casual jokes quickly cleared the initial awkwardness between the strangers.
examples.zh: 几句随意的玩笑很快消除了陌生人之间最初的尴尬与生疏。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古诺斯语 afgr（偏离、不利的）+ 后缀 -ward（朝向），核心义为“笨拙的、不顺的”。

lemmas.def_en: cause to become
lemmas.def_zh: 使成为；给予；翻译；表现

examples.en: The sudden shock rendered him completely speechless.
examples.zh: 突如其来的打击让他完全说不出话来。

lemmas.def_en: a performance of a musical composition or a dramatic role etc.
lemmas.def_zh: 表现；演奏；翻译；渲染图

examples.en: The artist produced an impressive 3D rendering of the new museum.
examples.zh: 艺术家制作了这座新博物馆令人印象深刻的3D效果图。

lemmas.def_zh: 译文, 施舍, 表演
lemmas.def_en: a performance of a musical composition or a dramatic role etc.

examples.en: Her soulful rendition of the classic song moved the entire audience to tears.
examples.zh: 她对这首经典歌曲深情款款的演绎让全场观众感动落泪。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 reddere（归还、给予），演变为使成为某种状态、呈现或提供。

lemmas.def_en: be behind; approve of
lemmas.def_zh: 赞同；支持；代言（产品）；背书

examples.en: The former president officially endorsed the candidate yesterday.
examples.zh: 前总统昨天正式公开支持这位候选人。

lemmas.def_en: a promotional statement (as found on the dust jackets of books)
lemmas.def_zh: 支持；代言；背书

examples.en: The celebrity endorsement boosted the brand's sales significantly.
examples.zh: 明星代言极大地提升了该品牌的销量。

lemmas.def_en: someone who expresses strong approval
lemmas.def_zh: 背书人, 转让人

examples.en: The check cannot be cashed until the endorser signs on the back.
examples.zh: 在背书人于背面签字之前，这张支票无法兑现。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 indorsare（背书，in- + dorsum 背部），引申为公开支持或代言。

lemmas.def_en: a public area set aside as a pedestrian walk
lemmas.def_zh: 大型购物中心；林荫街

examples.en: The local mall was packed with shoppers on Christmas Eve.
examples.zh: 平安夜那天，当地的购物中心挤满了购物的人。

family_guide.root_logic: 原指打木球的游戏草坪（Pall-mall），后演变为林荫步道，现专指大型购物中心。

lemmas.def_en: informal term for information
lemmas.def_zh: （口语）代，世代；（英俚）情报，真实信息

examples.en: He gave us the lowdown and gen on the new company policy.
examples.zh: 他向我们透露了公司新政策的内幕和真实信息。

lemmas.def_en: family based on male descent
lemmas.def_zh: 氏族, 宗族, 部落

examples.en: Historians analyzed how power was distributed across each ancient Roman gens.
examples.zh: 历史学家分析了古罗马各个氏族之间是如何分配权力的。

family_guide.root_logic: generation 的口语缩写（如 Gen Z），或 intelligence 的英式俚语缩写（信息、内幕）。

lemmas.def_en: emanating from God; ; ; -Saturday Review
lemmas.def_zh: 神的, 神圣的, 非凡的

examples.en: The ancient Greeks built grand temples to seek divine protection and wisdom.
examples.zh: 古希腊人建造宏伟的神庙以寻求神圣的保护与智慧。

lemmas.def_zh: 占卜的, 预见的, 预言的
lemmas.def_en: resembling or characteristic of a prophet or prophecy

examples.en: Ancient shamans cast carved bones on the ground for mysterious divinatory ceremonies.
examples.zh: 古代萨满将刻有符文的兽骨掷在地上，进行神秘的占卜仪式。

lemmas.def_en: any supernatural being worshipped as controlling some part of the world or some aspect of life or who is the personification of a force
lemmas.def_zh: 神, 神性

examples.en: Scholars debated whether the ancient monarch claimed true divinity during his reign.
examples.zh: 学者们争论这位古代君王在统治期间是否自诩拥有真正的神性。

lemmas.def_en: successful conjecture by unusual insight or good luck
lemmas.def_zh: 占卜, 卜卦, 预测

examples.en: Ancient priests used bone cracks as a method of divination before battle.
examples.zh: 古代祭司在战前利用骨头上的裂纹作为占卜的方法。

lemmas.def_en: by divine means
lemmas.def_zh: 象神一样地, 凭神的力量, 极度地

examples.en: The dessert was divinely rich, satisfying everyone at the dinner table completely.
examples.zh: 这道甜点极其浓郁美味，让餐桌上的每个人都无比满足。

lemmas.def_en: perceive intuitively or through some inexplicable perceptive powers

examples.en: The ancient Greeks built grand temples to seek divine protection and wisdom.
examples.zh: 古希腊人建造宏伟的神庙以寻求神圣的保护与智慧。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 divus（神），核心义与神相关，作动词时引申为“占卜、领悟”。
family_guide.core_distinction: divine (adj.) 指神圣的；divine (v.) 指推测、预知。

lemmas.def_en: be amazed at
lemmas.def_zh: 惊叹；感到惊异

examples.en: Visitors marvel at the intricate architecture of the ancient temple.
examples.zh: 游客们对这座古老寺庙错综复杂的建筑惊叹不已。

lemmas.def_en: extraordinarily good or great ; used especially as intensifiers
lemmas.def_zh: 极好的；绝妙的；不可思议的

examples.en: We had a marvelous time during our vacation in Italy.
examples.zh: 我们在意大利度假期间度过了一段美妙的时光。

lemmas.def_en: (used as an intensifier) extremely well
lemmas.def_zh: 令人惊讶地, 不可思议地, 妙极地

examples.en: The new musical performed marvelously, receiving a standing ovation from the audience.
examples.zh: 这部新音乐剧演得妙极了，赢得了全场观众的起立鼓掌。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 mirari（惊异、惊叹），表示对不可思议之事的惊叹。

lemmas.def_en: to believe especially on uncertain or tentative grounds
lemmas.def_zh: 推测；投机买卖

examples.en: Scientists speculate that life may once have existed on Mars.
examples.zh: 科学家推测火星上曾经可能存在生命。

lemmas.def_en: a message expressing an opinion based on incomplete evidence
lemmas.def_zh: 推测；投机活动

examples.en: Her sudden resignation sparked intense media speculation.
examples.zh: 她的突然辞职引发了媒体的强烈推测。

lemmas.def_en: someone who makes conjectures without knowing the facts
lemmas.def_zh: 投机者, 投机商人, 思索者

examples.en: The real estate speculator made a huge profit by flipping properties quickly.
examples.zh: 那个房地产投机商通过迅速倒卖房产赚取了巨额利润。

lemmas.def_en: not financially safe or secure
lemmas.def_zh: 推测性的；投机性的

examples.en: The stock market fell amid a wave of speculative buying.
examples.zh: 在一波投机性买入后，股市出现下跌。

lemmas.def_en: with speculation; in a speculative manner
lemmas.def_zh: 思考地, 思索地; 投机地

examples.en: The detective looked speculatively at the broken window, considering every possible scenario.
examples.zh: 侦探若有所思地看着破损的窗户，思考着每一种可能的场景。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 specere（看、观察），引申为“推测、揣摩”及商业上的“投机”。
family_guide.core_distinction: speculation 为抽象名词（推测/投机）；speculative 为对应形容词。

lemmas.def_en: express strong disapproval of
lemmas.def_zh: 谴责；判刑；宣告（建筑物）为危房

examples.en: World leaders were quick to condemn the terrorist attack.
examples.zh: 各国领导人迅速对该恐怖袭击表示谴责。

lemmas.def_en: an expression of strong disapproval; pronouncing as wrong or morally culpable
lemmas.def_zh: 谴责；定罪

examples.en: The harsh policy drew widespread condemnation from the public.
examples.zh: 这一严苛政策招致了公众的广泛谴责。

lemmas.def_zh: 非难的, 处罚的
lemmas.def_en: containing or imposing condemnation or censure

examples.en: The panel issued a severely condemnatory report following their investigation into police misconduct.
examples.zh: 调查小组在调查警察不端行为后发布了一份严厉谴责的报告。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 condemnare（判罪、定罪），引申为严厉谴责或宣布不可使用。

lemmas.def_en: fearless and daring
lemmas.def_zh: 勇敢的；大胆的；黑体的，粗体的

examples.en: Taking that entrepreneurial leap was a bold career move.
examples.zh: 迈出创业这一步是职业生涯中一个大胆的举动。

lemmas.def_en: with boldness, in a bold manner
lemmas.def_zh: 大胆地, 显眼地

examples.en: The young entrepreneur boldly pitched her radical idea to the skeptical investors.
examples.zh: 这位年轻的企业家大胆地向持怀疑态度的投资者推介了自己的激进想法。

lemmas.def_en: the trait of being willing to undertake things that involve risk or danger
lemmas.def_zh: 大胆, 勇敢, 冒失

examples.en: Her boldness in questioning the company policy earned respect from her peers.
examples.zh: 她敢于质疑公司政策的魄力赢得了同事们的尊重。

family_guide.root_logic: 日耳曼语源，原义为“勇敢的、自信的”，引申为粗体的、醒目的。

lemmas.def_en: transfer a file or program to a central computer from a smaller computer or a computer at a remote location
lemmas.def_zh: 上传（数据或文件）

examples.en: It took nearly an hour to upload the high-resolution video.
examples.zh: 上传那个高分辨率视频花了近一个小时。

family_guide.root_logic: 由 up（向上）+ load（装载）合成，指将数据从本地计算机上传至远程网络。

lemmas.def_en: enter upon an activity or enterprise
lemmas.def_zh: 承担；着手做；承诺

examples.en: The university agreed to undertake the feasibility study.
examples.zh: 该大学同意承担这项可行性研究。

lemmas.def_en: enter upon an activity or enterprise
lemmas.def_zh: 承担；着手做（undertake的过去分词）

examples.en: The project undertaken by the team has yielded promising results.
examples.zh: 该团队承担的项目已经取得了可观的成果。

lemmas.def_en: enter upon an activity or enterprise
lemmas.def_zh: 承担；着手做（undertake的过去式）

examples.en: She undertook the challenging task without any hesitation.
examples.zh: 她毫不犹豫地承担了这项艰巨的任务。

lemmas.def_en: any piece of work that is undertaken or attempted
lemmas.def_zh: 事业；任务；许诺

examples.en: Building the cross-sea bridge was a massive financial undertaking.
examples.zh: 修建跨海大桥是一项耗资巨大的工程。

family_guide.root_logic: 由 under（在...之下）+ take（承接）构成，原指“将任务承担到自己肩下”，即承担、着手。
family_guide.core_distinction: undertake/undertook/undertaken 为动词各时态；undertaking 为名词形式。

lemmas.def_en: a slender and greatly elongated substance capable of being spun into yarn
lemmas.def_zh: 纤维；光纤；品格（美式拼法）

examples.en: A diet rich in dietary fiber promotes good digestive health.
examples.zh: 富含膳食纤维的饮食有助于消化健康。

lemmas.def_en: a slender and greatly elongated substance capable of being spun into yarn
lemmas.def_zh: 纤维；光纤；品格（英式拼法）

examples.en: High-speed optical fibre networks are now available nationwide.
examples.zh: 高速光纤网络现已覆盖全国。

lemmas.def_zh: 纤维的, 纤维性的
lemmas.def_en: having or resembling fibers especially fibers used in making cordage such as those of jute

examples.en: Broccoli and beans are fibrous vegetables that help keep your digestive system healthy.
examples.zh: 西兰花和豆类是富含纤维的蔬菜，有助于保持消化系统健康。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 fibra（细丝、纤维），现代英语中美式拼法为 fiber，英式拼法为 fibre。
family_guide.core_distinction: fiber 与 fibre 仅为美英拼写差异，语义完全一致。

lemmas.def_en: make a copy or equivalent of
lemmas.def_zh: 繁殖；复制；再现

examples.en: Most bacteria reproduce rapidly in warm, moist environments.
examples.zh: 大多数细菌在温暖潮湿的环境中会迅速繁殖。

lemmas.def_en: producing new life or offspring
lemmas.def_zh: 生殖的；繁殖的

examples.en: Pesticides may cause damage to the human reproductive system.
examples.zh: 杀虫剂可能会对人类的生殖系统造成损害。

lemmas.def_en: the process of generating offspring
lemmas.def_zh: 繁殖；生殖；复制品

examples.en: The painting in the hallway is a reproduction, not the original.
examples.zh: 走廊里的那幅画是复制品，不是原件。

family_guide.root_logic: 由 re-（再次）+ produce（生产）构成，核心义为“再次生产”，引申为繁衍或复制。
family_guide.core_distinction: reproductive 为形容词（生殖的/复制的）；reproduction 为名词（繁殖/复制品）。

lemmas.def_en: a rude expression intended to offend or hurt
lemmas.def_zh: 侮辱, 无礼, 损害

examples.en: His sarcastic remark was perceived as a direct insult to the host.
examples.zh: 他讽刺的言辞被认为是对主人的直接侮辱。

lemmas.def_en: treat, mention, or speak to rudely
lemmas.def_zh: 损害, 侮辱, 攻击

examples.en: His sarcastic remark was perceived as a direct insult to the host.
examples.zh: 他讽刺的言辞被认为是对主人的直接侮辱。

lemmas.def_en: in a disrespectful and insulting manner
lemmas.def_zh: 侮辱地, 无礼地

examples.en: The clerk dismissed the customer insultingly, leading to an immediate formal complaint.
examples.zh: 店员极其无礼地打发了顾客，导致了随即而来的正式投诉。

lemmas.def_zh: adj. 侮辱性的，无礼的
lemmas.def_en: disrespectful or rude; expressing extreme contempt
lemmas.usage_note: 常用于修饰言辞、行为、态度等，如 insulting remarks/behavior。

examples.en: She found his comments deeply insulting and refused to speak to him.
examples.zh: 她觉得他的话极具侮辱性，并拒绝再同他说话。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 insultare（跳到…身上、嘲弄），引申为言语或行为上的冒犯、侮辱。

lemmas.def_en: the official name of some states in the United States (Massachusetts and Pennsylvania and Virginia and Kentucky) and associated territories (Puerto Rico)
lemmas.def_zh: 共和国；联邦；国民整体

examples.en: Member states gathered to discuss economic cooperation across the entire global commonwealth.
examples.zh: 各成员国齐聚一堂，探讨整个英联邦范围内的经济合作。

family_guide.root_logic: 由 common（公共的）+ wealth（福祉、财富）构成，本义为“大众福祉”，引申为联邦或联合体。

lemmas.def_en: a dark region of considerable extent on the surface of the moon
lemmas.def_zh: 玛丽亚（女名）

examples.en: Maria decided to pursue a degree in computer science at the university.
examples.zh: 玛丽亚决定在大学攻读计算机科学学位。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 mare（海洋）的复数形式，天文学上指月球等天体表面低洼平坦的暗区（月海）。

lemmas.def_en: (microbiology) single-celled or noncellular spherical or spiral or rod-shaped organisms lacking chlorophyll that reproduce by fission; important as pathogens and for biochemical properties; taxonomy is difficult; often considered to be plants
lemmas.def_zh: 细菌

examples.en: Scientists identified a rare bacterium that can survive in extreme volcanic heat.
examples.zh: 科学家发现了一种能在火山极端高温下生存的罕见细菌。

lemmas.def_en: (microbiology) single-celled or noncellular spherical or spiral or rod-shaped organisms lacking chlorophyll that reproduce by fission; important as pathogens and for biochemical properties; taxonomy is difficult; often considered to be plants
lemmas.def_zh: [医] 细菌, [无芽胞]杆菌

examples.en: Regular handwashing effectively prevents harmful bacteria from spreading among family members.
examples.zh: 经常洗手能有效防止有害细菌在家庭成员之间传播。

lemmas.def_en: relating to or caused by bacteria
lemmas.def_zh: 细菌的

examples.en: The doctor prescribed antibiotics to treat her severe bacterial infection.
examples.zh: 医生开了抗生素来治疗她的严重细菌感染。

lemmas.def_en: by bacteria
lemmas.def_zh: bactiterial的变形

examples.en: The drinking water was found to be bacterially contaminated after the flood.
examples.zh: 洪水过后，饮用水被发现受到了细菌污染。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 bakterion（小棍子），最初在显微镜下观察到的细菌多呈杆状，后泛指细菌。
family_guide.core_distinction: bacterium 为单数形式，bacteria 既是其规则复数，现代英语中也常作不可数集合名词使用。

lemmas.def_en: a system of timekeeping that defines the beginning and length and divisions of the year
lemmas.def_zh: 日历, 日程表

examples.en: She marked the important meeting date on her wall calendar.
examples.zh: 她在墙上的日历上标出了重要会议的日期。

lemmas.def_en: enter into a calendar
lemmas.def_zh: 列入表中

examples.en: She marked the important meeting date on her wall calendar.
examples.zh: 她在墙上的日历上标出了重要会议的日期。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 kalendarium（账本），因罗马人每月初一（Kalendae）结账算利息，引申为记录日期的日历、日程。

lemmas.def_en: painstakingly careful and accurate
lemmas.def_zh: 十分的, 彻底的

examples.en: The police conducted a thorough investigation into the sudden disappearance.
examples.zh: 警方对这起离奇失踪案展开了彻底的调查。

lemmas.def_en: in an exhaustive manner
lemmas.def_zh: 彻底地, 绝对地, 透彻地, 详尽地, 周到地, 完全地, 完善地, 全面地

examples.en: Make sure you read the contract thoroughly before signing your name.
examples.zh: 签字前请务必把合同彻底仔细地读一遍。

lemmas.def_en: conscientiousness in performing all aspects of a task
lemmas.def_zh: 十分, 完全；彻底

examples.en: Her thoroughness in preparing the financial report impressed the entire board.
examples.zh: 她在准备财务报告时的严谨周到给整个董事会留下了深刻印象。

family_guide.root_logic: 古英语中与 through（穿过）同源，引申为“从头穿到尾”，即彻底的、全面的。

lemmas.def_en: either of two saclike respiratory organs in the chest of vertebrates; serves to remove carbon dioxide and provide oxygen to the blood
lemmas.def_zh: 肺, 肺脏, 空地

examples.en: Smoking can cause serious long-term damage to your lung capacity.
examples.zh: 吸烟会对你的肺活量造成严重的长期损害。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自日耳曼语系，本义为“轻的器官”（因肺部充满空气能浮在水上），专指呼吸器官。

lemmas.def_en: a solid substance in the form of tiny loose particles; a solid that has been pulverized
lemmas.def_zh: 粉, 粉末, 火药

examples.en: She gently dusted some baby powder over her hands to stay dry.
examples.zh: 她在手上轻轻扑了些婴儿爽身粉以保持干爽。

lemmas.def_en: make into a powder by breaking up or cause to become dust
lemmas.def_zh: 搽粉于, 搽粉, 撒粉, 使成粉末；搽粉, 变成粉末

examples.en: She gently dusted some baby powder over her hands to stay dry.
examples.zh: 她在手上轻轻扑了些婴儿爽身粉以保持干爽。

lemmas.def_en: consisting of fine particles
lemmas.def_zh: 粉的, 粉状的

examples.en: The fresh snow on the mountain was dry, light, and powdery.
examples.zh: 山上的新雪干燥、轻盈且呈粉末状。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 pulvis（灰尘、粉末），指研磨成细碎的固体微粒。

lemmas.def_en: relating to or used in or promoting agriculture or farming
lemmas.def_zh: 农业的

examples.en: New technology has greatly improved agricultural production across the rural region.
examples.zh: 新技术极大地提高了该农村地区的农业生产效率。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 agricultura（ager 田地 + cultura 耕作），意指与农业、农耕相关。

lemmas.def_en: of the relatively near future
lemmas.def_zh: 即将来临的, 即将出现的

examples.en: The students are studying hard for the upcoming final exams next week.
examples.zh: 学生们正在为下周即将到来的期末考试努力复习。

family_guide.root_logic: 由 up（向上、临近）+ coming（到来）复合而成，形象表示“即将来临的”。

lemmas.def_en: something that resembles a tablet of medicine in shape or size
lemmas.def_zh: 药丸, 弹丸, 屈辱, 胡说

examples.en: He swallowed a vitamin pill with a glass of warm water.
examples.zh: 他喝了一杯温水吞下一片维生素药丸。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 pila（球），原指小圆球状物，后专指小球或圆片状的药丸。

lemmas.def_en: color with a liquid dye or tint
lemmas.def_zh: 沾染, 染污, 着色；变脏

examples.en: Red wine can easily stain your white cotton shirt if spilled.
examples.zh: 如果红酒洒出来，很容易弄脏你的白色棉衬衫。

lemmas.def_en: a soiled or discolored appearance
lemmas.def_zh: 污染, 污点, 着色剂

examples.en: Red wine can easily stain your white cotton shirt if spilled.
examples.zh: 如果红酒洒出来，很容易弄脏你的白色棉衬衫。

lemmas.def_en: steel containing chromium that makes it resistant to corrosion
lemmas.def_zh: [机] 不绣的, 污染的

examples.en: Our new kitchen knives are made of durable and sharp stainless steel.
examples.zh: 我们新买的厨房刀具是由耐用锋利的不锈钢制成的。

lemmas.def_en: a worker who stains (wood or fabric)
lemmas.def_zh: 着色工, 染色工, 色料

examples.en: The wood stainer carefully applied a rich walnut finish to the cabinet.
examples.zh: 着色工小心地给橱柜涂上了一层浓郁的核桃木色漆。

lemmas.def_en: not stained
lemmas.def_zh: 没有沾污的, 无污点的

examples.en: Despite the messy work, his apron remained completely clean and unstained.
examples.zh: 尽管工作很杂乱，他的围裙依然完全干净、没有污渍。

family_guide.root_logic: 来自古诺斯语 steina（染色、污损），核心语义指颜色附着导致弄脏或改变外观。

lemmas.def_en: a temporally organized plan for matters to be attended to
lemmas.def_zh: [计] 待议事件

examples.en: Climate change is the most urgent item on today's meeting agenda.
examples.zh: 气候变化是今天会议议程上最紧急的一项。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 agere（做）的动名词复数，字面义为“应当去做的事情”，引申为议事日程。

lemmas.def_en: the magnitude of something in a particular direction (especially length or width or height)
lemmas.def_zh: 尺寸, 次元, 面积, 维数

examples.en: Virtual reality technology adds an entirely new dimension to video games.
examples.zh: 虚拟现实技术为电子游戏增添了一个全新的维度。

lemmas.def_en: indicate the dimensions on
lemmas.def_zh: 标出尺寸

examples.en: Virtual reality technology adds an entirely new dimension to video games.
examples.zh: 虚拟现实技术为电子游戏增添了一个全新的维度。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 dis-（分开）+ metiri（测量），原指测量出的距离或长宽高，引申为维度、层面。

lemmas.def_en: put or introduce into something
lemmas.def_zh: v. 插入，嵌入；添写

examples.en: Insert the key into the lock and turn it clockwise.
examples.zh: 将钥匙插入锁孔，然后顺时针旋转。

lemmas.def_en: a message (spoken or written) that is introduced or inserted
lemmas.def_zh: 插入, 刊载, 插入物

examples.en: The painless insertion of the medical tube took only a few seconds.
examples.zh: 医用导管的无痛插入仅花费了几秒钟。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 in-（入内）+ sert（放置、连接），核心义为“放入、插入”。

lemmas.def_en: travel on water propelled by wind or by other means
lemmas.def_zh: v. 导航，航行；操纵，应对（复杂局势）

examples.en: He skillfully navigated the company through the financial crisis.
examples.zh: 他熟练地带领公司渡过了金融危机。

lemmas.def_en: the guidance of ships or airplanes from place to place
lemmas.def_zh: n. 导航，航行；（网站或系统的）导航栏

examples.en: The GPS navigation system recalculated the quickest route.
examples.zh: GPS 导航系统重新计算出了最快的路线。

lemmas.def_en: the ship's officer in charge of navigation
lemmas.def_zh: 航海家

examples.en: The experienced navigator guided the ship safely through the dense sea fog.
examples.zh: 经验丰富的领航员引导船只安全穿过了浓厚的海雾。

lemmas.def_zh: 适航性, 耐航性
lemmas.def_en: the quality of being suitable for the passage of a ship or aircraft
of or relating to navigation
lemmas.def_zh: [计] 导航的

examples.en: Modern aircraft rely heavily on advanced navigational systems during long flights.
examples.zh: 现代飞机在长途飞行中极度依赖先进的导航系统。

lemmas.def_zh: 可航行的, 可通船的, 适于航行的
lemmas.def_en: able to be sailed on or through safely

examples.en: Heavy spring rains made the shallow river navigable for small cargo boats once again.
examples.zh: 春季的大雨让这条浅河再次适合小型货船航行。

lemmas.def_zh: 不可通航的
lemmas.def_en: incapable of being navigated

family_guide.root_logic: nav（船）+ ig/ag（引导、驱动），原指航海，引申为指引方向或操纵前行。
family_guide.core_distinction: navigate 为动词动作；navigation 为其名词形式，指导航系统或航行行为。

lemmas.def_en: take a risk in the hope of a favorable outcome
lemmas.def_zh: v. 赌博；投机，冒险

examples.en: They gambled everything on the success of their new startup.
examples.zh: 他们把一切都押在了新初创公司的成功上。

lemmas.def_en: a person who wagers money on the outcome of games or sporting events
lemmas.def_zh: 赌博者, 赌徒

examples.en: The reckless gambler lost all his savings at the poker table tonight.
examples.zh: 这个不计后果的赌徒今晚在牌桌上输光了所有积蓄。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语表示“玩耍、嬉戏”的词，后特指拿有价值之物作注冒险。

lemmas.def_en: an army unit usually consisting of two or more divisions and their support
lemmas.def_zh: n. 军团，兵种；专门团体，团队

examples.en: She joined the diplomatic corps after graduating from university.
examples.zh: 大学毕业后，她加入了外交使团。

lemmas.def_en: a business firm whose articles of incorporation have been approved in some state
lemmas.def_zh: n. （口语或缩写）公司，法人

examples.en: He works at the headquarters of a multinational corp.
examples.zh: 他在一家跨国公司的总部工作。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 corpus（身体），引申为由众人组织而成的“专门团体或部队”。
family_guide.core_distinction: corps 指特种部队或专门团体（末尾 s 不发音）；corp 为 corporation（公司）的常见缩写。

lemmas.def_en: following accepted customs and proprieties
lemmas.def_zh: adj. 传统的，常规的；墨守成规的

examples.en: She prefers conventional medicine over alternative therapies.
examples.zh: 相比替代疗法，她更倾向于传统医学。

lemmas.def_en: not conforming to accepted rules or standards
lemmas.def_zh: 不依惯例的, 非传统的, 非常规的

examples.en: Her unconventional teaching methods sparked creativity and enthusiasm among all her students.
examples.zh: 她非传统的教学方法激发了所有学生身上的创造力与热情。

lemmas.def_en: in a conventional manner
lemmas.def_zh: 照惯例, 照常套, 照老例

examples.en: He prefers to dress conventionally in a dark suit for business meetings.
examples.zh: 他习惯在商务会议上循规蹈矩地穿深色西装。

lemmas.def_en: in an unconventional manner
lemmas.def_zh: 不依惯例地, 异常地

examples.en: She decorated her apartment unconventionally with vintage posters and recycled industrial metal.
examples.zh: 她别出心裁地用复古海报和回收工业金属装饰了公寓。

lemmas.def_en: conformity with conventional thought and behavior
lemmas.def_zh: 惯例性, 老一套的行为, 习俗, 因袭性

examples.en: Tired of social conventionality, the young artist moved to an isolated village.
examples.zh: 厌倦了社会陈规的年轻艺术家搬到了一个偏僻的村庄。

lemmas.def_en: originality by virtue of being unconventional
lemmas.def_zh: 非常规；异常

examples.en: The critics praised the novel for its refreshing unconventionality and bold themes.
examples.zh: 批评家们称赞这部小说令人耳目一新的非常规风格与大胆主题。

family_guide.root_logic: con-（共同）+ vent（来），大家共同遵循的约定，引申为“传统的、常规的”。

lemmas.def_en: describe roughly or briefly or give the main points or summary of
lemmas.def_zh: 描画轮廓, 描述要点

examples.en: Please outline your main arguments before writing the final draft of the essay.
examples.zh: 在写这篇论文的定稿之前，请先概述你的主要论点。

lemmas.def_en: the line that appears to bound an object
lemmas.def_zh: 大纲, 轮廓, 概要；大纲, 分级, 轮廓

examples.en: Please outline your main arguments before writing the final draft of the essay.
examples.zh: 在写这篇论文的定稿之前，请先概述你的主要论点。

family_guide.root_logic: out（外围）+ line（线条），本义为“外轮廓”，引申为“勾画大纲”。
family_guide.core_distinction: outline 兼具名词（轮廓、大纲）与动词（概述、画轮廓）用法。

lemmas.def_en: any of numerous elongate mostly marine carnivorous fishes with heterocercal caudal fins and tough skin covered with small toothlike scales
lemmas.def_zh: 鲨鱼, 骗子

examples.en: A ruthless loan shark threatened him when he failed to pay the debt.
examples.zh: 当他未能偿还债务时，一个冷酷的高利贷骗子威胁了他。

lemmas.def_en: play the shark; act with trickery
lemmas.def_zh: 诈骗

examples.en: A ruthless loan shark threatened him when he failed to pay the debt.
examples.zh: 当他未能偿还债务时，一个冷酷的高利贷骗子威胁了他。

family_guide.root_logic: 原指海洋凶猛掠食者“鲨鱼”，后借其凶残本性引申为巧取豪夺之人或行为。

lemmas.def_en: one of the digits of the foot
lemmas.def_zh: 足趾, 趾部, 脚趾

examples.en: He accidentally stubbed his big toe against the corner of the wooden table.
examples.zh: 他不小心把大脚趾撞在了木桌角上。

lemmas.def_en: walk so that the toes assume an indicated position or direction
lemmas.def_zh: 以趾踏触, 用脚尖走；动脚尖

examples.en: He accidentally stubbed his big toe against the corner of the wooden table.
examples.zh: 他不小心把大脚趾撞在了木桌角上。

family_guide.root_logic: 日耳曼语源，本指身体最前方的“脚趾”，引申出碰触、用脚尖踢等动作。

lemmas.def_en: the difference between the market value of a property and the claims held against it
lemmas.def_zh: n. 公平，公正；（公司的）股本，资产净值

examples.en: The founders were reluctant to give up any more equity in the firm.
examples.zh: 创始人不愿再出让公司的任何股权。

family_guide.root_logic: equ-（平等、均等）+ -ity（名词后缀），核心义为“公平”，商法上引申为所有权与净值。

lemmas.def_en: a relatively small granular particle of a substance
lemmas.def_zh: 谷粒, 颗粒, 谷类, 纹理, 本质

examples.en: The country imported tons of grain to prevent widespread food shortages this winter.
examples.zh: 该国进口了数吨谷物以防止今年冬天出现大范围粮荒。

lemmas.def_zh: 间隔尺寸
lemmas.def_en: the quality of being composed of relatively large particles
the quality of being composed of relatively large particles
lemmas.def_zh: 粒状的, 多粒的, 木纹状的

examples.en: The extreme graininess of the low-light photograph made the suspect's face unrecognizable.
examples.zh: 这张弱光照片严重的颗粒感使得嫌疑人的面部无法辨认。

lemmas.def_en: thoroughly work in
lemmas.def_zh: (使)成谷粒

examples.en: The country imported tons of grain to prevent widespread food shortages this winter.
examples.zh: 该国进口了数吨谷物以防止今年冬天出现大范围粮荒。

lemmas.def_zh: 颗粒的, 粒状的
lemmas.def_en: composed of or covered with particles resembling meal in texture or consistency

examples.en: The chef added coarse, granular sea salt to enhance the steak's texture.
examples.zh: 厨师加入了粗颗粒海盐以提升牛排的口感。

lemmas.def_en: composed of or covered with particles resembling meal in texture or consistency
lemmas.def_zh: 有纹理的, 粒状的, 多粒的, 木纹状的

examples.en: The security camera captured grainy footage of the intruder escaping in the dark.
examples.zh: 监控摄像头拍下了入侵者在黑暗中逃跑的模糊颗粒画面。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 granum（谷粒、细小颗粒），引申指木材/石材的纹理。

lemmas.def_en: small workplace where handcrafts or manufacturing are done
lemmas.def_zh: n. 车间，作坊；专题研讨会，工作坊

examples.en: The university is hosting a two-day workshop on machine learning.
examples.zh: 该大学正在举办一场为期两天的机器学习研讨会。

family_guide.root_logic: work（工作）+ shop（店铺、作坊），指“生产制造的工坊”或“切磋技能的研讨会”。

lemmas.def_en: be oriented
lemmas.def_zh: v. 标定方向；使适应，使朝向

examples.en: New students need a few days to orient themselves to campus life.
examples.zh: 新生需要几天时间来适应校园生活。

lemmas.def_en: a member of an Oriental race; the term is regarded as offensive by Asians (especially by Asian Americans)
lemmas.def_zh: n. （旧时称谓，现常具冒犯性）东方人

examples.en: Historically, travelers often referred to inhabitants of the East as orientals.
examples.zh: 历史上，旅行者常将东方居民称为东方人。

lemmas.def_zh: adj. 以……为导向的；朝向……的；适应的
lemmas.def_en: adjusted or located in relation to surroundings or circumstances; interested in or directed towards a particular thing (often used in combination)
lemmas.usage_note: 常与名词或副词连用构成复合形容词，如 market-oriented, detail-oriented, career-oriented 等。

examples.en: The company adopted a more customer-oriented approach to improve sales.
examples.zh: 该公司采取了更加以客户为导向的方法来提高销售额。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 oriri（升起），原指太阳升起的东方，引申为确定方位、使适应。
family_guide.core_distinction: orient 作动词指“定方向、使适应”；oriental 作名词在现代多带有陈旧或特定文化色彩，指东方人。

lemmas.def_en: behave saucily or impudently towards
lemmas.def_zh: v. 给…调味加酱；对…粗鲁冒犯

examples.en: She garnished and sauced the grilled salmon to perfection.
examples.zh: 她为烤三文鱼配上了精美的装饰和恰到好处的酱汁。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 salsa（加盐腌制的），动词多表示调味或引申为言语俏皮无礼。

lemmas.def_en: move from one country or region to another and settle there
lemmas.def_zh: v. （候鸟、动物）迁徙；移居，迁移

examples.en: Many bird species migrate south to escape the harsh winter.
examples.zh: 许多鸟类向南迁徙以躲避严酷的冬天。

lemmas.def_en: the movement of persons from one country or locality to another
lemmas.def_zh: n. 迁徙，移居；（数据或系统的）迁移

examples.en: The annual wildebeest migration is a spectacular natural event.
examples.zh: 一年一度的角马大迁徙是一场壮观的自然奇观。

lemmas.def_en: traveler who moves from one region or country to another
lemmas.def_zh: 候鸟, 移居者

examples.en: Thousands of migrant workers travel to southern coastal cities every year seeking employment.
examples.zh: 成千上万的流动工人每年涌向南部沿海城市寻找工作。

lemmas.def_en: traveler who moves from one region or country to another
lemmas.def_zh: 候鸟, 移居者

examples.en: This small songbird is an impressive long-distance migrator across two continents.
examples.zh: 这种小鸣禽是跨越两大洲的了不起的长途候鸟。

lemmas.def_en: habitually moving from place to place especially in search of seasonal work
lemmas.def_zh: [法] 移居者

examples.en: Thousands of migrant workers travel to southern coastal cities every year seeking employment.
examples.zh: 成千上万的流动工人每年涌向南部沿海城市寻找工作。

lemmas.def_zh: 迁移的, 流浪的
lemmas.def_en: used of animals that move seasonally

examples.en: These wetlands provide an essential resting place for millions of migratory birds.
examples.zh: 这些湿地为数百万只候鸟提供了重要的歇息场所。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 migrare（移动、转移），指有规律或长距离的迁徙移动。
family_guide.core_distinction: migrate 为动作；migration 为其名词，指迁徙的整个过程或群体迁移。

lemmas.def_en: empty rhetoric or insincere or exaggerated talk
lemmas.def_zh: 爵士乐, 喧闹

examples.en: We spent a relaxing Friday evening listening to live jazz in a cozy bar.
examples.zh: 周五晚上，我们在一间温馨的酒吧里听着现场爵士乐，度过了轻松的时光。

lemmas.def_en: resembling jazz (especially in its rhythm)
lemmas.def_zh: 爵士的, 奔放的, 激烈的

examples.en: She wore a jazzy bright yellow dress that immediately caught everyone's attention.
examples.zh: 她穿了一件抢眼的亮黄色连衣裙，立刻引起了所有人的注意。

lemmas.def_en: play something in the style of jazz
lemmas.def_zh: 演奏爵士乐, 跳爵士舞, 游荡；奏爵士乐, 使活泼

examples.en: You can jazz up this plain outfit with a bright red silk scarf.
examples.zh: 你可以配上一条鲜艳的红丝巾，让这身平淡的装束活跃起来。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自美国非裔俚语，最初与活力、兴奋及性相关，后定型为一种富于即兴节奏的音乐风格并引申出使活泼之意。

lemmas.def_en: marked by blithe unconcern
lemmas.def_zh: 偶然的, 不经意的, 便装的

examples.en: He made a casual remark about the weather before starting the presentation.
examples.zh: 开始做报告之前，他随口聊了一句天气。

lemmas.def_en: not methodically or according to plan
lemmas.def_zh: 偶然地, 临时地, 随便地

examples.en: She casually mentioned that she had met the famous author at the party.
examples.zh: 她漫不经心地提起自己曾在聚会上见过那位著名作家。

lemmas.def_en: a casual manner
lemmas.def_zh: 偶然

examples.en: His apparent casualness concealed the fact that he was actually very nervous.
examples.zh: 他表面上的漫不经心掩盖了他其实非常紧张的事实。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 casus（偶发事件、机会），核心义为“非预谋的、随意的”，后引申出休闲和漫不经心。

lemmas.def_en: a signal transmitted along a narrow path; guides airplane pilots in darkness or bad weather
lemmas.def_zh: 横梁, 杆, 光线, 容光焕发

examples.en: The wooden beam supporting the ceiling was damaged by termites over time.
examples.zh: 支撑天花板的木梁随着时间的推移被白蚁破坏了。

lemmas.def_en: smile radiantly; express joy through one's facial expression
lemmas.def_zh: 用梁支承, 微笑, 射出光线；照耀, 感到欣喜

examples.en: The wooden beam supporting the ceiling was damaged by termites over time.
examples.zh: 支撑天花板的木梁随着时间的推移被白蚁破坏了。

lemmas.def_en: broad in the beam
lemmas.def_zh: 光亮的, 象梁一样的, 船身宽大的

examples.en: The beamy sailboat provided a remarkably stable platform even in rough coastal waters.
examples.zh: 即使在汹涌的近海中，这艘宽身帆船也表现出极佳的稳定性。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语，原指“树木、横梁”，因光线穿透如长木横贯，后引申为“光束”及如阳光般“灿烂微笑”。

lemmas.def_en: put up with something or somebody unpleasant
lemmas.def_zh: 忍受, 忍耐, 容忍, 耐；(正式)持久, 持续

examples.en: The villagers had to endure harsh winter storms without electricity for weeks.
examples.zh: 村民们不得不忍受断电数周且暴风雪肆虐的严冬。

lemmas.def_en: the power to withstand hardship or stress
lemmas.def_zh: 忍耐, 忍耐力, 耐性

examples.en: Running a full marathon requires great physical endurance and strong mental focus.
examples.zh: 跑完一场全程马拉松需要强大的体力和高度集中的精神。

lemmas.def_en: in an enduring manner
lemmas.def_zh: 耐久地, 永久地

examples.en: His childhood memories remained enduringly vivid in his mind throughout his long life.
examples.zh: 在他漫长的一生中，童年的记忆一直在脑海里历久弥新。

lemmas.def_zh: adj. 持久的，不朽的
lemmas.def_en: continuing or long-lasting; unceasing
lemmas.usage_note: 常用于修饰抽象事物，如 an enduring appeal / friendship / legacy。

examples.en: The novel has enjoyed enduring popularity since it was first published.
examples.zh: 这部小说自出版以来一直受到经久不衰的欢迎。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 durus（坚硬的），经前缀 en-（使进入）强化，核心义为“在艰难中坚挺支撑下去”。

lemmas.def_en: a manner of living that reflects the person's values and attitudes
lemmas.def_zh: 生活方式

examples.en: Adopting an active lifestyle can reduce the risk of many chronic health conditions.
examples.zh: 采取积极的生活方式可以降低患许多慢性疾病的风险。

family_guide.root_logic: 由 life（生活）+ style（风格、方式）构成的现代复合词，特指个人或群体独特的生活习惯与行为方式。

lemmas.def_en: marked by strong resentment or cynicism
lemmas.def_zh: 苦的, 痛苦的, 怀恨的

examples.en: He drank the herbal medicine quickly to avoid the unpleasant bitter taste.
examples.zh: 他迅速喝下了草药，以避开那难闻的苦味。

lemmas.def_en: a feeling of deep and bitter anger and ill-will
lemmas.def_zh: 苦味, 悲痛, 怨恨

examples.en: She spoke without any bitterness despite the unfair treatment she had received.
examples.zh: 尽管遭受了不公正的对待，她说话时却没有丝毫怨恨。

lemmas.def_en: with bitterness, in a resentful manner
lemmas.def_zh: 怨恨地, 悲痛地, 残酷地

examples.en: He bitterly regretted the harsh words he had spoken during the argument.
examples.zh: 他非常后悔自己在争吵中说出的那些伤人话语。
