lemmas.def_en: make bitter
lemmas.def_zh: (使)变苦

examples.en: He drank the herbal medicine quickly to avoid the unpleasant bitter taste.
examples.zh: 他迅速喝下了草药，以避开那难闻的苦味。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自原始日耳曼语“咬”，引申为如被咬般刺痛的苦味，进一步延伸至情绪上的愤恨和环境的严酷。

lemmas.def_en: issue commands or orders for
lemmas.def_zh: 听写, 口述, 口授；口述, 使听写, 命令

examples.en: The manager will dictate an urgent memo to his secretary this afternoon.
examples.zh: 经理今天下午会向他的秘书口述一份紧急备忘录。

lemmas.def_en: a speaker who dictates to a secretary or a recording machine
lemmas.def_zh: 命令者, 独裁者

examples.en: The cruel dictator suppressed all political opposition and limited freedom of speech.
examples.zh: 残暴的独裁者镇压了所有政治反对派并限制言论自由。

lemmas.def_en: a form of government in which the ruler is an absolute dictator (not restricted by a constitution or laws or opposition etc.)
lemmas.def_zh: 独裁者之职位, 独裁, 独裁政权

examples.en: The country finally transitioned to democracy after decades of oppressive military dictatorship.
examples.zh: 在经历了数十年的压迫性军事独裁后，该国最终转向了民主。

lemmas.def_en: an authoritative direction or instruction to do something
lemmas.def_zh: 听写, 口述, 命令

examples.en: The primary school teacher gave her class a short spelling dictation test.
examples.zh: 小学老师给全班同学进行了一次简短的单词听写测验。

lemmas.def_en: of or characteristic of a dictator
lemmas.def_zh: 独裁者的, 独裁的, 独断的

examples.en: Her dictatorial management style alienated most of the team members very quickly.
examples.zh: 她那独断专行的管理风格很快疏远了大多数团队成员。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 dicere（说），核心义为“口述”，引申为带有权威性地“发布命令、支配决定”。
family_guide.core_distinction: dictator 指拥有绝对权力的独裁统治者；dictatorship 指独裁政体或专制统治制度。

lemmas.def_en: a learner who is enrolled in an educational institution
lemmas.def_zh: 学生, 门生, 未成年人, 瞳孔

examples.en: His pupils dilated when the doctor shone a bright light into them.
examples.zh: 当医生用强光照射时，他的瞳孔放大了。

lemmas.def_zh: [医] 瞳孔的
lemmas.def_en: of or relating to the pupil of the eye

examples.en: The doctor checked the patient's pupillary reflex by shining a bright penlight.
examples.zh: 医生用亮笔灯照射，以检查患者的瞳孔反射。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 pupilla（小女孩、木偶），因映在眼中的微小人影而指“瞳孔”，引申义指受监护、受教导的“小学生”。

lemmas.def_en: characterized by feeling or showing fond affection for
lemmas.def_zh: 宝贵的, 珍贵的, 过于精致的, 珍爱的

examples.en: Clean drinking water has become an increasingly precious resource in this desert region.
examples.zh: 清洁的饮用水已成为这个沙漠地区日益珍贵的资源。

lemmas.def_en: the quality possessed by something with a great price or value
lemmas.def_zh: 珍贵；过分讲究

examples.en: Facing serious illness made him realize the true preciousness of everyday moments.
examples.zh: 面对重病让他意识到了平凡日常真正的宝贵。

lemmas.def_en: extremely
lemmas.def_zh: 昂贵地；仔细地；过分讲究地

examples.en: She guarded her rare coin collection preciously in a locked steel safe.
examples.zh: 她把珍贵的稀有硬币收藏小心翼翼地保存在锁好的钢制保险箱里。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 pretium（价值、价格），核心义为“珍贵的、价值连城的”，引申为情感上备受珍视的。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to or caused by a toxin or poison
lemmas.def_zh: 有毒的, 中毒的

examples.en: Industrial waste dumped into the river released toxic chemicals that harmed wildlife.
examples.zh: 排入河中的工业废料释放出有毒化学物质，危及了野生动物。

lemmas.def_en: not producing or resulting from poison
lemmas.def_zh: 无毒的

examples.en: This eco-friendly paint is completely nontoxic and safe for children's bedrooms.
examples.zh: 这种环保涂料完全无毒，可安全用于儿童卧室。

lemmas.def_en: the degree to which something is poisonous
lemmas.def_zh: 毒性

examples.en: Researchers are testing the toxicity of the newly developed chemical compound.
examples.zh: 研究人员正在测试这种新开发化合物的毒性。

lemmas.def_zh: 毒素
lemmas.def_en: a poisonous substance produced during the metabolism and growth of certain microorganisms and some higher plant and animal species

examples.en: Certain poisonous mushrooms produce a deadly toxin that can cause rapid liver failure.
examples.zh: 某些毒蘑菇会产生一种致命毒素，可导致迅速的肝衰竭。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 toxikon pharmakon（涂在箭上的毒药），核心义为“有毒的”，现代广泛引申为“有害身心的、恶劣的”。
family_guide.core_distinction: toxic 为形容词，强调属性有害；toxicity 为名词，特指毒性程度或毒害性质。

lemmas.def_en: a particle that is electrically charged (positive or negative); an atom or molecule or group that has lost or gained one or more electrons
lemmas.def_zh: 离子

examples.en: A sodium ion carries a single positive electrical charge in water.
examples.zh: 一个钠离子在水中带有一个单正电荷。

lemmas.def_en: the dialect of Ancient Greek spoken and written in Attica and Athens and Ionia
lemmas.def_zh: 爱奥尼亚方言

examples.en: Scholars still study ancient Ionic to better understand classical Greek literature.
examples.zh: 学者们仍在研究古爱奥尼亚方言，以更好地理解古典希腊文学。

lemmas.def_en: the condition of being dissociated into ions (as by heat or radiation or chemical reaction or electrical discharge)
lemmas.def_zh: 离子化, 电离

examples.en: High-energy radiation causes the rapid ionization of surrounding air molecules.
examples.zh: 高能辐射会引起周围空气分子的迅速电离。

lemmas.def_en: become converted into ions
lemmas.def_zh: 使离子化；电离

examples.en: Intense heat from the lightning bolt can instantly ionize atmospheric gases.
examples.zh: 闪电产生的强热能瞬间使大气中的气体电离。

lemmas.def_en: not converted into ions
lemmas.def_zh: [化] 在溶液中不分解成离子的

examples.en: The gentle cleanser uses a nonionic surfactant to prevent skin irritation.
examples.zh: 这款温和的洁面乳使用非离子表面活性剂，以防止刺激皮肤。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 ienai（走、移动），由物理学家法拉第引入，指在电场中“游走移动”的带电粒子。

lemmas.def_en: be earlier in time; go back further
lemmas.def_zh: 在...之前, 优于, 较...优先；在前面

examples.en: A brief introductory speech will precede the screening of the documentary.
examples.zh: 纪录片放映前将有一段简短的介绍性致辞。

lemmas.def_en: one who precedes you in time (as in holding a position or office)
lemmas.def_zh: n. 前任，前辈；原先的东西

examples.en: The new smartphone model is significantly faster and lighter than its predecessor.
examples.zh: 这款新智能手机比上一代机型速度显著提升且机身更轻。

lemmas.def_en: an example that is used to justify similar occurrences at a later time
lemmas.def_zh: 先例, 前例

examples.en: The judge's historic ruling set an important legal precedent for future cases.
examples.zh: 法官这一历史性的裁决为未来的案件树立了重要的法律先例。

lemmas.def_en: status established in order of importance or urgency
lemmas.def_zh: 优先, 居先

examples.en: Safety considerations must always take precedence over speed in this factory.
examples.zh: 在这家工厂里，安全考量必须始终优先于生产速度。

lemmas.def_en: the motion of a spinning body (as a top) in which it wobbles so that the axis of rotation sweeps out a cone
lemmas.def_zh: 先行, 优先

examples.en: Astronomers carefully measured the axial precession of the spinning planet.
examples.zh: 天文学家仔细测量了这颗自转行星的进动。

lemmas.def_en: having precedence (especially because of longer service)
lemmas.def_zh: (作为)先例的

examples.en: The court dismissed the argument because the cited case had no precedential value.
examples.zh: 法院驳回了该论点，因为所引用的案件没有先例价值。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 pre-（在……之前）+ cede（走），核心逻辑为“走在前面”，引申出时间、空间或次序上的先行。
family_guide.core_distinction: precede 为动作“先于”；precedent 强调由此留下的“先例、前例”。

lemmas.def_en: a hypothetical description of a complex entity or process
lemmas.def_zh: 结构, 骨架, 参照标准, 准则, 观点

examples.en: The treaty provides a comprehensive legal framework for international environmental cooperation.
examples.zh: 该条约跨越了国界，为国际环境合作提供了全面的法律框架。

family_guide.root_logic: 由 frame（框架、骨架）+ work（构造物）组合而成，核心义为“支撑整体的骨架”，引申为思维或体制架构。

lemmas.def_en: a momentary flash of light
lemmas.def_zh: 火花, 火星, 闪光, 无线电报务员, 瞬间放电, 活力, 朝气, 花花公子, 情郎

examples.en: His controversial remarks managed to spark fierce protests across the country.
examples.zh: 他那番颇具争议的言论在全国范围内引发了激烈的抗议。

lemmas.def_en: merriment expressed by a brightness or gleam or animation of countenance
lemmas.def_zh: n. 闪光；活力，光彩

examples.en: There was a mischievous sparkle in his eyes when he spoke.
examples.zh: 他说话时，眼里闪烁着淘气的光芒。

lemmas.def_en: diamonds
lemmas.def_zh: 钻石, 花炮, 烟火, 才华焕发的人

examples.en: The child waved a glowing sparkler excitedly on New Year's Eve.
examples.zh: 除夕夜，那个孩子兴奋地挥舞着发光的仙女棒。

lemmas.def_en: put in motion or move to act
lemmas.def_zh: 闪光, 发火花, 求婚；发动, 鼓舞, 使有朝气, 求婚

examples.en: His controversial remarks managed to spark fierce protests across the country.
examples.zh: 他那番颇具争议的言论在全国范围内引发了激烈的抗议。

lemmas.def_en: reflect brightly
lemmas.def_zh: v. 闪烁；闪耀

examples.en: There was a mischievous sparkle in his eyes when he spoke.
examples.zh: 他说话时，眼里闪烁着淘气的光芒。

lemmas.def_en: marked by high spirits or excitement
lemmas.def_zh: 闪耀的

examples.en: She wore a sparkly silver dress to the annual charity gala.
examples.zh: 她穿着一件闪亮的银色礼服出席了一年一度的慈善晚会。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语，原指迸发的微小“火花”，因火花能引燃烈火，故引申为“触发、激发”重大事件或灵感。

lemmas.def_en: any of numerous hairy-bodied insects including social and solitary species
lemmas.def_zh: 蜜蜂, 聚会

examples.en: A busy honey bee moved gently from one blossom to another.
examples.zh: 一只忙碌的蜜蜂在花朵间轻柔地穿梭。

lemmas.def_en: have the quality of being; (copula, used with an adjective or a predicate noun)
lemmas.def_zh: 是, 表示, 在

examples.en: Please be patient while our technical support team investigates the system issue.
examples.zh: 在我们的技术支持团队调查系统问题期间，请保持耐心。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自原始印欧语拟声词根，表嗡嗡作响的昆虫“蜜蜂”；be 属不同源巧合，源自表存在的印欧语根 *bheue-。
family_guide.core_distinction: bee 为昆虫名词；be 为核心系动词/助动词，两者词源无关联。

lemmas.def_en: a traditional story accepted as history; serves to explain the world view of a people
lemmas.def_zh: 神话；虚构的事，荒诞的说法

examples.en: It is a common myth that shaving makes hair grow back thicker.
examples.zh: 刮毛会让毛发长得更粗，这是一种普遍的荒谬说法。

lemmas.def_en: myths collectively; the body of stories associated with a culture or institution or person
lemmas.def_zh: n. 神话；神话体系；虚构的信念

examples.en: He has a deep interest in ancient Greek mythology.
examples.zh: 他对古希腊神话有着浓厚的兴趣。

lemmas.def_en: an expert on mythology
lemmas.def_zh: 神话学者, 神话作者

examples.en: The famous mythologist explained how ancient flood legends appeared across different continents.
examples.zh: 这位著名的神话学者解释了古代洪水传说为何会出现在不同的大洲。

lemmas.def_en: based on or told of in traditional stories; lacking factual basis or historical validity
lemmas.def_zh: 神话的, 存在于神话中的, 神话式的, 不真实的, 虚构的, 幻想出来的

examples.en: The dragon is a mythical beast featured prominently in many ancient legends.
examples.zh: 龙是一种虚构的神兽，在许多古老传说中占有显赫地位。

lemmas.def_en: based on or told of in traditional stories; lacking factual basis or historical validity
lemmas.def_zh: 神话的, 神话学的, 虚构的

examples.en: Dragons and unicorns are perhaps the most famous mythological creatures in European folklore.
examples.zh: 龙和独角兽大概是欧洲民间传说中最著名的神话生物。

lemmas.def_en: relating to or having the nature of myth
lemmas.def_zh: 神话的, 存在于神话中的, 神话式的, 不真实的, 虚构的, 幻想出来的

examples.en: The director gave the ordinary hero a truly mythic status onscreen.
examples.zh: 导演在银幕上赋予了这位普通英雄真正神话般的地位。

lemmas.def_en: based on or told of in traditional stories; lacking factual basis or historical validity
lemmas.def_zh: 神话的, 虚构的

examples.en: The museum displayed ancient Greek vases painted with diverse mythologic scenes and heroes.
examples.zh: 博物馆展出了绘有各种神话场景与英雄人物的古希腊花瓶。

lemmas.def_en: construct a myth
lemmas.def_zh: 使成为神话；研究神话, 讲神话

examples.en: Biographers tend to mythologize historical leaders, ignoring their very real personal flaws.
examples.zh: 传记作者往往倾向于将历史领袖神话，而忽略他们真实存在的人格缺陷。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 mythos（话语、故事），核心指代口耳相传的神话或被普遍误信的荒谬说法。

lemmas.def_en: made or consisting of (entirely or in part) or employing wood
lemmas.def_zh: 木制的；僵硬的，呆板的

examples.en: His wooden performance failed to convince the theater critics.
examples.zh: 他那呆板僵硬的表演未能打动剧评人。

lemmas.def_en: without grace; rigidly
lemmas.def_zh: 笨拙地, 呆板地

examples.en: The nervous actor delivered his lines woodenly during the final audition.
examples.zh: 这位紧张的演员在最终试镜时表现呆板地念完了台词。

family_guide.root_logic: wood（木头）+ -en（材质形容词后缀），引申指像木头一样僵硬、呆板。

lemmas.def_en: pass through
lemmas.def_zh: 经历，经受（变化、痛苦等）

examples.en: The ancient building will undergo extensive renovations next month.
examples.zh: 这座历史建筑下个月将接受大规模翻新。

lemmas.def_en: pass through
lemmas.def_zh: 经历，经受（undergo的过去式）

examples.en: She underwent major heart surgery and made a full recovery.
examples.zh: 她接受了一次大型心脏手术并完全康复了。

lemmas.def_en: pass through
lemmas.def_zh: 经历，经受（undergo的过去分词）

examples.en: The city has undergone a dramatic transformation in recent years.
examples.zh: 近年来，这座城市经历了翻天覆地的转变。

family_guide.root_logic: under-（在……之下，引申为承受）+ go（走），字面为“从下面走过”，引申为经历、经受。

lemmas.def_en: all living things (except people) that are undomesticated
lemmas.def_zh: 野生动植物，野生生物

examples.en: The forest fire posed a catastrophic threat to local wildlife.
examples.zh: 这场森林大火对当地的野生动植物造成了灾难性的威胁。

family_guide.root_logic: wild（野生的）+ life（生命），合成为野生动植物的总称。

lemmas.def_en: a short stout club used primarily by policemen
lemmas.def_zh: （野营用的）水壶，小铁锅；警棍

examples.en: We boiled some river water in the billy over the campfire.
examples.zh: 我们在篝火上用野营小铁壶煮了一些河水。

family_guide.root_logic: 多源拟人化昵称（William的昵称），在不同语境下借指便携小壶或警棍。

lemmas.def_en: close violently
lemmas.def_zh: 猛关；猛烈撞击；猛烈抨击

examples.en: He slammed the door behind him and stormed out of the house.
examples.zh: 他把门重重地关上，怒气冲冲地冲出了房子。

lemmas.def_en: a person who closes things violently
lemmas.def_zh: [法] 监狱

examples.en: The notorious jewel thief finally ended up behind bars in the slammer.
examples.zh: 那个臭名昭著的珠宝大盗最终身陷囹圄，被关进了监狱。

family_guide.root_logic: 拟声词，模拟重物猛烈撞击或关门发出的巨响，引申指猛烈撞击或猛烈抨击。

lemmas.def_en: make a sudden movement in a new direction so as to avoid
lemmas.def_zh: 躲开，避开；躲避（责任、问题等）

examples.en: The boxer managed to dodge the punch just in time.
examples.zh: 拳击手及时侧身躲开了那一拳。

lemmas.def_en: a shifty deceptive person
lemmas.def_zh: 躲闪者, 用诡计逃脱者, 蒙骗者, 推托者

examples.en: The notorious draft dodger fled across the border under a false name.
examples.zh: 那个臭名昭著的逃兵役者用假名逃到了边境另一侧。

lemmas.def_zh: 狡猾的, 逃避的, 难弄的
lemmas.def_en: of uncertain outcome; especially fraught with risk; - New Yorker

examples.en: They refused to invest money in what looked like a very dodgy business scheme.
examples.zh: 他们拒绝将资金投入到一个看起来非常可疑的商业计划中。

family_guide.root_logic: 拟声或方言起源，核心动作是身体或思维快速侧移以避开阻碍或责任。

lemmas.def_en: to become aware of through the senses
lemmas.def_zh: 感知，察觉；看待，理解

examples.en: Cats can perceive faint sounds that humans are unable to detect.
examples.zh: 猫能察觉到人类无法察觉的微弱声音。

lemmas.def_en: perceive incorrectly
lemmas.def_zh: 误解；看错

examples.en: It is common for anxious drivers to misperceive safe distances at night.
examples.zh: 焦虑的司机在夜间很容易看错安全距离。

lemmas.def_en: the representation of what is perceived; basic component in the formation of a concept
lemmas.def_zh: 知觉, 感觉, 领悟力, 获取

examples.en: Stress can significantly distort your perception of time during a high-pressure exam.
examples.zh: 在压力巨大的考试中，紧张情绪会显著扭曲你对时间的感知。

lemmas.def_en: a person who becomes aware (of things or events) through the senses
lemmas.def_zh: perceive的变形

examples.en: Beauty is often said to exist only in the mind of the perceiver.
examples.zh: 人们常说，美只存在于感知者的心中。

lemmas.def_zh: 洞察力, 直觉, 理解力
lemmas.def_en: a feeling of understanding

lemmas.def_zh: 知觉的, 有知觉力的, 感知的
lemmas.def_en: of or relating to perception

examples.en: Her perceptive comments during the meeting revealed a deep understanding of issues.
examples.zh: 她在会议期间敏锐的见解展现了对问题的深刻理解。

lemmas.def_zh: 知觉的, 有知觉的
lemmas.def_en: of or relating to the act of perceiving

examples.en: Optical illusions challenge our normal perceptual systems by confusing depth and color.
examples.zh: 视错觉通过混淆深度和色彩来挑战我们正常的知觉系统。

lemmas.def_zh: 可察觉的, 能感觉得到的, 看得见的
lemmas.def_en: capable of being perceived by the mind or senses

examples.en: There was a perceptible change in the room's temperature once the door opened.
examples.zh: 门一打开，房间里的温度就发生了明显的变化。

lemmas.def_en: not perceived or commented on
lemmas.def_zh: 未被发觉的, 未被人看见的, 未被察觉的

examples.en: The subtle change in his tone went entirely unperceived by the tired audience.
examples.zh: 他语调的微妙变化完全没有被疲惫的听众察觉。

lemmas.def_zh: [网络] 感官上；条女
lemmas.def_en: with regard to perception

examples.en: this task is perceptually very difficult

lemmas.def_zh: 洞察力强地, 敏锐地
lemmas.def_en: in a perceptive manner

family_guide.root_logic: per-（彻底）+ -ceive（抓住，来自拉丁语 capere），核心为完全通过感官或心智“捕捉”到信息。

lemmas.def_en: a professional cook
lemmas.def_zh: 厨师，主厨

examples.en: The executive chef personally designed the new seasonal menu.
examples.zh: 行政总厨亲自设计了这套新的时令菜单。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自法语 chef de cuisine（厨房主管），截断后特指专业主厨。

lemmas.def_en: utter obscenities or profanities
lemmas.def_zh: 诅咒, 咒骂

examples.en: He muttered a bitter curse under his breath after missing the last train.
examples.zh: 错过末班车后，他低声恨恨地咒骂了一句。

lemmas.def_en: utter obscenities or profanities

examples.en: The old sailor curst loudly when the sudden storm tore his main sail.
examples.zh: 突如其来的暴风雨撕裂了主帆，老水手大声咒骂起来。

lemmas.def_en: profane or obscene expression usually of surprise or anger
lemmas.def_zh: 咒骂, 诅咒

examples.en: He muttered a bitter curse under his breath after missing the last train.
examples.zh: 错过末班车后，他低声恨恨地咒骂了一句。

lemmas.def_zh: adj. 被诅咒的；可恶的，讨厌的
lemmas.def_en: under a curse; deserving a curse; often used as an intensifier expressing annoyance
lemmas.usage_note: 发音作 /kɜːst/ 时常表示受到诅咒；在文学或古旧用法中常发为双音节 /ˈkɜːsɪd/，意为可恶的、遭天谴的。

examples.en: Legends say that whoever enters the tomb will be cursed forever.
examples.zh: 传说中无论谁进入这座古墓都会受到永世的诅咒。

family_guide.root_logic: 古英语词，核心含义为通过话语召唤不幸或超自然力量施加惩罚，引申为咒骂或诅咒。

lemmas.def_en: a painful muscle spasm especially in the neck or back (`rick' and `wrick' are British)
lemmas.def_zh: 草堆

examples.en: The farmers worked quickly to rick the dry hay before the evening rain.
examples.zh: 农民们赶在晚雨来临前迅速将干草堆成垛。

lemmas.def_en: pile in ricks
lemmas.def_zh: 把...堆成垛

examples.en: The farmers worked quickly to rick the dry hay before the evening rain.
examples.zh: 农民们赶在晚雨来临前迅速将干草堆成垛。

family_guide.root_logic: 日耳曼语源，名词指干草堆，动词由堆叠扭曲之意引申为扭伤（身体部位）。

lemmas.def_en: cause to be interested or curious
lemmas.def_zh: 深深吸引，迷住

examples.en: Ancient Egyptian history has always fascinated her.
examples.zh: 古埃及历史一直令她深深着迷。

lemmas.def_en: the state of being intensely interested (as by awe or terror)
lemmas.def_zh: 令人着迷的事物, 入迷, 魅力

examples.en: Ancient ruins hold an endless fascination for travelers from all over the world.
examples.zh: 古代遗址对世界各地的旅行者有着无尽的吸引力。

lemmas.def_en: in a fascinating manner
lemmas.def_zh: 极有吸引力地; 迷人地

examples.en: She described the microscopic world fascinatingly, keeping every student fully engaged.
examples.zh: 她极具吸引力地描绘了微观世界，吸引了所有学生的注意。

lemmas.def_zh: adj. 迷人的，极有吸引力的
lemmas.def_en: extremely interesting; capable of arousing and holding attention
lemmas.usage_note: 本身带有极度吸引的意思，通常不与 very 连用，可与 absolutely 或 truly 搭配修饰。

examples.en: The museum offers a fascinating glimpse into ancient Roman history.
examples.zh: 该博物馆为人们提供了一窥古罗马迷人历史的绝佳视角。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 fascinum（符咒、巫术），核心意义是通过强烈的吸引力令人着迷、恍惚。

lemmas.def_en: regard something as probable or likely
lemmas.def_zh: 预料，预期；期望

examples.en: We anticipate that sales will rise sharply during the holiday season.
examples.zh: 我们预计节日期间的销售额将急剧上升。

lemmas.def_en: not anticipated; - H.W.Glidden
lemmas.def_zh: [计] 非先行的

examples.en: The sudden project cancellation caused several unanticipated financial challenges for the firm.
examples.zh: 项目的突然取消给公司带来了一些始料未及的财务挑战。

lemmas.def_zh: 期待着的, 先行的, 提早发生的
lemmas.def_en: in anticipation

examples.en: The nervous child experienced anticipatory anxiety long before his scheduled dental appointment.
examples.zh: 这个紧张的孩子早在牙医预约到来之前就产生了预期性焦虑。

lemmas.def_en: marked by eager anticipation
lemmas.def_zh: 预期的, 先发制人的, 占先的

examples.en: The company adopted an anticipative strategy to address potential supply chain disruptions.
examples.zh: 该公司采取了前瞻性策略，以应对潜在的供应链中断。

family_guide.root_logic: anti-（在……之前）+ -cip-（抓取，来自 capere）+ -ate（动词后缀），字面为“提前抓住”，引申为预料并做好准备。

lemmas.def_en: a rich sweet made of flavored sugar and often combined with fruit or nuts
lemmas.def_zh: 糖果, 冰糖

examples.en: Grandmother loves to candy orange peels as special treats for the holidays.
examples.zh: 祖母喜欢把橙皮做成糖渍零食，作为节日特供点心。

lemmas.def_en: coat with something sweet, such as a hard sugar glaze
lemmas.def_zh: 用糖煮, 使结晶为砂糖；结晶为砂糖

examples.en: Grandmother loves to candy orange peels as special treats for the holidays.
examples.zh: 祖母喜欢把橙皮做成糖渍零食，作为节日特供点心。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自阿拉伯语 qand（甘蔗糖），经法语进入英语，引申为糖果或用糖浸渍保存。

lemmas.def_en: a long walk usually for exercise or pleasure
lemmas.def_zh: 徒步旅行, 远足, 涨价, 提高

examples.en: We planned a challenging morning hike through the dense pine forest today.
examples.zh: 我们今天计划在茂密的松树林里进行一次充满挑战的晨间徒步。

lemmas.def_en: a foot traveler; someone who goes on an extended walk (for pleasure)
lemmas.def_zh: 徒步旅行者

examples.en: An exhausted hiker stopped by the mountain stream to refill his water bottle.
examples.zh: 一位疲惫的徒步旅行者停在山间溪流旁装满水壶。

lemmas.def_en: increase
lemmas.def_zh: 步行, 徒步旅行, 上升；使高涨, 拉起

examples.en: We planned a challenging morning hike through the dense pine forest today.
examples.zh: 我们今天计划在茂密的松树林里进行一次充满挑战的晨间徒步。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自方言词，核心表“费力行进、猛拉或大幅抬升”。

lemmas.def_en: make stronger
lemmas.def_zh: 加强, 增援, 补充；求援, 得到增援

examples.en: Engineers added extra steel beams to reinforce the aging bridge against earthquakes.
examples.zh: 工程师们增加了额外的钢梁，以加固老旧桥梁抗震。

lemmas.def_en: a military operation (often involving new supplies of men and materiel) to strengthen a military force or aid in the performance of its mission
lemmas.def_zh: 加强, 增援, 补充, 援军, 加固物

examples.en: The commander sent immediate reinforcement to hold the weakening defensive line.
examples.zh: 指挥官立即派遣援军，以守住日渐薄弱的防线。

lemmas.def_en: (psychology) a stimulus that strengthens or weakens the behavior that produced it
lemmas.def_zh: [化] 增强材料; 增强填料; 增强剂

examples.en: Carbon black is widely used as an effective reinforcer in rubber tire manufacturing.
examples.zh: 炭黑在橡胶轮胎制造中被广泛用作有效的增强填料。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 re-（再）+ in-（使入）+ force（力量），核心表“增强力量与稳固性”。

lemmas.def_en: a friend who is frequently in the company of another
lemmas.def_zh: 朋友, 陪伴, 指南, 升降口围罩

examples.en: A small faithful dog companion followed the lonely traveler wherever he went.
examples.zh: 一只忠实的小狗作为伴侣，无论这位孤独的旅行者去哪都紧紧跟随。

lemmas.def_en: the state of being with someone
lemmas.def_zh: 交往, 友谊, 一群同伴

examples.en: Living alone in the countryside made him truly appreciate the companionship of neighbors.
examples.zh: 独自在乡下生活让他真正体会到了邻里相伴的珍贵。

lemmas.def_en: be a companion to somebody
lemmas.def_zh: 陪伴

examples.en: A small faithful dog companion followed the lonely traveler wherever he went.
examples.zh: 一只忠实的小狗作为伴侣，无论这位孤独的旅行者去哪都紧紧跟随。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 com-（共同）+ panis（面包），原指“一起分吃面包的人”，引申为“同伴”。

lemmas.def_en: of a color intermediate between red and blue
lemmas.def_zh: 紫色的, 帝王的, 华而不实的

examples.en: The evening sky began to purple beautifully as the sun dipped behind hills.
examples.zh: 夕阳隐入山丘之后，晚霞渐渐化作一片美丽的紫色。

lemmas.def_en: a purple color or pigment
lemmas.def_zh: 紫色, 帝位

examples.en: The evening sky began to purple beautifully as the sun dipped behind hills.
examples.zh: 夕阳隐入山丘之后，晚霞渐渐化作一片美丽的紫色。

lemmas.def_en: become purple
lemmas.def_zh: (使)成紫色

examples.en: The evening sky began to purple beautifully as the sun dipped behind hills.
examples.zh: 夕阳隐入山丘之后，晚霞渐渐化作一片美丽的紫色。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 porphyra（骨螺紫染料），因其昂贵古代象征皇权，现指紫颜色及相关修辞。

lemmas.def_en: move downward and lower, but not necessarily all the way
lemmas.def_zh: 下降, 世代相传, 屈尊, 袭击；下降

examples.en: Dark shadows began to descend over the quiet valley as night approached quickly.
examples.zh: 随着夜幕迅速降临，黑暗的阴影开始笼罩幽静的山谷。

lemmas.def_en: a movement downward
lemmas.def_zh: 下降；下坡；血统

examples.en: The plane began its steep descent toward the runway.
examples.zh: 飞机开始向跑道急速下降。

lemmas.def_en: a person considered as descended from some ancestor or race
lemmas.def_zh: 后裔, 子孙

examples.en: He claims to be a direct descendant of the country's first president.
examples.zh: 他自称是该国第一任总统的直系后裔。

lemmas.def_en: a person considered as descended from some ancestor or race
lemmas.def_zh: [医] 下行的, 降的

examples.en: The doctor carefully examined the descendent branch of the patient's coronary artery.
examples.zh: 医生仔细检查了患者冠状动脉的降支。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 de-（向下）+ scend（攀爬，源自 scandere），核心表“由高向低移动”。

lemmas.def_en: an imperfection in an object or machine
lemmas.def_zh: 缺点, 裂纹, 瑕疵, 一阵狂风

examples.en: The security team quickly discovered a critical flaw in the software's coding.
examples.zh: 安全团队很快在软件编码中发现了一个严重缺陷。

lemmas.def_en: the state of being without a flaw or defect
lemmas.def_zh: 无瑕, 完美

examples.en: The judges were deeply impressed by the technical flawlessness of her performance.
examples.zh: 裁判对她表演在技术上的完美无瑕印象深刻。

lemmas.def_en: add a flaw or blemish to; make imperfect or defective
lemmas.def_zh: [化] 划痕; 裂缝; 裂纹

examples.en: The security team quickly discovered a critical flaw in the software's coding.
examples.zh: 安全团队很快在软件编码中发现了一个严重缺陷。

lemmas.def_en: without a flaw
lemmas.def_zh: 无瑕疵的, 无缺点的

examples.en: She delivered a flawless presentation and answered all questions with complete confidence.
examples.zh: 她做了一场完美的演讲，并自信地回答了所有问题。

lemmas.def_en: without a flaw
lemmas.def_zh: 无缺点的,完美无缺的

examples.en: His argument remained unflawed despite intense questioning from the opposing legal team.
examples.zh: 尽管受到对方律师团队的激烈质问，他的论点依然无懈可击。

lemmas.def_en: in an adroit manner
lemmas.def_zh: 无瑕地, 完美地

examples.en: The orchestra executed the complex musical piece flawlessly under the new conductor.
examples.zh: 乐团在新指挥的带领下完美无瑕地演奏了这首复杂的乐曲。

family_guide.root_logic: 词源不详，原指“雪花、裂片”，后引申为“裂痕、瑕疵、缺陷”。
family_guide.core_distinction: flaw 为名词/动词，flawless 为加后缀 -less（无……的）构成的形容词。

lemmas.def_en: compatibility in opinion and action
lemmas.def_zh: 协调, 和睦, 调和

examples.en: The committee worked hard to promote racial harmony within the local community.
examples.zh: 委员会努力促进当地社区内的种族和谐。

lemmas.def_en: a tone that is a component of a complex sound
lemmas.def_zh: 泛音, 谐波

examples.en: The engineer analyzed the upper harmonic produced by the vibrating steel cable.
examples.zh: 工程师分析了振动的钢索所产生的高次谐波。

lemmas.def_en: a piece of harmonized music
lemmas.def_zh: 调和化, 融洽, 一致

examples.en: The summit focused on the harmonization of international trade and environmental standards.
examples.zh: 此次峰会聚焦于国际贸易与环境标准的协调一致。

lemmas.def_en: a musician who sings or plays in harmony
lemmas.def_zh: 使和谐协调的人

examples.en: She acted as a natural harmonizer between the two arguing department managers.
examples.zh: 她在两位发生争执的部门经理之间充当了天生的调解人。

lemmas.def_en: musically pleasing
lemmas.def_zh: 和睦的, 调和的, 和谐的, 协调的

examples.en: They maintained a harmonious relationship despite having completely different political views.
examples.zh: 尽管政治观点截然不同，他们仍保持着融洽的关系。

lemmas.def_en: go together
lemmas.def_zh: 协调, 以和声唱；使一致, 使和谐

examples.en: We need to harmonize our tax policies with neighboring countries to boost trade.
examples.zh: 我们需要使税收政策与邻国相协调，以促进贸易。

lemmas.def_en: in a harmonious manner
lemmas.def_zh: 和谐地, 调和地

examples.en: Different cultures lived harmoniously in the historic city for several continuous centuries.
examples.zh: 几个世纪以来，不同文化在这座历史名城中和谐共存。

lemmas.def_en: with respect to harmony
lemmas.def_zh: 调和地, 和声地

examples.en: The brass instruments combined harmonically to create a very rich, warm sound.
examples.zh: 铜管乐器在和声上交融，营造出极其丰富而温暖的声音。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 harmos（结合、关节），引申为声音、结构或关系上的“协调一致”。

lemmas.def_en: accumulated wealth in the form of money or jewels etc.
lemmas.def_zh: 宝物, 财富

examples.en: I will always treasure the valuable lessons my grandfather taught me in childhood.
examples.zh: 我将永远珍视祖父童年时教给我的宝贵经验。

lemmas.def_en: hold dear
lemmas.def_zh: 珍爱, 重视, 秘藏

examples.en: I will always treasure the valuable lessons my grandfather taught me in childhood.
examples.zh: 我将永远珍视祖父童年时教给我的宝贵经验。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 thesauros（储藏处、财宝），核心指“积聚的珍宝”及“视若珍宝”。

lemmas.def_en: the process in which part of the output of a system is returned to its input in order to regulate its further output
lemmas.def_zh: 反馈, 反应

examples.en: Customer feedback played a crucial role in improving our latest mobile application.
examples.zh: 客户反馈在改进我们最新的手机应用程序中起到了关键作用。

family_guide.root_logic: 复合词 feed（供给）+ back（返回），核心表“系统将输出端的信息反哺回输入端”。

lemmas.def_en: being ten more than forty

examples.en: Over fifty experienced firefighters worked together to bring the forest fire under control.
examples.zh: 五十多名经验丰富的消防员协同作业，控制住了森林火灾。

lemmas.def_en: the cardinal number that is the product of ten and five

examples.en: Over fifty experienced firefighters worked together to bring the forest fire under control.
examples.zh: 五十多名经验丰富的消防员协同作业，控制住了森林火灾。

family_guide.root_logic: 古英语 fīftig，由 fīf（五）+ -tig（十人组、几十）构成，即“五个十”。

lemmas.def_en: (Old Testament) Adam's wife in Judeo-Christian mythology: the first woman and mother of the human race; God created Eve from Adam's rib and placed Adam and Eve in the Garden of Eden
lemmas.def_zh: 前夕, 前夜

examples.en: Families gathered together on the eve of the festival to share a meal.
examples.zh: 家人们在节日的前夕聚在一起共进晚餐。

family_guide.root_logic: evening（傍晚）的诗意缩写，后特指“重大节日或事件的前夕”。

lemmas.def_en: the highest level or degree attainable; the highest stage of development
lemmas.def_zh: 顶点, 最高阶层, 最高级会议

examples.en: The brave climbers managed to summit the dangerous mountain despite heavy snowstorms.
examples.zh: 尽管遭遇大暴雪，勇敢的登山者们还是成功登顶了险峰。

lemmas.def_en: reach the summit (of a mountain)

examples.en: The brave climbers managed to summit the dangerous mountain despite heavy snowstorms.
examples.zh: 尽管遭遇大暴雪，勇敢的登山者们还是成功登顶了险峰。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 summus（最高的），核心表“顶点、最高权力”。

lemmas.def_en: press or grind with a crushing noise
lemmas.def_zh: 磨擦, 磨碎, 磨光, 折磨, 压榨；磨, 磨碎, 苦干

examples.en: She uses a manual machine every morning to grind fresh coffee beans.
examples.zh: 她每天早晨都用一台手动机器研磨新鲜的咖啡豆。

lemmas.def_en: a large sandwich made of a long crusty roll split lengthwise and filled with meats and cheese (and tomato and onion and lettuce and condiments); different names are used in different sections of the United States
lemmas.def_zh: 推磨的人, 研磨者

examples.en: The traditional grinder crushed the roasted spices into a very fine aromatic powder.
examples.zh: 传统的研磨机将烤熟的香料压成了非常细腻的香粉。

family_guide.root_logic: 古英语 grindan，核心表“通过反复挤压、摩擦使破碎”或“费力且单调地劳作”。

lemmas.def_en: tilt or slant to one side
lemmas.def_zh: 使耸立, 使竖起, 堆成锥形小干草堆；大摇大摆地走, 翘起

examples.en: The curious dog cocked its ears when it heard the strange unfamiliar noise.
examples.zh: 好奇的狗听到奇怪陌生的声音时竖起了耳朵。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拟声词，模拟公鸡叫声，后衍生出形态上的“翘起、竖起、扳起击锤”动作。

lemmas.def_en: a drama set to music; consists of singing with orchestral accompaniment and an orchestral overture and interludes
lemmas.def_zh: 歌剧

examples.en: We bought front row tickets to see the famous Italian opera tonight.
examples.zh: 我们买了今晚去看著名意大利歌剧的前排票。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to or characteristic of opera
lemmas.def_zh: 歌剧的, 歌剧风格的

examples.en: Her operatic performance moved the entire audience to tears during the finale.
examples.zh: 在终场时，她歌剧风格的表演让全场观众感动落泪。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 opus（工作、劳动）的复数形式 opera，转借为“集戏剧、音乐、布景等多种艺术劳动于一体的杰作”。

lemmas.def_en: (of persons or their actions) able or disposed to inflict pain or suffering
lemmas.def_zh: adj. 残忍的，野蛮的；不讲情面的

examples.en: The harsh winter wind felt brutal against her skin.
examples.zh: 刺骨的冬风刮在她皮肤上，带来针扎般的酷烈痛感。

lemmas.def_en: the trait of extreme cruelty
lemmas.def_zh: n. 残暴，野蛮行径

examples.en: The documentary exposed the brutality of the conflict.
examples.zh: 这部纪录片揭露了这场冲突的残暴本质。

lemmas.def_en: the condition of being treated in a cruel and savage manner
lemmas.def_zh: 兽性, 残酷

examples.en: The documentary exposed the brutalization of prisoners of war during the conflict.
examples.zh: 这部纪录片揭露了冲突期间战俘遭受的残酷虐待。

lemmas.def_en: in a vicious manner
lemmas.def_zh: adv. 残忍地；直截了当地

examples.en: He was brutally honest about his shortcomings.
examples.zh: 他对自己的缺点坦诚得毫不留情面。

lemmas.def_en: treat brutally
lemmas.def_zh: 使残忍, 残酷地对待, 使残酷无情, 变成野兽一样残忍

examples.en: Years of severe neglect can brutalize young animals and make them aggressive.
examples.zh: 多年的严重忽视会使年幼的动物变得凶残且具攻击性。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 brutus（沉重的、愚钝的、野兽般的），引申为残忍的、毫无人性的。
family_guide.core_distinction: brutal为形容词；brutality为名词形式；brutally为副词。

lemmas.def_en: a strip of land projecting into a body of water
lemmas.def_zh: n. 斗篷，披风；海角，岬

examples.en: The lighthouse stands on a rocky cape overlooking the ocean.
examples.zh: 灯塔矗立在俯瞰大洋的岩石海角上。

lemmas.def_en: lie at the top of
lemmas.def_zh: v. 覆盖顶部；限制（数量或金额）

examples.en: The government decided to cap university tuition fees.
examples.zh: 政府决定对大学学费设置上限。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 caput（头），引申指突出的海角或戴在头颈部的披风。
family_guide.core_distinction: cape指披风或海角；cap源自同源词，作动词时表示覆盖顶部或限制。

lemmas.def_en: (physics and chemistry) the smallest component of an element having the chemical properties of the element
lemmas.def_zh: n. 原子；微粒，微量

examples.en: Water is made up of hydrogen and oxygen atoms.
examples.zh: 水由氢原子和氧原子构成。

lemmas.def_en: a dispenser that turns a liquid (such as perfume) into a fine mist
lemmas.def_zh: 雾化器

examples.en: She pressed the perfume atomizer gently to release a fine fragrant mist.
examples.zh: 她轻轻按压香水喷雾器，喷出一层细腻的芬芳薄雾。

lemmas.def_en: separating something into fine particles
lemmas.def_zh: 粉碎, 以原子弹轰炸, 雾化

examples.en: Effective fuel atomization is essential for optimal engine performance and low emissions.
examples.zh: 有效的燃油雾化对于发动机的最佳性能和低排放至关重要。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to or comprising atoms
lemmas.def_zh: adj. 原子的；原子能的

examples.en: The discovery marked the dawn of the atomic age.
examples.zh: 这一发现标志着原子能时代的开端。

lemmas.def_en: spray very finely
lemmas.def_zh: 使粉碎, 将...喷成雾状

examples.en: The nozzle is designed to atomize the liquid fertilizer over the crops.
examples.zh: 这个喷嘴设计用于将液体肥料雾化喷洒在农作物上。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 atomos（不可分割的），引申为构成物质的基本微粒。
family_guide.core_distinction: atom为名词原子；atomic为派生形容词。

lemmas.def_en: a farewell remark
lemmas.def_zh: n. 告别，再见；告别辞

examples.en: They said their goodbyes at the airport terminal.
examples.zh: 他们在机场航站楼相互道别。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自中古英语 God be with you（愿上帝与你同在）的缩略演变，现用作告别语。

lemmas.def_en: a list of dishes available at a restaurant
lemmas.def_zh: n. 菜单；选项单，功能表

examples.en: The waiter handed us the seasonal dessert menu.
examples.zh: 服务员递给了我们时令甜点菜单。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自法语 menu（细小的），原指小而细致的清单，引申为餐馆菜单及计算机选项单。

lemmas.def_en: pat or squeeze fondly or playfully, especially under the chin
lemmas.def_zh: v. 轻拍，抚弄

examples.en: She leaned down to pat the dog on the head.
examples.zh: 她俯下身轻轻拍了拍那只狗的头。

family_guide.root_logic: 拟声词，模拟轻拍的声音或动作，引申为轻拍。

lemmas.def_en: an inspection of the accounting procedures and records by a trained accountant or CPA
lemmas.def_zh: n. 审计，查账；全面核查

examples.en: The company hired an independent firm to conduct an annual audit.
examples.zh: 公司聘请了一家独立机构进行年度审计。

lemmas.def_en: someone who listens attentively
lemmas.def_zh: 审计员, 听者, 旁听生

examples.en: An independent auditor arrived this morning to examine the firm's financial records.
examples.zh: 一名独立审计员今天早晨到达，审查公司的财务记录。

lemmas.def_en: examine carefully for accuracy with the intent of verification
lemmas.def_zh: v. 审计；查账

examples.en: The company hired an independent firm to conduct an annual audit.
examples.zh: 公司聘请了一家独立机构进行年度审计。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 audire（听），古代官员通过听取口头汇报来查账，引申为正式审计与旁听。
family_guide.core_distinction: audit兼具名词（审计行为/报告）与动词（审查账目/旁听）用法。

lemmas.def_en: state categorically
lemmas.def_zh: v. 坚称，断言；维护（权威、权利）

examples.en: She continued to assert her innocence throughout the trial.
examples.zh: 在整个审判过程中，她始终坚称自己是无辜的。

lemmas.def_en: a declaration that is made emphatically (as if no supporting evidence were necessary)
lemmas.def_zh: n. 断言，明确肯定；维护

examples.en: His assertion that the project was on track proved false.
examples.zh: 他断言项目进展顺利，但后来被证实并非如此。

lemmas.def_en: aggressive self-assurance; given to making bold assertions
lemmas.def_zh: 魄力, 自信

examples.en: Developing assertiveness can help you communicate your boundaries clearly in the workplace.
examples.zh: 培养魄力有助于你在职场中清晰地传达自己的界限。

lemmas.def_en: aggressively self-assured
lemmas.def_zh: 武断的, 过分自信的

examples.en: You need to be more assertive if you want your opinions heard.
examples.zh: 如果你想让自己的意见被倾听，就需要更加自信果断。

lemmas.def_en: inclined to timidity or lack of self-confidence
lemmas.def_zh: 不武断的, 谦虚的, 害羞的

examples.en: His unassertive nature made it difficult for him to lead the team effectively.
examples.zh: 他那缺乏魄力的性格使他很难有效地领导团队。

lemmas.def_en: in an assertive manner
lemmas.def_zh: 独断地；断言地

examples.en: She spoke assertively during the meeting to ensure her project received funding.
examples.zh: 她在会议上坚定地发言，以确保她的项目获得资金。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 ad-（朝向）+ serere（连接、束缚），原意为将手置于某物上宣布主权，引申为坚定声称或维护权利。
family_guide.core_distinction: assert为动词；assertion为名词断言或主张。

lemmas.def_en: express greetings upon meeting someone
lemmas.def_zh: v. 问候，向……打招呼；迎接

examples.en: The host stood at the entrance to greet the guests.
examples.zh: 主人站在入口处迎接宾客。

lemmas.def_en: (usually plural) an acknowledgment or expression of good will (especially on meeting)
lemmas.def_zh: n. 问候，致意；问候卡

examples.en: She nodded in polite greeting as he entered the room.
examples.zh: 他走进房间时，她礼貌地点头致意。

lemmas.def_en: a person who greets
lemmas.def_zh: 欢迎人员

examples.en: A friendly greeter welcomed every guest at the entrance of the luxury hotel.
examples.zh: 一位友善的迎宾员在豪华酒店门口迎接每一位客人。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 gretan（接近、称呼），核心语义为以言语或举止向他人致意。
family_guide.core_distinction: greet为动词；greeting为名词问候语或迎接。

lemmas.def_en: under the level of the ground
lemmas.def_zh: adj. 地下的；秘密的，非官方的

examples.en: The city is expanding its underground rail network.
examples.zh: 该市正在扩建其地下铁道网络。

family_guide.root_logic: 由 under（在……下）+ ground（地面）构成的复合词，字面指地下，引申为地下的、秘密的。

lemmas.def_zh: prep. （诉讼、竞赛等中）对，对抗；与……相比

examples.en: The final match will be France versus Argentina.
examples.zh: 决赛将是法国队对阵阿根廷队。

family_guide.root_logic: 拉丁语原词，源自 vertere（转动、转向），引申为正对着、对抗。

lemmas.def_en: being nine more than forty
lemmas.def_zh: adj. （作为前缀构成形容词）表示“不、非、无”

examples.en: The illegible signature on the document caused confusion.
examples.zh: 文件上难以辨认的签名引起了混乱。

family_guide.root_logic: 拉丁语否定前缀 in- 在辅音字母 l 前的同化变体，表“非、不”，通常作为前缀构词（如 illegal, illiterate）。

lemmas.def_en: currently happening
lemmas.def_zh: adj. 进行中的，持续存在的

examples.en: There is an ongoing debate about the ethics of artificial intelligence.
examples.zh: 关于人工智能伦理的争论仍在持续进行。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 on-（向前、进行）+ going（走），核心意为“持续进行中的”。

lemmas.def_en: the upper side of the thighs of a seated person
lemmas.def_zh: 膝盖, 舔, 一圈, 下摆, 衣兜, 山坳

examples.en: The cat jumped onto my lap and purred softly while I read.
examples.zh: 我读书时，猫跳到了我的膝盖上，轻轻地打着呼噜。

lemmas.def_en: lie partly over or alongside of something or of one another
lemmas.def_zh: 重叠, 围住, 轻拍, 舔；包围, 抱...在膝上, 使重叠, 舔, 拍打, 泼溅

examples.en: The cat jumped onto my lap and purred softly while I read.
examples.zh: 我读书时，猫跳到了我的膝盖上，轻轻地打着呼噜。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语，指平叠、环绕或拍打的状态，引申出大腿上方平坦处、跑道的一圈及轻拍声。

lemmas.def_en: a police officer who investigates crimes
lemmas.def_zh: n. 侦探，便衣刑警

examples.en: The detective found a crucial clue that broke the case wide open.
examples.zh: 侦探发现了一条让案情迎刃而解的关键线索。

family_guide.root_logic: 来自 detect（揭发、查明，de- 除去 + tect 遮盖），-ive 表示执行该动作的人。

lemmas.def_en: a situation resembling a terrifying dream
lemmas.def_zh: n. 噩梦；可怕的经历

examples.en: Finding parking downtown on a Friday night is an absolute nightmare.
examples.zh: 周五晚上在市中心找停车位简直是一场噩梦。

family_guide.root_logic: 由 night（夜晚）+ mare（古英语指压在熟睡者身上的女妖、梦魇）组合而成。

lemmas.def_en: articulate; either verbally or with a cry, shout, or noise
lemmas.def_zh: 发出声音, 做声, 发表, 发射, 流通

examples.en: The exhausted child was so tired that he could not utter a word.
examples.zh: 疲惫的孩子太累了，连一个字也说不出来。

lemmas.def_en: without qualification; used informally as (often pejorative) intensifiers
lemmas.def_zh: 全然的, 绝对的, 完全的

examples.en: The exhausted child was so tired that he could not utter a word.
examples.zh: 疲惫的孩子太累了，连一个字也说不出来。

lemmas.def_en: completely and without qualification; used informally as intensifiers
lemmas.def_zh: 完全地, 全然, 绝对

examples.en: I was utterly exhausted after hiking up the steep mountain all afternoon.
examples.zh: 在陡峭的山上徒步了一整个下午后，我彻底精疲力竭了。

lemmas.def_en: the use of uttered sounds for auditory communication
lemmas.def_zh: 发声, 言辞, 表达, 说话的方式, 死

examples.en: His sudden emotional utterance surprised everyone in the quiet meeting room.
examples.zh: 他在安静的会议室里突然情绪化的言辞让每个人都感到惊讶。

family_guide.root_logic: 源于古英语表示“向外”，由“向外表达”引申为说出，后扩展出“外在至极”即完全的、彻底的。
family_guide.core_distinction: utter 作动词表示发出声音或说出；作形容词强调程度的极端与完全。

lemmas.def_en: be a lodger; stay temporarily
lemmas.def_zh: 临时住宿, 倒伏, 寄宿, 投宿；安顿, 容纳, 提出, 把...射入, 存放

examples.en: We decided to lodge at a small mountain cabin during our ski trip.
examples.zh: 我们决定在滑雪旅行期间寄宿在一座小山间木屋里。

lemmas.def_en: structures collectively in which people are housed
lemmas.def_zh: 寄宿处, 寄宿

examples.en: The university helped international students find cheap lodging near the campus.
examples.zh: 大学帮助留学生在校园附近寻找便宜的住所。

lemmas.def_en: a tenant in someone's house
lemmas.def_zh: 寄宿者, 房客

examples.en: She decided to take in a lodger to help pay the monthly rent.
examples.zh: 她决定招收一名房客来分摊每月的房租。

lemmas.def_en: bringing a charge or accusation against someone
lemmas.def_zh: 住所, 住宿, 沉积, 存放物, 存放, 沉积物

examples.en: Rain caused a dangerous lodgement of mud and debris along the roadway.
examples.zh: 暴雨导致道路沿线出现了危险的泥沙和瓦砾堆积。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自日耳曼语中搭建的简易棚屋，引申为提供住宿、寄宿，后延伸出嵌入或正式提出。
family_guide.core_distinction: lodge 兼具动词与名词；lodging 专指暂住处或寄宿。

lemmas.def_en: the inner surface of the hand from the wrist to the base of the fingers
lemmas.def_zh: 手掌, 棕榈, 胜利

examples.en: The magician quickly palmed the silver coin and made it completely disappear.
examples.zh: 魔术师迅速将银币藏入掌中并使其彻底消失。

lemmas.def_en: touch, lift, or hold with the hands
lemmas.def_zh: 与...握手, 藏...于掌中

examples.en: The magician quickly palmed the silver coin and made it completely disappear.
examples.zh: 魔术师迅速将银币藏入掌中并使其彻底消失。

lemmas.def_zh: 手掌的, 掌中的
lemmas.def_en: relating to the palm of the hand or the sole of the foot

examples.en: The dermatologist carefully examined the strange rash developing on the patient's palmar surface.
examples.zh: 皮肤科医生仔细检查了患者手掌表面出现的一处奇怪皮疹。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 palma，原指手掌，因棕榈树叶形状如展开的手掌而同名，动词引申为手掌轻抚或隐匿。

lemmas.def_en: an onerous or difficult concern
lemmas.def_zh: 负担, 重载, 担子, 责任

examples.en: High medical bills placed a heavy financial burden on the young family.
examples.zh: 高额的医疗账单给这个年轻家庭带来了沉重的经济负担。

lemmas.def_en: weight down with a load
lemmas.def_zh: 装货于, 烦扰, 使负担

examples.en: High medical bills placed a heavy financial burden on the young family.
examples.zh: 高额的医疗账单给这个年轻家庭带来了沉重的经济负担。

lemmas.def_en: free or relieve (someone) of a burden
lemmas.def_zh: 使卸去负荷, 使安心, 吐露心事消除思想负担

examples.en: He finally unburdened his troubled mind to his closest childhood friend yesterday.
examples.zh: 昨天他终于向儿时最亲密的朋友吐露了心事。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自 bear（承受、背负），指所背负的重量，引申为精神或物质上的重担。

lemmas.def_en: all the weapons and equipment that a country has
lemmas.def_zh: n. 军火库，武器库；（储备的）应对手段

examples.en: The team used its full arsenal of strategies to win the tournament.
examples.zh: 该队动用了全部战术手段赢得了锦标赛。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自阿拉伯语 dār aṣ-ṣinā‘ah（工场、制造局），经意大利语传入，特指武器制造厂及军火库。

lemmas.def_en: an orderly pile
lemmas.def_zh: 堆叠, 堆, 大量, 书库, 枪架, 烟囱, 堆积, 存贮栈

examples.en: Volunteers began to stack the donated cardboard boxes neatly inside the warehouse.
examples.zh: 志愿者们开始将捐赠的纸箱整齐地堆放在仓库里。

lemmas.def_en: a laborer who builds up a stack or pile
lemmas.def_zh: 堆垛者, 堆垛工

examples.en: The warehouse hired an experienced stacker to operate the automated storage system.
examples.zh: 仓库雇用了一名经验丰富的堆垛工来操作自动化存储系统。

lemmas.def_en: load or cover with stacks
lemmas.def_zh: 堆积, 堆满, 暗中对...做手脚；堆起

examples.en: Volunteers began to stack the donated cardboard boxes neatly inside the warehouse.
examples.zh: 志愿者们开始将捐赠的纸箱整齐地堆放在仓库里。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古诺斯语 stakkr（干草堆），核心意象为“整齐成叠地堆放”。

lemmas.def_en: the part of a gunlock that strikes the percussion cap when the trigger is pulled
lemmas.def_zh: 锤, 铁锤, 钉锤

examples.en: He used a steel hammer to gently pound the loose nails back.
examples.zh: 他用一把钢锤轻轻地把松动的铁钉敲打回去。

lemmas.def_en: beat with or as if with a hammer
lemmas.def_zh: 锤打, 敲打, 钉；连续锤打

examples.en: He used a steel hammer to gently pound the loose nails back.
examples.zh: 他用一把钢锤轻轻地把松动的铁钉敲打回去。

family_guide.root_logic: 日耳曼原始词根，拟声敲击动作，指击打工具铁锤及反复锤炼、击打的动作。

lemmas.def_en: exaggerate or make bigger
lemmas.def_zh: 使膨胀, 使得意, 使通货膨胀, 使充气；充气, 膨胀

examples.en: We used a small electric pump to inflate the children's pool quickly.
examples.zh: 我们用一个小型电动气泵迅速给儿童泳池充了气。

lemmas.def_en: a general and progressive increase in prices
lemmas.def_zh: 胀大, 夸张, 通货膨胀

examples.en: High inflation rates eroded the purchasing power of everyday consumers this year.
examples.zh: 今年高企的通胀率削弱了日常消费者的购买力。

lemmas.def_en: an air pump operated by hand to inflate something (as a tire)
lemmas.def_zh: 充气者, 充气机

examples.en: Keep an emergency tire inflator inside your vehicle trunk during winter months.
examples.zh: 冬日里在车辆后备箱常备一个应急充气泵。

lemmas.def_en: designed to be filled with air or gas
lemmas.def_zh: 膨胀的, 得意的, 通货膨胀的

examples.en: The kids spent all afternoon playing on the bright inflatable water slide.
examples.zh: 孩子们整个下午都在鲜艳的充气水滑梯上玩耍。

lemmas.def_zh: 通货膨胀的, 通货膨胀倾向的
lemmas.def_en: associated with or tending to cause increases in inflation

examples.en: Rapid wage growth created strong inflationary pressure across the entire domestic economy.
examples.zh: 工资的快速增长给整个国内经济带来了强烈的通胀压力。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 in-（进入）+ flate（吹气），核心概念是“吹气膨胀”，引申指经济物价膨胀。
family_guide.core_distinction: inflate 为动词动作；inflation 为名词状态或经济学上的通货膨胀。

lemmas.def_en: spring back; spring away from an impact
lemmas.def_zh: 反跳, 弹跳；使跳回, 撞击

examples.en: The tennis ball had a high bounce on the newly paved court.
examples.zh: 网球在新铺设的球场上弹跳得很高。

lemmas.def_en: the quality of a substance that is able to rebound
lemmas.def_zh: 跳, 跳跃, 弹力, 撞击

examples.en: The tennis ball had a high bounce on the newly paved court.
examples.zh: 网球在新铺设的球场上弹跳得很高。

lemmas.def_en: a person whose duty is to throw troublemakers out of a bar or public meeting
lemmas.def_zh: 巨大的东西, 巨人, 跳跃的人, 同类中最大者

examples.en: The nightclub bouncer strictly checked everyone's identification before letting them enter inside.
examples.zh: 夜总会保镖在放行前严格检查了每个人的身份证件。

lemmas.def_zh: 反弹力
lemmas.def_en: the quality of a substance that is able to rebound

lemmas.def_zh: 快活的, 精神饱满的, 有弹性的, 自大的
lemmas.def_en: elastic; rebounds readily

examples.en: The children loved playing on the bouncy castle in the backyard.
examples.zh: 孩子们喜欢在后院的充气蹦床上玩耍。

family_guide.root_logic: 拟声词起源，模拟弹性碰撞后反弹的声音，核心动作为“弹起、跃动”。

lemmas.def_en: carefully thought out in advance
lemmas.def_zh: 深思熟虑的, 故意的, 从容的

examples.en: Her deliberate decision to change careers surprised everyone at the office yesterday.
examples.zh: 她昨天深思熟虑后做出的转行决定让办公室里的每个人都感到惊讶。

lemmas.def_en: involved in or characterized by deliberation and discussion and examination
lemmas.def_zh: 慎重的, 审议的

examples.en: The senate formed a deliberative committee to thoroughly examine the new proposal.
examples.zh: 参议院成立了一个审议委员会来彻底审查这项新提案。

lemmas.def_en: with intention; in an intentional manner
lemmas.def_zh: 故意地

examples.en: He deliberately arrived thirty minutes late to avoid speaking with his manager.
examples.zh: 他故意迟到了三十分钟，以避免与经理交谈。

lemmas.def_en: (usually plural) discussion of all sides of a question
lemmas.def_zh: 熟虑, 熟思, 审议

examples.en: After hours of careful deliberation, the jury finally reached a unanimous verdict.
examples.zh: 经过数小时的仔细审议，陪审团最终达成了全票判决。

lemmas.def_en: a rate demonstrating an absence of haste or hurry
lemmas.def_zh: 审慎, 蓄意, 故意

examples.en: She approached the delicate negotiations with remarkable deliberateness and exceptional calm demeanor.
examples.zh: 她以极度的从容审慎和非凡的冷静举止应对这场微妙的谈判。

lemmas.def_en: think about carefully; weigh
lemmas.def_zh: 仔细考虑

examples.en: The jury needed several hours to deliberate before reaching their final verdict.
examples.zh: 陪审团在做出最终裁决前需要几个小时来仔细考虑。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自 de-（完全）+ libra（天平），核心意象为“在天平上仔细称量”，引申为深思熟虑的、故意的。
family_guide.core_distinction: deliberate 作形容词读作 /-rət/（故意的）；作动词读作 /-reɪt/（仔细考虑）。

lemmas.def_en: the first light of day
lemmas.def_zh: 破晓, 黎明

examples.en: They set off just before dawn to catch the first morning train.
examples.zh: 他们天亮前就出发了，去赶清晨的第一班火车。

lemmas.def_en: become clear or enter one's consciousness or emotions
lemmas.def_zh: 破晓

examples.en: They set off just before dawn to catch the first morning train.
examples.zh: 他们天亮前就出发了，去赶清晨的第一班火车。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 dagian（变为白天），指破晓黎明，引申为事物初现或领悟萌生。

lemmas.def_en: take away to an undisclosed location against their will and usually in order to extract a ransom
lemmas.def_zh: 绑架，劫持

examples.en: Two foreign journalists were kidnapped by militants.
examples.zh: 两名外国记者遭激进分子绑架。

lemmas.def_en: (law) the unlawful act of capturing and carrying away a person against their will and holding them in false imprisonment
lemmas.def_zh: 绑架（罪），绑架案件

examples.en: Police are investigating the kidnapping of the wealthy heiress.
examples.zh: 警方正在调查这位豪门女继承人的遭绑案。

lemmas.def_en: someone who unlawfully seizes and detains a victim (usually for ransom)
lemmas.def_zh: 拐子, 绑架者

examples.en: The police tracked the kidnapper to an abandoned warehouse outside the city.
examples.zh: 警方追踪绑架者来到城外的一座废弃仓库。

family_guide.root_logic: 由 kid（小孩）+ nap/nab（绑架、抓走）构成，原指拐卖儿童，后泛指绑架任何人。

lemmas.def_en: tavern consisting of a building with a bar and public rooms; often provides light meals
lemmas.def_zh: 酒吧，酒馆

examples.en: We went to the local pub for a pint after work.
examples.zh: 下班后我们去当地的酒吧喝了一品脱啤酒。

family_guide.root_logic: public house（公馆、客栈）的日常口语缩略形式。

lemmas.def_en: a small fragment of something broken off from the whole
lemmas.def_zh: 碎片, 残余物, 些微, 片断, 铁屑, 吵架

examples.en: She quickly wrote the phone number down on a scrap of paper.
examples.zh: 她快速把电话号码写在一张纸片上。

lemmas.def_en: someone who fights (or is fighting)
lemmas.def_zh: 好打架的人, 拳击手

examples.en: Known as a fierce scrapper, the boxer never gave up in the ring.
examples.zh: 作为一名公认的勇猛拳手，他在擂台上从不轻言放弃。

lemmas.def_en: the trait of being scrappy and pugnacious
lemmas.def_zh: 斗志旺盛

examples.en: The team won the championship through sheer scrappiness and relentless effort.
examples.zh: 该队凭借顽强的斗志和不懈的努力赢得了冠军。

lemmas.def_en: dispose of (something useless or old)
lemmas.def_zh: 扔弃, 敲碎, 拆毁；互相殴打

examples.en: She quickly wrote the phone number down on a scrap of paper.
examples.zh: 她快速把电话号码写在一张纸片上。

lemmas.def_en: full of fighting spirit
lemmas.def_zh: 杂凑的, 不连贯的, 爱打架的, 坚决的

examples.en: The startup survived its first year thanks to a scrappy and determined team.
examples.zh: 凭借一支坚韧不拔的团队，这家初创公司度过了第一年。

family_guide.root_logic: 原指切割下的小碎片，引申指废料丢弃或街头碎裂性的小打小闹。

lemmas.def_en: immerse briefly into a liquid so as to wet, coat, or saturate
lemmas.def_zh: 浸，蘸；急剧下降；下沉

examples.en: Dip the strawberries into the melted chocolate.
examples.zh: 把草莓蘸进融化的巧克力里。

lemmas.def_en: a ladle that has a cup with a long handle
lemmas.def_zh: 显影液槽, 浸礼会教友, 浸染工, 北斗七星

examples.en: On clear nights, you can easily spot the Big Dipper in the sky.
examples.zh: 在晴朗的夜晚，你可以轻易在空中认出北斗七星。

family_guide.root_logic: 模仿物体快速放入液体再拿出的动作，核心逻辑为短暂下浸或浅尝。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to or resembling the eye
lemmas.def_zh: 眼睛的, 视觉的, 光学的

examples.en: The doctor examined the patient's optic nerve during the routine vision checkup.
examples.zh: 在常规视力检查中，医生检查了患者的视神经。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to or involving light or optics
lemmas.def_zh: 眼睛的, 视觉的, 光学的

examples.en: The microscope uses advanced optical technology to display microscopic organisms clearly.
examples.zh: 这台显微镜利用先进的光学技术清晰显示微生物。

lemmas.def_en: the organ of sight
lemmas.def_zh: 镜片

examples.en: The doctor examined the patient's optic nerve during the routine vision checkup.
examples.zh: 在常规视力检查中，医生检查了患者的视神经。

lemmas.def_en: in an optical manner
lemmas.def_zh: 眼睛地；视力地；光学地

examples.en: The new glass lenses are optically superior to the old plastic ones.
examples.zh: 新型玻璃镜片在光学性能上优于旧的塑料镜片。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 optikos（与视觉或眼睛相关的）。
family_guide.core_distinction: optic 常特指生物解剖学的眼部的（如 optic nerve）；optical 则广泛用于光学技术或视觉效果（如 optical illusion）。

lemmas.def_en: a political advocate of socialism
lemmas.def_zh: 社会主义者

examples.en: She has been a committed socialist all her adult life.
examples.zh: 她成年后一直是个坚定的社会主义者。

lemmas.def_en: a political theory advocating state ownership of industry
lemmas.def_zh: n. 社会主义

examples.en: The political debate focused on the principles of democratic socialism.
examples.zh: 这场政治辩论聚焦于民主社会主义的原则。

lemmas.def_en: advocating or following the socialist principles
lemmas.def_zh: 社会主义的

examples.en: The newly elected government began introducing several socialistic policies to reduce inequality.
examples.zh: 新当选的政府开始推行几项社会主义性质的政策以减少不平等。

family_guide.root_logic: 词根 social（社会的、群体的）+ -ist（…主义者），主张生产资料公有与社会平等的拥护者。

lemmas.def_en: behave in a certain manner; show a certain behavior; conduct or comport oneself
lemmas.def_zh: 表现，举止；听话，守规矩

examples.en: The children promised to behave while their parents were away.
examples.zh: 孩子们保证父母不在时会乖乖听话。

lemmas.def_en: behave badly
lemmas.def_zh: (使)行为无礼貌, (使)行为不端

examples.en: The teacher warned the children not to misbehave during the museum tour.
examples.zh: 老师警告孩子们在参观博物馆期间不要捣乱。

lemmas.def_en: improper or wicked or immoral behavior
lemmas.def_zh: 不正当的举止, 不规矩的行为

examples.en: His persistent misbehavior in class finally resulted in a call to his parents.
examples.zh: 他在课堂上一贯的不良行为最终导致老师通知了家长。

family_guide.root_logic: 由 be-（使…）+ have（拥有、克制），字面指“控制、守住自己”，引申为举止表现。

lemmas.def_en: continue to exist
lemmas.def_zh: 坚持，执意；持续存在

examples.en: If the symptoms persist for more than three days, see a doctor.
examples.zh: 如果症状持续超过三天，请就医。

lemmas.def_en: never-ceasing
lemmas.def_zh: 执着的；持续不断的

examples.en: His persistent efforts finally paid off when he got the job.
examples.zh: 当他得到这份工作时，他坚持不懈的努力终于得到了回报。

lemmas.def_en: the property of a continuous and connected period of time
lemmas.def_zh: 坚持不懈，毅力；持续

examples.en: Her persistence in pursuing the truth inspired everyone.
examples.zh: 她追求真相的执着鼓舞了所有人。

lemmas.def_en: persistent determination
lemmas.def_zh: 坚持, 固执, 持续, 持久性, 存留, 余辉的保留时间

examples.en: Her persistency in pursuing the truth eventually uncovered the whole scandal.
examples.zh: 她对真相的执着追求最终揭露了整桩丑闻。

lemmas.def_en: in a persistent manner
lemmas.def_zh: 坚持地; 固执地; 一个劲儿

examples.en: The young reporter persistently questioned the mayor until he gave an honest answer.
examples.zh: 年轻记者一再追问市长，直到他给出诚实的回答。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 per-（自始至终）+ sist（站立），意为“始终屹立不倒，坚持到底”。
family_guide.core_distinction: persistent 是形容词（坚持的，反复出现的）；persistence 是名词（毅力，持续性）。

lemmas.def_en: cattle that are reared for their meat
lemmas.def_zh: 牛肉, 肌肉

examples.en: They ordered grilled beef and roasted vegetables for dinner at the steakhouse.
examples.zh: 他们在牛排馆点了烤牛肉和烤蔬菜作为晚餐。

lemmas.def_en: complain
lemmas.def_zh: 养(牛), 宰(牛)；抱怨, 告发

examples.en: They ordered grilled beef and roasted vegetables for dinner at the steakhouse.
examples.zh: 他们在牛排馆点了烤牛肉和烤蔬菜作为晚餐。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古法语 boef（牛），俚语中衍生出由抱怨、争执而产生的“牢骚”。

lemmas.def_en: a portable computer small enough to use in your lap
lemmas.def_zh: 笔记本电脑

examples.en: She closed her laptop and packed it into her backpack.
examples.zh: 她合上笔记本电脑，将其装进了背包。

family_guide.root_logic: 由 lap（膝盖）+ top（上方）构成的复合词，指能放在膝盖上使用的便携式电脑。

lemmas.def_en: a position in a grammatical linguistic construction in which a variety of alternative units are interchangeable
lemmas.def_zh: 水沟, 细长孔, 硬币投币口, 缝, 狭槽, 狭通道, 位置, 一档(广播节目等)

examples.en: He dropped a coin into the slot to start the coffee machine.
examples.zh: 他把一枚硬币投进投币口以启动咖啡机。

lemmas.def_en: assign a time slot
lemmas.def_zh: 开槽于, 把...纳入机构

examples.en: He dropped a coin into the slot to start the coffee machine.
examples.zh: 他把一枚硬币投进投币口以启动咖啡机。

family_guide.root_logic: 原指细长的小孔，引申为容纳某物的狭长开口、时间位置或归入位置。

lemmas.def_en: consisting of or involving two parts or components usually in pairs
lemmas.def_zh: 双重的，两部分的

examples.en: The car has a dual airbag system for enhanced safety.
examples.zh: 这辆车配有双安全气囊系统以提高安全性。

lemmas.def_en: being twofold; a classification into two opposed parts or subclasses
lemmas.def_zh: 二元性

examples.en: The novel explores the duality of human nature through its two main characters.
examples.zh: 这部小说通过两位主角探讨了人性的二元性。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 duo（二），表示由两部分组成或具有双重性质的。

lemmas.def_en: dispose or incline or entice to
lemmas.def_zh: 诱惑，引诱

examples.en: The delicious smell tempted him to break his diet.
examples.zh: 诱人的香味诱使他打破了节食计划。

lemmas.def_en: something that seduces or has the quality to seduce
lemmas.def_zh: 诱惑，引诱物

examples.en: He resisted the temptation to check his phone during the meeting.
examples.zh: 他在开会期间抵制住了看手机的诱惑。

lemmas.def_en: a person who tempts others
lemmas.def_zh: 引诱者, 诱惑者

examples.en: He resisted the tempter offering him easy money through illegal schemes.
examples.zh: 他抵制住了诱惑者向他抛出的非法敛财诱饵。

lemmas.def_en: in a tempting seductive manner
lemmas.def_zh: 吸引人地; 诱人地; 诱惑人地; 迷人地

examples.en: Freshly baked pastries were arranged temptingly in the shop window to lure customers.
examples.zh: 新鲜出炉的糕点诱人地摆在橱窗里，以吸引顾客。

lemmas.def_zh: adj. 诱人的，吸引人的
lemmas.def_en: highly attractive and able to arouse hope or desire
lemmas.usage_note: 常搭配 offer, prospect, idea 等，如 a tempting job offer。

examples.en: It was a tempting offer, but she ultimately decided not to relocate.
examples.zh: 这是一个诱人的工作机会，但她最终还是决定不搬迁。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 temptare（试探、触摸），引申为利用吸引物来试探或诱使某人行动。
family_guide.core_distinction: tempt 为动词行动；temptation 为名词形式，指诱惑本身或诱惑状态。

lemmas.def_en: film that has been shot
lemmas.def_zh: n. 连续镜头，录像片段；英尺长度

examples.en: Police released surveillance footage of the suspect.
examples.zh: 警方公布了嫌疑人的监控录像片段。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自 foot（英尺），最初指以英尺计量的胶片长度，后引申为拍摄到的连续镜头或视频片段。

lemmas.def_en: be relevant to
lemmas.def_zh: v. 涉及；使担忧

examples.en: The growing wealth gap concerns many economists.
examples.zh: 不断扩大的贫富差距令许多经济学家担忧。

family_guide.root_logic: 来自 concern（关联、关心），现在分词转化为介词，表示“与……相关”。

lemmas.def_zh: prep. 在……之中，在……中间（等于 among）

examples.en: She found herself sitting amongst complete strangers.
examples.zh: 她发现自己坐在一群完全陌生的人中间。

family_guide.root_logic: among 的古体及英式变体，源自古英语 ongemang（在混杂中），加副词后缀 -st 构成。

lemmas.def_en: 12 o'clock at night; the middle of the night
lemmas.def_zh: n. 午夜，半夜十二点

examples.en: The deadline for submitting the application is midnight.
examples.zh: 提交申请的截止时间是午夜十二点。

family_guide.root_logic: 复合词 mid（中间）+ night（夜晚），字面即“夜半时分”。

lemmas.def_en: come open suddenly and violently, as if from internal pressure
lemmas.def_zh: v. 猛冲；爆炸，破裂；突然发作 |

examples.en: He burst into the room and announced the good news.
examples.zh: 他冲进房间，宣布了这个好消息。

lemmas.def_en: the act of exploding or bursting
lemmas.def_zh: n. 爆发；破裂

examples.en: He burst into the room and announced the good news.
examples.zh: 他冲进房间，宣布了这个好消息。

lemmas.def_en: a quantity of explosive to be set off at one time
lemmas.def_zh: [计] 分组器, 分页器, 分片器

examples.en: The automated burster quickly separated the continuous form paper into individual sheets.
examples.zh: 自动分页机迅速将连续折叠纸分离成单张。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 berstan，模拟物体因内部压力过大而突然破裂的声响与动作。

lemmas.def_en: disgraceful gossip about the private lives of other people
lemmas.def_zh: n. 丑闻，丑事；耻辱

examples.en: The political scandal forced the prime minister to resign.
examples.zh: 这起政治丑闻迫使首相辞职。

lemmas.def_en: giving offense to moral sensibilities and injurious to reputation; ; - Thackeray
lemmas.def_zh: 不体面的, 可耻的, 诽谤性的, 爱传播丑闻的

examples.en: The politician resigned immediately after the scandalous photos were leaked to the press.
examples.zh: 这些令人震惊的不雅照片泄露给媒体后，该政客立即辞职。

lemmas.def_en: strike with disgust or revulsion
lemmas.def_zh: 使生反感, 使震惊, 诽谤

examples.en: Her bold and rebellious behavior managed to scandalize the conservative elders of the village.
examples.zh: 她大胆叛逆的举止让村里保守的长辈们深感震惊与反感。

lemmas.def_en: in a scandalous manner
lemmas.def_zh: 过分地；诽谤性地；令人愤慨地

examples.en: The luxury hotel was scandalously expensive, yet the service was remarkably poor.
examples.zh: 这家豪华酒店的价格贵得离谱，但服务却差得出奇。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 skandalon（绊脚石、诱人犯罪的事物），引申为引发公众公愤的丑闻。

lemmas.def_en: cause to regain consciousness
lemmas.def_zh: v. （使）复苏，恢复；重新上映/演出

examples.en: A splash of cold water helped to revive him.
examples.zh: 泼了一脸凉水让他清醒了过来。

lemmas.def_en: bringing again into activity and prominence
lemmas.def_zh: n. 复兴；恢复；重新流行

examples.en: The town is experiencing an economic revival.
examples.zh: 该镇正在经历经济复苏。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 re-（再次）+ viv-（生命、活），字面即“重获新生”。

lemmas.def_en: put an end to a state or an activity
lemmas.def_zh: v. 停止，终止，结束

examples.en: The factory will cease operations by the end of this month.
examples.zh: 该工厂将在本月底停止运营。

lemmas.def_en: uninterrupted in time and indefinitely long continuing
lemmas.def_zh: 不停的, 不断的

examples.en: The sailors were completely exhausted by the ceaseless pounding of the heavy ocean waves.
examples.zh: 海浪不停的猛烈拍击让水手们精疲力竭。

lemmas.def_en: with unflagging resolve
lemmas.def_zh: 不停地, 不断地

examples.en: He worked ceaselessly throughout the long night to finish the project before dawn.
examples.zh: 他整夜不停地工作，以便在黎明前完成项目。

lemmas.def_zh: 停止
lemmas.def_en: a stopping

examples.en: Both nations finally agreed to an immediate cessation of hostile military operations.
examples.zh: 两国最终同意立即停止一切敌对军事行动。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 cedere（让步、离开、停止），表示活动或状态的终止。

lemmas.def_en: a book or pamphlet containing an enumeration of things
lemmas.def_zh: n. 目录，清单 |

examples.en: You can browse our full product catalog online.
examples.zh: 你可以在线浏览我们完整的产品目录。

lemmas.def_zh: 编目人
lemmas.def_en: a librarian who classifies publication according to a categorial system

examples.en: The library cataloguer carefully entered the rare manuscript's details into the database.
examples.zh: 图书馆编目员仔细地将那份珍贵手稿的详细信息录入数据库。

lemmas.def_en: make a catalogue, compile a catalogue
lemmas.def_zh: v. 编入目录，记载

examples.en: You can browse our full product catalog online.
examples.zh: 你可以在线浏览我们完整的产品目录。

lemmas.def_en: make an itemized list or catalog of; classify
lemmas.def_zh: v. 编入目录，记载（主要为英式拼写）

examples.en: The library has catalogued thousands of rare manuscripts.
examples.zh: 该图书馆已将数千份珍贵手稿编目入库。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 kata-（完全地）+ logos（计算、账目），指将物品按次序完整列出的清单。

lemmas.def_en: extraordinarily large in size or extent or amount or power or degree; ; ; ; - Walter Lippman
lemmas.def_zh: adj. 巨大的，庞大的

examples.en: The project requires an enormous amount of time and money.
examples.zh: 这个项目需要耗费巨大的时间和资金。

lemmas.def_en: extremely
lemmas.def_zh: 非常地, 巨大地

examples.en: The new marketing strategy helped enormously in boosting the company's annual sales.
examples.zh: 新的营销策略对提升公司的年销售额起到了巨大的帮助。

lemmas.def_zh: 暴行, 极恶, 巨大
lemmas.def_en: the quality of being outrageous

examples.en: It took several days for the nation to grasp the enormity of tragedy.
examples.zh: 举国上下用了好几天时间才真正意识到这场悲剧的巨大破坏性。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 e-（出、超出）+ norm（常规、准则）+ -ous（形容词后缀），本义为“超出常规尺度的”，引申为巨大的。

lemmas.def_en: contrived by art rather than nature
lemmas.def_zh: adj. 人造的，人工的；虚假的

examples.en: The juice contains no artificial colors or flavors.
examples.zh: 该果汁不含任何人造色素或香精。

lemmas.def_en: not according to nature; not by natural means
lemmas.def_zh: 人工地, 人为地, 不自然地

examples.en: The government attempted to keep food prices artificially low during the harsh winter months.
examples.zh: 政府试图在严冬期间人为压低食品价格。

lemmas.def_en: the quality of being produced by people and not occurring naturally
lemmas.def_zh: 人工制造, 虚假性, 不自然

examples.en: She strongly disliked the artificiality of the polite conversation at the formal dinner party.
examples.zh: 她非常讨厌正式晚宴上客套对话的虚假与不自然。

family_guide.root_logic: 词根 art-（技巧、人工）+ fic-（做、制造）+ -ial，指由人力而非自然力量制成的。

lemmas.def_en: love intensely
lemmas.def_zh: v. 热爱，深爱；崇拜

examples.en: Parents usually adore their newborn babies.
examples.zh: 父母通常对他们的新生婴儿疼爱有加。

lemmas.def_en: lovable especially in a childlike or naive way
lemmas.def_zh: adj. 可爱的，讨人喜欢的

examples.en: What an adorable little puppy!
examples.zh: 多么可爱的一只小狗啊！

lemmas.def_en: extreme attractiveness
lemmas.def_zh: adorable的变形

examples.en: The sheer adorableness of the little golden retriever puppy melted everyone's heart instantly.
examples.zh: 这只金毛小奶狗十足的可爱瞬间融化了所有人的心。

lemmas.def_en: someone who admires a young woman
lemmas.def_zh: 爱慕者, 崇拜者

examples.en: The famous opera singer received hundreds of red roses from a secret adorer.
examples.zh: 这位著名的歌剧演唱家收到了一位神秘爱慕者送来的数百朵红玫瑰。

lemmas.def_en: extreme attractiveness
lemmas.def_zh: adorable的变形

examples.en: The internet fell in love with the sheer adorability of the rescued baby otter.
examples.zh: 互联网被这只获救小水獭令人无法抗拒的可爱彻底征服了。

lemmas.def_en: with adoration
lemmas.def_zh: 敬慕地；崇拜地

examples.en: The proud mother looked adoringly at her newborn baby sleeping peacefully in the crib.
examples.zh: 骄傲的母亲慈爱地注视着在婴儿床里安睡的新生儿。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 ad-（去、朝向）+ ore（口、祈祷），原指对神明低声祈求崇敬，后泛化为极度喜爱。

lemmas.def_en: make a search (for)
lemmas.def_zh: v. 寻求，探求（常与 for 连用）

examples.en: Philosophers have long quested for the meaning of life.
examples.zh: 哲学家们长期以来一直在探求生命的意义。

lemmas.def_en: someone making a search or inquiry
lemmas.def_zh: 探求者；追求者

examples.en: As a lifelong quester for spiritual truth, he traveled to remote mountain temples.
examples.zh: 作为精神真理的终生追求者，他远赴偏远的山间寺庙。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 quaerere（寻求、询问），表示带着明确目的的长途跋涉或探寻。

lemmas.def_en: someone who organizes a business venture and assumes the risk for it
lemmas.def_zh: n. 创业者，企业家

examples.en: As a successful entrepreneur, she has launched several tech startups.
examples.zh: 作为一名成功的创业家，她创办了数家科技初创公司。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to an entrepreneur
lemmas.def_zh: 创业的, 具有企业精神的; 企业性质的

examples.en: Her strong entrepreneurial spirit led her to launch three successful startups in five years.
examples.zh: 强烈的创业精神促使她在五年内创办了三家成功的初创公司。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自法语 entre-（在……之间）+ prendre（承担、拿取），原指中间承揽人，后专指承担商业风险的创业者。

lemmas.def_en: predict in advance
lemmas.def_zh: v. 预测，预报

examples.en: Meteorologists forecast heavy rain and strong winds for tomorrow.
examples.zh: 气象学家预测明天会有暴雨和大风。

lemmas.def_en: someone who makes predictions of the future (usually on the basis of special knowledge)
lemmas.def_zh: 预报员

examples.en: The weather forecaster warned residents that a severe blizzard would strike the region tonight.
examples.zh: 气象预报员警告居民，一场严重的暴风雪将于今晚袭击该地区。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 fore-（预先）+ cast（投掷、计算），核心逻辑为“预先估算”。

lemmas.def_en: great merriment
lemmas.def_zh: n. 狂喜，欢闹，引人发笑的事

examples.en: His ridiculous costume caused much hilarity at the party.
examples.zh: 他那滑稽的装扮在派对上引来一阵哄堂大笑。

lemmas.def_en: marked by or causing boisterous merriment or convulsive laughter
lemmas.def_zh: adj. 极其滑稽的，令人捧腹的

examples.en: She told a hilarious story that had everyone in stitches.
examples.zh: 她讲了一个令人捧腹的故事，把大家逗得前仰后合。

lemmas.def_en: in a hilarious manner
lemmas.def_zh: 引人发笑地；滑稽地；喜不自禁地

examples.en: The low-budget comedy was hilariously funny and kept the entire audience laughing out loud.
examples.zh: 这部低成本喜剧滑稽得令人捧腹，引得全场观众开怀大笑。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 hilaros（欢快的），核心逻辑表示“极度欢乐、狂欢”。
family_guide.core_distinction: hilarious 为形容词（滑稽的、极开心的），hilarity 为不可数名词（狂喜、欢闹）。

lemmas.def_en: unusual or striking
lemmas.def_zh: adj. 非凡的，显著的，引人注目的

examples.en: She has made remarkable progress in her piano playing this year.
examples.zh: 今年她在钢琴演奏方面取得了显著的进步。

lemmas.def_en: found in the ordinary course of events; ; ; - Anita Diamant
lemmas.def_zh: 不显著的, 平凡的, 不值得注意的

examples.en: From the outside, the office was housed in a completely unremarkable grey concrete building.
examples.zh: 从外面看，这家办公室坐落在一座平平无奇的灰色混凝土建筑中。

family_guide.root_logic: re-（强调）+ mark（做标记、注意）+ -able（可…的），核心语义为“值得注意的、显著的”。

lemmas.def_en: inhabit or live in; be an inhabitant of
lemmas.def_zh: v. 居住于，栖息于

examples.en: Many rare bird species inhabit this remote tropical forest.
examples.zh: 许多稀有鸟类栖息在这片偏远的热带森林中。

lemmas.def_en: a person who inhabits a particular place
lemmas.def_zh: 居民, 居住者

examples.en: Every inhabitant of the small fishing village knows each other very well.
examples.zh: 这个小渔村的每一位居民彼此都非常熟悉。

lemmas.def_en: the act of dwelling in or living permanently in a place (said of both animals and men)
lemmas.def_zh: 居住, 栖居

examples.en: The damp and crumbling ruins showed no obvious signs of recent human inhabitation.
examples.zh: 潮湿残破的废墟上没有近期人类居住的明显痕迹。

lemmas.def_en: not having inhabitants; not lived in
lemmas.def_zh: 无人居住的, 杳无人迹的

examples.en: The explorers set foot on an uninhabited tropical island far off the standard shipping routes.
examples.zh: 探险家们踏上了一座远离常规航线的无人热带岛屿。

family_guide.root_logic: in-（入、内）+ habit（居住，源于拉丁语 habere 拥有、保持），核心表示“在某地居住”。

lemmas.def_en: the yield from plants in a single growing season
lemmas.def_zh: 收获, 成果, 收获物, 收获期

examples.en: Farmers celebrated a bountiful wheat harvest after months of ideal weather conditions.
examples.zh: 在经历了数月理想的天气后，农民们庆祝小麦的大丰收。

lemmas.def_en: someone who helps to gather the harvest
lemmas.def_zh: 收获者, 收割机

examples.en: The modern mechanical harvester quickly cut and gathered the entire field of corn.
examples.zh: 现代化的联合收割机迅速切割并收拢了整片田地的玉米。

lemmas.def_en: gather, as of natural products
lemmas.def_zh: 收割, 收获

examples.en: Farmers celebrated a bountiful wheat harvest after months of ideal weather conditions.
examples.zh: 在经历了数月理想的天气后，农民们庆祝小麦的大丰收。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 hærfest，原指“秋天”，后特指“秋收的果实”及“收割动作”。
family_guide.core_distinction: 名词指收获期或产物，动词指收割农作物或采收资源。

lemmas.def_en: endowed with talent or talents
lemmas.def_zh: adj. 有天赋的，有才干的

examples.en: He is a talented musician who can play four instruments fluently.
examples.zh: 他是一位才华横溢的音乐家，能流利演奏四种乐器。

lemmas.def_en: devoid of talent; not gifted
lemmas.def_zh: 缺乏才能的, 没有才干的；没有天赋的；不聪明的

examples.en: Hard work can easily beat an untalented person who refuses to practice diligently.
examples.zh: 努力工作可以轻松击败拒绝勤奋练习的平庸之人。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自 talent（本指古希腊货币单位，引申为“天赋”）+ -ed（具有…的），即“有天赋的”。

lemmas.def_en: two (or more) slices of bread with a filling between them
lemmas.def_zh: 三明治, 夹心面包, 夹层板

examples.en: I had to sandwich a quick meeting between two very long business seminars.
examples.zh: 我不得不将一次简短的会议夹在两个冗长的商务研讨会之间。

lemmas.def_en: make into a sandwich
lemmas.def_zh: 插入, 夹入, 把...制成三明治

examples.en: I had to sandwich a quick meeting between two very long business seminars.
examples.zh: 我不得不将一次简短的会议夹在两个冗长的商务研讨会之间。

family_guide.root_logic: 源于第四代三明治伯爵约翰·蒙塔古（因赌博时图方便而发明该吃法），引申为“夹在中间”。
family_guide.core_distinction: 名词指三明治，动词引申指被夹在两者之间。

lemmas.def_en: someone who creates plans to be used in making something (such as buildings)
lemmas.def_zh: n. 建筑师，设计师；缔造者

examples.en: The famous architect designed several iconic skyscrapers in the city.
examples.zh: 这位著名的建筑师设计了该市数座标志性的摩天大楼。

family_guide.root_logic: archi-（首席的、主管的）+ tect（建造者），原意为“主工匠、总建造师”。

lemmas.def_en: United States evangelical preacher famous as a mass evangelist (born in 1918)
lemmas.def_zh: n. 全麦粗面粉（常作定语，如全麦脆饼）

examples.en: The crust of the cheesecake is made from crushed graham crackers.
examples.zh: 这款芝士蛋糕的饼底是由碎全麦饼干制成的。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自倡导全麦健康饮食的美国牧师西尔维斯特·格雷厄姆（Sylvester Graham），现多指全麦粗磨面粉。

lemmas.def_en: relating to or based on experiment
lemmas.def_zh: adj. 实验性的，试验性的

examples.en: The patient was treated with an experimental drug that showed great promise.
examples.zh: 该患者接受了一种前景非常好的实验性药物治疗。

lemmas.def_en: in an experimental fashion
lemmas.def_zh: 实验式地, 在实验上

examples.en: The new cancer therapy was proven effective experimentally before clinical trials began.
examples.zh: 这种新的癌症疗法在临床试验开始前已在实验上被证实有效。

family_guide.root_logic: experiment（实验）+ -al（形容词后缀），表示“实验性的、根据实验的”。

lemmas.def_en: a very fine-grained soil that is plastic when moist but hard when fired
lemmas.def_zh: n. 黏土，陶土

examples.en: Potters shape wet clay on a wheel into various ceramic vessels.
examples.zh: 陶工在陶轮上将湿黏土塑造成各种陶瓷器皿。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 clǣg，表示黏稠、可塑性强的天然泥土。

lemmas.def_en: an ordered array of the components of an emission or wave
lemmas.def_zh: n. 光谱，范围，系列

examples.en: Her political opinions cover a broad spectrum from liberal to conservative.
examples.zh: 她的政治观点涵盖了从自由派到保守派的广泛范围。

lemmas.def_zh: 光谱的, 鬼怪的, 幻觉的
lemmas.def_en: of or relating to a spectrum

examples.en: A strange spectral light hovered over the abandoned churchyard at midnight.
examples.zh: 午夜时分，一道奇怪的幽灵般微光盘旋在废弃的墓地上空。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 specere（看），原指“幻影、景象”，现代科学中引申指分光展开的“连续序列/范围”。

lemmas.def_en: the state of being certain
lemmas.def_zh: n. 必然的事，确定性

examples.en: There is no certainty that the stock market will rebound soon.
examples.zh: 股市是否会很快反弹尚无定论。

lemmas.def_en: being unsettled or in doubt or dependent on chance
lemmas.def_zh: n. 不确定性，不可靠的事物

examples.en: Economic uncertainty has caused many consumers to reduce their spending.
examples.zh: 经济的不确定性导致许多消费者减少了支出。

family_guide.root_logic: cert-（确定的）+ -ty（名词后缀，表状态），un- 表示否定。
family_guide.core_distinction: certainty 表示肯定或确定的事，uncertainty 强调不可预测或犹豫不决的状态。

lemmas.def_en: study of the earth's surface; includes people's responses to topography and climate and soil and vegetation
lemmas.def_zh: n. 地理学，地形，地貌

examples.en: Students learn about rivers, mountains, and climate zones in geography class.
examples.zh: 学生们在地理课上学习河流、山脉和气候区知识。

lemmas.def_en: an expert on geography
lemmas.def_zh: 地理学者

examples.en: The geographer spent several years mapping the remote valleys of the mountain range.
examples.zh: 这位地理学者花了几年的时间绘制该山脉偏远山谷的地图。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to the science of geography
lemmas.def_zh: adj. 地理学的，地理的

examples.en: The island's geographical isolation preserved many unique species.
examples.zh: 该岛屿在地理上的隔绝使得许多独特物种得以存活。

lemmas.def_en: with respect to geography
lemmas.def_zh: [计] 自通地

examples.en: The isolated island is geographically distant from any other major landmass on Earth.
examples.zh: 该孤岛在地理位置上远离地球上的任何其他主要陆地。

family_guide.root_logic: geo-（地球、土地）+ -graphy（写、记录），核心逻辑是“描摹地球特征”。
family_guide.core_distinction: geography 是名词学科或地形，geographical 是其形容词形式。

lemmas.def_en: a kind of literary or artistic work
lemmas.def_zh: n. （文学、艺术、电影等的）体裁，类型

examples.en: Science fiction has always been my favorite literary genre.
examples.zh: 科幻小说一直是我最喜欢的文学体裁。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自法语 genre，追溯至拉丁语 genus（种类、家族），特指艺术和文学的门类。

lemmas.def_en: cut into pieces
lemmas.def_zh: v. 砍，劈，剁碎

examples.en: Chop the onions finely before adding them to the pan.
examples.zh: 下锅前先把洋葱剁碎。

lemmas.def_en: a grounder that bounces high in the air
lemmas.def_zh: 切物之人, 斧头, 切肉大刀

examples.en: He grabbed a heavy kitchen chopper to cut the frozen meat into small cubes.
examples.zh: 他拿起一把沉重的厨房砍刀，把冻肉剁成了小块。

lemmas.def_en: used of the sea during inclement or stormy weather
lemmas.def_zh: 波浪翻滚

examples.en: The sudden choppiness of the ocean waters made several passengers feel sea sick.
examples.zh: 海面上突然掀起的波浪让几名乘客感到晕船。

lemmas.def_en: marked by abrupt transitions
lemmas.def_zh: 猛地一动一停的, 突变的

examples.en: The ferry ride was rough due to the choppy waters in the harbor.
examples.zh: 由于港口波浪起伏，渡轮的行驶过程十分颠簸。

family_guide.root_logic: 拟声词源，核心意象为'用刀或重物猛力劈砍、切碎'。

lemmas.def_en: in part; in some degree; not wholly
lemmas.def_zh: adv. 部分地，在一定程度上

examples.en: The accident was partly due to the bad weather.
examples.zh: 这次事故部分是由于恶劣天气造成的。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自 part（部分），-ly 为副词后缀，表示'部分地，在一定程度上'。

lemmas.def_en: destruction of heart tissue resulting from obstruction of the blood supply to the heart muscle
lemmas.def_zh: n. 英里（mile的缩写）；唱名咪（音阶第三音）

examples.en: The speed limit on this highway is 65 mi/h.
examples.zh: 这条高速公路的限速是每小时65英里。

family_guide.root_logic: 作为缩写可代表英里（mile）或音阶中的第三音符（sol-fa系统）。

lemmas.def_en: accumulated knowledge or erudition or enlightenment
lemmas.def_zh: n. 智慧，明智，才智

examples.en: With age comes wisdom and experience.
examples.zh: 年龄带来智慧与经验。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自 wise（明智的）+ -dom（表状态、性质的名词后缀），核心为'洞察世事的智慧'。

lemmas.def_en: major items of military weaponry (as tanks or missile)
lemmas.def_zh: n. 五金器具；计算机硬件

examples.en: The company invested heavily in upgrading its computer hardware.
examples.zh: 该公司投入巨资升级计算机硬件。

family_guide.root_logic: hard（硬的）+ ware（器皿、物品），原指五金器具，后引申为计算机硬件。

lemmas.def_en: a place of business for retailing goods
lemmas.def_zh: n. 出口，发泄途径；专卖店；电源插座

examples.en: Sports give him a healthy outlet for his stress.
examples.zh: 体育运动为他提供了释放压力的健康途径。

family_guide.root_logic: out（向外）+ let（放出），核心意象为'向外排泄或发泄的出口'，引申指专卖店或电源插座。

lemmas.def_en: of extreme importance; vital to the resolution of a crisis
lemmas.def_zh: adj. 决定性的，至关重要的

examples.en: Effective communication is crucial to the success of the project.
examples.zh: 有效的沟通对项目的成功至关重要。

lemmas.def_en: to a crucial degree
lemmas.def_zh: 至关重要地, 关键地

examples.en: The rescue team arrived crucially just minutes before the rising flood waters struck.
examples.zh: 救援队在不断上涨的洪水袭来几分钟前关键性地赶到了。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 crux（十字架），原指面临十字路口的艰难抉择，引申为'决定性的，关键的'。

lemmas.def_en: appear like; be similar or bear a likeness to
lemmas.def_zh: v. 像，与……相似

examples.en: The twins resemble each other very closely.
examples.zh: 这对双胞胎长得极其相似。

lemmas.def_en: similarity in appearance or external or superficial details
lemmas.def_zh: n. 相似，相像之处

examples.en: There is a striking resemblance between the father and son.
examples.zh: 这对父子之间有着惊人的相似之处。

family_guide.root_logic: re-（强化或重复）+ semble（象，类似，源自拉丁语 similis），指在外貌或特征上相似。
family_guide.core_distinction: resemble 为动词；resemblance 为其名词形式，强调相似之处或相似程度。

lemmas.def_en: the repetition of a sound resulting from reflection of the sound waves
lemmas.def_zh: n. 回声；回音

examples.en: His words echoed through the empty hall.
examples.zh: 他的声音在空旷的大厅里回荡。

lemmas.def_en: to say again or imitate
lemmas.def_zh: v. 发出回声；附和，重复

examples.en: His words echoed through the empty hall.
examples.zh: 他的声音在空旷的大厅里回荡。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊神话仙女 Echo（回声女神），核心意象为'声音反射所产生的一模一样的回响'。
family_guide.core_distinction: echo 兼具名词（回声、共鸣）与动词（发出回声、附和）用法。

lemmas.def_en: lose blood from one's body
lemmas.def_zh: v. 出血，流血；榨取（钱财）

examples.en: Press firmly on the wound to stop it from bleeding.
examples.zh: 用力按住伤口以防流血。

lemmas.def_zh: 易出血的人, 血友病患者
lemmas.def_en: someone who has hemophilia and is subject to uncontrollable bleeding

examples.en: Because the patient was a known bleeder, the surgeon proceeded with extreme caution.
examples.zh: 由于该患者是已知的血友病患者，外科医生手术时格外小心。

family_guide.root_logic: 与 blood（血液）同源，指'液体（尤其是血液）渗出或流出'。

lemmas.def_en: combine into one
lemmas.def_zh: v. 融合；混合

examples.en: The tea is a delicate blend of jasmine and green tea.
examples.zh: 这种茶是茉莉花与绿茶的精致配搭。

lemmas.def_en: an occurrence of thorough mixing
lemmas.def_zh: n. 混合物，混合色；融合

examples.en: The tea is a delicate blend of jasmine and green tea.
examples.zh: 这种茶是茉莉花与绿茶的精致配搭。

lemmas.def_en: an electrically powered mixer with whirling blades that mix or chop or liquefy foods
lemmas.def_zh: 混合者, 混合器, 搅拌器

examples.en: She tossed fresh berries and yogurt into the blender to make a smoothie.
examples.zh: 她把新鲜浆果和酸奶扔进搅拌机里制作冰沙。

lemmas.def_en: not blended or mixed together
lemmas.def_zh: 未掺合[混合]的

examples.en: He prefers drinking pure, unblended malt whiskey because of its distinct original flavor.
examples.zh: 他更喜欢喝纯净的未调和麦芽威士忌，因为其原始风味独特。

family_guide.root_logic: 古英语词源，意为'搅拌、混合在一起使之界限模糊'，强调不同成分融为一体。
family_guide.core_distinction: blend 作动词强调混合的动作或相衬；作名词强调混合而成的产物或风味。

lemmas.def_en: a physician who specializes in surgery
lemmas.def_zh: n. 外科医生

examples.en: The surgeon successfully performed the complex heart operation.
examples.zh: 这位外科医生成功实施了那台复杂的心脏手术。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 kheirourgos（kheir 手 + ergon 工作），本义为'动手的工匠'，现代专指外科医生。

lemmas.def_en: (nontechnical usage) a tiny piece of anything
lemmas.def_zh: n. 微粒，极小量；粒子；助词

examples.en: Dust particles floated in the shaft of sunlight.
examples.zh: 尘埃微粒在一束阳光中漂浮。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 particula，由 part（部分）+ -icle（小词缀）构成，指'极其微小的碎片或颗粒'。

lemmas.def_en: moving slowly and gently
lemmas.def_zh: adj. 懒惰的，懒散的

examples.en: He spent a lazy afternoon reading on the porch.
examples.zh: 他在门廊上看书，度过了一个慵懒的下午。

lemmas.def_en: inactivity resulting from a dislike of work
lemmas.def_zh: 怠惰, 无精打采
